import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { createRedisAlertBridge, type AlertBridgeEnqueue } from './alert-bridge.js';
import { deliverQueuedAlert } from './alert-delivery.js';

const CHANNEL = 'swat:alert:queue';

function createDeliveryHarness() {
  const sentMessages: string[] = [];
  const deliverSignal = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ sent: true });
  const enqueue = vi.fn<AlertBridgeEnqueue>(async (_name, payload) => {
    await deliverQueuedAlert(payload, {
      deliverSignal,
      sendOperational: async (message) => {
        sentMessages.push(message);
      }
    });
  });
  const logRejected = vi.fn();
  const bridge = createRedisAlertBridge({
    channel: CHANNEL,
    enqueue,
    logRejected
  });
  return { bridge, deliverSignal, enqueue, logRejected, sentMessages };
}

describe('Redis alert bridge', () => {
  it('accepts, queues, formats, and delivers a nightly expectancy alert', async () => {
    const harness = createDeliveryHarness();
    const raw = JSON.stringify({
      type: 'NIGHTLY_EXPECTANCY',
      title: 'Nightly Expectancy Report',
      message: 'snipe | proven | solana | live\nCount: 12 | HR: 58.3% | Exp: $2.41'
    });

    const result = await harness.bridge.handleMessage(CHANNEL, raw);

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ accepted: true, kind: 'expectancy' });
    expect(harness.enqueue).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(harness.enqueue.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe('expectancy-alert');
    expect(harness.enqueue.mock.calls[0][1]).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'expectancy',
      eventType: 'NIGHTLY_EXPECTANCY'
    });
    expect(harness.enqueue.mock.calls[0][2]).toMatchObject({
      attempts: 4,
      deduplication: { ttl: 300_000 },
      removeOnComplete: true
    });
    expect(harness.sentMessages).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(harness.sentMessages[0]).toContain('<b>SWAT NIGHTLY EXPECTANCY</b>');
    expect(harness.sentMessages[0]).toContain('Count: 12 | HR: 58.3% | Exp: $2.41');
    expect(harness.deliverSignal).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('accepts a system alert and includes escaped operational context', async () => {
    const harness = createDeliveryHarness();
    const raw = JSON.stringify({
      type: 'ROBINHOOD_LIVE_NOT_READY',
      title: 'Robinhood <live> execution is not ready',
      message: 'Configured router & quoter do not match.',
      severity: 'critical',
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      requestedMode: 'live+shadow',
      checkedAt: '2026-07-26T10:00:00.000Z'
    });

    const result = await harness.bridge.handleMessage(CHANNEL, raw);

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ accepted: true, kind: 'system' });
    expect(harness.enqueue.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe('system-alert');
    expect(harness.sentMessages[0]).toContain('SWAT CRITICAL SYSTEM ALERT');
    expect(harness.sentMessages[0]).toContain('Robinhood &lt;live&gt; execution is not ready');
    expect(harness.sentMessages[0]).toContain('<b>Chain:</b> robinhood-chain');
    expect(harness.sentMessages[0]).toContain('Configured router &amp; quoter do not match.');
  });

  it('keeps escaped operational messages within Telegram limits', async () => {
    const harness = createDeliveryHarness();
    const raw = JSON.stringify({
      type: 'SYSTEM_CAP_EXCEEDED',
      title: '&'.repeat(200),
      message: '<'.repeat(12_000),
      severity: 'high',
      chain: '&'.repeat(64),
      requestedMode: 'live+shadow'
    });

    await harness.bridge.handleMessage(CHANNEL, raw);

    expect(harness.sentMessages[0].length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4_096);
    expect(harness.sentMessages[0]).not.toMatch(/&(?!amp;|lt;|gt;|quot;)/);
  });

  it('uses a stable deduplication ID for duplicate publications', async () => {
    const harness = createDeliveryHarness();
    const raw = JSON.stringify({
      type: 'SYSTEM_CAP_EXCEEDED',
      title: '24h Exposure Cap Exceeded: solana',
      message: 'A trade was blocked.',
      severity: 'high'
    });

    const first = await harness.bridge.handleMessage(CHANNEL, raw);
    const second = await harness.bridge.handleMessage(CHANNEL, raw);

    expect(first).toMatchObject({ accepted: true });
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ accepted: true });
    if (!first.accepted || !second.accepted) throw new Error('expected accepted alerts');
    expect(first.deduplicationId).toBe(second.deduplicationId);
    expect(harness.enqueue.mock.calls[0][2].deduplication?.id)
      .toBe(harness.enqueue.mock.calls[1][2].deduplication?.id);
  });

  it.each([
    ['invalid JSON', '{not-json'],
    ['missing message', JSON.stringify({ type: 'SYSTEM_CAP_EXCEEDED', title: 'Cap', severity: 'high' })],
    ['invalid severity', JSON.stringify({
      type: 'SYSTEM_CAP_EXCEEDED',
      title: 'Cap',
      message: 'Blocked',
      severity: 'urgent'
    })]
  ])('rejects %s without enqueueing or throwing', async (_label, raw) => {
    const harness = createDeliveryHarness();

    await expect(harness.bridge.handleMessage(CHANNEL, raw)).resolves.toEqual({
      accepted: false,
      reason: 'invalid_payload'
    });
    expect(harness.enqueue).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(harness.sentMessages).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(harness.logRejected).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});

describe('queued alert delivery', () => {
  it('preserves legacy signal-job routing', async () => {
    const deliverSignal = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ sent: true });
    const sendOperational = vi.fn();

    await deliverQueuedAlert({
      signalId: 'signal-123',
      pattern: 'snipe',
      tokenMint: 'mint-123',
      score: 91,
      isSafe: true
    }, { deliverSignal, sendOperational });

    expect(deliverSignal).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({

      signalId: 'signal-123',
      pattern: 'snipe'
    }));
    expect(sendOperational).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects malformed queued payloads before delivery', async () => {
    const deliverSignal = vi.fn();
    const sendOperational = vi.fn();

    await expect(deliverQueuedAlert({
      kind: 'system',
      eventType: 'NIGHTLY_EXPECTANCY',
      title: 'Wrong discriminant',
      message: 'This must not be sent.'
    }, { deliverSignal, sendOperational })).rejects.toThrow('alert kind does not match');
    expect(deliverSignal).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(sendOperational).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('propagates operational delivery failures for BullMQ retry handling', async () => {
    const deliveryError = new Error('Telegram unavailable');

    await expect(deliverQueuedAlert({
      kind: 'system',
      eventType: 'SYSTEM_CAP_EXCEEDED',
      title: 'Exposure cap exceeded',
      message: 'Trade blocked.',
      severity: 'high'
    }, {
      deliverSignal: vi.fn(),
      sendOperational: vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(deliveryError)
    })).rejects.toThrow('Telegram unavailable');
  });
});

==> apps/alert-service/src/alert-bridge.ts <==
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import type { JobsOptions } from 'bullmq';
import {
  AlertPayloadValidationError,
  parsePublishedAlertMessage,
  type OperationalAlertPayload
} from './alert-payload.js';

const DEDUPLICATION_TTL_MS = 5 * 60_000;

export type AlertBridgeEnqueue = (
  name: 'system-alert' | 'expectancy-alert',
  payload: OperationalAlertPayload,
  options: JobsOptions
) => Promise<unknown>;

export type RedisAlertBridgeDependencies = {
  channel: string;
  enqueue: AlertBridgeEnqueue;
  logRejected?: (message: string, error?: unknown) => void;
};

export type AlertBridgeResult =
  | { accepted: true; kind: OperationalAlertPayload['kind']; deduplicationId: string }
  | { accepted: false; reason: 'unexpected_channel' | 'invalid_payload' };

function deduplicationId(payload: OperationalAlertPayload): string {
  return createHash('sha256')
    .update(JSON.stringify(payload))
    .digest('hex');
}

/** One-way bridge from Redis Pub/Sub into the durable BullMQ alert queue. */
export function createRedisAlertBridge(dependencies: RedisAlertBridgeDependencies) {
  return {
    async handleMessage(channel: string, message: string): Promise<AlertBridgeResult> {
      if (channel !== dependencies.channel) {
        return { accepted: false, reason: 'unexpected_channel' };
      }

      let payload: OperationalAlertPayload;
      try {
        payload = parsePublishedAlertMessage(message);
      } catch (error) {
        const reason = error instanceof AlertPayloadValidationError
          ? error.message
          : 'unexpected alert validation failure';
        dependencies.logRejected?.(`[alert-service] rejected published alert: ${reason}`, error);
        return { accepted: false, reason: 'invalid_payload' };
      }

      const id = deduplicationId(payload);
      await dependencies.enqueue(
        payload.kind === 'expectancy' ? 'expectancy-alert' : 'system-alert',
        payload,
        {
          attempts: 4,
          backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 2_000 },
          deduplication: { id, ttl: DEDUPLICATION_TTL_MS },
          removeOnComplete: true,
          removeOnFail: 1_000
        }
      );

      return { accepted: true, kind: payload.kind, deduplicationId: id };
    }
  };
}

==> apps/alert-service/src/alert-delivery.ts <==
import {
  formatOperationalAlert,
  parseQueuedAlertPayload,
  type SignalAlertPayload
} from './alert-payload.js';

export type AlertDeliveryDependencies = {
  deliverSignal: (payload: SignalAlertPayload) => Promise<unknown>;
  sendOperational: (message: string) => Promise<void>;
};

export async function deliverQueuedAlert(
  value: unknown,
  dependencies: AlertDeliveryDependencies
): Promise<unknown> {
  const payload = parseQueuedAlertPayload(value);
  if (payload.kind === 'signal') {
    return dependencies.deliverSignal(payload);
  }

  const message = formatOperationalAlert(payload);
  await dependencies.sendOperational(message);
  return { sent: true, kind: payload.kind };
}

==> apps/alert-service/src/alert-payload.ts <==
export type AlertSeverity = 'info' | 'warning' | 'high' | 'critical';

export type SignalAlertPayload = {
  kind: 'signal';
  signalId: string;
  pattern: string;
  tokenMint?: string;
  clusterId?: string;
  confidence?: number;
  score?: number;
  isSafe?: boolean;
  warnings?: string[];
  liquidity?: number | null;
  top10HolderPct?: number | null;
  buyerCount?: number;
  buyVolume?: number;
  exitVolume?: number;
  sellerCount?: number;
  clusterSize?: number;
  sellerPct?: number;
  soldToken?: string;
  boughtToken?: string;
  window?: string;
};

export type SystemAlertPayload = {
  kind: 'system';
  eventType: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  severity: AlertSeverity;
  chain?: string;
  requestedMode?: string;
  checkedAt?: string;
};

export type ExpectancyAlertPayload = {
  kind: 'expectancy';
  eventType: 'NIGHTLY_EXPECTANCY';
  title: string;
  message: string;
};

export type OperationalAlertPayload = SystemAlertPayload | ExpectancyAlertPayload;
export type AlertPayload = SignalAlertPayload | OperationalAlertPayload;

export class AlertPayloadValidationError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'AlertPayloadValidationError';
  }
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function requiredString(
  value: Record<string, unknown>,
  field: string,
  maxLength: number
): string {
  const candidate = value[field];
  if (typeof candidate !== 'string' || candidate.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError(`${field} must be a non-empty string`);
  }
  if (candidate.length > maxLength) {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError(`${field} exceeds ${maxLength} characters`);
  }
  return candidate.trim();
}

function optionalString(
  value: Record<string, unknown>,
  field: string,
  maxLength: number
): string | undefined {
  if (value[field] === undefined) return undefined;
  return requiredString(value, field, maxLength);
}

function optionalFiniteNumber(
  value: Record<string, unknown>,
  field: string,
  nullable = false
): number | null | undefined {
  const candidate = value[field];
  if (candidate === undefined) return undefined;
  if (candidate === null && nullable) return null;
  if (typeof candidate !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(candidate)) {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError(`${field} must be a finite number${nullable ? ' or null' : ''}`);
  }
  return candidate;
}

function parseSignalAlert(value: Record<string, unknown>): SignalAlertPayload {
  const payload: SignalAlertPayload = {
    kind: 'signal',
    signalId: requiredString(value, 'signalId', 128),
    pattern: requiredString(value, 'pattern', 64)
  };

  const stringFields = [
    'tokenMint',
    'clusterId',
    'soldToken',
    'boughtToken',
    'window'
  ] as const;
  for (const field of stringFields) {
    const candidate = optionalString(value, field, 512);
    if (candidate !== undefined) payload[field] = candidate;
  }

  const numberFields = [
    'confidence',
    'score',
    'buyerCount',
    'buyVolume',
    'exitVolume',
    'sellerCount',
    'clusterSize',
    'sellerPct'
  ] as const;
  for (const field of numberFields) {
    const candidate = optionalFiniteNumber(value, field);
    if (candidate !== undefined && candidate !== null) payload[field] = candidate;
  }

  const liquidity = optionalFiniteNumber(value, 'liquidity', true);
  if (liquidity !== undefined) payload.liquidity = liquidity;
  const top10HolderPct = optionalFiniteNumber(value, 'top10HolderPct', true);
  if (top10HolderPct !== undefined) payload.top10HolderPct = top10HolderPct;

  if (value.isSafe !== undefined) {
    if (typeof value.isSafe !== 'boolean') {
      throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('isSafe must be a boolean');
    }
    payload.isSafe = value.isSafe;
  }

  if (value.warnings !== undefined) {
    if (
      !Array.isArray(value.warnings) ||
      value.warnings.length > 50 ||
      value.warnings.some((warning) => typeof warning !== 'string' || warning.length > 500)
    ) {
      throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('warnings must be an array of at most 50 strings');
    }
    payload.warnings = [...value.warnings];
  }

  return payload;
}

const SEVERITIES = new Set<AlertSeverity>(['info', 'warning', 'high', 'critical']);
const EVENT_TYPE_PATTERN = /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,79}$/;

function parseOperationalAlert(
  value: Record<string, unknown>,
  eventTypeField: 'type' | 'eventType'
): OperationalAlertPayload {
  const eventType = requiredString(value, eventTypeField, 80);
  if (!EVENT_TYPE_PATTERN.test(eventType)) {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError(`${eventTypeField} must be an uppercase event identifier`);
  }

  const title = requiredString(value, 'title', 200);
  const message = requiredString(value, 'message', 12_000);
  if (eventType === 'NIGHTLY_EXPECTANCY') {
    return { kind: 'expectancy', eventType, title, message };
  }

  const severityValue = requiredString(value, 'severity', 16);
  if (!SEVERITIES.has(severityValue as AlertSeverity)) {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('severity must be info, warning, high, or critical');
  }

  const checkedAt = optionalString(value, 'checkedAt', 64);
  if (checkedAt !== undefined && !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(checkedAt))) {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('checkedAt must be a valid timestamp');
  }

  return {
    kind: 'system',
    eventType,
    title,
    message,
    severity: severityValue as AlertSeverity,
    chain: optionalString(value, 'chain', 64),
    requestedMode: optionalString(value, 'requestedMode', 64),
    checkedAt
  };
}

export function parsePublishedAlertMessage(message: string): OperationalAlertPayload {
  let value: unknown;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(message);
  } catch {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('published alert is not valid JSON');
  }
  if (!isRecord(value)) {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('published alert must be a JSON object');
  }
  return parseOperationalAlert(value, 'type');
}

export function parseQueuedAlertPayload(value: unknown): AlertPayload {
  if (!isRecord(value)) {
    throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('queued alert must be an object');
  }

  if (value.kind === 'signal' || (value.kind === undefined && value.signalId !== undefined)) {
    return parseSignalAlert(value);
  }
  if (value.kind === 'system' || value.kind === 'expectancy') {
    const parsed = parseOperationalAlert(value, 'eventType');
    if (value.kind !== parsed.kind) {
      throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('alert kind does not match its event type');
    }
    return parsed;
  }

  throw new AlertPayloadValidationError('queued alert has an unsupported kind');
}

export function escapeTelegramHtml(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

function escapeTelegramHtmlWithin(value: string, maxLength: number): string {
  let escaped = '';
  for (const character of value) {
    const encoded = escapeTelegramHtml(character);
    if (escaped.length + encoded.length > maxLength - 3) return `${escaped}...`;
    escaped += encoded;
  }
  return escaped;
}

export function formatOperationalAlert(payload: OperationalAlertPayload): string {
  if (payload.kind === 'expectancy') {
    return [
      '<b>SWAT NIGHTLY EXPECTANCY</b>',
      `<b>${escapeTelegramHtmlWithin(payload.title, 400)}</b>`,
      '',
      escapeTelegramHtmlWithin(payload.message, 3_200)
    ].join('\n');
  }

  const context = (value: string) => escapeTelegramHtmlWithin(value, 192);
  const lines = [
    `<b>SWAT ${payload.severity.toUpperCase()} SYSTEM ALERT</b>`,
    `<b>${escapeTelegramHtmlWithin(payload.title, 400)}</b>`,
    `<b>Event:</b> <code>${escapeTelegramHtml(payload.eventType)}</code>`,
    `<b>Severity:</b> ${payload.severity.toUpperCase()}`
  ];
  if (payload.chain) lines.push(`<b>Chain:</b> ${context(payload.chain)}`);
  if (payload.requestedMode) {
    lines.push(`<b>Requested mode:</b> ${context(payload.requestedMode)}`);
  }
  if (payload.checkedAt) lines.push(`<b>Checked at:</b> ${context(payload.checkedAt)}`);
  lines.push('', escapeTelegramHtmlWithin(payload.message, 2_400));
  return lines.join('\n');
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Telegram ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

async function sendTelegram(message: string, maxRetries = 3) {
  if (!telegramToken || !telegramChatId) {
    throw new Error('Telegram is not configured for alert delivery');
  }

  // Enforce Telegram message limit (4096 characters)
  const text = message.length > 4096 ? message.slice(0, 4093) + '...' : message;

  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    const response = await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${telegramToken}/sendMessage`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        chat_id: telegramChatId,
        text,
        parse_mode: 'HTML'
      })
    });

    if (response.ok) return;

    if (response.status === 429) {
      const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const retryAfter = data?.parameters?.retry_after ?? 5;
      console.warn(`[alert-service] Telegram rate limited. Retrying after ${retryAfter}s...`);
      if (attempt === maxRetries) {
        throw new Error('Telegram rate limit exceeded after max retries');
      }
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, retryAfter * 1000));
      continue;
    }

    throw new Error(`Telegram error: ${response.status}`);
  }
}

async function sendIngestionHealthTelegram(message: string) {
  if (!telegramToken || !telegramChatId) {
    throw new Error('Telegram is not configured for ingestion-health alerts');
  }
  await sendTelegram(message);
}

async function sendOperationalTelegram(message: string) {
  if (!telegramToken || !telegramChatId) {
    throw new Error('Telegram is not configured for system and expectancy alerts');
  }
  await sendTelegram(message);
}

const ingestionHealthPollMs = clampInteger(
  process.env.INGESTION_HEALTH_POLL_MS,
  60_000,
  10_000,
  15 * 60_000
);
let ingestionHealthCheckRunning = false;

async function pollIngestionHealth() {
  if (ingestionHealthCheckRunning) return;
  ingestionHealthCheckRunning = true;
  try {
    await checkIngestionHealth({
      loadHealth: getIngestionHealth24h,
      reserve: reserveIngestionHealthAlert,
      complete: completeIngestionHealthAlert,
      release: releaseIngestionHealthAlert,
      send: sendIngestionHealthTelegram,
      logError: (message, error) => console.error(message, error)
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[alert-service] ingestion health poll failed', error);
  } finally {
    ingestionHealthCheckRunning = false;
  }
}

void pollIngestionHealth();
const ingestionHealthTimer = setInterval(
  () => void pollIngestionHealth(),
  ingestionHealthPollMs
);
ingestionHealthTimer.unref();

async function pollPusdLiquidity() {

  pusdLiquidityCheckRunning = true;
  try {
    await checkPusdLiquidity({
      loadInputs: async () => ({
        depth: { nativeUsdcAvailable: null },
        aggregateFloatUsd: null,
        collateralPaused: null,
        simulatedUnwrap: null,
        swapOutputDifferenceBps: null
      }),
      sendAlert: sendOperationalTelegram,
      logError: (message, error) => console.error(message, error)
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[alert-service] pUSD liquidity poll failed', error);
  } finally {
    pusdLiquidityCheckRunning = false;
  }
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Token metadata helper ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

async function getTokenMeta(mint: string) {
  const rows = await query<{ symbol: string | null; name: string | null }>(
    `SELECT symbol, name FROM tokens WHERE mint = $1`, [mint]
  );
  return rows[0] ?? { symbol: null, name: null };
}

async function getPolymarketMarketDetails(mint: string) {
  const rows = await query<{
    question: string | null;
    outcome_count: number | null;
    outcome_name: string | null;
  }>(`
    SELECT m.question, m.outcome_count, o.outcome AS outcome_name
    FROM polymarket_outcomes o
    JOIN polymarket_markets m ON o.condition_id = m.condition_id
    WHERE o.token_id = $1
      AND m.context_complete = TRUE
  `, [mint]);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

async function getClusterMeta(clusterId: string) {
  const rows = await query<{
    name: string | null;
    confidence: number;
    total_realized_roi: number | null;
    avg_composite_score: number | null;
    wallet_count: number;
  }>(`SELECT name, confidence, total_realized_roi, avg_composite_score, wallet_count
      FROM wallet_clusters WHERE id = $1`, [clusterId]);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Alert Formatter ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

function formatSafe(val: boolean | undefined): string {
  if (val === undefined) return '‚ùì Unknown';
  return val ? '‚úÖ Passed' : 'üõë Failed';
}

function formatLiquidity(liquidity: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (liquidity == null) return '‚ùì Unknown';
  if (liquidity >= 1_000_000) return `$${(liquidity / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M ‚úÖ`;
  if (liquidity >= 50_000) return `$${(liquidity / 1000).toFixed(0)}K ‚úÖ`;
  return `$${(liquidity / 1000).toFixed(0)}K üõë LOW`;
}

function formatHolderConc(pct: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (pct == null) return '‚ùì Unknown';
  if (pct > 60) return `${pct}% üõë HIGH`;
  if (pct > 35) return `${pct}% ‚ö†Ô∏è`;
  return `${pct}% ‚úÖ`;
}

function patternHeader(pattern: string, score: number | undefined): string {
  const scoreStr = score != null ? ` ‚Äî Score: ${score}/100` : '';
  const icons: Record<string, string> = {
    snipe:        `üéØ SNIPE SIGNAL${scoreStr}`,
    accumulation: `üìà ACCUMULATION SIGNAL${scoreStr}`,
    rotation:     `üîÑ ROTATION SIGNAL${scoreStr}`,
    exit:         `üî¥ EXIT SIGNAL${scoreStr}`,
    stealth:      `üïµÔ∏è STEALTH BUY${scoreStr}`
  };
  return icons[pattern] ?? `‚ö° SIGNAL [${pattern.toUpperCase()}]${scoreStr}`;
}

function escapeHtml(text: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

async function formatSignalAlert(payload: SignalAlertPayload): Promise<string> {
  const ca = payload.tokenMint ?? 'N/A';
  const chain = payload.tokenMint?.includes(':') ? payload.tokenMint.split(':')[0] : 'solana';
  const rawCa = payload.tokenMint?.includes(':') ? payload.tokenMint.split(':')[1] : ca;

  const token = payload.tokenMint ? await getTokenMeta(payload.tokenMint) : null;
  const cluster = payload.clusterId ? await getClusterMeta(payload.clusterId) : null;

  let polymarketDetails = null;
  if (chain === 'polygon' && payload.tokenMint) {
    polymarketDetails = await getPolymarketMarketDetails(payload.tokenMint);
  }

  const isExit = payload.pattern === 'exit';
  const tokenLabel = polymarketDetails?.outcome_name
    ? escapeHtml(`$${polymarketDetails.outcome_name}`)
    : (token?.symbol ? escapeHtml(`$${token.symbol}`) : 'Unknown Token');
  const tokenName = escapeHtml(polymarketDetails?.question ?? (token?.name ?? ''));

  const lines: string[] = [
    `<b>${patternHeader(payload.pattern, payload.score)}</b>`,
    ''
  ];

  // ‚îÄ‚îÄ CA block (most important) ‚îÄ‚îÄ
  if (!isExit) {
    if (chain === 'polygon') {
      lines.push(`üìã <b>Token ID:</b> <code>${rawCa}</code>`);
      lines.push(`üèÜ <b>Polymarket Market:</b> ${escapeHtml(polymarketDetails?.question) || 'Unknown Market'}`);
      lines.push(`üéØ <b>Traded Outcome:</b> ${escapeHtml(polymarketDetails?.outcome_name) || 'Unknown Outcome'}`);
      lines.push(`üìä <b>Outcomes Count:</b> ${polymarketDetails?.outcome_count ?? 2}`);
    } else {
      lines.push(`üìã <b>CA:</b> <code>${ca}</code>`);
      if (tokenLabel !== 'Unknown Token') {
        lines.push(`Token: ${tokenLabel}${tokenName ? ` (${tokenName})` : ''}`);
      }
    }
    lines.push('');
  } else {
    if (chain === 'polygon') {
      lines.push(`üèÜ <b>Market:</b> ${escapeHtml(polymarketDetails?.question) || 'Unknown Market'}`);
      lines.push(`üéØ <b>Outcome:</b> ${escapeHtml(polymarketDetails?.outcome_name) || 'Unknown Outcome'} ‚Äî <code>${rawCa}</code>`);
    } else {
      lines.push(`Token: ${tokenLabel} ‚Äî <code>${ca}</code>`);
    }
    lines.push('');
  }

  // ‚îÄ‚îÄ Cluster intel ‚îÄ‚îÄ
  if (cluster) {
    const roi = cluster.total_realized_roi != null
      ? `${cluster.total_realized_roi >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(cluster.total_realized_roi * 100).toFixed(0)}% ‚úÖ`
      : 'N/A';
    lines.push('‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ');
    lines.push('<b>üìä CLUSTER INTEL</b>');
    lines.push('‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ');
    lines.push(`Cluster: ${escapeHtml(cluster.name) || payload.clusterId}`);
    lines.push(`Cluster 90d ROI: ${roi}`);
    lines.push(`Cluster confidence: ${Math.round(cluster.confidence * 100)}%`);
    lines.push(`Wallets triggered: ${payload.buyerCount ?? payload.sellerCount ?? '?'} of ${cluster.wallet_count}`);
    lines.push(`Pattern: ${payload.pattern.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + payload.pattern.slice(1)}`);
    if (payload.window) lines.push(`Window: ${payload.window}`);
    if (payload.buyVolume) lines.push(`Volume: $${payload.buyVolume.toLocaleString()}`);
    if (payload.exitVolume) lines.push(`Exit volume: $${payload.exitVolume.toLocaleString()}`);
    if (isExit && payload.sellerPct) lines.push(`Sellers: ${payload.sellerPct}% of cluster`);
    lines.push('');
  }

  // ‚îÄ‚îÄ Token Safety ‚îÄ‚îÄ
  if (!isExit) {
    lines.push('‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ');
    lines.push('<b>ü™ô TOKEN SAFETY</b>');
    lines.push('‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ');
    lines.push(`Safety check: ${formatSafe(payload.isSafe)}`);
    lines.push(`Liquidity: ${formatLiquidity(payload.liquidity)}`);
    lines.push(`Top 10 holders: ${formatHolderConc(payload.top10HolderPct)}`);

    if (payload.warnings && payload.warnings.length > 0) {
      lines.push('');
      lines.push('‚ö†Ô∏è <b>WARNINGS:</b>');
      payload.warnings.forEach(w => lines.push(`  - ${escapeHtml(w)}`));
    }
    lines.push('');
  }

  // ‚îÄ‚îÄ Suggested execution ‚îÄ‚îÄ
  if (!isExit && payload.isSafe) {
    const chain = payload.tokenMint?.includes(':') ? payload.tokenMint.split(':')[0] : 'solana';
    let sizeStr = '';
    if (chain === 'solana') {
      const baseSol = parseFloat(process.env.BASE_POSITION_SOL ?? '0.5');
      sizeStr = `${baseSol} SOL`;
    } else if (chain === 'polygon') {
      const baseUsdc = parseFloat(process.env.BASE_POSITION_USDC ?? '100');
      sizeStr = `${baseUsdc} USDC`;
    } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
      const baseEth = parseFloat(process.env.BASE_POSITION_ETH ?? '0.05');
      sizeStr = `${baseEth} ETH`;
    } else {
      sizeStr = '0.5 SOL';
    }

    lines.push('‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ');
    lines.push('<b>‚ö° SUGGESTED EXECUTION</b>');
    lines.push('‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ');
    lines.push(`Size: ${sizeStr}`);
    lines.push(`Slippage: 15%`);
    lines.push(`TP1: 2x ‚Üí sell 50%`);
    lines.push(`TP2: 3x ‚Üí sell 25%`);
    lines.push(`SL: -25%`);
    lines.push('');
  }

  if (isExit) {
    lines.push('‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ');
    lines.push(`‚ö†Ô∏è Consider taking profit or tightening SL.`);
  } else if (!payload.isSafe) {
    lines.push('‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ‚îÅ');
    lines.push('üõë <b>EXECUTION BLOCKED ‚Äî Safety check failed</b>');
  }

  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`Signal ID: <code>${payload.signalId}</code>`);

  if (payload.tokenMint) {
    if (chain === 'polygon') {
      lines.push([
        `<a href="https://dexscreener.com/polygon/${rawCa}">DexScreener</a>`,
        `<a href="https://polygonscan.com/token/${rawCa}">Polygonscan</a>`
      ].join(' | '));
    } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
      lines.push(`<code>${rawCa}</code> (Robinhood Network)`);
    } else {
      lines.push([
        `<a href="https://dexscreener.com/solana/${rawCa}">DexScreener</a>`,
        `<a href="https://solscan.io/token/${rawCa}">Solscan</a>`,
        `<a href="https://birdeye.so/token/${rawCa}">Birdeye</a>`
      ].join(' | '));
    }
  }

  return lines.join('\n');
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Worker ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

async function deliverSignal(payload: SignalAlertPayload) {
  let lockKey = '';
  if (payload.signalId) {
    lockKey = `swat:alert:claim:${payload.signalId}`;
    const claimed = await redis.set(lockKey, '1', 'EX', 60, 'NX');
    if (!claimed) return { sent: false, reason: 'locked by another worker' };

    const [existing] = await query<{ alerted_at: Date | null }>(
      `SELECT alerted_at FROM signals WHERE id = $1`,
      [payload.signalId]
    );
    if (existing && existing.alerted_at) {
      await redis.del(lockKey);
      return { sent: false, reason: 'already alerted' };
    }
  }

  try {
    const message = await formatSignalAlert(payload);
    await sendTelegram(message);

    if (payload.signalId) {
      await query(
        `UPDATE signals SET alerted_at = NOW(), status = 'alerted' WHERE id = $1 AND alerted_at IS NULL`,
        [payload.signalId]
      );
    }

    return { sent: true };
  } finally {
    if (lockKey) {
      await redis.del(lockKey).catch(() => {});
    }
  }
}

const worker = new Worker(
  QUEUES.alerts,
  (job) => deliverQueuedAlert(job.data, {
    deliverSignal,
    sendOperational: sendOperationalTelegram
  }),
  { connection: redis }
).on('error', (err) => console.error('[alert-service] worker error', err));

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Pub/Sub bridge ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

const bridge = createRedisAlertBridge({
  channel: REDIS_CHANNELS.alertQueue,
  enqueue: (name, payload, options) => alertQueue.add(name, payload, options),
  logRejected: (message, error) => console.warn(message, error)
});
const pendingBridgeDeliveries = new Set<Promise<unknown>>();

subscriber.on('message', (channel, message) => {
  const delivery = bridge.handleMessage(channel, message).catch((error) => {
    console.error('[alert-service] failed to bridge published alert', error);
  });
  pendingBridgeDeliveries.add(delivery);
  void delivery.finally(() => pendingBridgeDeliveries.delete(delivery));
});
subscriber.on('error', (error) => {
  console.error('[alert-service] alert subscriber error', error);
});

void subscriber.subscribe(REDIS_CHANNELS.alertQueue).then(() => {
  console.log(`[alert-service] subscribed to ${REDIS_CHANNELS.alertQueue}`);
}).catch((error) => {
  console.error('[alert-service] alert subscription failed', error);
});

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Shutdown ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

let shuttingDown = false;

async function shutdown(signal: NodeJS.Signals): Promise<void> {
  if (shuttingDown) return;
  shuttingDown = true;
  console.log(`[alert-service] ${signal} received; closing resources`);
  clearInterval(ingestionHealthTimer);

  const failures: unknown[] = [];
  try {
    await subscriber.unsubscribe(REDIS_CHANNELS.alertQueue);
  } catch (error) {
    failures.push(error);
  }

  const bridgeClosures = await Promise.allSettled([...pendingBridgeDeliveries]);
  for (const result of bridgeClosures) {
    if (result.status === 'rejected') failures.push(result.reason);
  }

  const serviceClosures = await Promise.allSettled([
    worker.close(),
    alertQueue.close()
  ]);
  for (const result of serviceClosures) {
    if (result.status === 'rejected') failures.push(result.reason);
  }

  const redisClosures = await Promise.allSettled([
    subscriber.quit(),
    bridgeRedis.quit(),
    redis.quit()
  ]);
  for (const result of redisClosures) {
    if (result.status === 'rejected') failures.push(result.reason);
  }

  if (failures.length > 0) {
    process.exitCode = 1;
    console.error('[alert-service] shutdown completed with errors', failures);
  } else {
    console.log('[alert-service] shutdown complete');
  }
}

process.once('SIGINT', () => void shutdown('SIGINT'));
process.once('SIGTERM', () => void shutdown('SIGTERM'));

console.log('[alert-service] service running');

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { INGESTION_CHAINS, type Chain, type RawIngestionHealth } from '@swat/shared';
import {
  checkIngestionHealth,
  formatIngestionOpsMessage
} from './ingestion-health.js';

const NOW = new Date('2026-07-19T12:00:00.000Z');

function row(
  chain: Chain,
  lastEventAt: string | null
): RawIngestionHealth {
  return {
    chain,
    lastEventAt,
    lastBatchAt: lastEventAt,
    lastSuccessAt: lastEventAt,
    inserted24h: 9,
    skipped24h: 1,
    failed24h: 0
  };
}

function rowsWith(
  target: RawIngestionHealth
): RawIngestionHealth[] {
  const healthyEvent = '2026-07-19T11:59:00.000Z';
  return INGESTION_CHAINS.map((chain) =>
    chain === target.chain ? target : row(chain, healthyEvent)
  );
}

function createStatefulReservations() {
  const states = new Map<Chain, 'unknown' | 'healthy' | 'stale'>();
  const reservations = new Map<string, { chain: Chain; target: 'healthy' | 'stale' }>();
  let sequence = 0;

  return {
    reserve: vi.fn(async (chain: Chain, target: 'healthy' | 'stale') => {
      const current = states.get(chain) ?? 'unknown';
      if (target === 'healthy' && current !== 'stale') {
        states.set(chain, 'healthy');
        return null;
      }
      if (target === current) return null;
      const token = `reservation-${++sequence}`;
      reservations.set(token, { chain, target });
      return token;
    }),
    complete: vi.fn(async (
      chain: Chain,
      reservation: string,
      target: 'healthy' | 'stale'
    ) => {
      const pending = reservations.get(reservation);
      if (!pending || pending.chain !== chain || pending.target !== target) return false;
      states.set(chain, target);
      reservations.delete(reservation);
      return true;
    }),
    release: vi.fn(async (_chain: Chain, reservation: string) => {
      reservations.delete(reservation);
    })
  };
}

describe('ingestion health alert monitor', () => {
  it('deduplicates stale alerts and sends one recovery transition', async () => {
    const state = createStatefulReservations();
    const send = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    let rows = rowsWith(row('solana', '2026-07-19T11:50:00.000Z'));
    const dependencies = {
      ...state,
      loadHealth: async () => rows,
      send,
      now: () => NOW
    };

    await checkIngestionHealth(dependencies);
    await checkIngestionHealth(dependencies);
    rows = rowsWith(row('solana', '2026-07-19T11:59:00.000Z'));
    await checkIngestionHealth(dependencies);
    await checkIngestionHealth(dependencies);

    expect(send).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(send.mock.calls[0][0]).toContain('SWAT INGESTION OPS ALERT');
    expect(send.mock.calls[1][0]).toContain('SWAT INGESTION RECOVERY');
  });

  it('releases an unsent reservation so the next poll can retry', async () => {
    const state = createStatefulReservations();
    const send = vi
      .fn()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Telegram unavailable'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined);
    const dependencies = {
      ...state,
      loadHealth: async () => rowsWith(row('polygon', null)),
      send,
      now: () => NOW
    };

    const first = await checkIngestionHealth(dependencies);
    const second = await checkIngestionHealth(dependencies);

    expect(first.find((item) => item.chain === 'polygon')?.action).toBe('failed');
    expect(second.find((item) => item.chain === 'polygon')?.action).toBe('sent');
    expect(state.release).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it('formats empty state as an explicit no-data incident', () => {
    const message = formatIngestionOpsMessage({
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      status: 'empty',
      lastEventAt: null,
      lastBatchAt: null,
      lastSuccessAt: null,
      lagSeconds: null,
      batchLagSeconds: null,
      staleAfterSeconds: 900,
      targetLagSeconds: 900,
      inserted24h: 0,
      skipped24h: 0,
      failed24h: 1,
      insertRatio: null
    }, 'stale');

    expect(message).toContain('<b>State:</b> NO DATA');
    expect(message).toContain('<b>Last event:</b> never');
  });
});

import {
  buildIngestionHealthSnapshots,
  type Chain,
  type IngestionHealthSnapshot,
  type RawIngestionHealth
} from '@swat/shared';

export type IngestionAlertTarget = 'healthy' | 'stale';

type MonitorDependencies = {
  loadHealth: () => Promise<RawIngestionHealth[]>;
  reserve: (chain: Chain, target: IngestionAlertTarget) => Promise<string | null>;
  complete: (
    chain: Chain,
    reservation: string,
    target: IngestionAlertTarget
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
  release: (chain: Chain, reservation: string) => Promise<void>;
  send: (message: string) => Promise<void>;
  now?: () => Date;
  logError?: (message: string, error: unknown) => void;
};

export type IngestionMonitorResult = {
  chain: Chain;
  target: IngestionAlertTarget;
  action: 'none' | 'sent' | 'failed';
};

function formatDuration(seconds: number | null): string {
  if (seconds === null) return 'no tracked event';
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const remaining = seconds % 60;
  return remaining === 0 ? `${minutes}m` : `${minutes}m ${remaining}s`;
}

function formatRatio(value: number | null): string {
  return value === null ? 'N/A' : `${(value * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
}

export function formatIngestionOpsMessage(
  health: IngestionHealthSnapshot,
  target: IngestionAlertTarget
): string {
  const recovery = target === 'healthy';
  const heading = recovery
    ? 'SWAT INGESTION RECOVERY'
    : 'SWAT INGESTION OPS ALERT';
  const state = recovery
    ? 'HEALTHY'
    : health.status === 'empty'
      ? 'NO DATA'
      : 'STALE';

  return [
    `<b>${heading}</b>`,
    '',
    `<b>Chain:</b> ${health.chain}`,
    `<b>State:</b> ${state}`,
    `<b>Event lag:</b> ${formatDuration(health.lagSeconds)}`,
    `<b>Alert threshold:</b> ${formatDuration(health.staleAfterSeconds)}`,
    `<b>Last event:</b> ${health.lastEventAt ?? 'never'}`,
    `<b>Last batch:</b> ${health.lastBatchAt ?? 'never'}`,
    '',
    `<b>24h inserted:</b> ${health.inserted24h}`,
    `<b>24h skipped:</b> ${health.skipped24h}`,
    `<b>24h failed:</b> ${health.failed24h}`,
    `<b>Insert ratio:</b> ${formatRatio(health.insertRatio)}`
  ].join('\n');
}

export async function checkIngestionHealth(
  dependencies: MonitorDependencies
): Promise<IngestionMonitorResult[]> {
  const now = dependencies.now?.() ?? new Date();
  const snapshots = buildIngestionHealthSnapshots(
    await dependencies.loadHealth(),
    now
  );
  const results: IngestionMonitorResult[] = [];

  for (const health of snapshots) {
    const target: IngestionAlertTarget =
      health.status === 'healthy' ? 'healthy' : 'stale';
    let reservation: string | null = null;
    let sent = false;

    try {
      reservation = await dependencies.reserve(health.chain, target);
      if (!reservation) {
        results.push({ chain: health.chain, target, action: 'none' });
        continue;
      }

      await dependencies.send(formatIngestionOpsMessage(health, target));
      sent = true;
      const completed = await dependencies.complete(
        health.chain,
        reservation,
        target
      );
      if (!completed) {
        throw new Error(`Lost ingestion alert reservation for ${health.chain}`);
      }
      results.push({ chain: health.chain, target, action: 'sent' });
    } catch (error) {
      if (reservation && !sent) {
        await dependencies.release(health.chain, reservation).catch(() => {});
      }
      dependencies.logError?.(
        `[alert-service] ingestion ${target} notification failed for ${health.chain}`,
        error
      );
      results.push({ chain: health.chain, target, action: 'failed' });
    }
  }

  return results;
}

==> apps/alert-service/src/pusd-monitor.ts <==
import {
  assessPusdWithdrawalPath,
  type PusdMonitorInput,
  type PusdMonitorVerdict
} from '@swat/shared';

export interface PusdMonitorDependencies {
  readonly loadInputs: () => Promise<PusdMonitorInput>;
  readonly sendAlert: (message: string) => Promise<void>;
  readonly logError?: (message: string, error: unknown) => void;
  readonly onVerdict?: (verdict: PusdMonitorVerdict) => Promise<void>;
}

export function formatPusdOpsMessage(verdict: PusdMonitorVerdict): string {
  const isImpaired = verdict.outcome === 'impaired';
  const heading = isImpaired
    ? 'SWAT PUSD WITHDRAWAL IMPAIRMENT ALERT'
    : 'SWAT PUSD WITHDRAWAL STATUS';

  const lines = [
    `<b>${heading}</b>`,
    '',
    `<b>Outcome:</b> ${verdict.outcome.toUpperCase()}`,
    `<b>Reason Code:</b> ${verdict.reasonCode}`,
    `<b>Detail:</b> ${verdict.detail}`
  ];

  if (verdict.failures.length > 0) {
    lines.push(`<b>Failures:</b> ${verdict.failures.join(', ')}`);
  }
  if (verdict.unassessed.length > 0) {
    lines.push(`<b>Unassessed:</b> ${verdict.unassessed.join(', ')}`);
  }

  return lines.join('\n');
}

/**
 * Polls and assesses pUSD withdrawal-pool liquidity and offramp health (`S4-M42`).
 *
 * Dispatches Telegram operational alerts when `outcome === 'impaired'`.
 */
export async function checkPusdLiquidity(
  dependencies: PusdMonitorDependencies
): Promise<PusdMonitorVerdict | null> {
  try {
    const input = await dependencies.loadInputs();
    const verdict = assessPusdWithdrawalPath(input);
    if (verdict.outcome === 'impaired') {
      await dependencies.sendAlert(formatPusdOpsMessage(verdict));
    }
    await dependencies.onVerdict?.(verdict);
    return verdict;
  } catch (error) {
    dependencies.logError?.('[alert-service] pUSD liquidity check failed', error);
    return null;
  }
}

==> apps/api/src/attribution-routes.ts <==
import type { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import type {
  AttributionDashboardData,
  AttributionLatencyRow,
  ExpectancyReport,
  LiveShadowCostRow
} from '@swat/db';

export type AttributionRouteDependencies = {
  getDashboard: () => Promise<AttributionDashboardData>;
  getExpectancy: () => Promise<ExpectancyReport | null>;
  getLatency: () => Promise<AttributionLatencyRow[]>;
  getShadowCost: () => Promise<LiveShadowCostRow[]>;
};

export type ManualThresholds = {
  min_signal_score: number | null;
  auto_execute_min_score: number | null;
  max_position_pct: number | null;
  max_daily_exposure_pct: number | null;
  stop_loss_pct: number | null;
  captured_at: Date | string | null;
};

function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? value as Record<string, unknown>
    : null;
}

function finiteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
}

export function extractManualThresholds(report: ExpectancyReport | null): ManualThresholds {
  const signals = asRecord(report?.config_snapshot.signals?.value);
  const trading = asRecord(report?.config_snapshot.trading?.value);
  const risk = asRecord(report?.config_snapshot.risk?.value);

  return {
    min_signal_score: finiteNumber(signals?.min_signal_score),
    auto_execute_min_score: finiteNumber(signals?.auto_execute_min_score),
    max_position_pct: finiteNumber(trading?.max_position_pct),
    max_daily_exposure_pct: finiteNumber(trading?.max_daily_exposure_pct),
    stop_loss_pct: finiteNumber(risk?.stop_loss_pct),
    captured_at: report?.generated_at ?? null
  };
}

export function registerAttributionRoutes(
  app: FastifyInstance,
  dependencies: AttributionRouteDependencies
): void {
  app.get('/v1/trading/expectancy', async () => ({
    report: await dependencies.getExpectancy()
  }));

  app.get('/v1/trading/latency', async () => ({
    items: await dependencies.getLatency()
  }));

  app.get('/v1/trading/shadow-cost', async () => ({
    report: await dependencies.getShadowCost()
  }));

  app.get('/v1/trading/attribution', async () => {
    const dashboard = await dependencies.getDashboard();
    return {
      ...dashboard,
      manual_thresholds: extractManualThresholds(dashboard.report)
    };
  });
}

import type { FastifyReply, FastifyRequest } from 'fastify';

/**

 * `DATABASE_URL is required` while being evaluated. Hoisted so it runs before
 * that import, and `??=` so CI's real value is left alone. No query is ever

function replyStub() {
  const sent: { status?: number; body?: unknown } = {};
  const reply = {
    code(status: number) {
      sent.status = status;
      return this;
    },
    send(body: unknown) {
      sent.body = body;
      return this;
    }
  } as unknown as FastifyReply;
  return { reply, sent };
}

function userRequest(role: 'admin' | 'user', id = 'u1'): FastifyRequest {
  return {
    principal: { kind: 'user', user: { id, role, status: 'active' }, sessionId: 's1' }
  } as unknown as FastifyRequest;
}

const serviceRequest = { principal: { kind: 'service' } } as unknown as FastifyRequest;
const anonymousRequest = {} as unknown as FastifyRequest;

describe('requireUser', () => {
  it('returns a scope for a user principal', () => {
    const { reply } = replyStub();
    expect(requireUser(userRequest('user'), reply)?.userId).toBe('u1');
  });

  it('rejects the internal service principal', () => {
    // The legacy shared key predates tenancy and carries no tenant, so treating
    // it as a user would be a cross-tenant hole by construction. This is checked
    // centrally rather than at every route precisely so it cannot be forgotten.
    const { reply, sent } = replyStub();
    expect(requireUser(serviceRequest, reply)).toBeNull();
    expect(sent.status).toBe(401);
  });

  it('rejects an unauthenticated request', () => {
    const { reply, sent } = replyStub();
    expect(requireUser(anonymousRequest, reply)).toBeNull();
    expect(sent.status).toBe(401);
  });
});

describe('requireRole', () => {
  it('admits an admin', () => {
    const { reply } = replyStub();
    expect(requireRole(userRequest('admin'), reply, 'admin')?.role).toBe('admin');
  });

  it('refuses an ordinary user with 403, not 401', () => {
    // 401 would tell a signed-in operator their credentials are wrong and invite
    // them to retype a password that is already correct.
    const { reply, sent } = replyStub();
    expect(requireRole(userRequest('user'), reply, 'admin')).toBeNull();
    expect(sent.status).toBe(403);
  });

  it('refuses the service principal, which has no role at all', () => {
    // Worth pinning: `registerAdminOnlyGlobals` deliberately ADMITS the service
    // principal on operator routes, so it is easy to assume requireRole does too.
    // It must not -- a route that calls requireRole is asking for a human admin.
    const { reply, sent } = replyStub();
    expect(requireRole(serviceRequest, reply, 'admin')).toBeNull();
    expect(sent.status).toBe(403);
  });

  it('refuses an anonymous request', () => {
    const { reply, sent } = replyStub();
    expect(requireRole(anonymousRequest, reply, 'admin')).toBeNull();
    expect(sent.status).toBe(403);
  });
});

describe('isUserReachable', () => {
  it('admits the auth, me, and billing prefixes and health', () => {
    expect(isUserReachable('/v1/auth/login')).toBe(true);
    expect(isUserReachable('/v1/me/subscriptions')).toBe(true);
    expect(isUserReachable('/v1/billing/plans')).toBe(true);
    expect(isUserReachable('/v1/billing/status')).toBe(true);
    expect(isUserReachable('/v1/health')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('refuses operator surfaces', () => {
    for (const path of ['/v1/wallets', '/v1/config', '/v1/scorer/run', '/v1/logs/stream']) {
      expect(isUserReachable(path)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it('is an allowlist, so an unknown new route is admin-gated by default', () => {
    // A blocklist would leave every new operator route wide open until somebody
    // remembered to add it, which is what makes tenancy controls decorative.
    expect(isUserReachable('/v1/some-route-added-later')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('admits every /v1/auth/ path, which is why credential-minting routes there need their own role check', () => {
    // This is the shape of a real escalation found on 2026-08-25: POST
    // /v1/auth/ticket mints an SSE ticket that the auth hook upgrades to a
    // `service` principal, and `service` is admitted on every operator route.
    // The prefix allowlist does not and cannot catch that -- the route must
    // check for itself, and apps/api/src/index.ts now calls requireRole there.
    expect(isUserReachable('/v1/auth/ticket')).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('issueCsrfToken', () => {
  it('returns a fresh high-entropy token each call', () => {
    const tokens = new Set(Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => issueCsrfToken()));
    expect(tokens.size).toBe(50);
    for (const token of tokens) expect(token.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(40);
  });
});

==> apps/api/src/auth/plugin.ts <==
import { createHash, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import type { FastifyInstance, FastifyReply, FastifyRequest } from 'fastify';
import '@fastify/cookie';
import { findUserById, resolveSession, forUser, type UserScope, type UserRecord } from '@swat/db';

/**
 * Layered authentication (D12).
 *
 * Three credential types, resolved in this order:
 *
 *   1. **Session cookie** ‚Äî a browser user. Carries a tenant.
 *   2. **`Authorization: Bearer swat_‚Ä¶`** ‚Äî a per-user API key. Carries a tenant.
 *   3. **`X-Api-Key` matching the legacy `API_KEY`** ‚Äî an internal service.
 *      Carries **no** tenant, and must never satisfy a `/v1/me/*` route.
 *
 * That last rule is the important one. The legacy key predates tenancy; treating
 * it as a user would be a cross-tenant hole by construction, so `requireUser`
 * rejects it explicitly rather than relying on every route to remember.
 */

export type AuthPrincipal =
  | { readonly kind: 'user'; readonly user: UserRecord; readonly sessionId: string | null }
  | { readonly kind: 'service' };

declare module 'fastify' {
  interface FastifyRequest {
    principal?: AuthPrincipal;
  }
}

export const SESSION_COOKIE = 'swat_session';
export const CSRF_COOKIE = 'swat_csrf';
export const CSRF_HEADER = 'x-csrf-token';

/** Paths that never require authentication. */
const PUBLIC_PATHS = new Set([
  '/v1/health',
  '/v1/auth/signup',
  '/v1/auth/login',
  '/v1/auth/wallet/nonce',
  '/v1/auth/wallet/verify'
]);

export interface AuthPluginOptions {
  /** SHA-256 digest of the legacy shared key. */
  readonly legacyKeyHash: Buffer;
  readonly isProduction: boolean;
  /**
   * Atomically consumes a one-time SSE ticket, returning true if it was valid.
   *
   * Injected rather than inlined because the hook is the *only* place the ticket
   * is checked ‚Äî `GET /v1/logs/stream` itself does no validation, so if this
   * returns true for an invalid ticket the stream is simply unauthenticated.
   */
  readonly consumeSseTicket: (ticket: string) => Promise<boolean>;
}

function constantTimeMatches(provided: string, expected: Buffer): boolean {
  const providedHash = createHash('sha256').update(provided).digest();
  return providedHash.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(providedHash, expected);
}

export function issueCsrfToken(): string {
  return randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');
}

/**
 * Double-submit CSRF check.
 *
 * Cookie authentication means the browser attaches credentials to cross-site
 * requests automatically, so without this any site could POST as a logged-in
 * user. `SameSite=Lax` blocks the common case but is deliberately *not* relied
 * on alone: it is a defence the browser applies, not one we can verify, and the
 * SIWE flow requires `Lax` rather than `Strict`.
 *
 * Only applies to cookie-authenticated requests. An API key is not sent
 * automatically by a browser, so it is not CSRF-reachable.
 */
function csrfValid(request: FastifyRequest): boolean {
  const cookieToken = (request.cookies as Record<string, string | undefined>)[CSRF_COOKIE];
  const headerToken = request.headers[CSRF_HEADER];
  const presented = Array.isArray(headerToken) ? headerToken[0] : headerToken;
  if (!cookieToken || !presented) return false;
  const a = Buffer.from(cookieToken);
  const b = Buffer.from(presented);
  return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
}

/**
 * Paths any authenticated user may reach. Everything else under `/v1/` is an
 * operator surface and requires `admin` or the internal service principal.
 *
 * An allowlist, not a blocklist, on purpose: a new global route added later is
 * admin-gated by default. A blocklist would leave every new operator route wide
 * open until somebody remembered to add it, which is exactly the failure mode
 * that makes tenancy controls decorative.
 */
const USER_REACHABLE_PREFIXES = ['/v1/auth/', '/v1/me/', '/v1/billing/'] as const;

export function isUserReachable(path: string): boolean {
  if (path === '/v1/health') return true;
  return USER_REACHABLE_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => path.startsWith(prefix));
}

/**
 * Restricts operator surfaces to admins and internal services (checklist S2-11).
 *
 * Register **after** `registerAuth` so `request.principal` is populated. The
 * service principal is allowed because these are the routes service‚ÜíAPI calls
 * legitimately use; it carries no tenant, which is precisely why `requireUser`
 * rejects it on `/v1/me/*` while this hook admits it here.
 */
export async function registerAdminOnlyGlobals(app: FastifyInstance): Promise<void> {
  app.addHook('onRequest', async (request, reply) => {
    if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') return;
    const path = request.url.split('?')[0]!;
    if (!path.startsWith('/v1/')) return;
    if (isUserReachable(path)) return;

    const principal = request.principal;
    if (principal?.kind === 'service') return;
    if (principal?.kind === 'user' && principal.user.role === 'admin') return;
    return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'Forbidden' });
  });
}

export async function registerAuth(app: FastifyInstance, options: AuthPluginOptions): Promise<void> {
  app.decorateRequest('principal', undefined);

  app.addHook('onRequest', async (request, reply) => {
    if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') return;
    const path = request.url.split('?')[0]!;
    const isPublic = PUBLIC_PATHS.has(path);

    const sessionToken = (request.cookies as Record<string, string | undefined>)[SESSION_COOKIE];
    if (sessionToken) {
      const resolved = await resolveSession(sessionToken);
      if (resolved && resolved.user.status === 'active') {
        // State-changing cookie requests must carry the double-submit token.
        // Applies on public paths too: `POST /v1/auth/wallet/verify` links a
        // wallet to the *session's* account, which is state-changing.
        if (request.method !== 'GET' && request.method !== 'HEAD' && !csrfValid(request)) {
          // `code` is machine-readable on purpose. A CSRF failure and a role
          // failure are both 403, and a client that tells them apart by matching
          // the prose breaks the next time the prose is reworded. The distinction
          // matters to the reader: a stale `swat_csrf` cookie is fixed by
          // reloading, whereas a role failure never is -- and conflating them
          // sends an operator hunting a permissions problem that does not exist.
          return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'Invalid CSRF token', code: 'csrf_invalid' });
        }
        request.principal = { kind: 'user', user: resolved.user, sessionId: resolved.sessionId };
        return;
      }
      // A public route must still be reachable with a stale cookie ‚Äî otherwise a
      // user whose session expired could not log in again without manually
      // clearing cookies.
      if (isPublic) return;
      if (resolved && resolved.user.status !== 'active') {
        // Status is disclosed only once the credential is proven.
        return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'Account suspended' });
      }
      return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
    }

    if (isPublic) return;

    // SSE cannot send headers, so it authenticates with a one-time ticket in the
    // query string. The ticket must be consumed HERE: the stream route performs
    // no validation of its own, so falling through without checking would leave
    // it open to anyone.
    if (path.startsWith('/v1/logs/stream')) {
      const ticket = (request.query as { ticket?: unknown }).ticket;
      if (typeof ticket === 'string' && ticket && (await options.consumeSseTicket(ticket))) {
        request.principal = { kind: 'service' };
        return;
      }
      // Fall through: a legacy key may still authorise the stream.
    }

    const authorization = request.headers.authorization;
    if (authorization?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      // Per-user API keys land here once S1-20 ships. Until then a bearer token
      // is not a valid credential and must not fall through to the legacy key.
      return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
    }

    const legacyKey = request.headers['x-api-key'];
    const presented = Array.isArray(legacyKey) ? legacyKey[0] ?? '' : legacyKey ?? '';
    if (presented && constantTimeMatches(presented, options.legacyKeyHash)) {
      request.principal = { kind: 'service' };
      return;
    }

    return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
  });
}

/**
 * Asserts a tenant-bearing principal and returns its scope.
 *
 * A service principal is rejected here rather than at each call site: the legacy
 * key has no tenant, so any route that scopes data must refuse it.
 */
export function requireUser(request: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply): UserScope | null {
  if (request.principal?.kind !== 'user') {
    reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
    return null;
  }
  return forUser(request.principal.user.id);
}

export function requireRole(
  request: FastifyRequest,
  reply: FastifyReply,
  role: 'admin'
): UserRecord | null {
  const principal = request.principal;
  if (principal?.kind !== 'user' || principal.user.role !== role) {
    // 404-style opacity is not used here: the caller is authenticated, so
    // telling them they lack the role is not an information leak.
    reply.code(403).send({ error: 'Forbidden' });
    return null;
  }
  return principal.user;
}

const TIER_RANK: Record<string, number> = { free: 0, operator: 1, ultra: 2 };

export function requireTier(
  request: FastifyRequest,
  reply: FastifyReply,
  minimum: 'operator' | 'ultra'
): UserRecord | null {
  const principal = request.principal;
  if (principal?.kind !== 'user') {
    reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
    return null;
  }
  const { user } = principal;
  // An expired paid tier is treated as free. `tier_expires_at IS NULL` means
  // lifetime, so a null expiry must never be read as "expired".
  const expired = user.tierExpiresAt !== null && user.tierExpiresAt.getTime() < Date.now();
  const effectiveTier = expired ? 'free' : user.tier;
  if ((TIER_RANK[effectiveTier] ?? 0) < (TIER_RANK[minimum] ?? 0)) {
    reply.code(403).send({ error: 'Upgrade required', requiredTier: minimum });
    return null;
  }
  return user;
}

export async function loadPrincipalUser(userId: string): Promise<UserRecord | null> {
  return findUserById(userId);
}

==> apps/api/src/auth/routes.ts <==
import type { FastifyInstance, FastifyReply } from 'fastify';
import '@fastify/cookie';
import type { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  AUDIT_EVENTS,
  authenticateUser,
  createSession,
  createUser,
  EmailAlreadyRegisteredError,
  findUserById,
  findUserIdByAuthWallet,
  forUser,
  linkAuthWallet,
  listAuthWallets,
  recordAuditEvent,
  revokeSession,
  WalletAlreadyLinkedError,
  type UserRecord
} from '@swat/db';
import {
  buildSignInMessage,
  generateNonce,
  normaliseAddress,
  NONCE_TTL_SECONDS,
  verifySignInSignature
} from './wallet-signature.js';
import {
  CSRF_COOKIE,
  SESSION_COOKIE,
  issueCsrfToken,
  requireUser
} from './plugin.js';

const emailSchema = z.string().trim().min(3).max(254).email();
/**
 * Length over composition. Composition rules push users toward predictable
 * substitutions ("Password1!") without adding real entropy; 12 characters is the
 * OWASP-aligned floor.
 */
const passwordSchema = z.string().min(12).max(200);

const signupSchema = z.object({
  email: emailSchema,
  password: passwordSchema,
  displayName: z.string().trim().min(1).max(64).optional()
});

const loginSchema = z.object({
  email: emailSchema,
  password: z.string().min(1).max(200)
});

const chainKindSchema = z.enum(['evm', 'solana']);

const nonceSchema = z.object({
  chainKind: chainKindSchema,
  address: z.string().trim().min(32).max(100)
});

const verifySchema = z.object({
  chainKind: chainKindSchema,
  address: z.string().trim().min(32).max(100),
  message: z.string().min(1).max(2000),
  signature: z.string().min(1).max(500)
});

export interface AuthRouteOptions {
  readonly redis: Redis;
  readonly isProduction: boolean;
  /** Origin this server accepts sign-in messages for. Bound into every nonce. */
  readonly domain: string;
  readonly uri: string;
  readonly allowedOrigins?: readonly string[];
}

function publicUser(user: UserRecord) {
  return {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    displayName: user.displayName,
    role: user.role,
    tier: user.tier,
    tierExpiresAt: user.tierExpiresAt
  };
}

export async function registerAuthRoutes(
  app: FastifyInstance,
  options: AuthRouteOptions
): Promise<void> {
  const { redis } = options;

  /** Issues the session + CSRF cookie pair. */
  async function establishSession(
    reply: FastifyReply,
    user: UserRecord,
    ip: string | null,
    userAgent: string | null
  ): Promise<void> {
    const session = await createSession({ userId: user.id, ip, userAgent });
    const csrf = issueCsrfToken();
    const isSecure = process.env.COOKIE_SECURE !== undefined
      ? process.env.COOKIE_SECURE === 'true'
      : (options.isProduction && (reply.request.protocol === 'https' || reply.request.headers['x-forwarded-proto'] === 'https'));
    reply.setCookie(SESSION_COOKIE, session.token, {
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: isSecure,
      // Lax, not Strict: the wallet-linking flow can return the user via a
      // top-level cross-site navigation, which Strict would strip the cookie
      // from. The double-submit CSRF token covers what Lax does not.
      sameSite: 'lax',
      path: '/',
      expires: session.expiresAt
    });
    reply.setCookie(CSRF_COOKIE, csrf, {
      // Deliberately readable by JavaScript ‚Äî the client must echo it in a
      // header. That is the "double submit"; secrecy is not what makes it work,
      // same-origin read access is.
      httpOnly: false,
      secure: isSecure,
      sameSite: 'lax',
      path: '/',
      expires: session.expiresAt
    });
  }

  app.post('/v1/auth/signup', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = signupSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Invalid signup payload' });
    }
    try {
      const user = await createUser({
        email: parsed.data.email,
        password: parsed.data.password,
        displayName: parsed.data.displayName ?? null
      });
      await establishSession(reply, user, request.ip, request.headers['user-agent'] ?? null);
      await recordAuditEvent({
        actorType: 'user',
        actorId: user.id,
        event: AUDIT_EVENTS.signup,
        ip: request.ip,
        userAgent: request.headers['user-agent'] ?? null
      });
      return reply.code(201).send({ user: publicUser(user) });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof EmailAlreadyRegisteredError) {
        return reply.code(409).send({ error: 'Email already registered' });
      }
      throw error;
    }
  });

  app.post('/v1/auth/login', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = loginSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Invalid login payload' });
    }
    const user = await authenticateUser(parsed.data.email, parsed.data.password);
    if (!user) {
      await recordAuditEvent({
        actorType: 'anonymous',
        event: AUDIT_EVENTS.loginFailed,
        ip: request.ip,
        userAgent: request.headers['user-agent'] ?? null,
        // The attempted email is the whole point of this row for abuse
        // detection. It is not a secret; the password never appears.
        metadata: { email: parsed.data.email }
      });
      // Identical body for unknown-email and wrong-password. `authenticateUser`
      // burns a matching argon2 verify in the unknown case so timing matches too.
      return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Invalid credentials' });
    }
    if (user.status !== 'active') {
      return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'Account suspended' });
    }
    await establishSession(reply, user, request.ip, request.headers['user-agent'] ?? null);
    await recordAuditEvent({
      actorType: 'user',
      actorId: user.id,
      event: AUDIT_EVENTS.login,
      ip: request.ip,
      userAgent: request.headers['user-agent'] ?? null
    });
    return reply.send({ user: publicUser(user) });
  });

  app.post('/v1/auth/logout', async (request, reply) => {
    const token = (request.cookies as Record<string, string | undefined>)[SESSION_COOKIE];
    if (token) await revokeSession(token);
    reply.clearCookie(SESSION_COOKIE, { path: '/' });
    reply.clearCookie(CSRF_COOKIE, { path: '/' });
    if (request.principal?.kind === 'user') {
      await recordAuditEvent({
        actorType: 'user',
        actorId: request.principal.user.id,
        event: AUDIT_EVENTS.logout,
        ip: request.ip
      });
    }
    return reply.send({ ok: true });
  });

  app.get('/v1/auth/me', async (request, reply) => {
    const scope = requireUser(request, reply);
    if (!scope) return;
    const user = await findUserById(scope.userId);
    if (!user) return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });
    const wallets = await listAuthWallets(scope);
    return reply.send({
      user: publicUser(user),
      wallets: wallets.map((wallet) => ({
        chainKind: wallet.chainKind,
        address: wallet.address,
        verifiedAt: wallet.verifiedAt
      }))
    });
  });

  app.post('/v1/auth/wallet/nonce', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = nonceSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Invalid nonce payload' });
    }
    const address = normaliseAddress(parsed.data.chainKind, parsed.data.address);
    const nonce = generateNonce();
    const issuedAt = new Date().toISOString();

    const rawOrigin = (typeof request.headers.origin === 'string' && request.headers.origin.trim().length > 0)
      ? request.headers.origin.trim()
      : null;
    let requestDomain = options.domain;
    let requestUri = options.uri;
    if (rawOrigin) {
      // Validate rawOrigin against configured allowlist or options.uri (H-04)
      const isAllowed = options.allowedOrigins && options.allowedOrigins.length > 0
        ? options.allowedOrigins.includes(rawOrigin)
        : rawOrigin === options.uri;

      if (isAllowed || !options.isProduction) {
        try {
          const u = new URL(rawOrigin);
          requestDomain = u.host;
          requestUri = `${u.protocol}//${u.host}`;
        } catch {
          // Fallback to options default
        }
      }
    }

    const message = buildSignInMessage({
      domain: requestDomain,
      uri: requestUri,
      address,
      nonce,
      issuedAt,
      chainKind: parsed.data.chainKind
    });
    // Bound to the address it was issued for, so a nonce minted for one wallet
    // cannot be spent proving control of another.
    await redis.set(
      `swat:siwe:${nonce}`,
      JSON.stringify({ chainKind: parsed.data.chainKind, address, domain: requestDomain, uri: requestUri }),
      'EX',
      NONCE_TTL_SECONDS
    );
    return reply.send({
      nonce,
      message,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + NONCE_TTL_SECONDS * 1000).toISOString()
    });
  });

  app.post('/v1/auth/wallet/verify', async (request, reply) => {
    const parsed = verifySchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Invalid verify payload' });
    }
    const address = normaliseAddress(parsed.data.chainKind, parsed.data.address);

    const nonceLine = parsed.data.message
      .split('\n')
      .find((line) => line.startsWith('Nonce: '));
    const nonce = nonceLine?.slice('Nonce: '.length).trim();
    if (!nonce) return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'Bad Request', message: 'Missing nonce' });

    // Atomic consume-and-read. GETDEL makes replay impossible: two concurrent
    // requests with the same nonce cannot both observe it, which a GET-then-DEL
    // pair would allow.
    const bound = await redis.getdel(`swat:siwe:${nonce}`);
    if (!bound) return reply.code(410).send({ error: 'Nonce expired or already used' });

    let boundChain = parsed.data.chainKind;
    let boundAddr = address;
    let expectedDomain = options.domain;
    let expectedUri = options.uri;

    try {
      const parsedBound = JSON.parse(bound);
      boundChain = parsedBound.chainKind;
      boundAddr = parsedBound.address;
      expectedDomain = parsedBound.domain || options.domain;
      expectedUri = parsedBound.uri || options.uri;
    } catch {
      // Legacy string format fallback
      if (bound !== `${parsed.data.chainKind}:${address}`) {
        return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Invalid signature' });
      }
    }

    if (boundChain !== parsed.data.chainKind || boundAddr !== address) {
      return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Invalid signature' });
    }

    const result = await verifySignInSignature({
      chainKind: parsed.data.chainKind,
      address,
      message: parsed.data.message,
      signature: parsed.data.signature,
      expectedNonce: nonce,
      expectedDomain,
      expectedUri
    });
    if (!result.ok) {
      await recordAuditEvent({
        actorType: 'anonymous',
        event: AUDIT_EVENTS.walletLoginFailed,
        ip: request.ip,
        metadata: { chainKind: parsed.data.chainKind, address, reason: result.reason }
      });
      return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Invalid signature' });
    }

    // Authenticated session present ‚Üí link. Otherwise ‚Üí wallet-only login.
    if (request.principal?.kind === 'user') {
      const scope = forUser(request.principal.user.id);
      try {
        const wallet = await linkAuthWallet(scope, {
          chainKind: parsed.data.chainKind,
          address
        });
        await recordAuditEvent({
          actorType: 'user',
          actorId: scope.userId,
          event: AUDIT_EVENTS.walletLinked,
          targetType: 'auth_wallet',
          targetId: address,
          ip: request.ip
        });
        return reply.send({
          wallet: {
            chainKind: wallet.chainKind,
            address: wallet.address,
            verifiedAt: wallet.verifiedAt
          }
        });
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof WalletAlreadyLinkedError) {
          return reply.code(409).send({ error: 'Wallet already linked to another account' });
        }
        throw error;
      }
    }

    const userId = await findUserIdByAuthWallet(parsed.data.chainKind, address);
    if (!userId) {
      // A proven signature for an unlinked wallet is not an account. Creating one
      // here would let anyone with a keypair mint accounts without an email.
      return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Wallet not linked to any account' });
    }
    const user = await findUserById(userId);
    if (!user || user.status !== 'active') {
      return reply.code(403).send({ error: 'Account suspended' });
    }
    await establishSession(reply, user, request.ip, request.headers['user-agent'] ?? null);
    await recordAuditEvent({
      actorType: 'user',
      actorId: user.id,
      event: AUDIT_EVENTS.login,
      ip: request.ip,
      metadata: { method: 'wallet', chainKind: parsed.data.chainKind }
    });
    return reply.send({ user: publicUser(user) });
  });
}
