      source: getBackfillSource(chain),
      inserted: 1,
      failed: 0
    }));
  });

  it('rejects malformed jobs before invoking a chain backfill', async () => {
    await expect(processor({
      data: { chain: 'polygon', address: `solana:${SOLANA_ADDRESS}` }
    })).rejects.toThrow(/does not match requested chain/);
    await expect(processor({
      data: { chain: 'unsupported', address: EVM_ADDRESS }
    })).rejects.toThrow(/Unsupported wallet backfill chain/);

    expect(dependencies.backfillSolana).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(dependencies.backfillPolygon).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(dependencies.backfillRobinhood).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

==> apps/indexer/src/backfill-worker.ts <==
import type { Job } from 'bullmq';
import type { RecordIngestionBatchInput } from '@swat/db';
import {
  isChain,
  resolveChainAddress,
  type Chain,
  type WalletBackfillJobData
} from '@swat/shared';
import { runTrackedIngestion, type IngestionBatchResult } from './ingestion-health.js';

type BatchRecorder = (input: RecordIngestionBatchInput) => Promise<void>;

export type WalletBackfillProcessorDependencies = {
  backfillSolana(address: string): Promise<IngestionBatchResult>;
  backfillPolygon(address: string): Promise<IngestionBatchResult>;
  backfillRobinhood(address: string): Promise<IngestionBatchResult>;
  recordBatch: BatchRecorder;
  sourceForChain?: (chain: Chain) => string;
};

export function getBackfillSource(chain: Chain): string {
  if (chain === 'solana') return 'solana-backfill';
  if (chain === 'polygon') return 'polymarket-data-api';
  return 'robinhood-evm';
}

export function createWalletBackfillProcessor(
  dependencies: WalletBackfillProcessorDependencies
) {
  return async (job: Pick<Job, 'data'>) => {
    const data = job.data as Partial<WalletBackfillJobData>;
    if (!isChain(data.chain)) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported wallet backfill chain: ${String(data.chain)}`);
    }
    if (typeof data.address !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('Wallet backfill job is missing an address');
    }

    const resolved = resolveChainAddress(data.address, data.chain);
    const { chain, raw: address } = resolved;
    const source = dependencies.sourceForChain?.(chain) ?? getBackfillSource(chain);
    console.log(`[indexer] backfill started for ${address} (${chain})`);

    const result = await runTrackedIngestion({
      chain,
      source,
      run: () => {
        if (chain === 'solana') return dependencies.backfillSolana(address);
        if (chain === 'polygon') return dependencies.backfillPolygon(address);
        return dependencies.backfillRobinhood(address);
      }
    }, dependencies.recordBatch);

    console.log(`[indexer] backfill complete for ${address} (${chain}):`, result);

    // Immediate post-backfill scoring so trader metrics are created instantly
    try {
      const { getWalletMetrics, updateWalletScore } = await import('@swat/db');
      const { calculateCompositeScore, scoreToTier } = await import('@swat/shared');
      const metrics = await getWalletMetrics(resolved.prefixed, chain);
      const score = calculateCompositeScore(metrics);
      const tier = scoreToTier(score);
      await updateWalletScore(resolved.prefixed, score, tier, metrics);
      console.log(`[indexer] immediate post-backfill scoring complete for ${resolved.prefixed}: score=${score}, tier=${tier}`);
    } catch (scoreErr) {
      console.warn(`[indexer] post-backfill scoring deferred for ${resolved.prefixed}:`, scoreErr);
    }

    return { address, chain, ...result };
  };
}

  };

    transactionIndex: 0,

  };
}

function clientFor(
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell' | 'rejected',
  walletTargetQuantity?: bigint
) {
  const targetQuantity = walletTargetQuantity ?? (direction === 'sell' ? 4_000n : 5_000n);
  const transfer = direction === 'buy'
    ? parsedTransfer(pool, wallet, targetQuantity)
    : parsedTransfer(wallet, pool, targetQuantity);
  const receiptLogs = direction === 'buy'
    ? [receiptSwap(1_000n, -5_000n), receiptTransfer(pool, wallet, targetQuantity, 2)]
    : direction === 'sell'
      ? [receiptSwap(-800n, 4_000n), receiptTransfer(wallet, pool, targetQuantity, 2)]
      : [receiptTransfer(pool, wallet, targetQuantity, 2)];

  return {
    getBlockNumber: vi.fn(async () => 10n),
    getLogs: vi.fn(async (input: { args?: { from?: string; to?: string } }) => {
      if (direction === 'buy') return input.args?.to ? [transfer] : [];
      return input.args?.from ? [transfer] : [];

  };

import {
  createPublicClient,
  erc20Abi,
  http,
  parseAbiItem,
  type PublicClient
} from 'viem';
import { polygon } from 'viem/chains';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import { Queue } from 'bullmq';
import {
  query,
  upsertToken,
  upsertWallet,
  insertParsedTransaction,
  updateTokenLaunchTimestamp,
  refreshWalletActivity,
  logDiscoveryRun
} from '@swat/db';
import {
  prefixChainValue,
  REDIS_CHANNELS,
  QUEUES,
  createWalletBackfillJob,
  resolveChainValue,
  fetchTokenPriceUsd,
  type Chain
} from '@swat/shared';
import {
  IngestionBatchError,
  type IngestionBatchResult
} from './ingestion-health.js';
import {
  classifyRobinhoodReceipt,
  parseRobinhoodIngestionConfig,
  type RobinhoodClassifiedSwap
} from './robinhood-ingestion.js';
import {
  persistRobinhoodSourceTrade,
  SourceTradePersistenceError
} from './source-trade-lifecycle.js';

export type WalletChain = Chain;

const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
const redis = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
const NATIVE_TOKEN = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000';

const BASE_TOKENS: Record<string, Set<string>> = {
  polygon: new Set([
    '0x0d500B1d8E8eF31E21C99d1Db9A6444d3ADf1270'.toLowerCase(), // WMATIC
    '0x3c499c542cEF5E3811e1192ce70d8cC03d5c3359'.toLowerCase(), // USDC (native)
    '0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174'.toLowerCase(), // USDC (bridged)
    '0xc2132D05D31c914a87C6611C10748AEb04B58e8F'.toLowerCase(), // USDT
    '0x7ceB23fD6bC0adD59E62ac25578270cFf1b9f619'.toLowerCase(), // WETH
  ]),
  'robinhood-chain': new Set()
};

function getBaseTokens(chain: WalletChain): Set<string> {
  const set = new Set(BASE_TOKENS[chain] ?? []);
  if (chain === 'robinhood-chain' && process.env.ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET) {
    set.add(process.env.ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET.toLowerCase());
  }
  return set;
}

function isBaseToken(address: string, _symbol: string, chain: WalletChain): boolean {
  const addr = address.toLowerCase();
  // H-18: Verify base-asset identity strictly by contract address, never spoofable symbol
  return getBaseTokens(chain).has(addr);
}

// Instantiate clients
function getPublicClient(chain: WalletChain): PublicClient {
  if (chain === 'polygon') {
    const url = process.env.POLYGON_RPC_URL ?? 'https://polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com';
    return createPublicClient({ chain: polygon, transport: http(url) });
  } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
    const url = process.env.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL ?? 'https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com';
    // The chain ID is a deployment fact verified by the executor startup gate. The
    // indexer intentionally does not embed an unreviewed chain definition.
    return createPublicClient({ transport: http(url) });
  }
  throw new Error(`Unsupported chain: ${chain}`);
}

export type EvmBackfillDependencies = {
  client?: PublicClient;
  publish?: (channel: string, message: string) => Promise<unknown>;
};

async function fetchEvmTokenMetadata(client: any, tokenAddress: `0x${string}`, chain: WalletChain) {
  try {
    const [decimals, name, symbol] = await Promise.all([
      client.readContract({
        address: tokenAddress,
        abi: erc20Abi,
        functionName: 'decimals'
      }).catch(() => null),
      client.readContract({
        address: tokenAddress,
        abi: erc20Abi,
        functionName: 'name'
      }).catch(() => 'Unknown'),
      client.readContract({
        address: tokenAddress,
        abi: erc20Abi,
        functionName: 'symbol'
      }).catch(() => 'UNKNOWN')
    ]);
    if (decimals === null) return null;
    return { decimals: Number(decimals), name: String(name), symbol: String(symbol) };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

const tokenMetadataCache = new Map<string, { decimals: number; symbol: string; name: string }>();

async function getEvmTokenMetadata(client: any, tokenAddress: `0x${string}`, chain: WalletChain) {
  const addr = tokenAddress.toLowerCase();
  const cacheKey = `${chain}:${addr}`;
  if (tokenMetadataCache.has(cacheKey)) return tokenMetadataCache.get(cacheKey)!;

  // Try DB first
  const dbRows = await query<{ decimals: number | null; symbol: string | null; name: string | null }>(
    `SELECT decimals, symbol, name FROM tokens WHERE mint = $1 AND chain = $2`,
    [prefixChainValue(addr, chain), chain]
  );
  if (dbRows.length > 0 && dbRows[0].decimals !== null) {
    const meta = {
      decimals: dbRows[0].decimals,
      symbol: dbRows[0].symbol ?? 'UNKNOWN',
      name: dbRows[0].name ?? 'Unknown'
    };
    tokenMetadataCache.set(cacheKey, meta);
    return meta;
  }

  // Fallback to contract read
  const meta = await fetchEvmTokenMetadata(client, tokenAddress, chain);
  if (!meta) return null;
  
  // Upsert into tokens table
  await upsertToken(addr, {
    chain,
    decimals: meta.decimals,
    symbol: meta.symbol,
    name: meta.name
  });

  tokenMetadataCache.set(cacheKey, meta);
  return meta;
}

export async function backfillEvmWallet(
  address: string,
  chain: 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain',
  dependencies: EvmBackfillDependencies = {}
): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> {
  const normalizedAddress = resolveChainValue(address, chain).raw;
  const client = dependencies.client ?? getPublicClient(chain);
  const publish = dependencies.publish
    ?? ((channel: string, message: string) => redis.publish(channel, message));
  const currentBlock = await client.getBlockNumber();
  const blockWindow = BigInt(process.env.EVM_BACKFILL_BLOCKS ?? '100000');
  const logChunkSize = BigInt(process.env.EVM_LOG_CHUNK_SIZE ?? '2000');
  if (logChunkSize <= 0n) throw new Error('EVM_LOG_CHUNK_SIZE must be positive');
  const fromBlock = currentBlock - blockWindow > 0n ? currentBlock - blockWindow : 0n;

  console.log(`[indexer] EVM backfill querying logs for ${normalizedAddress} on ${chain} from block ${fromBlock}`);

  const transferEvent = parseAbiItem('event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)');

  const collectedLogs: any[] = [];
  for (let chunkStart = fromBlock; chunkStart <= currentBlock; chunkStart += logChunkSize) {
    const chunkEnd = chunkStart + logChunkSize - 1n > currentBlock
      ? currentBlock
      : chunkStart + logChunkSize - 1n;
    const [sentLogs, receivedLogs] = await Promise.all([
      client.getLogs({
        event: transferEvent,
        args: { from: normalizedAddress as `0x${string}` },
        fromBlock: chunkStart,
        toBlock: chunkEnd
      }),
      client.getLogs({
        event: transferEvent,
        args: { to: normalizedAddress as `0x${string}` },
        fromBlock: chunkStart,
        toBlock: chunkEnd
      })
    ]);
    collectedLogs.push(...sentLogs, ...receivedLogs);
  }

  const dedupedLogs = new Map<string, any>();
  for (const log of collectedLogs) {
    const key = `${log.transactionHash}:${log.logIndex}`;
    dedupedLogs.set(key, log);
  }
  const allLogs = [...dedupedLogs.values()].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.blockNumber !== b.blockNumber) {
      return Number(a.blockNumber! - b.blockNumber!);
    }
    return Number(a.transactionIndex! - b.transactionIndex!);
  });

  const logsByTx = new Map<string, typeof allLogs>();
  for (const log of allLogs) {
    const hash = log.transactionHash!;
    if (!logsByTx.has(hash)) {
      logsByTx.set(hash, []);
    }
    logsByTx.get(hash)!.push(log);
  }

  console.log(`[indexer] EVM backfill found ${logsByTx.size} unique transactions for ${normalizedAddress}`);

  let inserted = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  let latestBlockTime: number | null = null;
  let lastEventAt: Date | null = null;
  let sourceTradeFailure: SourceTradePersistenceError | null = null;

  const blockCache = new Map<bigint, number>();
  async function getBlockTimestamp(blockNumber: bigint) {
    if (blockCache.has(blockNumber)) return blockCache.get(blockNumber)!;
    const block = await client.getBlock({ blockNumber });
    const ts = Number(block.timestamp);
    blockCache.set(blockNumber, ts);
    return ts;
  }

  const BATCH_SIZE = Number(process.env.BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE ?? 5);
  const txHashes = Array.from(logsByTx.keys());

  for (let i = 0; i < txHashes.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = txHashes.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    
    await Promise.all(batch.map(async (hash) => {
      try {
        const txLogs = logsByTx.get(hash)!;
        const firstLog = txLogs[0];
        const blockNumber = firstLog.blockNumber!;
        const blockTime = await getBlockTimestamp(blockNumber);
        const timestamp = new Date(blockTime * 1000);
        if (!lastEventAt || timestamp > lastEventAt) lastEventAt = timestamp;

        const receipt = await client.getTransactionReceipt({ hash: hash as `0x${string}` });

        let reviewedRobinhoodSwap: RobinhoodClassifiedSwap | null = null;
        if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
          let ingestionConfig;
          try {
            ingestionConfig = parseRobinhoodIngestionConfig();
          } catch (error) {
            console.warn('[indexer] Robinhood reviewed router/pool configuration is unavailable:', error);
            skipped++;
            return;
          }
          const classification = classifyRobinhoodReceipt({
            status: receipt.status,
            from: receipt.from,
            to: receipt.to,
            transactionHash: hash,
            logs: receipt.logs.map((log) => ({
              address: log.address,
              data: log.data,
              topics: log.topics,
              logIndex: log.logIndex,
              transactionHash: log.transactionHash
            }))
          }, normalizedAddress, ingestionConfig);
          if (classification.status === 'rejected') {
            skipped++;
            return;
          }
          reviewedRobinhoodSwap = classification;
        }

        // Separate user's transfers
        const userSent: Array<{ token: string; amount: bigint; decimals: number; symbol: string; name: string }> = [];
        const userReceived: Array<{ token: string; amount: bigint; decimals: number; symbol: string; name: string }> = [];

        for (const log of txLogs) {
          const meta = await getEvmTokenMetadata(client, log.address, chain);
          if (!meta) continue;
          const amount = log.args.value ? BigInt(log.args.value) : 0n;
          const from = log.args.from?.toLowerCase();
          const to = log.args.to?.toLowerCase();
          if (from === normalizedAddress && to === normalizedAddress) continue;
          
          if (from === normalizedAddress) {
            userSent.push({ token: log.address.toLowerCase(), amount, ...meta });
          }
          if (to === normalizedAddress) {
            userReceived.push({ token: log.address.toLowerCase(), amount, ...meta });
          }
        }

        // Determine tokenIn, tokenOut, direction, targetToken
        let tokenIn = '';
        let tokenOut = '';
        let amountIn = '0';
        let amountOut = '0';
        let direction: 'buy' | 'sell' = 'buy';
        let targetToken = '';
        let targetDecimals: number | null = null;

        if (reviewedRobinhoodSwap) {
          tokenIn = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.tokenIn;
          tokenOut = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.tokenOut;
          amountIn = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.amountIn.toString();
          amountOut = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.amountOut.toString();
          direction = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.direction;
          targetToken = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.targetToken;
          const targetMetadata = await getEvmTokenMetadata(
            client,
            targetToken as `0x${string}`,
            chain
          );
          if (!targetMetadata) {
            skipped++;
            return;
          }
          targetDecimals = targetMetadata.decimals;
        } else if (userSent.length > 0 && userReceived.length > 0) {
          // Cross-token swap
          const sentBase = userSent.find(s => isBaseToken(s.token, s.symbol, chain));
          const receivedBase = userReceived.find(r => isBaseToken(r.token, r.symbol, chain));

          if (sentBase && !receivedBase) {
            // Sent base, received speculative => Buy
            const spec = userReceived[0];
            tokenIn = sentBase.token;
            tokenOut = spec.token;
            amountIn = sentBase.amount.toString();
            amountOut = spec.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'buy';
          } else if (!sentBase && receivedBase) {
            // Sent speculative, received base => Sell
            const spec = userSent[0];
            tokenIn = spec.token;
            tokenOut = receivedBase.token;
            amountIn = spec.amount.toString();
            amountOut = receivedBase.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'sell';
          } else {
            // Arbitrary swap
            const sent = userSent[0];
            const received = userReceived[0];
            tokenIn = sent.token;
            tokenOut = received.token;
            amountIn = sent.amount.toString();
            amountOut = received.amount.toString();
            targetToken = received.token;
            direction = 'buy';
          }
        } else if (userReceived.length > 0) {
          // Received token only, check for native value
          const spec = userReceived[0];
          const tx = await client.getTransaction({ hash: hash as `0x${string}` });
          if (tx.value > 0n) {
            tokenIn = NATIVE_TOKEN;
            tokenOut = spec.token;
            amountIn = tx.value.toString();
            amountOut = spec.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'buy';
          } else {
            // Airdrop or simple transfer
            tokenIn = NATIVE_TOKEN;
            tokenOut = spec.token;
            amountIn = '0';
            amountOut = spec.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'buy';
          }
        } else if (userSent.length > 0) {
          // Sent token only, check if they received base token (from receipt logs)
          const spec = userSent[0];
          
          let receivedBaseFromReceipt: { token: string; amount: bigint } | undefined;
          for (const log of receipt.logs) {
            // Check for Transfer log
            if (log.topics[0] === '0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef') {
              const toAddress = log.topics[2] ? '0x' + log.topics[2].substring(26) : '';
              if (toAddress.toLowerCase() === normalizedAddress) {
                const meta = await getEvmTokenMetadata(client, log.address, chain);
                if (!meta) continue;
                if (isBaseToken(log.address, meta.symbol, chain)) {
                  // Found the base transfer!
                  const amount = log.data ? BigInt(log.data) : 0n;
                  receivedBaseFromReceipt = { token: log.address.toLowerCase(), amount };
                  break;
                }
              }
            }
          }

          if (receivedBaseFromReceipt) {
            tokenIn = spec.token;
            tokenOut = receivedBaseFromReceipt.token;
            amountIn = spec.amount.toString();
            amountOut = receivedBaseFromReceipt.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'sell';
          } else {
            // Simple send
            tokenIn = spec.token;
            tokenOut = NATIVE_TOKEN;
            amountIn = spec.amount.toString();
            amountOut = '0';
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'sell';
          }
        } else {
          skipped++;
          return;
        }

        // Fetch target token USD price (from DexScreener if available)
        const targetPrice = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(
          prefixChainValue(targetToken, chain)
        ).catch(() => null);
        let amountInUsd: number | null = null;
        let amountOutUsd: number | null = null;

        if (targetPrice) {
          const specDecimals = targetDecimals ?? (direction === 'buy'
            ? (userReceived.find(r => r.token === targetToken)?.decimals ?? 18)
            : (userSent.find(s => s.token === targetToken)?.decimals ?? 18));
          
          const specAmount = direction === 'buy' ? amountOut : amountIn;
          const floatAmount = Number(BigInt(specAmount)) / (10 ** specDecimals);
          const usdVal = floatAmount * targetPrice;
          amountInUsd = usdVal;
          amountOutUsd = usdVal;
        }

        if (tokenIn === NATIVE_TOKEN || tokenOut === NATIVE_TOKEN) {
          await upsertToken(NATIVE_TOKEN, {
            chain,
            decimals: 18,
            symbol: chain === 'polygon' ? 'POL' : 'ETH',
            name: chain === 'polygon' ? 'Polygon' : 'Ether'
          });
        }

        const persisted = await insertParsedTransaction({
          signature: hash,
          chain,
          walletAddress: normalizedAddress,
          tokenIn,
          tokenOut,
          amountIn,
          amountOut,
          amountInUsd,
          amountOutUsd,
          direction,
          targetToken,
          programId: reviewedRobinhoodSwap ? 'uniswap-v3-reviewed' : 'uniswap',
          slot: Number(blockNumber),
          timestamp,
          blockTime
        });

        const walletTargetQuantity = (direction === 'buy' ? userReceived : userSent)
          .filter((transfer) => transfer.token === targetToken)
          .reduce((total, transfer) => total + transfer.amount, 0n);
        if (reviewedRobinhoodSwap && walletTargetQuantity <= 0n) {
          throw new Error('Reviewed Robinhood swap has no target-token wallet transfer');
        }
        const sourceTrade = reviewedRobinhoodSwap
          ? await persistRobinhoodSourceTrade({
            transactionHash: hash,
            walletAddress: normalizedAddress,
            tokenMint: targetToken,
            side: direction,
            quantity: walletTargetQuantity.toString(),
            eventAt: timestamp,
            blockNumber
          })
          : null;

        if (persisted) {
          inserted++;
          if (!latestBlockTime || blockTime > latestBlockTime) {
            latestBlockTime = blockTime;
          }

          await updateTokenLaunchTimestamp(targetToken, timestamp, chain);

          // Publish Swap event to Redis
          await publish(
            REDIS_CHANNELS.walletSwap,
            JSON.stringify({
              chain,
              walletAddress: prefixChainValue(normalizedAddress, chain),
              signature: hash,
              sourceTradeId: sourceTrade?.event.id,
              tokenMint: prefixChainValue(targetToken, chain),
              direction,
              amountUsd: amountInUsd,
              timestamp: timestamp.toISOString()
            })
          );
        } else {
          skipped++;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[indexer] Failed to process EVM transaction ${hash}:`, err);
        failed++;
        if (err instanceof SourceTradePersistenceError) {
          sourceTradeFailure ??= err;
        }
      }
    }));
  }

  const result = {
    fetched: txHashes.length,
    inserted,
    skipped,
    failed,
    lastEventAt
  };

  try {
    await refreshWalletActivity(
      prefixChainValue(normalizedAddress, chain),
      latestBlockTime ? new Date(latestBlockTime * 1000) : null,
      inserted
    );
  } catch (error) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Failed to refresh ${chain} wallet activity for ${normalizedAddress}`,
      { ...result, failed: result.failed + 1 },
      { cause: error }
    );
  }
  if (sourceTradeFailure) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Canonical ${chain} source-trade persistence failed for ${normalizedAddress}`,
      result,
      { cause: sourceTradeFailure }
    );
  }
  return result;
}

/**
 * Discover and seed early & big buyers of an EVM ERC-20 token on Robinhood Chain or Polygon.
 */
export async function discoverFromEvmToken(
  tokenAddress: string,
  chain: 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain',
  dependencies: EvmBackfillDependencies & { backfillQueue?: Queue } = {}
): Promise<{ earlyBuyers: number; bigBuyers: number; scanned: number }> {
  const normalizedAddress = resolveChainValue(tokenAddress, chain).raw.toLowerCase() as `0x${string}`;
  const client = dependencies.client ?? getPublicClient(chain);
  const currentBlock = await client.getBlockNumber();
  const blockWindow = BigInt(process.env.EVM_BACKFILL_BLOCKS ?? '100000');
  const logChunkSize = BigInt(process.env.EVM_LOG_CHUNK_SIZE ?? '2000');
  const fromBlock = currentBlock - blockWindow > 0n ? currentBlock - blockWindow : 0n;

  // Metadata retrieval & caching
  try {
    await getEvmTokenMetadata(client, normalizedAddress, chain);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[indexer] Failed to fetch EVM token metadata for ${normalizedAddress} on ${chain}:`, err);
  }

  console.log(`[indexer] EVM token discovery querying Transfer logs for ${normalizedAddress} on ${chain} from block ${fromBlock}`);

  const transferEvent = parseAbiItem('event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)');
  const collectedLogs: any[] = [];
  for (let chunkStart = fromBlock; chunkStart <= currentBlock; chunkStart += logChunkSize) {
    const chunkEnd = chunkStart + logChunkSize - 1n > currentBlock
      ? currentBlock
      : chunkStart + logChunkSize - 1n;
    try {
      const logs = await client.getLogs({
        address: normalizedAddress,
        event: transferEvent,
        fromBlock: chunkStart,
        toBlock: chunkEnd
      });
      collectedLogs.push(...logs);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[indexer] EVM token discovery chunk failed (${chunkStart}-${chunkEnd}):`, err);
    }
  }

  // Aggregate per buyer: earliest blockNumber + total base units acquired
  type Agg = { earliestBlock: bigint; amount: bigint };
  const buyers = new Map<string, Agg>();

  for (const log of collectedLogs) {
    const to = (log.args?.to as string | undefined)?.toLowerCase();
    const value = log.args?.value as bigint | undefined;
    if (!to || !value || to === NATIVE_TOKEN || to === normalizedAddress) continue;
    if (to === '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000') continue;

    const blockNum = log.blockNumber ?? currentBlock;
    const cur = buyers.get(to);
    if (cur) {
      cur.amount += value;
      if (blockNum < cur.earliestBlock) cur.earliestBlock = blockNum;
    } else {
      buyers.set(to, { earliestBlock: blockNum, amount: value });
    }
  }

  const entries = Array.from(buyers.entries());
  const byEarliest = [...entries].sort((a, b) => (a[1].earliestBlock < b[1].earliestBlock ? -1 : a[1].earliestBlock > b[1].earliestBlock ? 1 : 0));
  const early = byEarliest.slice(0, 40).map(([owner]) => owner);
  const earlySet = new Set(early);

  const byAmount = [...entries]
    .filter(([owner]) => !earlySet.has(owner))
    .sort((a, b) => (b[1].amount > a[1].amount ? -1 : b[1].amount < a[1].amount ? 1 : 0));
  const big = byAmount.slice(0, 10).map(([owner]) => owner);

  const targetQueue = dependencies.backfillQueue ?? new Queue(QUEUES.walletBackfill, { connection: redis });

  for (const owner of early) {
    await upsertWallet({ address: owner, chain, source: 'discovered', discoveryMethod: 'token-early' });
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(owner, chain);
    await targetQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }
  for (const owner of big) {
    await upsertWallet({ address: owner, chain, source: 'discovered', discoveryMethod: 'token-big' });
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(owner, chain);
    await targetQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }

  await logDiscoveryRun('token', normalizedAddress, early.length + big.length);
  await redis.publish(REDIS_CHANNELS.clusterRefresh, JSON.stringify({ reason: 'token-discovery', mint: normalizedAddress, chain }));

  console.log(`[indexer] EVM token ${normalizedAddress} on ${chain}: seeded ${early.length} early + ${big.length} big buyers from ${buyers.size} candidates`);
  return { earlyBuyers: early.length, bigBuyers: big.length, scanned: collectedLogs.length };
}

import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { Queue, QueueEvents, Worker, type Job } from 'bullmq';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import {
  closePool,
  insertParsedTransaction,
  query,
  refreshWalletActivity,
  upsertToken,
  upsertWallet
} from '@swat/db';
import {
  createWalletBackfillJob,
  QUEUES,
  resolveChainAddress,
  resolveChainValue,
  type Chain
} from '@swat/shared';
import { createWalletBackfillProcessor } from './backfill-worker.js';
import type { IngestionBatchResult } from './ingestion-health.js';

const BASE58_ALPHABET = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';

function encodeBase58(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let value = BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(bytes).toString('hex')}`);
  let encoded = '';
  while (value > 0n) {
    encoded = BASE58_ALPHABET[Number(value % 58n)] + encoded;
    value /= 58n;
  }
  for (const byte of bytes) {
    if (byte !== 0) break;
    encoded = `1${encoded}`;
  }
  return encoded || '1';
}

type Fixture = {
  chain: Chain;
  address: string;
  signature: string;
  tokenIn: string;
  tokenOut: string;
  targetToken: string;
};

function createFixtures(runId: string): Fixture[] {
  const evmAddress = () => `0x${randomBytes(20).toString('hex')}`;
  return [
    {
      chain: 'solana',
      address: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      signature: `${runId}-solana`,
      tokenIn: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      tokenOut: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      targetToken: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32))
    },
    {
      chain: 'polygon',
      address: evmAddress(),
      signature: `${runId}-polygon`,
      tokenIn: evmAddress(),
      tokenOut: evmAddress(),
      targetToken: evmAddress()
    },
    {
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      address: evmAddress(),
      signature: `${runId}-robinhood`,
      tokenIn: evmAddress(),
      tokenOut: evmAddress(),
      targetToken: evmAddress()
    }
  ];
}

export async function runG0D11Acceptance(): Promise<void> {
  const runId = `g0d11-${Date.now()}-${randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
  const fixtures = createFixtures(runId);
  const fixtureByWallet = new Map(
    fixtures.map((fixture) => [`${fixture.chain}:${fixture.address.toLowerCase()}`, fixture])
  );
  const executionCounts = new Map<Chain, number>();
  const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
  const queueName = `${QUEUES.walletBackfill}-acceptance-${runId}`;
  const queueConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const eventsConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const workerConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const queue = new Queue(queueName, { connection: queueConnection });
  const queueEvents = new QueueEvents(queueName, { connection: eventsConnection });
  let worker: Worker | null = null;
  const jobs: Job[] = [];
  let passSummary: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
  let primaryError: unknown;

  const backfillFixture = async (address: string, chain: Chain): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> => {
    const fixture = fixtureByWallet.get(`${chain}:${address.toLowerCase()}`);
    if (!fixture) throw new Error(`No ${chain} acceptance fixture for ${address}`);
    executionCounts.set(chain, (executionCounts.get(chain) ?? 0) + 1);

    await Promise.all([
      upsertToken(fixture.tokenIn, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0IN' }),
      upsertToken(fixture.tokenOut, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0OUT' }),
      upsertToken(fixture.targetToken, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0TARGET' })
    ]);
    const eventAt = new Date();
    const inserted = await insertParsedTransaction({
      chain,
      signature: fixture.signature,
      walletAddress: fixture.address,
      tokenIn: fixture.tokenIn,
      tokenOut: fixture.tokenOut,
      amountIn: '1000000',
      amountOut: '2000000',
      amountInUsd: 1,
      amountOutUsd: 2,
      direction: 'buy',
      targetToken: fixture.targetToken,
      programId: 'g0-d11-fixture',
      timestamp: eventAt,
      blockTime: Math.floor(eventAt.getTime() / 1000)
    });
    await refreshWalletActivity(
      resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, chain).prefixed,
      eventAt,
      inserted ? 1 : 0
    );
    return {
      fetched: 1,
      inserted: inserted ? 1 : 0,
      skipped: inserted ? 0 : 1,
      failed: 0,
      lastEventAt: eventAt
    };
  };

  try {
    await queueEvents.waitUntilReady();
    const [existingWorkers, existingJobs] = await Promise.all([
      queue.getWorkers(),
      queue.getJobs(['active', 'waiting', 'delayed', 'prioritized', 'waiting-children'])
    ]);
    if (existingWorkers.length > 0 || existingJobs.length > 0) {
      const jobSummary = await Promise.all(existingJobs.map(async (job) => ({
        id: job.id,
        state: await job.getState()
      })));
      throw new Error(
        `Backfill queue is not isolated: ${JSON.stringify({
          workers: existingWorkers.map((workerInfo) => ({
            id: workerInfo.id,
            name: workerInfo.name
          })),
          jobs: jobSummary
        })}`
      );
    }

    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      await upsertWallet({
        address: fixture.address,
        chain: fixture.chain,
        source: 'discovered',
        discoveryMethod: 'g0-d11-acceptance'
      });
      const spec = createWalletBackfillJob(fixture.address, fixture.chain);
      const first = await queue.add(spec.name, spec.data, spec.options);
      const duplicate = await queue.add(spec.name, spec.data, spec.options);
      if (first.id !== spec.options.jobId || duplicate.id !== first.id) {
        throw new Error(`Queue did not deduplicate ${fixture.chain} job ${spec.options.jobId}`);
      }
      jobs.push(first);
    }

    const queuedIds = new Set(
      (await queue.getJobs(['waiting', 'prioritized'])).map((job) => job.id)
    );
    if (queuedIds.size !== jobs.length || jobs.some((job) => !queuedIds.has(job.id))) {
      throw new Error(`Expected ${jobs.length} unique queued jobs before worker startup`);
    }

    const waits = jobs.map((job) => job.waitUntilFinished(queueEvents, 30_000));
    const processor = createWalletBackfillProcessor({
      backfillSolana: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'solana'),
      backfillPolygon: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'polygon'),
      backfillRobinhood: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'robinhood-chain'),
      recordBatch: async () => {},
      sourceForChain: (chain) => `g0-d11-acceptance-${chain}`
    });
    worker = new Worker(queueName, processor, {
      connection: workerConnection,
      concurrency: 1
    });
    await worker.waitUntilReady();
    const results = await Promise.all(waits);

    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      if (executionCounts.get(fixture.chain) !== 1) {
        throw new Error(`${fixture.chain} fixture executed ${executionCounts.get(fixture.chain) ?? 0} times`);
      }
    }
    if (results.some((result) => result.inserted !== 1 || result.failed !== 0)) {
      throw new Error(`Backfill results were not successful: ${JSON.stringify(results)}`);
    }

    const signatures = fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.signature);
    const transactions = await query<{
      chain: Chain;
      signature: string;
      wallet_address: string;
    }>(
      `SELECT chain, signature, wallet_address
         FROM transactions
        WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])
        ORDER BY chain`,
      [signatures]
    );
    if (transactions.length !== fixtures.length) {
      throw new Error(`Expected ${fixtures.length} transaction rows, found ${transactions.length}`);
    }
    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      const expectedWallet = resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, fixture.chain).prefixed;
      const transaction = transactions.find((row) => row.signature === fixture.signature);
      if (transaction?.chain !== fixture.chain || transaction.wallet_address !== expectedWallet) {
        throw new Error(`Transaction identity mismatch for ${fixture.chain}`);
      }
    }

    passSummary = {
      runId,
      queueName,
      deduplicatedJobs: jobs.map((job) => job.id),
      transactions: transactions.map((row) => ({
        chain: row.chain,
        signature: row.signature,
        walletAddress: row.wallet_address
      }))
    };
  } catch (error) {
    primaryError = error;
  }

  const cleanupErrors: Error[] = [];
  const cleanupStep = async (label: string, action: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      await action();
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupErrors.push(new Error(`G0-D11 cleanup failed: ${label}`, { cause: error }));
    }
  };

  await cleanupStep('close worker', async () => {
    await worker?.close();
  });
  await cleanupStep('obliterate isolated queue', async () => {
    await queue.obliterate({ force: true });
  });

  const signatures = fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.signature);
  const tokenMints = fixtures.flatMap((fixture) => [
    resolveChainValue(fixture.tokenIn, fixture.chain).prefixed,
    resolveChainValue(fixture.tokenOut, fixture.chain).prefixed,
    resolveChainValue(fixture.targetToken, fixture.chain).prefixed
  ]);
  const walletAddresses = fixtures.map((fixture) =>
    resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, fixture.chain).prefixed
  );
  await cleanupStep('delete transaction fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM transactions WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])', [signatures]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('delete token fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM tokens WHERE mint = ANY($1::varchar[])', [tokenMints]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('delete wallet fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM wallets WHERE address = ANY($1::varchar[])', [walletAddresses]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('verify database fixture cleanup', async () => {
    const [counts] = await query<{
      transaction_count: string;
      token_count: string;
      wallet_count: string;
    }>(
      `SELECT
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])) AS transaction_count,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tokens WHERE mint = ANY($2::varchar[])) AS token_count,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallets WHERE address = ANY($3::varchar[])) AS wallet_count`,
      [signatures, tokenMints, walletAddresses]
    );
    if (
      !counts
      || Number(counts.transaction_count) !== 0
      || Number(counts.token_count) !== 0
      || Number(counts.wallet_count) !== 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Fixture rows remain after cleanup: ${JSON.stringify(counts)}`);
    }
  });
  await cleanupStep('close queue events', () => queueEvents.close());
  await cleanupStep('close queue', () => queue.close());
  await cleanupStep('close queue Redis connection', () => queueConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close event Redis connection', () => eventsConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close worker Redis connection', () => workerConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close PostgreSQL pool', () => closePool());

  const errors = [primaryError, ...cleanupErrors].filter((error) => error !== undefined);
  if (errors.length === 1) throw errors[0];
  if (errors.length > 1) {
    throw new AggregateError(errors, 'G0-D11 acceptance and cleanup encountered multiple failures');
  }

  console.log('[G0-D11] PASS', JSON.stringify(passSummary));
}

export async function ingestWallets(input: Array<{ address: string; chain?: WalletChain; source?: 'shiller' | 'manual' | 'discovered'; nickname?: string }>) {
  const parsed = input.map((wallet) => walletInputSchema.safeParse(wallet));
  const valid = parsed.filter((p): p is { success: true; data: { address: string; chain: WalletChain; source: 'shiller' | 'manual' | 'discovered'; nickname?: string } } => p.success).map((p) => p.data);

  for (const wallet of valid) {
    await upsertWallet(wallet);
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(wallet.address, wallet.chain);
    await backfillQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }

  return { accepted: valid.length, rejected: parsed.length - valid.length };
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Helius RPC helpers ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

type HeliusSignature = { signature: string; slot: number; blockTime?: number };

const HELIUS_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS = Number(process.env.HELIUS_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS ?? 15000);
const HELIUS_MAX_RETRIES = Number(process.env.HELIUS_MAX_RETRIES ?? 5);

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

async function heliusRpc<T>(method: string, params: unknown[]): Promise<T> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) throw new Error('HELIUS_API_KEY is not set');

  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
    // Without a timeout a single stalled request hangs the whole backfill batch
    // (Promise.all never settles). Abort slow requests so they fail fast.
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), HELIUS_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS);
    let response: Response;
    try {
      response = await fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: method, method, params }),
        signal: controller.signal
      });
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }

    // Back off and retry on rate limits (429) and transient 5xx ‚Äî the Helius
    // free tier throttles aggressively during bulk backfills.
    if ((response.status === 429 || response.status >= 500) && attempt < HELIUS_MAX_RETRIES) {
      const retryAfter = Number(response.headers.get('retry-after')) * 1000;
      const backoff = Number.isFinite(retryAfter) && retryAfter > 0 ? retryAfter : 500 * 2 ** attempt;
      await sleep(backoff);
      continue;
    }

    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Helius RPC failed: ${response.status}`);

    const json = (await response.json()) as { result?: T; error?: { message?: string } };
    if (json.error) throw new Error(`Helius RPC error (${method}): ${json.error.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
    return json.result as T;
  }
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Token metadata fetcher ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

async function fetchTokenMintInfo(mint: string): Promise<{ decimals: number; mintAuthorityDisabled: boolean; freezeAuthorityDisabled: boolean } | null> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) return null;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        jsonrpc: '2.0',
        id: 'getMintInfo',
        method: 'getAccountInfo',
        params: [mint, { encoding: 'jsonParsed' }]
      })
    });
    if (!response.ok) return null;
    const json = await response.json() as any;
    const info = json.result?.value?.data?.parsed?.info;
    if (!info) return null;
    return {
      decimals: info.decimals ?? 9,
      mintAuthorityDisabled: info.mintAuthority === null,
      freezeAuthorityDisabled: info.freezeAuthority === null
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function extractProgramId(tx: HeliusParsedTransaction): string | null {
  const instructions = tx.transaction?.message?.instructions ?? [];
  const ids = instructions
    .map((i) => i.programId)
    .filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string');

  return ids.find((id) => SWAP_PROGRAM_IDS.has(id)) ?? ids[0] ?? null;
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ SOL Price Cache ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

async function getCachedSolPrice(): Promise<number | null> {
  const cached = await redis.get('sol:price');
  if (cached) {
    const p = parseFloat(cached);
    if (Number.isFinite(p)) return p;
  }

  // Negative cache: if the price lookup just failed (e.g. APIs unreachable), a
  // marker is set for a short window so we don't re-hit the network ‚Äî and
  // re-log the failure ‚Äî on every single transaction in a backfill batch.
  if (await redis.get('sol:price:fail')) return null;

  // Do NOT fabricate a fallback price ‚Äî a wrong SOL price silently corrupts every
  // SOL-leg trade's USD value (and gets cached for 30s). Return null on failure
  // and only cache a real price.
  const price = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(SOL_MINT);
  if (price === null || !Number.isFinite(price)) {
    await redis.setex('sol:price:fail', 15, '1');
    return null;
  }
  await redis.setex('sol:price', 30, price.toString());
  return price;
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ USD Enrichment ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

async function enrichTransactionUsd(
  tokenIn: string,
  tokenOut: string,
  amountInStr: string,
  amountOutStr: string,
  targetToken: string
): Promise<{ amountInUsd: number | null; amountOutUsd: number | null }> {
  const solPrice = await getCachedSolPrice();

  // SOL ‚Üí token (buy) or token ‚Üí SOL (sell) ‚Äî both legs measured in SOL.
  // If the SOL price is unavailable, leave USD null rather than fabricating it.
  if (tokenIn === SOL_MINT) {
    if (solPrice === null) return { amountInUsd: null, amountOutUsd: null };
    const amountInUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountInStr, 9) * solPrice;
    return { amountInUsd, amountOutUsd: amountInUsd };
  }
  if (tokenOut === SOL_MINT) {
    if (solPrice === null) return { amountInUsd: null, amountOutUsd: null };
    const amountOutUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountOutStr, 9) * solPrice;
    return { amountInUsd: amountOutUsd, amountOutUsd };
  }

  // USDC-denominated pairs
  if (tokenIn === USDC_MINT) {
    const amountInUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountInStr, 6);
    return { amountInUsd, amountOutUsd: amountInUsd };
  }
  if (tokenOut === USDC_MINT) {
    const amountOutUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountOutStr, 6);
    return { amountInUsd: amountOutUsd, amountOutUsd };
  }

  // Token-to-token swaps (Jupiter routed) ‚Äî use target token price + known decimals
  const targetPrice = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(targetToken);
  if (targetPrice) {
    // Decimals must be known: applying the wrong scale (e.g. defaulting 9-decimal
    // tokens to 6) produces a 1000x-wrong USD value. If we don't know the
    // decimals, leave USD null rather than recording a fabricated number ‚Äî the
    // backfill-usd pass can fill it once the token's decimals are populated.
    const decimals = await getTokenDecimals(targetToken);
    if (decimals === null) return { amountInUsd: null, amountOutUsd: null };

    // Determine which side is the target
    if (targetToken === tokenOut) {
      const amountUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountOutStr, decimals) * targetPrice;
      return { amountInUsd: amountUsd, amountOutUsd: amountUsd };
    } else {
      const amountUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(amountInStr, decimals) * targetPrice;
      return { amountInUsd: amountUsd, amountOutUsd: amountUsd };
    }
  }

  return { amountInUsd: null, amountOutUsd: null };
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Process Single Transaction (shared by backfill + webhook) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

export async function processTransaction(
  tx: HeliusParsedTransaction,
  address: string,
  source: SolanaIngestionSource = 'solana-backfill'
): Promise<'inserted' | 'skipped'> {
  const canonicalEvent = parseCanonicalSolanaSwapEvent(tx, address);
  if (!canonicalEvent) return 'skipped';
  const parsed = canonicalEvent;
  const signature = canonicalEvent.transactionIdentity;

  // Upsert both tokens ‚Äî fetch mint info for target token to populate safety data
  const [, , targetMintInfo] = await Promise.all([
    upsertToken(parsed.tokenIn),
    upsertToken(parsed.tokenOut),
    fetchTokenMintInfo(parsed.targetToken)
  ]);

  await upsertToken(parsed.targetToken, targetMintInfo ? {
    decimals: targetMintInfo.decimals,
    mintAuthorityDisabled: targetMintInfo.mintAuthorityDisabled,
    freezeAuthorityDisabled: targetMintInfo.freezeAuthorityDisabled
  } : undefined);

  const blockTime = tx.blockTime!;
  const timestamp = canonicalEvent.occurredAt;

  const { amountInUsd, amountOutUsd } = await enrichTransactionUsd(
    parsed.tokenIn,
    parsed.tokenOut,
    parsed.amountIn,
    parsed.amountOut,
    parsed.targetToken
  );

  const persisted = await insertParsedTransaction({
    signature,
    walletAddress: address,
    tokenIn: parsed.tokenIn,
    tokenOut: parsed.tokenOut,
    amountIn: parsed.amountIn,
    amountOut: parsed.amountOut,
    amountInUsd,
    amountOutUsd,
    direction: parsed.direction,
    targetToken: parsed.targetToken,
    programId: extractProgramId(tx),
    slot: tx.slot ?? null,
    timestamp,
    blockTime
  });

  const sourceTrade = await persistSolanaSourceTrade({
    event: canonicalEvent,
    source
  });

  if (persisted) {
    // Record earliest-seen time for the traded token (powers early-entry score)
    // and any SOL-funding edges observed in this transaction.
    await updateTokenLaunchTimestamp(parsed.targetToken, timestamp);
    await recordFundingEdges(tx);

    await redis.publish(
      REDIS_CHANNELS.walletSwap,
      JSON.stringify({
        chain: 'solana',
        walletAddress: prefixChainValue(address, 'solana'),
        signature,
        sourceTradeId: sourceTrade.event.id,
        tokenMint: prefixChainValue(parsed.targetToken, 'solana'),
        direction: parsed.direction,
        amountUsd: amountInUsd,
        timestamp: timestamp.toISOString()
      })
    );
  }

  return persisted ? 'inserted' : 'skipped';
}

/**
 * Persist any meaningful SOL transfers in this transaction as funding edges.
 * Best-effort: failures are logged but never block ingestion.
 */
async function recordFundingEdges(tx: HeliusParsedTransaction) {
  const transfers = extractFundingTransfers(tx);
  for (const t of transfers) {
    try {
      await recordFundingEdge(t.source, t.destination, t.lamports);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[indexer] failed to record funding edge', error);
    }
  }
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ On-chain token discovery ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

// How many signatures, from the OLDEST (launch) forward, to scan for buyers.
const TOKEN_DISCOVERY_WINDOW = Number(process.env.TOKEN_DISCOVERY_WINDOW ?? 5000);
// Hard cap on total signatures paged while walking back to the launch, so a
// hyper-active token can't make us page forever. If we hit this before reaching
// the genesis the launch time is best-effort (logged).
const TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES = Number(process.env.TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES ?? 20000);
// 40 earliest big buyers (kept unconditionally) + 10 biggest buyers (profit-gated
// later by the scorer's pruneUnprofitableBigBuyers).
const EARLY_BUYER_SLOTS = Number(process.env.EARLY_BUYER_SLOTS ?? 40);
const BIG_BUYER_SLOTS = Number(process.env.BIG_BUYER_SLOTS ?? 10);

const SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID_OWNER = '11111111111111111111111111111111';

// Owners that are never real trader wallets ‚Äî the mint itself and the swap
// programs. Pool/vault accounts can still slip through; the backfill+scoring
// pass and the token-big profit prune filter those out downstream.
function isDiscardableOwner(owner: string, mint: string): boolean {
  return owner === mint || SWAP_PROGRAM_IDS.has(owner) || owner === SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID_OWNER;
}

/**
 * Discover and seed a token's early & biggest buyers from on-chain history.
 *
 * 1. Page `getSignaturesForAddress(mint)` back to the launch (bounded by a safety
 *    cap), reverse to chronological order, take the first `TOKEN_DISCOVERY_WINDOW`
 *    signatures from launch forward.
 * 2. Fetch those txs, and for each gather the accounts that net-gained the mint
 *    (`extractTokenBuyers`). Aggregate per owner: earliest buy time + total base
 *    units acquired.
 * 3. Take the 40 EARLIEST distinct buyers (`token-early`, kept unconditionally)
 *    and, from the rest, the 10 LARGEST by acquired amount (`token-big`,
 *    profit-gated later). Upsert each and enqueue a normal history backfill so the
 *    scorer can score/cluster them like any other wallet.
 */
export async function discoverFromToken(mint: string) {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) {
    console.warn('[indexer] skipping token discovery: HELIUS_API_KEY is not set');
    return { earlyBuyers: 0, bigBuyers: 0, scanned: 0 };
  }

  // ‚îÄ‚îÄ 1. Walk signatures back to the launch ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
  const all: HeliusSignature[] = [];
  let before: string | undefined;
  let cappedOut = false;
  while (all.length < TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES) {
    const page = await heliusRpc<HeliusSignature[]>('getSignaturesForAddress', [
      mint,
      before ? { limit: 1000, before } : { limit: 1000 }
    ]);
    if (page.length === 0) break;
    all.push(...page);
    before = page[page.length - 1].signature;
    if (page.length < 1000) break; // reached the genesis of this account
    await sleep(150); // gentle pacing
  }
  if (all.length >= TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES) {
    cappedOut = true;
    console.warn(`[indexer] token ${mint}: hit signature cap (${TOKEN_DISCOVERY_MAX_TOTAL_SIGNATURES}); launch detection best-effort`);
  }
  if (all.length === 0) {
    console.warn(`[indexer] token ${mint}: no signatures found`);
    return { earlyBuyers: 0, bigBuyers: 0, scanned: 0 };
  }

  // Oldest-first. getSignaturesForAddress returns newest‚Üíoldest within a page and
  // we paged from newest‚Üíoldest, so the global ordering is already newest‚Üíoldest.
  // Reversing ensures intra-slot order is oldest‚Üínewest.
  all.reverse();
  all.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.blockTime != null && b.blockTime != null && a.blockTime !== b.blockTime) {
      return a.blockTime - b.blockTime;
    }
    return a.slot - b.slot;
  });
  const window = all.slice(0, TOKEN_DISCOVERY_WINDOW);
  const launchBlockTime = window[0]?.blockTime;

  // Ensure the token row + decimals exist so USD math elsewhere works, and record
  // the launch time (LEAST ‚Üí only moves earlier).
  const mintInfo = await fetchTokenMintInfo(mint);
  await upsertToken(mint, mintInfo ? { decimals: mintInfo.decimals } : undefined);
  if (launchBlockTime) await updateTokenLaunchTimestamp(mint, new Date(launchBlockTime * 1000));

  console.log(`[indexer] token ${mint}: scanning ${window.length}/${all.length} sigs from launch${cappedOut ? ' (capped)' : ''}`);

  // ‚îÄ‚îÄ 2. Fetch the window's transactions and aggregate buyers ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
  type Agg = { earliest: number; amount: bigint };
  const buyers = new Map<string, Agg>();
  const sigList = window.map((s) => s.signature);
  const BATCH = Number(process.env.BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE ?? 5);
  for (let i = 0; i < sigList.length; i += BATCH) {
    if (i > 0) await sleep(150);
    const batch = sigList.slice(i, i + BATCH);
    const results = await Promise.all(
      batch.map((sig) =>
        heliusRpc<HeliusParsedTransaction | null>('getTransaction', [
          sig,
          { maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0, commitment: 'confirmed', encoding: 'jsonParsed' }
        ]).catch(() => null)
      )
    );
    for (const tx of results) {
      if (!tx?.blockTime) continue;
      for (const buyer of extractTokenBuyers(tx, mint)) {
        if (isDiscardableOwner(buyer.owner, mint)) continue;
        const cur = buyers.get(buyer.owner);
        if (cur) {
          cur.amount += buyer.amount;
          if (tx.blockTime < cur.earliest) cur.earliest = tx.blockTime;
        } else {
          buyers.set(buyer.owner, { earliest: tx.blockTime, amount: buyer.amount });
        }
      }
    }
    if ((i / BATCH) % 20 === 0) console.log(`[indexer] token ${mint}: scanned ${Math.min(i + BATCH, sigList.length)}/${sigList.length}`);
  }

  // ‚îÄ‚îÄ 3. Allocate slots: 40 earliest, then 10 biggest of the rest ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
  const entries = Array.from(buyers.entries()); // [owner, Agg]
  const byEarliest = [...entries].sort((a, b) => a[1].earliest - b[1].earliest);
  const early = byEarliest.slice(0, EARLY_BUYER_SLOTS).map(([owner]) => owner);
  const earlySet = new Set(early);

  const byAmount = [...entries]
    .filter(([owner]) => !earlySet.has(owner))
    .sort((a, b) => (b[1].amount > a[1].amount ? 1 : b[1].amount < a[1].amount ? -1 : 0));
  const big = byAmount.slice(0, BIG_BUYER_SLOTS).map(([owner]) => owner);

  // ‚îÄ‚îÄ 4. Seed wallets + enqueue history backfill ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
  for (const owner of early) {
    await upsertWallet({ address: owner, chain: 'solana', source: 'discovered', discoveryMethod: 'token-early' });
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(owner, 'solana');
    await backfillQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }
  for (const owner of big) {
    await upsertWallet({ address: owner, chain: 'solana', source: 'discovered', discoveryMethod: 'token-big' });
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(owner, 'solana');
    await backfillQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }

  await logDiscoveryRun('token', mint, early.length + big.length);
  // Tell the scorer to (re)cluster once backfills settle; the profit prune runs
  // there too. Best-effort ‚Äî the nightly batch would pick it up regardless.
  await redis.publish(REDIS_CHANNELS.clusterRefresh, JSON.stringify({ reason: 'token-discovery', mint }));

  console.log(`[indexer] token ${mint}: seeded ${early.length} early + ${big.length} big buyers from ${buyers.size} candidates`);
  return { earlyBuyers: early.length, bigBuyers: big.length, scanned: window.length };
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Backfill ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

export async function backfillWallet(address: string): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) {
    throw new Error('HELIUS_API_KEY is not set');
  }

  const sigLimit = clampInteger(
    process.env.BACKFILL_SIGNATURE_LIMIT,
    1000,
    1,
    1000
  );
  const signatures = await heliusRpc<HeliusSignature[]>('getSignaturesForAddress', [address, { limit: sigLimit }]);
  if (signatures.length === 0) {
    await refreshWalletActivity(address.includes(':') ? address : `solana:${address}`, null, 0);
    return {
      fetched: 0,
      inserted: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      failed: 0,
      lastEventAt: null
    };
  }

  const signatureList = signatures.map((s) => s.signature);
  console.log(`[indexer] fetching ${signatureList.length} transactions for ${address}`);
  // Solana JSON-RPC has no `getParsedTransactions` (plural) method ‚Äî Helius
  // replies "Method not found". Fetch each signature with `getTransaction`
  // (jsonParsed), in bounded-concurrency batches to respect rate limits.
  const txs: Array<HeliusParsedTransaction | null | undefined> = [];
  let failed = 0;
  const BATCH = Number(process.env.BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE ?? 5);
  for (let i = 0; i < signatureList.length; i += BATCH) {
    if (i > 0) await sleep(150); // gentle pacing to stay under rate limits
    const batch = signatureList.slice(i, i + BATCH);
    const results = await Promise.all(
      batch.map((sig) =>
        heliusRpc<HeliusParsedTransaction | null>('getTransaction', [
          sig,
          { maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 0, commitment: 'confirmed', encoding: 'jsonParsed' }
        ]).catch((err) => {
          console.warn(`[indexer] getTransaction failed for ${sig}:`, err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
          failed++;
          return undefined;
        })
      )
    );
    txs.push(...results);
    console.log(`[indexer] ${address}: fetched ${txs.length}/${signatureList.length}`);
  }

  let inserted = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let latestBlockTime: number | null = null;
  let lastEventAt: Date | null = null;
  let sourceTradeFailure: SourceTradePersistenceError | null = null;

  for (const tx of txs) {
    if (tx === undefined) continue;
    if (tx === null) {
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }
    if (tx.blockTime) {
      const eventAt = new Date(tx.blockTime * 1000);
      if (!lastEventAt || eventAt > lastEventAt) lastEventAt = eventAt;
    }

    try {
      const result = await processTransaction(tx, address);
      if (result === 'inserted') {
        inserted++;
        if (tx.blockTime && (!latestBlockTime || tx.blockTime > latestBlockTime)) {
          latestBlockTime = tx.blockTime;
        }
      } else {
        skipped++;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      failed++;
      if (error instanceof SourceTradePersistenceError) {
        sourceTradeFailure ??= error;
      }
      console.warn(
        `[indexer] failed to process Solana transaction ${tx.transaction?.signatures?.[0] ?? 'unknown'}:`,
        error
      );
    }
  }

  const result = {
    fetched: signatureList.length,
    inserted,
    skipped,
    failed,
    lastEventAt
  };

  try {
    await refreshWalletActivity(
      address.includes(':') ? address : `solana:${address}`,
      latestBlockTime ? new Date(latestBlockTime * 1000) : null,
      inserted
    );
  } catch (error) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Failed to refresh Solana wallet activity for ${address}`,
      { ...result, failed: result.failed + 1 },
      { cause: error }
    );
  }
  if (sourceTradeFailure) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Canonical Solana source-trade persistence failed for ${address}`,
      result,
      { cause: sourceTradeFailure }
    );
  }
  return result;
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Polymarket order-book feed (S4-M38) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

/**
 * Streams Polymarket order books into Redis so `signal-engine` can gate fan-out
 * on real depth before admitting copiers.
 *
 * **Why this lives here.** The book is the only honest liquidity figure for a
 * Polymarket outcome share ‚Äî it trades on Polymarket's own CLOB, not a DEX pair,
 * so DexScreener TVL is either absent or belongs to an unrelated Polygon pair.
 * Without this feed every polygon cohort reads `capacity-unknown` and nobody
 * copies a Polymarket signal.
 *
 * **Failure is bounded on purpose.** Everything below degrades rather than
 * throws: a failed seed starts with no markets, a dropped socket invalidates
 * books to `awaiting-snapshot`, a failed resync lets entries age into
 * `book-snapshot-stale`. Every one of those reads as *unknown* downstream, which
 * excludes copiers rather than admitting them against depth nobody measured. A
 * throw here, by contrast, would take down the process that also ingests Solana
 * and Robinhood Chain.
 */
/**
 * How often the subscription set is recomputed.
 *
 * Five minutes, not the resync cadence: this is a *membership* refresh (which
 * markets exist and matter), not a *freshness* refresh (what the book says).
 * Freshness is the subscriber's own 15s resync. A market that becomes active
 * between refreshes is simply unsubscribed until the next one, which reads as
 * `book-not-cached` and excludes its cohort ‚Äî fail-closed, and the cost of a
 * tighter cadence is a repeated scan of two tables for a set that rarely moves.
 */
const POLYMARKET_BOOK_SUBSCRIPTION_REFRESH_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

const polymarketBookRuntime = createPolymarketBookRuntimeOnRedis(redis, {
  logger: {
    info: (message: string) => console.log(`[indexer] ${message}`),
    warn: (message: string, error?: unknown) =>
      console.warn(`[indexer] ${message}`, error ?? '')
  }
});

polymarketBookRuntime.start();

/**
 * Seed the subscription set, then refresh it periodically.
 *
 * The set is the union of markets a tracked master traded recently and markets
 * somebody still holds ‚Äî the first are fan-out candidates, the second have to
 * stay exitable. Refreshed on a cadence because a market that becomes active
 * after boot would otherwise never be subscribed until the next restart.
 */
async function refreshPolymarketBookSubscriptions(): Promise<void> {
  const set = await loadPolymarketBookSubscriptionSet({
    now: new Date(),
    onFailure: (detail: string) => console.warn(`[indexer] ${detail}`)
  });

  polymarketBookRuntime.subscriber.subscribe(set.tokenIds);

  console.log(
    `[indexer] polymarket book subscriptions: ${set.tokenIds.length} market(s) `
      + `(${set.counts.recentTrade} recently traded, ${set.counts.openPosition} held)`
      + `${set.evicted === 0 ? '' : `, ${set.evicted} evicted by the cap`}`
  );
}

void refreshPolymarketBookSubscriptions().catch((error: unknown) => {
  console.warn('[indexer] polymarket book subscription seed failed', error);
});

setInterval(() => {
  void refreshPolymarketBookSubscriptions().catch((error: unknown) => {
    console.warn('[indexer] polymarket book subscription refresh failed', error);
  });
}, POLYMARKET_BOOK_SUBSCRIPTION_REFRESH_MS);

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Shutdown ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

/**
 * Stop the book feed on the way out.
 *
 * `stop()` invalidates every cached book before closing the socket, so a
 * deliberate shutdown cannot leave entries in Redis that look fresh while
 * nothing is updating them. Registered for both signals because a container stop
 * sends SIGTERM and an interactive run sends SIGINT.
 */
let shuttingDown = false;
function shutdown(signal: string): void {
  if (shuttingDown) return;
  shuttingDown = true;
  console.log(`[indexer] ${signal} received; stopping the polymarket book feed`);
  try {
    polymarketBookRuntime.stop();
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[indexer] book feed shutdown failed', error);
  }
}

process.on('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));
process.on('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));

console.log('[indexer] service running');

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  IngestionBatchError,
  runTrackedIngestion,
  type IngestionBatchResult
} from './ingestion-health.js';

const RESULT: IngestionBatchResult = {
  fetched: 12,
  inserted: 8,
  skipped: 3,
  failed: 1,
  lastEventAt: new Date('2026-07-19T12:00:00.000Z')
};

describe('tracked ingestion batches', () => {
  it('records completed counters with the source event time', async () => {
    const recorder = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);

    await expect(
      runTrackedIngestion({
        chain: 'robinhood-chain',
        source: 'robinhood-evm',
        run: async () => RESULT
      }, recorder)
    ).resolves.toBe(RESULT);

    expect(recorder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      source: 'robinhood-evm',
      lastEventAt: RESULT.lastEventAt,
      inserted: 8,
      skipped: 3,
      failed: 1
    }));
  });

  it('records partial counters and rethrows a failed batch', async () => {
    const recorder = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    const error = new IngestionBatchError('wallet refresh failed', RESULT);

    await expect(
      runTrackedIngestion({
        chain: 'polygon',
        source: 'polymarket-data-api',
        run: async () => {
          throw error;
        }
      }, recorder)
    ).rejects.toBe(error);

    expect(recorder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      inserted: 8,
      skipped: 3,
      failed: 1,
      errorMessage: 'wallet refresh failed'
    }));
  });

  it('records one failed batch when ingestion stops before counters exist', async () => {
    const recorder = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);

    await expect(
      runTrackedIngestion({
        chain: 'solana',
        source: 'solana-backfill',
        run: async () => {
          throw new Error('RPC unavailable');
        }
      }, recorder)
    ).rejects.toThrow('RPC unavailable');

    expect(recorder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      inserted: 0,
      skipped: 0,
      failed: 1,
      lastEventAt: null
    }));
  });

  it('does not misclassify a health write failure as an ingestion failure', async () => {
    const recorder = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('health write failed'));

    await expect(
      runTrackedIngestion({
        chain: 'solana',
        source: 'solana-backfill',
        run: async () => RESULT
      }, recorder)
    ).rejects.toThrow('health write failed');

    expect(recorder).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});

==> apps/indexer/src/ingestion-health.ts <==
import type { RecordIngestionBatchInput } from '@swat/db';
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';

export type IngestionBatchResult = {
  fetched: number;
  inserted: number;
  skipped: number;
  failed: number;
  lastEventAt: Date | null;
};

export class IngestionBatchError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    readonly result: IngestionBatchResult,
    options?: { cause?: unknown }
  ) {
    super(message, options);
    this.name = 'IngestionBatchError';
  }
}

type Recorder = (input: RecordIngestionBatchInput) => Promise<void>;

export async function runTrackedIngestion(
  input: {
    chain: Chain;
    source: string;
    run: () => Promise<IngestionBatchResult>;
  },
  recorder: Recorder
): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> {
  const batchAt = new Date();
  let result: IngestionBatchResult;

  try {
    result = await input.run();
  } catch (error) {
    const failedResult = error instanceof IngestionBatchError
      ? error.result
      : {
          fetched: 0,
          inserted: 0,
          skipped: 0,
          failed: 1,
          lastEventAt: null
        };

    try {
      await recorder({
        chain: input.chain,
        source: input.source,
        batchAt,
        lastEventAt: failedResult.lastEventAt,
        inserted: failedResult.inserted,
        skipped: failedResult.skipped,
        failed: Math.max(1, failedResult.failed),
        errorMessage: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      });
    } catch (recordError) {
      throw new AggregateError(
        [error, recordError],
        `Ingestion and health recording both failed for ${input.chain}`
      );
    }
    throw error;
  }

  await recorder({
    chain: input.chain,
    source: input.source,
    batchAt,
    lastEventAt: result.lastEventAt,
    inserted: result.inserted,
    skipped: result.skipped,
    failed: result.failed
  });
  return result;
}

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  extractFundingTransfers,
  extractTokenBuyers,
  getWalletTokenDeltas,
  SOL_MINT,
  USDC_MINT,
  SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID,
  type HeliusParsedTransaction
} from './parse.js';

const WALLET = 'Wa11etAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA';
const FUNDER = 'Funderxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx';
const TOKEN = 'Tokenyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy';
const TOKEN_TWO = 'Tokenzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz';

describe('extractFundingTransfers', () => {
  it('extracts a top-level SystemProgram transfer above the threshold', () => {
    const tx: HeliusParsedTransaction = {
      transaction: {
        message: {
          instructions: [
            {
              programId: SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID,
              parsed: { type: 'transfer', info: { source: FUNDER, destination: WALLET, lamports: 100_000_000 } }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    };
    expect(extractFundingTransfers(tx)).toEqual([
      { source: FUNDER, destination: WALLET, lamports: 100_000_000 }
    ]);
  });

  it('extracts transfers nested in inner instructions', () => {
    const tx: HeliusParsedTransaction = {
      meta: {
        innerInstructions: [
          {
            instructions: [
              {
                program: 'system',
                parsed: { type: 'transfer', info: { source: FUNDER, destination: WALLET, lamports: 500_000_000 } }
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    };
    expect(extractFundingTransfers(tx)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('ignores dust transfers below the threshold', () => {
    const tx: HeliusParsedTransaction = {
      transaction: {
        message: {
          instructions: [
            {
              programId: SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID,
              parsed: { type: 'transfer', info: { source: FUNDER, destination: WALLET, lamports: 1_000 } }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    };
    expect(extractFundingTransfers(tx)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('ignores non-SystemProgram instructions', () => {
    const tx: HeliusParsedTransaction = {
      transaction: {
        message: {
          instructions: [
            {
              programId: 'SomeOtherProgram1111111111111111111111111111',
              parsed: { type: 'transfer', info: { source: FUNDER, destination: WALLET, lamports: 100_000_000 } }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    };
    expect(extractFundingTransfers(tx)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('ignores self-transfers and missing parties', () => {
    const tx: HeliusParsedTransaction = {
      transaction: {
        message: {
          instructions: [
            {
              programId: SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID,
              parsed: { type: 'transfer', info: { source: WALLET, destination: WALLET, lamports: 100_000_000 } }
            },
            {
              programId: SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID,
              parsed: { type: 'transfer', info: { destination: WALLET, lamports: 100_000_000 } }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    };
    expect(extractFundingTransfers(tx)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('respects a custom minimum threshold', () => {
    const tx: HeliusParsedTransaction = {
      transaction: {
        message: {
          instructions: [
            {
              programId: SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID,
              parsed: { type: 'transfer', info: { source: FUNDER, destination: WALLET, lamports: 10_000 } }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    };
    expect(extractFundingTransfers(tx, 1_000)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('returns an empty array for a transaction with no instructions', () => {
    expect(extractFundingTransfers({})).toEqual([]);
  });
});
