export function parsePolymarketTimestamp(value: string | number): Date {
  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(numeric) || numeric <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket timestamp: ${String(value)}`);
  }

  const milliseconds = numeric < 1_000_000_000_000 ? numeric * 1000 : numeric;
  const date = new Date(milliseconds);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket timestamp: ${String(value)}`);
  }
  return date;
}

export type ConfirmedPolymarketTrade = {
  proxyWallet: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  conditionId: string;
  asset: string;
  size: number;
  price: number;
  side: 'BUY' | 'SELL';
  transactionHash: string;
  outcome: string;
  title: string;
};

export type PolymarketMarketContext = {
  conditionId: string;
  question: string;
  slug: string | null;
  endDate: Date;
  resolutionSource: string | null;
  active: boolean;
  closed: boolean;
  acceptingOrders: boolean;
  negRisk: boolean;
  tickSize: number;
  resolutionStatus: string;
  status: 'active' | 'inactive' | 'closed';
  outcomes: Array<{
    tokenId: string;
    outcome: string;
    outcomeIndex: number;
  }>;
};

function nonEmptyString(value: unknown, field: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket ${field}`);
  }
  return value.trim();
}

function positiveNumber(value: unknown, field: string): number {
  const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket ${field}: ${String(value)}`);
  }
  return parsed;
}

function normalizeConditionId(value: unknown): string {
  const conditionId = nonEmptyString(value, 'condition ID').toLowerCase();
  if (!/^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(conditionId)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket condition ID: ${conditionId}`);
  }
  return conditionId;
}

function normalizeProxyWallet(value: unknown): string {
  const proxyWallet = nonEmptyString(value, 'proxy wallet').toLowerCase();
  if (!/^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(proxyWallet)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket proxy wallet: ${proxyWallet}`);
  }
  return proxyWallet;
}

function normalizeTransactionHash(value: unknown): string {
  const hash = nonEmptyString(value, 'transaction hash').toLowerCase();
  if (!/^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(hash)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket transaction hash: ${hash}`);
  }
  return hash;
}

function normalizeTokenId(value: unknown): string {
  const tokenId = nonEmptyString(value, 'asset token ID');
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(tokenId)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket asset token ID: ${tokenId}`);
  }
  return tokenId;
}

function stringArray(value: unknown, field: string): string[] {
  let parsed = value;
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(value);
    } catch {
      throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket ${field}`);
    }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed) || parsed.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket ${field}`);
  }
  return parsed.map((item) => nonEmptyString(item, field));
}

export function parseConfirmedPolymarketTrade(value: unknown): ConfirmedPolymarketTrade {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid Polymarket confirmed trade');
  }
  const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const side = nonEmptyString(raw.side, 'trade side').toUpperCase();
  if (side !== 'BUY' && side !== 'SELL') {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket trade side: ${side}`);
  }
  const price = positiveNumber(raw.price, 'trade price');
  if (price > 1) throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket trade price: ${price}`);

  return {
    proxyWallet: normalizeProxyWallet(raw.proxyWallet),
    timestamp: parsePolymarketTimestamp(raw.timestamp as string | number),
    conditionId: normalizeConditionId(raw.conditionId),
    asset: normalizeTokenId(raw.asset),
    size: positiveNumber(raw.size, 'trade size'),
    price,
    side,
    transactionHash: normalizeTransactionHash(raw.transactionHash),
    outcome: nonEmptyString(raw.outcome, 'trade outcome'),
    title: nonEmptyString(raw.title, 'market title')
  };
}

export function parsePolymarketMarketContext(
  value: unknown,
  expectedConditionId: string,
  fallbackTickSize?: unknown
): PolymarketMarketContext {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    throw new Error(`Missing Polymarket market context for ${expectedConditionId}`);
  }
  const raw = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  const conditionId = normalizeConditionId(
    raw.conditionId ?? raw.condition_id ?? expectedConditionId
  );
  if (conditionId !== normalizeConditionId(expectedConditionId)) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket condition mismatch: expected ${expectedConditionId}, received ${conditionId}`);
  }
  const outcomes = stringArray(raw.outcomes, 'outcomes');
  const tokenIds = stringArray(raw.clobTokenIds, 'CLOB token IDs').map(normalizeTokenId);
  if (outcomes.length !== tokenIds.length) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket outcome/token count mismatch for ${conditionId}`);
  }
  if (typeof raw.negRisk !== 'boolean') {
    throw new Error(`Missing Polymarket neg-risk state for ${conditionId}`);
  }
  const endDateValue = nonEmptyString(raw.endDate ?? raw.end_date, 'end date');
  const endDate = new Date(endDateValue);
  if (Number.isNaN(endDate.getTime())) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket end date: ${endDateValue}`);
  }
  const tickSize = positiveNumber(
    raw.orderPriceMinTickSize ?? raw.minimumTickSize ?? fallbackTickSize,
    'tick size'
  );
  if (tickSize > 1) throw new Error(`Invalid Polymarket tick size: ${tickSize}`);
  const active = raw.active === true;
  const closed = raw.closed === true;
  const acceptingOrders = typeof raw.acceptingOrders === 'boolean'
    ? raw.acceptingOrders
    : active && !closed;
  const resolutionStatus = typeof raw.umaResolutionStatus === 'string' && raw.umaResolutionStatus.trim()
    ? raw.umaResolutionStatus.trim()
    : closed ? 'unknown' : 'unresolved';

  return {
    conditionId,
    question: nonEmptyString(raw.question, 'market question'),
    slug: typeof raw.slug === 'string' && raw.slug.trim() ? raw.slug.trim() : null,
    endDate,
    resolutionSource: typeof raw.resolutionSource === 'string' && raw.resolutionSource.trim()
      ? raw.resolutionSource.trim()
      : null,
    active,
    closed,
    acceptingOrders,
    negRisk: raw.negRisk as boolean,
    tickSize,
    resolutionStatus,
    status: closed ? 'closed' : active ? 'active' : 'inactive',
    outcomes: outcomes.map((outcome, outcomeIndex) => ({
      tokenId: tokenIds[outcomeIndex]!,
      outcome,
      outcomeIndex
    }))
  };
}

export function assertPolymarketCertificationBatch(input: {
  trades: ConfirmedPolymarketTrade[];
  mappedTokenIds: Iterable<string>;
  now?: Date;
  maxLagSeconds?: number;
}): { contextCoverage: number; lagSeconds: number } {
  if (input.trades.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Polymarket certification fixture contains no confirmed trades');
  }
  const mapped = new Set(input.mappedTokenIds);
  const mappedCount = input.trades.filter((trade) => mapped.has(trade.asset)).length;
  const contextCoverage = mappedCount / input.trades.length;
  if (contextCoverage !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket market context coverage is ${(contextCoverage * 100).toFixed(2)}%, expected 100%`);
  }
  const now = input.now ?? new Date();
  const latestTimestamp = Math.max(...input.trades.map((trade) => trade.timestamp.getTime()));
  const lagSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor((now.getTime() - latestTimestamp) / 1000));
  const maxLagSeconds = input.maxLagSeconds ?? 5 * 60;
  if (lagSeconds > maxLagSeconds) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket ingestion lag is ${lagSeconds}s, expected <= ${maxLagSeconds}s`);
  }
  return { contextCoverage, lagSeconds };
}

describe('Polymarket trade paging', () => {
  const USER = `0x${'3'.repeat(40)}`;

  function page(count: number, timestampBase: number): unknown[] {
    return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
      ...trade,
      timestamp: timestampBase - index
    }));
  }

  function urlsOf(fetchImpl: { mock: { calls: unknown[][] } }): URL[] {
    return fetchImpl.mock.calls.map(([input]) => new URL(String(input)));
  }

  it('walks offsets until a short page ends the history', async () => {
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async (input: string | URL | Request) => {
      const offset = Number(new URL(String(input)).searchParams.get('offset'));
      return jsonResponse(offset === 0 ? page(2, 1_000) : page(1, 998));
    }) as unknown as typeof fetch & { mock: { calls: unknown[][] } };

    const trades = await fetchConfirmedPolymarketTradePages({
      user: USER,
      fetchImpl,
      pageLimit: 2,
      maxOffset: 100
    });

    expect(trades).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(urlsOf(fetchImpl).map((url) => url.searchParams.get('offset'))).toEqual(['0', '2']);
    // A single window is enough here, so `end` is never pinned.
    expect(urlsOf(fetchImpl).every((url) => url.searchParams.get('end') === null)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('re-anchors on a new end window instead of walking past the offset cap', async () => {
    // The API answers an offset past its cap with a 400 rather than clamping,
    // so a flat walk would abort the whole backfill for a high-volume wallet.
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async (input: string | URL | Request) => {
      const url = new URL(String(input));
      const offset = Number(url.searchParams.get('offset'));
      const end = url.searchParams.get('end');
      if (offset > 2) return jsonResponse({ error: 'offset out of range' }, 400);
      if (end === null) return jsonResponse(page(2, 1_000 - offset));
      if (end === '997') return jsonResponse(offset === 0 ? page(2, 997) : page(1, 995));
      return jsonResponse([]);
    }) as unknown as typeof fetch & { mock: { calls: unknown[][] } };

    const trades = await fetchConfirmedPolymarketTradePages({
      user: USER,
      fetchImpl,
      pageLimit: 2,
      maxOffset: 4
    });

    const windows = urlsOf(fetchImpl).map((url) => [
      url.searchParams.get('offset'),
      url.searchParams.get('end')
    ]);
    expect(windows).toEqual([
      ['0', null],
      ['2', null],
      // Budget spent: re-anchor on the oldest fill seen and reset the offset.
      ['0', '997'],
      ['2', '997']
    ]);
    expect(trades).toHaveLength(7);
  });

  it('stops instead of looping when a window cannot advance', async () => {
    // Every window returns the same oldest timestamp, so re-anchoring would
    // re-read the same rows forever.
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async () => jsonResponse(page(2, 500))) as unknown as
      typeof fetch & { mock: { calls: unknown[][] } };
    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});

    const trades = await fetchConfirmedPolymarketTradePages({
      user: USER,
      fetchImpl,
      pageLimit: 2,
      maxOffset: 4
    });

    expect(trades.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    // Truncation is loud: a silent stop here would read as a complete backfill.
    expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('could not advance the trade window'));
    warn.mockRestore();
  });

  it('propagates a non-OK page as an error', async () => {
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async () => jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 500)) as typeof fetch;
    await expect(fetchConfirmedPolymarketTradePages({ user: USER, fetchImpl }))
      .rejects.toThrow('Polymarket Data API returned status 500');
  });
});

function getRedis(): Redis {
  redis ??= new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  return redis;
}

/**
 * Page size. The Data API clamps `limit` at 10000; 500 keeps the request count
 * ~5x lower than the old 100 while staying far inside the 200 req / 10s budget
 * documented for `/trades`.
 */
const TRADES_PAGE_LIMIT = 500;

/**
 * The Data API *rejects* an `offset` past 10000 with a 400 rather than clamping
 * it, and each `start`/`end` window carries its own offset budget.
 */
const TRADES_MAX_OFFSET = 10_000;

function rawTradeTimestampSeconds(row: unknown): number | null {
  const value = (row as { timestamp?: unknown } | null)?.timestamp;
  const seconds = typeof value === 'string' ? Number(value) : value;
  return typeof seconds === 'number' && Number.isFinite(seconds) ? seconds : null;
}

/**
 * Read a wallet's whole confirmed-trade history out of the Data API.
 *
 * Paging is windowed, not a flat offset walk. A flat walk cannot get past
 * offset 10000 - the API answers a deeper offset with a 400, which used to
 * abort the entire backfill and discard every page already read, so the
 * highest-volume wallets (exactly the ones worth tracking) could never be
 * backfilled at all. When a window's offset budget is spent we re-anchor `end`
 * on the oldest fill seen and open a fresh window. Rows repeated across a
 * boundary cost nothing: `recordConfirmedPolymarketTrade` dedupes on its
 * natural key and the source-trade fill index is a hash of the same identity.
 */
export async function fetchConfirmedPolymarketTradePages(input: {
  user: string;
  fetchImpl: FetchImplementation;
  pageLimit?: number;
  maxOffset?: number;
}): Promise<unknown[]> {
  const pageLimit = input.pageLimit ?? TRADES_PAGE_LIMIT;
  const maxOffset = input.maxOffset ?? TRADES_MAX_OFFSET;
  const rawTrades: unknown[] = [];
  let offset = 0;
  let windowEnd: number | null = null;
  let oldestInWindow: number | null = null;

  while (true) {
    const url = new URL('https://data-api.polymarket.com/trades');
    // `user` first so the query string stays recognisable in logs and tests.
    url.searchParams.set('user', input.user);
    url.searchParams.set('limit', String(pageLimit));
    url.searchParams.set('offset', String(offset));
    if (windowEnd !== null) url.searchParams.set('end', String(windowEnd));

    const response = await input.fetchImpl(url.toString());
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Polymarket Data API returned status ${response.status}`);
    }
    const page = await response.json() as unknown;
    if (!Array.isArray(page)) throw new Error('Polymarket Data API returned a non-array trade page');
    if (page.length === 0) break;
    console.log(
      `[polymarket] Fetched ${page.length} confirmed trades (offset: ${offset}`
      + `${windowEnd === null ? '' : `, end: ${windowEnd}`}) for ${input.user}`
    );
    rawTrades.push(...page);
    for (const row of page) {
      const seconds = rawTradeTimestampSeconds(row);
      if (seconds === null) continue;
      if (oldestInWindow === null || seconds < oldestInWindow) oldestInWindow = seconds;
    }

    // A short page means this window is exhausted, and the last window is the
    // whole history.
    if (page.length < pageLimit) break;

    offset += pageLimit;
    if (offset + pageLimit <= maxOffset) continue;

    if (oldestInWindow === null) {
      console.warn(
        `[polymarket] offset budget spent with no usable timestamp to re-anchor on for ${input.user};`
        + ' history older than this point was not read'
      );
      break;
    }
    if (windowEnd !== null && oldestInWindow >= windowEnd) {
      // The window did not move, so another pass would re-read the same rows
      // forever. Stop, and say so - a silent truncation here would read as a
      // complete backfill.
      console.warn(
        `[polymarket] could not advance the trade window past ${windowEnd} for ${input.user};`
        + ' history older than that timestamp was not read'
      );
      break;
    }
    windowEnd = oldestInWindow;
    oldestInWindow = null;
    offset = 0;
  }

  return rawTrades;
}

async function fetchGammaMarket(
  conditionId: string,
  fetchImpl: FetchImplementation
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const normTarget = conditionId.toLowerCase();

  // Try 1: Open / active markets via condition_id and condition_ids
  try {
    const response = await fetchImpl(
      `https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets?condition_id=${encodeURIComponent(conditionId)}&condition_ids=${encodeURIComponent(conditionId)}`
    );
    if (response.ok) {
      const payload = (await response.json()) as unknown;
      if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
        const match = payload.find(
          (m: any) =>
            typeof m === 'object' &&
            m !== null &&
            (m.conditionId?.toLowerCase() === normTarget || m.condition_id?.toLowerCase() === normTarget)
        );
        if (match) {
          return {
            ...match,
            negRisk: typeof (match as any).negRisk === 'boolean'
              ? (match as any).negRisk
              : Boolean((match as any).neg_risk)
          };
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to closed markets
  }

  // Try 2: Closed / resolved historical markets via condition_id, condition_ids, & closed=true
  try {
    const response = await fetchImpl(
      `https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets?condition_id=${encodeURIComponent(conditionId)}&condition_ids=${encodeURIComponent(conditionId)}&closed=true`
    );
    if (response.ok) {
      const payload = (await response.json()) as unknown;
      if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
        const match = payload.find(
          (m: any) =>
            typeof m === 'object' &&
            m !== null &&
            (m.conditionId?.toLowerCase() === normTarget || m.condition_id?.toLowerCase() === normTarget)
        );
        if (match) {
          return {
            ...match,
            negRisk: typeof (match as any).negRisk === 'boolean'
              ? (match as any).negRisk
              : Boolean((match as any).neg_risk)
          };
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to CLOB fallback
  }

  // Try 3: CLOB market endpoint directly as ultimate fallback
  try {
    const clobRes = await fetchImpl(
      `https://clob.polymarket.com/markets/${encodeURIComponent(conditionId)}`
    );
    if (clobRes.ok) {
      const clobData = (await clobRes.json()) as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (clobData && Array.isArray(clobData.tokens)) {
        return {
          ...clobData,
          conditionId: clobData.condition_id ?? conditionId,
          outcomes: (clobData.tokens as any[]).map((t) => t.outcome),
          clobTokenIds: (clobData.tokens as any[]).map((t) => t.token_id),
          negRisk: clobData.neg_risk ?? false,
          endDate: clobData.end_date_iso ?? clobData.end_date ?? new Date().toISOString(),
          orderPriceMinTickSize: clobData.minimum_tick_size ?? 0.001
        };
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore
  }

  throw new Error(`Polymarket market context not found for ${conditionId}`);
}

async function fetchTickSize(asset: string, fetchImpl: FetchImplementation): Promise<unknown> {
  const response = await fetchImpl(
    `https://clob.polymarket.com/tick-size?token_id=${encodeURIComponent(asset)}`
  );
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket CLOB tick-size endpoint returned status ${response.status}`);
  }
  const payload = await response.json() as Record<string, unknown>;
  return payload.minimum_tick_size ?? payload.minimumTickSize;
}

async function ensurePolymarketContext(
  trade: ConfirmedPolymarketTrade,
  fetchImpl: FetchImplementation
) {
  const cached = await getPolymarketOutcomeContext(trade.asset);
  if (cached) {
    if (
      cached.conditionId !== trade.conditionId
      || cached.outcome.toLowerCase() !== trade.outcome.toLowerCase()
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Cached Polymarket outcome mapping conflicts with trade ${trade.transactionHash}`);
    }
    return cached;
  }

  const rawMarket = await fetchGammaMarket(trade.conditionId, fetchImpl);
  const hasTickSize = rawMarket.orderPriceMinTickSize !== undefined
    || rawMarket.minimumTickSize !== undefined;
  const fallbackTickSize = hasTickSize ? undefined : await fetchTickSize(trade.asset, fetchImpl);
  const market = parsePolymarketMarketContext(rawMarket, trade.conditionId, fallbackTickSize);
  const tradedOutcome = market.outcomes.find((outcome) => outcome.tokenId === trade.asset);
  if (!tradedOutcome) {
    throw new Error(`Trade asset ${trade.asset} is not mapped by market ${trade.conditionId}`);
  }
  if (tradedOutcome.outcome.toLowerCase() !== trade.outcome.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error(`Trade outcome does not match asset ${trade.asset}`);
  }

  await upsertPolymarketContext({
    conditionId: market.conditionId,
    question: market.question,
    slug: market.slug,
    endDate: market.endDate,
    resolutionSource: market.resolutionSource,
    outcomeCount: market.outcomes.length,
    clobTokenIds: market.outcomes.map((outcome) => outcome.tokenId),
    status: market.status,
    tickSize: market.tickSize,
    negRisk: market.negRisk,
    acceptingOrders: market.acceptingOrders,
    resolutionStatus: market.resolutionStatus,
    outcomes: market.outcomes
  });

  const persisted = await getPolymarketOutcomeContext(trade.asset);
  if (!persisted) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket context was not persisted for asset ${trade.asset}`);
  }
  return persisted;
}

function toSixDecimalUnits(value: number, field: string): string {
  const units = Math.round(value * 1_000_000);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(units) || units < 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid ${field} amount for 6-decimal persistence`);
  }
  return String(units);
}

export async function backfillPolymarketWallet(
  address: string,
  dependencies: PolymarketBackfillDependencies = {}
): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> {
  const cleanAddr = stripChainPrefix(address).trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!/^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(cleanAddr)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid Polygon wallet for Polymarket backfill: ${address}`);
  }
  const fetchImpl = dependencies.fetchImpl ?? fetch;
  const publish = dependencies.publish
    ?? ((channel: string, message: string) => getRedis().publish(channel, message));
  console.log(`[polymarket] Backfilling confirmed trades for ${cleanAddr}`);

  await upsertToken(POLYMARKET_USDC, {
    chain: 'polygon',
    decimals: 6,
    symbol: 'USDC',
    name: 'USD Coin'
  });

  let inserted = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  let lastEventAt: Date | null = null;
  let sourceTradeFailure: SourceTradePersistenceError | null = null;
  const rawTrades = await fetchConfirmedPolymarketTradePages({
    user: cleanAddr,
    fetchImpl
  });

  const proxyActivity = new Map<string, { inserted: number; latestTimestamp: Date }>();

  for (const rawTrade of rawTrades) {
    let trade: ConfirmedPolymarketTrade;
    try {
      trade = parseConfirmedPolymarketTrade(rawTrade);
    } catch (error) {
      failed++;
      console.warn('[polymarket] rejected invalid confirmed trade:', error);
      continue;
    }

    if (!lastEventAt || trade.timestamp > lastEventAt) lastEventAt = trade.timestamp;

    try {
      const context = await ensurePolymarketContext(trade, fetchImpl);
      await upsertWallet({
        address: trade.proxyWallet,
        chain: 'polygon',
        source: 'discovered',
        discoveryMethod: 'polymarket-proxy'
      });
      await recordConfirmedPolymarketTrade({
        transactionHash: trade.transactionHash,
        proxyWallet: trade.proxyWallet,
        asset: trade.asset,
        conditionId: trade.conditionId,
        side: trade.side,
        size: trade.size,
        price: trade.price,
        timestamp: trade.timestamp
      });

      const usdValue = trade.size * trade.price;
      const outcomeUnits = toSixDecimalUnits(trade.size, 'Polymarket outcome');
      const collateralUnits = toSixDecimalUnits(usdValue, 'Polymarket collateral');
      const persisted = await insertParsedTransaction({
        chain: 'polygon',
        signature: trade.transactionHash,
        walletAddress: trade.proxyWallet,
        tokenIn: trade.side === 'BUY' ? POLYMARKET_USDC : trade.asset,
        tokenOut: trade.side === 'BUY' ? trade.asset : POLYMARKET_USDC,
        amountIn: trade.side === 'BUY' ? collateralUnits : outcomeUnits,
        amountOut: trade.side === 'BUY' ? outcomeUnits : collateralUnits,
        amountInUsd: usdValue,
        amountOutUsd: usdValue,
        direction: trade.side === 'BUY' ? 'buy' : 'sell',
        targetToken: trade.asset,
        programId: 'polymarket-data-api',
        slot: null,
        timestamp: trade.timestamp,
        blockTime: Math.floor(trade.timestamp.getTime() / 1000)
      });
      const sourceTrade = await persistPolymarketSourceTrade({
        trade,
        quantity: outcomeUnits,
        amountUsd: usdValue
      });

      const activity = proxyActivity.get(trade.proxyWallet);
      if (!activity || trade.timestamp > activity.latestTimestamp) {
        proxyActivity.set(trade.proxyWallet, {
          inserted: (activity?.inserted ?? 0) + (persisted ? 1 : 0),
          latestTimestamp: trade.timestamp
        });
      } else if (persisted) {
        activity.inserted++;
      }

      if (!persisted) {
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }
      inserted++;
      await publish(
        REDIS_CHANNELS.walletSwap,
        JSON.stringify({
          chain: 'polygon',
          walletAddress: `polygon:${trade.proxyWallet}`,
          signature: trade.transactionHash,
          sourceTradeId: sourceTrade.event.id,
          tokenMint: context.tokenId,
          direction: trade.side === 'BUY' ? 'buy' : 'sell',
          amountUsd: usdValue,
          timestamp: trade.timestamp.toISOString(),
          conditionId: context.conditionId,
          marketQuestion: context.question,
          outcome: context.outcome,
          marketState: context.marketStatus,
          endDate: context.endDate.toISOString()
        })
      );
    } catch (error) {
      failed++;
      if (error instanceof SourceTradePersistenceError) {
        sourceTradeFailure ??= error;
      }
      console.warn(
        `[polymarket] failed to process confirmed trade ${trade.transactionHash}:`,
        error
      );
    }
  }

  const result = {
    fetched: rawTrades.length,
    inserted,
    skipped,
    failed,
    lastEventAt
  };

  try {
    for (const [proxyWallet, activity] of proxyActivity) {
      await refreshWalletActivity(
        `polygon:${proxyWallet}`,
        activity.latestTimestamp,
        activity.inserted
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Failed to refresh Polymarket proxy wallet activity for ${cleanAddr}`,
      { ...result, failed: result.failed + 1 },
      { cause: error }
    );
  }

  if (sourceTradeFailure) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Canonical Polymarket source-trade persistence failed for ${cleanAddr}`,
      result,
      { cause: sourceTradeFailure }
    );
  }

  return result;
}

function parseOutcomePrices(value: unknown): number[] {
  let parsed = value;
  if (typeof value === 'string') parsed = JSON.parse(value);
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
  return parsed.map(Number).filter(Number.isFinite);
}

export async function pollPolymarketResolutions() {
  console.log('[polymarket] Polling for market resolutions...');
  const activeMarkets = await query<{ condition_id: string }>(
    `SELECT condition_id FROM polymarket_markets WHERE status = 'active' AND context_complete = TRUE`
  );

  for (const { condition_id } of activeMarkets) {
    try {
      const cached = await getPolymarketMarket(condition_id);
      const rawMarket = await fetchGammaMarket(condition_id, fetch);
      if (rawMarket.closed === true) {
        const market = parsePolymarketMarketContext(rawMarket, condition_id, cached?.tick_size);
        const prices = parseOutcomePrices(rawMarket.outcomePrices);
        const winningIndex = prices.findIndex((price) => price >= 0.99);
        const winningTokenId = winningIndex >= 0
          ? `polygon:${market.outcomes[winningIndex]?.tokenId}`
          : null;
        await query(
          `UPDATE polymarket_markets
              SET status = 'closed',
                  accepting_orders = FALSE,
                  resolution_status = $1,
                  winning_token_id = $2,
                  updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE condition_id = $3`,
          [market.resolutionStatus, winningTokenId, condition_id]
        );
        console.log(`[polymarket] Market ${condition_id} closed; winning token: ${winningTokenId}`);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[polymarket] failed to poll resolution for ${condition_id}`, error);
    }
  }
}

  address: string,
  from: string,
  to: string,
  value: bigint,
  logIndex: number
): RobinhoodReceiptLog {

    address,
    topics: encodeEventTopics({ abi: [transferEvent], eventName: 'Transfer', args: { from, to } }),

    logIndex,
    transactionHash
  };
}

    from: wallet,
    to: router,

    logs
  };

      status: 'classified',

      amountOut: 800n

      receipt([swap, transfer, { ...swap }, { ...transfer }]),

          data: '0x' as const,
          logIndex: 2,
          transactionHash
        }
      ],
      reason: 'missing_wallet_transfer'

    expect(classifyRobinhoodReceipt(receipt(logs), wallet, config)).toEqual({
      status: 'rejected',

    });
  });

  it('rejects a Swap-shaped log emitted by an unreviewed pool', () => {
    const result = classifyRobinhoodReceipt(receipt([

import { decodeEventLog, getAddress, parseAbiItem } from 'viem';

const transferEvent = parseAbiItem(
  'event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)'
);
const swapEvent = parseAbiItem(
  'event Swap(address indexed sender, address indexed recipient, int256 amount0, int256 amount1, uint160 sqrtPriceX96, uint128 liquidity, int24 tick)'
);

export type RobinhoodDirection = 'buy' | 'sell';

export type RobinhoodReceiptLog = {
  address: string;
  data: `0x${string}`;
  topics: readonly [`0x${string}`, ...`0x${string}`[]] | readonly `0x${string}`[];
  logIndex?: number | null;
  transactionHash?: string | null;
};

export type RobinhoodReviewedPool = {
  address: string;
  token0: string;
  token1: string;
};

export type RobinhoodIngestionConfig = {
  routers: ReadonlySet<string>;
  baseAsset: string;
  pools: ReadonlyMap<string, { token0: string; token1: string }>;
};

export type RobinhoodClassifiedSwap = {
  status: 'classified';
  direction: RobinhoodDirection;
  tokenIn: string;
  tokenOut: string;
  targetToken: string;
  amountIn: bigint;
  amountOut: bigint;
  poolAddresses: string[];
};

export type RobinhoodRejectedReceipt = {
  status: 'rejected';
  reason:
    | 'reverted_receipt'
    | 'wallet_not_sender'
    | 'unreviewed_router'
    | 'no_reviewed_pool_swap'
    | 'ambiguous_route'
    | 'missing_wallet_transfer';
};

export type RobinhoodReceiptClassification =
  | RobinhoodClassifiedSwap
  | RobinhoodRejectedReceipt;

type ReceiptInput = {
  status: 'success' | 'reverted';
  from: string;
  to: string | null;
  transactionHash: string;
  logs: readonly RobinhoodReceiptLog[];
};

export type RobinhoodReviewedFixture = {
  name: string;
  reviewed: boolean;
  wallet: string;
  receipt: ReceiptInput;
  expected: 'classify' | 'reject';
  expectedDirection?: RobinhoodDirection;
};

export type RobinhoodFixtureMetrics = {
  totalFixtures: number;
  reviewedFixtures: number;
  expectedSwaps: number;
  inserted: number;
  skipped: number;
  falsePositives: number;
  completeness: number | null;
  directionSamples: number;
  correctDirections: number;
  directionAccuracy: number | null;
};

function normalizeAddress(value: string, label: string): string {
  try {
    return getAddress(value).toLowerCase();
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${label} must be a valid EVM address`);
  }
}

export function parseRobinhoodIngestionConfig(
  values: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env
): RobinhoodIngestionConfig {
  const routerValue = values.ROBINHOOD_INGESTION_ROUTERS ?? values.ROBINHOOD_SWAP_ROUTER;
  const baseAssetValue = values.ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET;
  const poolsValue = values.ROBINHOOD_REVIEWED_POOLS_JSON;
  if (!routerValue) throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_INGESTION_ROUTERS is required');
  if (!baseAssetValue) throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET is required');
  if (!poolsValue) throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_REVIEWED_POOLS_JSON is required');

  const routers = new Set(
    routerValue.split(',').map((value) => normalizeAddress(value.trim(), 'Robinhood router'))
  );
  if (routers.size === 0) throw new Error('At least one Robinhood router is required');

  let decoded: unknown;
  try {
    decoded = JSON.parse(poolsValue);
  } catch {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_REVIEWED_POOLS_JSON must be valid JSON');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(decoded) || decoded.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_REVIEWED_POOLS_JSON must contain a non-empty array');
  }

  const pools = new Map<string, { token0: string; token1: string }>();
  for (const [index, item] of decoded.entries()) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') {
      throw new Error(`Robinhood reviewed pool ${index} must be an object`);
    }
    const candidate = item as Partial<RobinhoodReviewedPool>;
    if (!candidate.address || !candidate.token0 || !candidate.token1) {
      throw new Error(`Robinhood reviewed pool ${index} is incomplete`);
    }
    const address = normalizeAddress(candidate.address, `Robinhood pool ${index} address`);
    const token0 = normalizeAddress(candidate.token0, `Robinhood pool ${index} token0`);
    const token1 = normalizeAddress(candidate.token1, `Robinhood pool ${index} token1`);
    if (token0 === token1) throw new Error(`Robinhood reviewed pool ${index} has identical tokens`);
    if (pools.has(address)) throw new Error(`Duplicate Robinhood reviewed pool ${address}`);
    pools.set(address, { token0, token1 });
  }

  return {
    routers,
    baseAsset: normalizeAddress(baseAssetValue, 'ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET'),
    pools
  };
}

function logIdentity(log: RobinhoodReceiptLog): string {
  return [
    log.transactionHash ?? '',
    log.logIndex ?? '',
    log.address.toLowerCase(),
    log.data,
    ...log.topics
  ].join(':');
}

function decodeErc20Transfer(log: RobinhoodReceiptLog) {
  // ERC-721 Transfer has four topics and no uint256 data. Only the ERC-20 shape is accepted.
  if (log.topics.length !== 3 || !/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(log.data)) return null;
  try {
    const decoded = decodeEventLog({
      abi: [transferEvent],
      data: log.data,
      topics: log.topics as [`0x${string}`, ...`0x${string}`[]]
    });
    const args = decoded.args as { from: string; to: string; value: bigint };
    return {
      token: normalizeAddress(log.address, 'Transfer token'),
      from: normalizeAddress(args.from, 'Transfer from'),
      to: normalizeAddress(args.to, 'Transfer to'),
      amount: args.value
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function classifyRobinhoodReceipt(
  receipt: ReceiptInput,
  walletValue: string,
  config: RobinhoodIngestionConfig
): RobinhoodReceiptClassification {
  if (receipt.status !== 'success') return { status: 'rejected', reason: 'reverted_receipt' };
  const wallet = normalizeAddress(walletValue, 'Robinhood wallet');
  if (normalizeAddress(receipt.from, 'Receipt sender') !== wallet) {
    return { status: 'rejected', reason: 'wallet_not_sender' };
  }
  if (!receipt.to || !config.routers.has(normalizeAddress(receipt.to, 'Receipt target'))) {
    return { status: 'rejected', reason: 'unreviewed_router' };
  }

  const uniqueLogs = new Map<string, RobinhoodReceiptLog>();
  for (const log of receipt.logs) uniqueLogs.set(logIdentity(log), log);

  const tokenDeltas = new Map<string, bigint>();
  const poolAddresses = new Set<string>();
  for (const log of uniqueLogs.values()) {
    const poolAddress = normalizeAddress(log.address, 'Receipt log address');
    const pool = config.pools.get(poolAddress);
    if (!pool) continue;
    try {
      const decoded = decodeEventLog({
        abi: [swapEvent],
        data: log.data,
        topics: log.topics as [`0x${string}`, ...`0x${string}`[]]
      });
      const args = decoded.args as { amount0: bigint; amount1: bigint };
      tokenDeltas.set(pool.token0, (tokenDeltas.get(pool.token0) ?? 0n) + args.amount0);
      tokenDeltas.set(pool.token1, (tokenDeltas.get(pool.token1) ?? 0n) + args.amount1);
      poolAddresses.add(poolAddress);
    } catch {
      // A log from a reviewed pool is not sufficient unless it decodes as the reviewed Swap ABI.
    }
  }
  if (poolAddresses.size === 0) {
    return { status: 'rejected', reason: 'no_reviewed_pool_swap' };
  }

  const baseDelta = tokenDeltas.get(config.baseAsset) ?? 0n;
  const nonBase = [...tokenDeltas.entries()].filter(
    ([token, amount]) => token !== config.baseAsset && amount !== 0n
  );
  if (baseDelta === 0n || nonBase.length !== 1) {
    return { status: 'rejected', reason: 'ambiguous_route' };
  }
  const [targetToken, targetDelta] = nonBase[0];
  const isBuy = baseDelta > 0n && targetDelta < 0n;
  const isSell = baseDelta < 0n && targetDelta > 0n;
  if (!isBuy && !isSell) return { status: 'rejected', reason: 'ambiguous_route' };

  const transfers = [...uniqueLogs.values()]
    .map(decodeErc20Transfer)
    .filter((transfer): transfer is NonNullable<typeof transfer> => transfer !== null)
    .filter((transfer) => transfer.from !== transfer.to);
  const hasWalletTargetTransfer = transfers.some((transfer) =>
    transfer.token === targetToken && transfer.amount > 0n && (
      isBuy ? transfer.to === wallet : transfer.from === wallet
    )
  );
  if (!hasWalletTargetTransfer) {
    return { status: 'rejected', reason: 'missing_wallet_transfer' };
  }

  return isBuy
    ? {
        status: 'classified',
        direction: 'buy',
        tokenIn: config.baseAsset,
        tokenOut: targetToken,
        targetToken,
        amountIn: baseDelta,
        amountOut: -targetDelta,
        poolAddresses: [...poolAddresses]
      }
    : {
        status: 'classified',
        direction: 'sell',
        tokenIn: targetToken,
        tokenOut: config.baseAsset,
        targetToken,
        amountIn: targetDelta,
        amountOut: -baseDelta,
        poolAddresses: [...poolAddresses]
      };
}

export function measureRobinhoodFixtures(
  fixtures: readonly RobinhoodReviewedFixture[],
  config: RobinhoodIngestionConfig
): RobinhoodFixtureMetrics {
  const reviewed = fixtures.filter((fixture) => fixture.reviewed);
  let expectedSwaps = 0;
  let inserted = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let falsePositives = 0;
  let directionSamples = 0;
  let correctDirections = 0;

  for (const fixture of reviewed) {
    const result = classifyRobinhoodReceipt(fixture.receipt, fixture.wallet, config);
    if (fixture.expected === 'classify') {
      expectedSwaps++;
      if (result.status === 'classified') inserted++;
      else skipped++;
      if (fixture.expectedDirection) {
        directionSamples++;
        if (result.status === 'classified' && result.direction === fixture.expectedDirection) {
          correctDirections++;
        }
      }
    } else if (result.status === 'classified') {
      falsePositives++;
    }
  }

  return {
    totalFixtures: fixtures.length,
    reviewedFixtures: reviewed.length,
    expectedSwaps,
    inserted,
    skipped,
    falsePositives,
    completeness: expectedSwaps > 0 ? inserted / expectedSwaps : null,
    directionSamples,
    correctDirections,
    directionAccuracy: directionSamples > 0 ? correctDirections / directionSamples : null
  };
}

export function evaluateRobinhoodFixtureGate(metrics: RobinhoodFixtureMetrics): {
  passed: boolean;
  reasons: string[];
} {
  const reasons: string[] = [];
  if (metrics.reviewedFixtures === 0) reasons.push('reviewed fixture set is empty');
  if (metrics.expectedSwaps === 0) reasons.push('reviewed fixture set has no expected swaps');
  if (metrics.directionSamples === 0) reasons.push('reviewed fixture set has no direction samples');
  if (metrics.falsePositives > 0) reasons.push('reviewed fixture set produced false positives');
  if (metrics.completeness === null || metrics.completeness <= 0.9) {
    reasons.push('measured completeness is not greater than 90%');
  }
  if (metrics.directionAccuracy === null || metrics.directionAccuracy <= 0.95) {
    reasons.push('measured direction accuracy is not greater than 95%');
  }
  return { passed: reasons.length === 0, reasons };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { parseSeedWalletAddresses } from './seed-wallets.js';

const SOLANA_ADDRESS = '11111111111111111111111111111111';

describe('indexer wallet seeds', () => {
  it('accepts bare Solana and chain-prefixed EVM wallets', () => {

      parseSeedWalletAddresses(
        `${SOLANA_ADDRESS}, polygon:${EVM_ADDRESS}, robinhood-chain:${EVM_ADDRESS}`
      )
    ).toEqual([

        address: SOLANA_ADDRESS,
        chain: 'solana',
        source: 'manual'
      },

        chain: 'polygon',
        source: 'manual'
      },
      {
        address: EVM_ADDRESS,
        chain: 'robinhood-chain',
        source: 'manual'
      }
    ]);
  });

  it('deduplicates normalized seeds and rejects ambiguous raw EVM addresses', () => {
    expect(
      parseSeedWalletAddresses(
        `polygon:${EVM_ADDRESS.toUpperCase().replace('0X', '0x')},polygon:${EVM_ADDRESS}`
      )
    ).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(() => parseSeedWalletAddresses(EVM_ADDRESS)).toThrow(/explicit chain/);
  });

  it('rejects invalid prefixed addresses before startup ingestion', () => {
    expect(() => parseSeedWalletAddresses('polygon:not-an-address')).toThrow(
      /invalid polygon address/
    );
  });
});

==> apps/indexer/src/seed-wallets.ts <==
import {
  getChainPrefix,
  isValidAddressForChain,
  resolveChainValue,
  type Chain
} from '@swat/shared';

export type SeedWallet = {
  address: string;
  chain: Chain;
  source: 'manual';
};

export function parseSeedWalletAddresses(value: string | undefined): SeedWallet[] {
  const wallets: SeedWallet[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const [index, entry] of (value ?? '').split(',').entries()) {
    const address = entry.trim();
    if (!address) continue;

    try {
      const prefixedChain = getChainPrefix(address);
      const resolved = resolveChainValue(address, prefixedChain ?? undefined);
      if (!isValidAddressForChain(resolved.raw, resolved.chain)) {
        throw new Error(`invalid ${resolved.chain} address`);
      }

      if (!seen.has(resolved.prefixed)) {
        seen.add(resolved.prefixed);
        wallets.push({
          address: resolved.raw,
          chain: resolved.chain,
          source: 'manual'
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(
        `WALLET_ADDRESSES entry ${index} is invalid: ${
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
        }`
      );
    }
  }

  return wallets;
}

  it.each(fixtures)('$name is identical through webhook and backfill normalization', (fixture) => {
    const backfillEvent = parseCanonicalSolanaSwapEvent(
      toRawBackfillTransaction(fixture),
      WALLET
    );
    const webhookEvent = parseCanonicalSolanaSwapEvent(
      enhancedEventToTransaction(toEnhancedWebhookEvent(fixture), WALLET),
      WALLET

    expect(parseCanonicalSolanaSwapEvent(transaction, WALLET)).toEqual(
      parseCanonicalSolanaSwapEvent(transaction, WALLET)
    );
  });

    expect(recordSourceTradeEvent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(insertParsedTransaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('propagates lifecycle failure before downstream publication and enrichment', async () => {
    vi.mocked(recordSourceTradeEvent).mockRejectedValueOnce(
      new Error('canonical lifecycle unavailable')
    );

    await expect(processTransaction(confirmedBuy(), wallet, 'solana-backfill'))
      .rejects.toThrow('canonical lifecycle unavailable');

    expect(mocks.publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(updateTokenLaunchTimestamp).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('fails a backfill batch when canonical lifecycle persistence fails', async () => {
    vi.mocked(recordSourceTradeEvent).mockRejectedValueOnce(
      new Error('canonical lifecycle unavailable')
    );
    vi.mocked(fetch).mockImplementation(async (_input, init) => {
      const request = JSON.parse(String(init?.body)) as { method: string };
      const result = request.method === 'getSignaturesForAddress'
        ? [{ signature, slot: 351_000_000, blockTime: 1_760_000_000 }]
        : request.method === 'getTransaction'
          ? confirmedBuy()
          : { value: null };
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ result }), { status: 200 });
    });

    await expect(backfillWallet(wallet)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'IngestionBatchError',
      result: { fetched: 1, inserted: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 1 }
    });

    expect(mocks.publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

==> apps/indexer/src/source-trade-lifecycle.ts <==
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  recordSourceTradeEvent,
  type SourceTradeEventInput
} from '@swat/db';
import {
  resolveChainAddress,
  resolveChainValue
} from '@swat/shared';
import {
  USDC_MINT,
  USDT_MINT,
  type CanonicalSolanaSwapEvent
} from './parse.js';
import type { ConfirmedPolymarketTrade } from './polymarket-helpers.js';

export type SolanaIngestionSource = 'solana-backfill' | 'solana-webhook';

export class SourceTradePersistenceError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly chain: SourceTradeEventInput['chain'],
    options: { cause: unknown }
  ) {
    const detail = options.cause instanceof Error ? `: ${options.cause.message}` : '';
    super(`Failed to persist ${chain} canonical source trade${detail}`, options);
    this.name = 'SourceTradePersistenceError';
  }
}

async function persistSourceTrade(input: SourceTradeEventInput) {
  try {
    return await recordSourceTradeEvent(input);
  } catch (cause) {
    throw new SourceTradePersistenceError(input.chain, { cause });
  }
}

function normalizeAtomicQuantity(value: string): string {
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(value)) throw new Error('Atomic quantity must be an unsigned integer');
  const normalized = value.replace(/^0+(?=\d)/, '');
  if (normalized === '0') throw new Error('Atomic quantity must be greater than zero');
  return normalized;
}

function normalizeEvmHash(value: string, field: string): string {
  if (!/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(value)) throw new Error(`${field} must be a 32-byte hex value`);
  return value.toLowerCase();
}

function formatScaledInteger(value: string, decimals: number): string {
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(value)) throw new Error('Atomic quantity must be an unsigned integer');
  if (!Number.isInteger(decimals) || decimals < 0 || decimals > 255) {
    throw new Error('Token decimals must be an integer between 0 and 255');
  }

  const normalized = value.replace(/^0+(?=\d)/, '');
  if (decimals === 0) return normalized;
  const padded = normalized.padStart(decimals + 1, '0');
  const integer = padded.slice(0, -decimals);
  const fraction = padded.slice(-decimals).replace(/0+$/, '');
  return fraction ? `${integer}.${fraction}` : integer;
}

function deterministicSolanaPricing(
  event: CanonicalSolanaSwapEvent
): Pick<SourceTradeEventInput, 'amountUsd' | 'priceUsd'> {
  const quoteAmount = event.direction === 'buy'
    ? (event.tokenIn === USDC_MINT || event.tokenIn === USDT_MINT ? event.amountIn : null)
    : (event.tokenOut === USDC_MINT || event.tokenOut === USDT_MINT ? event.amountOut : null);
  if (quoteAmount === null) return { amountUsd: null, priceUsd: null };

  return {
    amountUsd: formatScaledInteger(quoteAmount, 6),
    // Parsed transaction balances do not currently carry target decimals.
    // Externally-fetched metadata can change availability between replays, so
    // it must not become part of the immutable source payload.
    priceUsd: null
  };
}

export function buildSolanaSourceTradeInput(input: {
  event: CanonicalSolanaSwapEvent;
  source: SolanaIngestionSource;
}): SourceTradeEventInput {
  const { event } = input;
  const wallet = resolveChainAddress(event.walletAddress, 'solana');
  const token = resolveChainValue(event.targetToken, 'solana');
  const quantity = normalizeAtomicQuantity(
    event.direction === 'buy' ? event.amountOut : event.amountIn
  );
  const pricing = deterministicSolanaPricing(event);
  return {
    chain: 'solana',
    sourceEventType: 'transaction',
    sourceEventId: event.transactionIdentity,
    sourceEventIndex: wallet.raw,
    transactionHash: event.transactionIdentity,
    walletAddress: wallet.raw,
    tokenMint: token.raw,
    side: event.direction,
    quantity,
    ...pricing,
    eventAt: event.occurredAt,
    confirmationState: 'confirmed',
    confirmationEvidenceId: `${input.source}:${event.transactionIdentity}:${event.slot ?? 'unknown-slot'}`
  };
}

export async function persistSolanaSourceTrade(input: {
  event: CanonicalSolanaSwapEvent;
  source: SolanaIngestionSource;
}) {
  return persistSourceTrade(buildSolanaSourceTradeInput(input));
}

function polymarketFillIndex(trade: ConfirmedPolymarketTrade, quantity: string): string {
  const identity = [
    trade.transactionHash,
    trade.proxyWallet,
    trade.conditionId,
    trade.asset,
    trade.side,
    quantity,
    String(trade.price),
    trade.timestamp.toISOString()
  ].join('\u0000');
  return createHash('sha256').update(identity).digest('hex');
}

export function buildPolymarketSourceTradeInput(input: {
  trade: ConfirmedPolymarketTrade;
  quantity: string;
  amountUsd: number;
}): SourceTradeEventInput {
  const { trade } = input;
  const transactionHash = normalizeEvmHash(trade.transactionHash, 'Polymarket transaction hash');
  const conditionId = normalizeEvmHash(trade.conditionId, 'Polymarket condition ID');
  const wallet = resolveChainAddress(trade.proxyWallet, 'polygon');
  const token = resolveChainValue(trade.asset, 'polygon');
  const quantity = normalizeAtomicQuantity(input.quantity);
  const sourceEventIndex = polymarketFillIndex({
    ...trade,
    transactionHash,
    conditionId,
    proxyWallet: wallet.raw,
    asset: token.raw
  }, quantity);
  return {
    chain: 'polygon',
    sourceEventType: 'venue_trade',
    sourceEventId: transactionHash,
    sourceEventIndex,
    transactionHash,
    walletAddress: wallet.raw,
    tokenMint: token.raw,
    side: trade.side === 'BUY' ? 'buy' : 'sell',
    quantity,
    amountUsd: input.amountUsd,
    priceUsd: trade.price,
    eventAt: trade.timestamp,
    confirmationState: 'confirmed',
    confirmationEvidenceId: `polymarket-data-api:${transactionHash}:${sourceEventIndex}`
  };
}

export async function persistPolymarketSourceTrade(input: {
  trade: ConfirmedPolymarketTrade;
  quantity: string;
  amountUsd: number;
}) {
  return persistSourceTrade(buildPolymarketSourceTradeInput(input));
}

export function buildRobinhoodSourceTradeInput(input: {
  transactionHash: string;
  walletAddress: string;
  tokenMint: string;
  side: 'buy' | 'sell';
  quantity: string;
  eventAt: Date;
  blockNumber: bigint;
}): SourceTradeEventInput {
  const transactionHash = normalizeEvmHash(input.transactionHash, 'Robinhood transaction hash');
  const wallet = resolveChainAddress(input.walletAddress, 'robinhood-chain');
  const token = resolveChainAddress(input.tokenMint, 'robinhood-chain');
  const quantity = normalizeAtomicQuantity(input.quantity);
  if (input.blockNumber < 0n) throw new Error('Robinhood block number must not be negative');
  return {
    chain: 'robinhood-chain',
    sourceEventType: 'transaction',
    sourceEventId: transactionHash,
    sourceEventIndex: wallet.raw,
    transactionHash,
    walletAddress: wallet.raw,
    tokenMint: token.raw,
    side: input.side,
    quantity,
    amountUsd: null,
    priceUsd: null,
    eventAt: input.eventAt,
    confirmationState: 'confirmed',
    confirmationEvidenceId: `robinhood-receipt:${transactionHash}:${input.blockNumber}`
  };
}

export async function persistRobinhoodSourceTrade(input: {
  transactionHash: string;
  walletAddress: string;
  tokenMint: string;
  side: 'buy' | 'sell';
  quantity: string;
  eventAt: Date;
  blockNumber: bigint;
}) {
  return persistSourceTrade(buildRobinhoodSourceTradeInput(input));
}

    })).toBe(true);
    expect(isRawHeliusTransaction({ accountData: [] })).toBe(false);

==> apps/indexer/src/webhook-helpers.ts <==
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import type { HeliusParsedTransaction } from './parse.js';

export type EnhancedTokenBalanceChange = {
  userAccount?: string;
  mint?: string;
  rawTokenAmount?: {
    tokenAmount?: string;
  };
};

export type EnhancedAccountData = {
  account?: string;
  nativeBalanceChange?: number;
  tokenBalanceChanges?: EnhancedTokenBalanceChange[];
};

export type EnhancedNativeTransfer = {
  fromUserAccount?: string;
  toUserAccount?: string;
  amount?: number;
};

export type EnhancedWebhookEvent = {
  type?: string;
  feePayer?: string;
  signature?: string;
  slot?: number;
  timestamp?: number;
  fee?: number;
  accountData?: EnhancedAccountData[];
  nativeTransfers?: EnhancedNativeTransfer[];
};

export function verifyStaticAuthorization(
  authHeader: string | undefined,
  configuredHeader: string | undefined
): boolean {
  if (!authHeader || !configuredHeader) return false;
  const expected = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(configuredHeader).digest();
  const actual = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(authHeader).digest();
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(actual, expected);
}

export function isRawHeliusTransaction(value: unknown): value is HeliusParsedTransaction {
  const event = value as HeliusParsedTransaction | null;
  return Boolean(
    event &&
    event.transaction?.signatures?.[0] &&
    event.meta &&
    event.transaction.message
  );
}

export function getEnhancedWalletCandidates(event: EnhancedWebhookEvent): string[] {
  const candidates = new Set<string>();
  if (event.feePayer) candidates.add(event.feePayer);

  for (const account of event.accountData ?? []) {
    if (account.account) candidates.add(account.account);
    for (const change of account.tokenBalanceChanges ?? []) {
      if (change.userAccount) candidates.add(change.userAccount);
    }
  }

  for (const transfer of event.nativeTransfers ?? []) {
    if (transfer.fromUserAccount) candidates.add(transfer.fromUserAccount);
    if (transfer.toUserAccount) candidates.add(transfer.toUserAccount);
  }

  return [...candidates];
}

export function enhancedEventToTransaction(
  event: EnhancedWebhookEvent,
  walletAddress: string
): HeliusParsedTransaction {
  const deltas = new Map<string, bigint>();
  for (const account of event.accountData ?? []) {
    for (const change of account.tokenBalanceChanges ?? []) {
      if (change.userAccount !== walletAddress || !change.mint) continue;
      const amount = BigInt(change.rawTokenAmount?.tokenAmount ?? '0');
      deltas.set(change.mint, (deltas.get(change.mint) ?? 0n) + amount);
    }
  }

  const preTokenBalances = [];
  const postTokenBalances = [];
  for (const [mint, delta] of deltas) {
    preTokenBalances.push({
      owner: walletAddress,
      mint,
      uiTokenAmount: { amount: delta < 0n ? (-delta).toString() : '0' }
    });
    postTokenBalances.push({
      owner: walletAddress,
      mint,
      uiTokenAmount: { amount: delta > 0n ? delta.toString() : '0' }
    });
  }

  const nativeChange = (event.accountData ?? [])
    .find((account) => account.account === walletAddress)
    ?.nativeBalanceChange ?? 0;
  const nativeMagnitude = Math.abs(nativeChange);

  return {
    slot: event.slot,
    blockTime: event.timestamp,
    transaction: {
      signatures: event.signature ? [event.signature] : [],
      message: {
        accountKeys: [walletAddress],
        instructions: (event.nativeTransfers ?? []).map((transfer) => ({
          program: 'system',
          parsed: {
            type: 'transfer',
            info: {
              source: transfer.fromUserAccount,
              destination: transfer.toUserAccount,
              lamports: transfer.amount
            }
          }
        }))
      }
    },
    meta: {
      fee: event.fee ?? 0,
      preBalances: [nativeChange < 0 ? nativeMagnitude : 0],
      postBalances: [nativeChange > 0 ? nativeMagnitude : 0],
      preTokenBalances,
      postTokenBalances
    }
  };
}

==> apps/indexer/src/webhook.ts <==
import Fastify from 'fastify';
import {
  query,
  recordIngestionBatch,
  refreshWalletActivity
} from '@swat/db';
import { prefixChainValue } from '@swat/shared';
import { processTransaction } from './index.js';
import {
  enhancedEventToTransaction,
  getEnhancedWalletCandidates,
  isRawHeliusTransaction,
  verifyStaticAuthorization,
  type EnhancedWebhookEvent
} from './webhook-helpers.js';

const webhookSecret = process.env.HELIUS_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
const webhookPort = Number(process.env.WEBHOOK_PORT ?? 3002);

if (!webhookSecret) {
  console.warn(
    '[webhook] HELIUS_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set ‚Äî the /webhook/helius endpoint will reject all requests.'
  );
}

export const app = Fastify({ logger: true });

async function getTrackedWallets(candidates: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
  const raw = [...new Set(candidates)].filter(Boolean);
  if (raw.length === 0) return [];
  const prefixed = raw.map((address) => prefixChainValue(address, 'solana'));
  const rows = await query<{ address: string }>(
    `SELECT address FROM wallets WHERE chain = 'solana' AND address = ANY($1::text[])`,
    [prefixed]
  );
  return rows.map((row) => row.address.slice('solana:'.length));
}

app.post('/webhook/helius', async (req, reply) => {
  const authHeader = req.headers.authorization as string | undefined;
  if (!verifyStaticAuthorization(authHeader, webhookSecret)) {
    return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Invalid authorization' });
  }

  const events = Array.isArray(req.body) ? req.body : [req.body];
  let processed = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  let lastEventAt: Date | null = null;

  for (const event of events) {
    try {
      const candidates = isRawHeliusTransaction(event)
        ? (event.transaction?.message?.accountKeys ?? [])
            .map((key) => typeof key === 'string' ? key : key.pubkey)
            .filter((key): key is string => Boolean(key))
        : getEnhancedWalletCandidates(event as EnhancedWebhookEvent);
      const wallets = await getTrackedWallets(candidates);
      if (wallets.length === 0) {
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      for (const walletAddress of wallets) {
        try {
          const transaction = isRawHeliusTransaction(event)
            ? event
            : enhancedEventToTransaction(event as EnhancedWebhookEvent, walletAddress);
          const blockTime = transaction.blockTime;
          if (blockTime) {
            const eventAt = new Date(blockTime * 1000);
            if (!lastEventAt || eventAt > lastEventAt) lastEventAt = eventAt;
          }

          const result = await processTransaction(transaction, walletAddress, 'solana-webhook');
          if (result === 'inserted') {
            processed++;
            await refreshWalletActivity(
              prefixChainValue(walletAddress, 'solana'),
              blockTime ? new Date(blockTime * 1000) : null,
              1
            );
          } else {
            skipped++;
          }
        } catch (error) {
          failed++;
          req.log.error(
            { error, walletAddress },
            '[webhook] tracked wallet processing failed'
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      failed++;
      req.log.error({ error }, '[webhook] event processing failed');
    }
  }

  await recordIngestionBatch({
    chain: 'solana',
    source: 'solana-webhook',
    lastEventAt,
    inserted: processed,
    skipped,
    failed,
    errorMessage: failed > 0 ? `${failed} webhook item(s) failed` : null
  });

  if (failed > 0) {
    return reply.code(503).send({
      processed,
      skipped,
      failed,
      error: 'Webhook batch requires retry'
    });
  }
  return reply.code(200).send({ processed, skipped, failed });
});

app.get('/webhook/health', async () => ({ status: 'ok', service: 'indexer-webhook' }));

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
  app.listen({ host: '0.0.0.0', port: webhookPort }).then(() => {
    console.log(`[indexer] Helius webhook listening on port ${webhookPort}`);
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error('[indexer] webhook server failed to start', error);
  });
}

==> apps/lp/README.md <==
# WAKE LP Dashboard (`@swat/lp`)

Liquidity-provider operations for WAKE: discover pools on **Meteora DLMM (Solana)** and **Uniswap v3/v4 (Robinhood Chain)**, score them for risk, deploy laddered positions from named strategy presets, monitor them against price drift, rebalance only when the economics justify it, and enforce per-user risk guardrails ‚Äî all under the same paper-mode and execution-certification gates as the rest of WAKE.

Built from the 40-task plan in [`WAKE LP Dashboard ‚Äî Coding Build Plan (GLM 5.3 Flash).md`](./WAKE%20LP%20Dashboard%20‚Äî%20Coding%20Build%20Plan%20(GLM%205.3%20Flash).md), Tracks A through H plus **Track I (manual position builder)** and the E5/F6 behavior changes, one tested checkpoint per track.

## Current capability boundary

The service is currently a **read-only discovery, valuation, preview, and paper-mode operations service**. It is not yet the live position-custody service for the whole WAKE platform.

### Working now

- Scans Meteora DLMM pools through Meteora's current Data API (`/pools`) with pagination, live token prices, fees, volume, and nested pool metadata.
- Reads Solana DLMM bins directly from mainnet RPC and calculates exact active TVL when the pool has usable token prices.
- Scans the configured Robinhood Chain Uniswap v3 pools through the configured EVM RPC.
- Reads live pool state, token decimals, current ticks, bitmap words, initialized ticks, signed `liquidityNet`, and reconstructs tick liquidity bands.
- Calculates decimal-normalized Robinhood active TVL. The configured WETH/USDG pools can use USDG as the stable quote and derive the WETH USD price from the live pool price.
- Provides risk filtering, pool ranking, strategy-template resolution, ladder math, live Solana/EVM context, and read-only per-rung liquidity previews.
- Provides authenticated position-management routes and paper-mode plans. Paper mode records intent and refuses to sign or broadcast transactions.

### Intentionally deferred

- Robinhood swap-log indexing for 24-hour volume and fee metrics; those fields remain zero until an indexed/log-based source is wired.
- Live position ownership and valuation: Meteora position accounts and Uniswap v3 position NFTs are not yet the service's production wallet index.
- Live transaction construction, signing, broadcasting, and receipt recovery for Meteora or Robinhood positions.
- Full Postgres/Redis deployment and integration testing against a migrated environment.

The live chain work completed here is deliberately read-only. Adding a private key or enabling live mode does not turn these readers into a production execution system.

---

## What the product does, end to end

```
 pool scan (B) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ risk filter (C) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ Discover feed (H1)
                                        ‚îÇ
 LP wallet indexer (D) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ leaderboard ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚î§
                                        ‚ñº
             ladder preview (I2: live bins/ticks, read-only)
                                ‚îÇ  E5 resolver pre-fills; user may edit
                                ‚ñº
             Deploy confirm (H5) ‚îÄ‚îÄ guardrails (G1: exposure cap)
                                ‚ñº
                    buildPosition() entrypoint (E6)
                                ‚îÇ  template or custom ladder (E5, E2/E4)
                                ‚ñº
                 position row (state: building) + execution plan
                                ‚îÇ
                    monitor pass (F1/F2, scheduled)
                                ‚îÇ  state: active / near_edge / out_of_range
                                ‚ñº
              rebalance economic check (F3) ‚îÄ‚îÄ only positive ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂
              LP execution queue ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ rebalance executor (F4/F5)
                                ‚îÇ
              position close ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ profit banking (G2) ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ reserve sub-vault (G3)
```

- **Users** browse risk-assessed pools, deploy a ladder from a preset
  (`tight-spot-scalp`, `deep-bidask-accumulation`, `wide-range-dump-capture`,
  `passive-majors-auto-compound`) or custom parameters, and watch positions
  from the position manager.
- **The system** rescans pools, re-scores risk, monitors every open position
  against the current price, and queues rebalances only when the projected
  fee uplift clears impermanent loss + gas + repositioning cost.
- **Nothing broadcasts in paper mode.** The deploy returns a *plan*; the
  monitor records intent; the execution workers refuse to sign. The live path
  exists end to end behind the same `resolveChainMode` clamp the trade
  executor uses (`off` ‚Üí refuse, `paper` ‚Üí plan, `live` ‚Üí sign-ready, plus
  `live+shadow` ‚Üí treated as paper for LP).

## The data model (migrations `059` + `060`)

`060_lp_auto_rebalance.sql` (Track I) adds `lp_positions.auto_rebalance BOOLEAN
NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE` and replaces the transition trigger to widen the state
machine with `active ‚Üí rebalancing` (the manual trigger may re-center an
in-range position; the scheduled monitor never uses that edge).

| Table | Role | Precedent followed |
|---|---|---|
| `lp_pools` | scanner cache; `risk_score IS NULL` = not yet assessed; partial index keeps unassessed rows out of the feed | `user_balances` (cache of an on-chain fact) |
| `lp_guardrail_configs` | per-user caps: `max_pool_allocation_pct` (default 50), `profit_bank_pct` (default 50), reserve sub-vault pointer (unprefixed, per the `047` convention) | preferences ‚Üí CASCADE on user delete |
| `lp_positions` | one user ladder: strategy type, range bounds, rung JSONB, deposit, state | fund-touching ‚Üí RESTRICT from users |
| `lp_position_state_history` | every transition journaled with a reason | `copy_execution_state_history` |
| `lp_tracked_wallets` | external wallets the indexer watches (chain-prefixed) | `source_trades.wallet_address` shape |
| `lp_wallet_snapshots` | raw per-position value series (the PnL input) | ‚Äî |
| `lp_wallet_position_results` | closed books per position; the leaderboard aggregates ONLY this | ‚Äî |

Chains are deliberately narrower than the platform: every LP `chain` CHECK
allows `('solana', 'robinhood-chain')` only ‚Äî polygon is a copy-trading chain.
Pool, position, and mint columns are chain-prefixed
(`solana:‚Ä¶`, `robinhood-chain:0x‚Ä¶`); the reserve sub-vault pointer is a
user-owned account and follows the `user_*` unprefixed convention.

## The position state machine

```
building ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ active ‚áÑ near_edge ‚áÑ out_of_range ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ rebalancing ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ ‚Ä¶ ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚ñ∂ closed
```

Enforced **twice, on purpose**:

1. **Code** ‚Äî `canTransitionLpPosition` in `@swat/shared`
   (`LP_POSITION_TRANSITIONS` is the readable source of truth), covered by its
   own unit tests (`packages/shared/src/lp-lifecycle.test.ts`).
2. **SQL** ‚Äî the `enforce_lp_position_state_transition` trigger on
   `lp_positions` (cloned from the `copy_executions` trigger in `028`).

Every transition (including the initial `building`) is journaled to
`lp_position_state_history` with the reason. `transitionLpPosition` in
`packages/db/src/lp-positions.ts` is the only writer; it locks the row
`FOR UPDATE` (ownership filter rides in the locked SELECT ‚Äî one round trip, no
check-then-lock race) and refuses invalid transitions *without writing*.

## How the pieces work

### Scanner (Tracks B1‚ÄìB6)
`runPoolScan` iterates the configured fetchers. Each fetcher normalizes its
chain into `NormalizedPool` (chain-prefixed addresses, USD money fields,
`activeTvlUsd` + `activeTvlExact`). Active TVL comes from the shared
calculator ‚Äî bins within ¬±10 of the active bin on Meteora, sqrt-band tick
math on Uniswap. When bin/tick context or prices are missing, the fetcher
degrades to `activeTvlUsd = tvl` with `activeTvlExact: false` (a ceiling,
never an underestimate). Fee APR is `fees √∑ TVL` per window, deliberately NOT
annualized ‚Äî a two-day-old pool would print a made-up √ó365 number. One
fetcher failing loses nothing: the summary reports
`failedFetchers: ['solana:meteora-dlmm']` and the other chain still lands.

### Risk filter (Tracks C1‚ÄìC6)
Checks return *findings* (stable flag codes + human detail); the combiner in
`score.ts` owns all weights (mint authority 50, liquidity unlocked 40, holder
concentration 35, bundled launch 25, freeze 25, blacklist 20, pause 10;
deduplicated by flag, capped at 100). The pass runs after the scan, scores
every `risk_score IS NULL` pool, and attaches score + flags. A pool whose
checks throw stays unassessed ‚Äî and therefore unlisted ‚Äî until the next pass;
"we have not looked yet" is the honest state. A chain with **no checks
configured** (Robinhood Chain today) also stays unassessed: scoring it 0 would
present "we have not looked" as "clean" and put those pools on the feed.

The scan pass also prunes pools unseen for 7 days (`pruneStaleLpPools`) ‚Äî an
upsert-only cache can never remove a pool that dropped off the source list.

### Wallet indexer (Tracks D1‚ÄìD5)
Each scheduled pass reads every tracked wallet through its chain's reader,
writes the observation into `lp_wallet_snapshots`, and ‚Äî for positions whose
series has ‚â• 2 points ‚Äî closes the books into `lp_wallet_position_results`
via `netLpResult`. The series method is honest about its limits: it sees
uncollected-fee growth and inventory drift; it cannot see mid-series fee
claims or gas, so its output is a *floor* on the true net result. The
leaderboard (`GET /v1/lp/wallets/leaderboard`) aggregates the results table in
SQL ‚Äî realized PnL, win rate over closed positions only, modal strategy.

### Ladder builder (Tracks E1‚ÄìE6)
`buildLadderPlan` divides the range into geometric bands (equal log-widths, so
rung exposure is comparable at both ends of a wide range), weights them by
distribution, and snaps to chain granularity ‚Äî bin ids on Meteora
(`id = ln(price)/ln(1+binStep)`), spaced ticks on Uniswap
(`tick = ln(price)/ln(1.0001)`, floored to spacing). Per-rung allocation =
weight √ó deposit. Weight shapes: `spot` is equal; `curve` decays from the
rung **nearest the current price** in log space, in both directions (so a
down-tilted range loads its top rung ‚Äî dump capture ‚Äî and the shape follows
the price rather than the index); `bidask` concentrates at **both** edges
symmetrically, dipping in the middle (the accumulation shape). On Meteora a
rung is one position (`addLiquidityByStrategy` per rung ‚Äî the SDK has no
batched multi-position call); on Uniswap it is one NFT mint, preceded by a
swap step when the rung needs base tokens.

`buildPosition` runs, in order: execution-mode gate (off refuses before
anything else runs) ‚Üí deploy guard (G1 exposure cap) ‚Üí pool lookup in the scan
cache (a pool without a scan or price cannot anchor a ladder) ‚Üí template or
custom params (both at once is an error) ‚Üí plan ‚Üí persist as `building` ‚Üí
execution steps. **In paper mode the build ends with a `building ‚Üí active`
transition** ‚Äî the recorded plan IS the build, and without it the position
would sit in `building` forever, invisible to the monitor and un-closable by
rebalance. In live mode that transition belongs to the executor's broadcast
confirmation (`attachOnChainPositionAddress`). Guardrail refusals return
`rejectionReasons` with an empty bundle (HTTP 403 with reasons, not a generic
500).

### Manual position builder (Track I)

The builder flow is **preview ‚Üí confirm**:

1. **Live context (I1)** ‚Äî `GET /v1/lp/ladder-preview` fetches the selected
   pool's bin/tick state *now*. On Solana this reads the DLMM program directly
   over RPC with no SDK ‚Äî `@meteora-ag/dlmm@1.9.14` cannot be imported in this
   environment (broken ESM re-exports; CJS build missing the `DLMM` class), so
   `scanner/solana-bins.ts` speaks the wire format itself:
   `getAccountInfo` on the pool decodes `active_id` (i32 @76), `bin_step`
   (u16 @80) and the token mints (@88/@120); `getProgramAccounts` with a
   memcmp filter at offset **24** (the `lb_pair` field inside `BinArray` ‚Äî the
   folk recipe's offset 16 returns zero accounts; both were tested live)
   fetches the pool's bin arrays, decoded with a 144-byte stride
   (`amount_x` u64, `amount_y` u64, price as Q64.64 u128). Every offset was
   verified byte-by-byte against mainnet, and the live decode was smoke-tested
   against a real pool (active bin price matched `(1+binStep/10000)^activeId`).
   On Robinhood Chain the context comes from the viem pool reader
   (`slot0` ‚Üí tick + price). If a live fetch fails, the source degrades to the
   scan cache **with an explicit warning on the context** ‚Äî a preview backing
   a real deposit must say when it is stale.
2. **Preview calculator (I2)** ‚Äî `buildLivePreview` resolves the template
   (E5 pre-fill) or validates the user-edited custom params, snaps rungs to the
   live granularity, and annotates each rung with the share of the pool's
   *live* liquidity already sitting in that rung's range. Read-only: nothing
   persisted, no chain writes.
3. **Confirm (I3)** ‚Äî the UI posts the (possibly edited) params to
   `POST /v1/lp/positions/deploy` as `custom`, which re-validates them and
   runs E6 behind the existing guardrails. The deploy body also carries
   `autoRebalance` (Track I opt-in) and `PATCH
   /v1/lp/positions/:positionId/auto-rebalance` flips it later.

### Monitor + rebalancer (Tracks F1‚ÄìF6)
Every `LP_POSITION_MONITOR_CRON`, the monitor prices each open position and
classifies it. The state transition happens only on change ‚Äî and that
re-labeled state **is** the recommendation the position manager surfaces.

**F6 change (Track I): the monitor no longer auto-fires rebalances by
default.** For a `near_edge`/`out_of_range` position whose owner has not set
`auto_rebalance`, the monitor records
`rebalancesDeclined: [{ reason: 'auto-rebalance-not-opted-in' }]` and stops ‚Äî
no economics estimate, no queue job. Only an opted-in position runs the
economic gate (`evaluateRebalanceEconomics` strictly positive) and gets
queued on the chain's concurrency-1 execution queue. Manual triggers bypass
the flag entirely (the user IS the consent): `POST
/v1/lp/positions/:positionId/rebalance` queues the job and transitions the
position to `rebalancing`. A refused transition (racing a close) logs and
moves on.

### Guardrails (Tracks G1‚ÄìG4)
- **Exposure cap (G1)**: `(poolExposure + request) / (deployed + request) ‚â§
  cap%`, with the cap equation inverted to return the largest allowed top-up
  when blocked. The first deposit always passes (nothing is deployed to be a
  share of).
- **Profit banking (G2)**: on close/harvest, `bankAmount = gain √ó pct` ‚Äî
  losses sweep nothing; 0% banking is an explicit disabled state. The sweep
  port returns a receipt; a sweep that silently no-ops is the failure mode it
  exists to prevent.
- **Reserve sub-vault (G3)**: the pointer in `lp_guardrail_configs` is
  validated against an active vault-kind execution grant. Fail-closed: an
  unvalidated address refuses the sweep loudly.
- **State machine fold-in (G4)**: guardrails are checks *inside* the deploy
  and close flows ‚Äî there is no parallel lifecycle.

## Running it

Preconditions (same as the rest of WAKE): Postgres and Redis up, `.env` from
`.env.example`, Node 22+.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm db:migrate          # applies 059_lp_dashboard.sql (replay-safe; every statement idempotent)
pnpm dev:lp              # API on :3010 + cron passes + execution workers
```

Config (all optional unless noted ‚Äî see `.env.example` "LP Dashboard" block):

| Var | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `LP_PORT` | `3010` | Fastify API port |
| `METEORA_API_URL` | `https://dlmm.datapi.meteora.ag` | Meteora Data API `/pools` source; supports `page`, `page_size`, `query`, and `sort_by` |
| `LP_POOL_SCAN_CRON` | `*/30 * * * *` | pool scan |
