==> apps/lp/src/scanner/scan-job.ts <==
import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';
import { realizedFeeApr } from './fee-apr.js';
import type { NormalizedPool, PoolFetcher, ScanSummary } from './types.js';

/**
 * The scan job (Track B6) ‚Äî wires the fetchers (B1/B2), the active-TVL
 * calculators (B3, inside the fetchers), the fee APR calculator (B4), and the
 * ranking function (B5, applied by the API at request time) into one scheduled
 * pass that writes the `lp_pools` cache, tagged by chain.
 *
 * One fetcher failing must not lose the other chain's scan: failed fetchers
 * are reported in the summary, not thrown. A pool without a risk score still
 * gets written (Track C6 attaches the score in a second step) ‚Äî the *feed*
 * excludes unassessed pools, so a crash between scan and risk pass degrades
 * freshness, never correctness.
 */

export interface UpsertLpPoolPort {
  upsert(input: {
    chain: LpChain;
    protocol: NormalizedPool['protocol'];
    poolAddress: string;
    pairLabel: string;
    baseTokenMint: string;
    quoteTokenMint: string;
    feeBps: number;
    binStep: number | null;
    tickSpacing: number | null;
    currentPrice: number | null;
    tvl: number;
    activeTvl: number;
    volume24h: number;
    feeApr24h: number | null;
    feeApr7d: number | null;
  }): Promise<unknown>;
}

export interface ScanJobDeps {
  readonly fetchers: readonly PoolFetcher[];
  readonly store: UpsertLpPoolPort;
}

export async function runPoolScan(deps: ScanJobDeps): Promise<ScanSummary> {
  const scannedByChain: Record<string, number> = {};
  const failedFetchers: string[] = [];

  for (const fetcher of deps.fetchers) {
    try {
      const pools = await fetcher.fetch();
      let written = 0;
      for (const pool of pools) {
        const apr = realizedFeeApr({ fees24h: pool.fees24h, fees7d: pool.fees7d, tvl: pool.tvl });
        await deps.store.upsert({
          chain: pool.chain,
          protocol: pool.protocol,
          poolAddress: pool.poolAddress,
          pairLabel: pool.pairLabel,
          baseTokenMint: pool.baseTokenMint,
          quoteTokenMint: pool.quoteTokenMint,
          feeBps: pool.feeBps,
          binStep: pool.binStep,
          tickSpacing: pool.tickSpacing,
          currentPrice: pool.currentPrice,
          tvl: pool.tvl,
          activeTvl: pool.activeTvlUsd,
          volume24h: pool.volume24h,
          feeApr24h: apr.feeApr24h,
          feeApr7d: apr.feeApr7d
        });
        written += 1;
      }
      scannedByChain[fetcher.chain] = (scannedByChain[fetcher.chain] ?? 0) + written;
    } catch (error) {
      failedFetchers.push(`${fetcher.chain}:${fetcher.protocol}`);
      console.error(
        `[lp] scan fetcher failed for ${fetcher.chain}/${fetcher.protocol}:`,
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
      );
    }
  }

  return { scannedByChain, failedFetchers };
}

==> apps/lp/src/scanner/solana-bins.test.ts <==
import bs58 from 'bs58';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY,
  BIN_STRIDE,
  createRpcSolanaBinSource,
  decodeBinArrayBins,
  decodeLbPairState,
  readU128LE,
  type SolanaRpcBinPort
} from './solana-bins.js';

/**
 * Layout fixtures encode the wire format exactly as verified on mainnet
 * (pool 5hbf9JP8‚Ä¶: active_id ‚àí604, bin_step 20, MET/USDC 6/6 decimals) so a
 * regression in the offsets cannot pass silently.
 */

const LB_PAIR_DISCRIMINATOR = Buffer.from([33, 11, 49, 98, 181, 101, 177, 13]);
const BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR = Buffer.from([92, 142, 92, 220, 5, 148, 70, 181]);
const LB_PAIR_SIZE = 8 + 32 + 32 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 4 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 32 + 32 + 32 + 32;
const B58_MET = 'METvsvVRapdj9cFLzq4Tr43xK4tAjQfwX76z3n6mWQL';
const B58_USDC = 'EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v';

function writeU128LE(buffer: Buffer, offset: number, value: bigint): void {
  buffer.writeBigUInt64LE(value & 0xffffffffffffffffn, offset);
  buffer.writeBigUInt64LE(value >> 64n, offset + 8);
}

function encodeLbPair(activeBinId: number, binStep: number): Buffer {
  const data = Buffer.alloc(LB_PAIR_SIZE);
  LB_PAIR_DISCRIMINATOR.copy(data, 0);
  // StaticParameters @8 (32B), VariableParameters @40 (32B) ‚Äî zeros are fine.
  data.writeInt32LE(activeBinId, 76);
  data.writeUInt16LE(binStep, 80);
  Buffer.from(bs58.decode(B58_MET)).copy(data, 88);
  Buffer.from(bs58.decode(B58_USDC)).copy(data, 120);
  return data;
}

function encodeBinArray(index: number, bins: { binId: number; rawX: bigint; rawY: bigint; priceQ64: bigint }[]): Buffer {
  const data = Buffer.alloc(56 + BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY * BIN_STRIDE);
  BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR.copy(data, 0);
  data.writeBigInt64LE(BigInt(index), 8);
  data[16] = 2; // version, as seen on mainnet
  for (const bin of bins) {
    const i = bin.binId - index * BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY;
    if (i < 0 || i >= BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY) continue;
    const base = 56 + i * BIN_STRIDE;
    data.writeBigUInt64LE(bin.rawX, base);
    data.writeBigUInt64LE(bin.rawY, base + 8);
    writeU128LE(data, base + 16, bin.priceQ64);
  }
  return data;
}

const Q64 = 2n ** 64n;
const priceQ64 = (humanPrice: number): bigint => BigInt(Math.round(humanPrice * Number(Q64)));

function portWith(overrides: Partial<SolanaRpcBinPort> = {}): SolanaRpcBinPort & { calls: string[] } {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  const lbPair = encodeLbPair(-604, 20);
  const arrays = [
    // One account per real array (mainnet never duplicates a bin across
    // accounts): index -9 covers -630..-561 and holds everything near active;
    // index -8 covers -560..-491 ‚Äî outside ¬±10, must be filtered out entirely.
    encodeBinArray(-9, [
      { binId: -606, rawX: 0n, rawY: 910_000000n, priceQ64: priceQ64(0.29806) },
      { binId: -605, rawX: 0n, rawY: 900_000000n, priceQ64: priceQ64(0.298657) },
      { binId: -595, rawX: 0n, rawY: 940_000000n, priceQ64: priceQ64(0.3026) }
    ]),
    encodeBinArray(-8, [{ binId: -560, rawX: 4_099_893529n, rawY: 0n, priceQ64: priceQ64(0.326645) }])
  ];
  return {
    calls,
    async getAccountInfoBase64(address) {
      calls.push(`info:${address}`);
      return lbPair.toString('base64');
    },
    async getProgramAccountsMemcmp(programId, offset, bytes) {
      calls.push(`gpa:${programId}:${offset}:${bytes}`);
      return arrays.map((data) => ({ pubkey: 'arr', dataBase64: data.toString('base64') }));
    },
    async getTokenDecimals(mint) {
      calls.push(`dec:${mint}`);
      return 6; // both MET and USDC carry 6 ‚Äî verified on mainnet
    },
    ...overrides
  };
}

describe('decodeLbPairState (mainnet-verified offsets)', () => {
  it('reads active_id @76, bin_step @80, and the mints @88/@120', () => {
    const state = decodeLbPairState(encodeLbPair(-604, 20));
    expect(state.activeBinId).toBe(-604);
    expect(state.binStep).toBe(20);
    expect(state.tokenXMint).toBe(B58_MET);
    expect(state.tokenYMint).toBe(B58_USDC);
  });

  it('rejects a truncated account before reading out of bounds', () => {
    expect(() => decodeLbPairState(Buffer.alloc(100))).toThrow('too short');
  });
});

describe('decodeBinArrayBins', () => {
  it('validates the discriminator and maps index ‚Üí bin ids', () => {
    const { index, bins } = decodeBinArrayBins(
      encodeBinArray(-8, [{ binId: -560, rawX: 1n, rawY: 2n, priceQ64: 3n }])
    );
    expect(index).toBe(-8);
    expect(bins).toHaveLength(BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY);
    expect(bins[0]?.binId).toBe(-560); // -8 * 70 + 0
    expect(bins[69]?.binId).toBe(-491);
  });

  it('rejects a non-BinArray account', () => {
    const wrong = Buffer.alloc(56 + 70 * BIN_STRIDE);
    expect(() => decodeBinArrayBins(wrong)).toThrow('discriminator');
  });

  it('reads the Q64.64 price across the u128 boundary', () => {
    const data = Buffer.alloc(56 + BIN_STRIDE);
    BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR.copy(data, 0);
    writeU128LE(data, 56 + 16, (1n << 64n) + 5n); // 1.000000000000000005
    const { bins } = decodeBinArrayBins(data);
    expect(bins[0]?.priceQ64).toBe((1n << 64n) + 5n);
    expect(readU128LE(data, 56 + 16)).toBe((1n << 64n) + 5n);
  });
});

describe('createRpcSolanaBinSource', () => {
  it('humanizes amounts and prices, filters to ¬±binsEachSide, and filters by memcmp @24', async () => {
    const port = portWith();
    const source = createRpcSolanaBinSource({ port, binsEachSide: 10 });
    const { bins, activeBinId } = await source.fetchBins('solana:5hbf9JP8k5zdrZp9pokPypFQoBse5mGCmW6nqodurGcd');

    expect(activeBinId).toBe(-604);
    // Array -9's span (-630..-561) fully covers the ¬±10 window, so every bin
    // -614..-594 comes back ‚Äî zero-liquidity ones included, exactly like the
    // live mainnet response (21 bins there too). Array -8's -560 stays out.
    const ids = bins.map((bin) => bin.binId).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    expect(ids).toHaveLength(21);
    expect(ids[0]).toBe(-614);
    expect(ids.at(-1)).toBe(-594);
    expect(bins.some((bin) => bin.binId === -560)).toBe(false);
    const below = bins.find((bin) => bin.binId === -605);
    expect(below?.quoteAmount).toBeCloseTo(900, 6);
    const above = bins.find((bin) => bin.binId === -595);
    expect(above?.quoteAmount).toBeCloseTo(940, 6);
    expect(below?.quoteAmount).toBeCloseTo(900, 6); // 900_000000 / 10^6
    expect(below?.baseAmount).toBe(0);
    // Q64.64 price √ó 10^(decX ‚àí decY) = human quote-per-base
    expect(below?.price).toBeCloseTo(0.298657, 8);
    expect(above?.price).toBeCloseTo(0.3026, 8);

    // the memcmp filter used the verified lb_pair offset, not the folk 16
    expect(port.calls.some((call) => call.startsWith('gpa:') && call.includes(':24:'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('throws when the pair account does not exist', async () => {
    const source = createRpcSolanaBinSource({
      port: portWith({ getAccountInfoBase64: async () => null })
    });
    await expect(source.fetchBins('solana:5hbf9JP8k5zdrZp9pokPypFQoBse5mGCmW6nqodurGcd')).rejects.toThrow('not found');
  });

  it('passes a bare base58 pool address through unchanged', async () => {
    const port = portWith();
    const source = createRpcSolanaBinSource({ port });
    await source.fetchBins('5hbf9JP8k5zdrZp9pokPypFQoBse5mGCmW6nqodurGcd');
    expect(port.calls[0]).toBe('info:5hbf9JP8k5zdrZp9pokPypFQoBse5mGCmW6nqodurGcd');
  });
});

==> apps/lp/src/scanner/solana-bins.ts <==
import bs58 from 'bs58';
import type { MeteoraBin } from './active-tvl.js';
import type { MeteoraBinSource } from './meteora-pools.js';

/**
 * The live Solana bin source (Track I1) ‚Äî reads DLMM bin liquidity straight
 * from RPC, with no SDK. `@meteora-ag/dlmm@1.9.14` cannot be imported in this
 * environment (broken ESM re-exports, CJS build missing the DLMM class), so
 * this module speaks the program's wire format directly. Every offset below
 * was verified byte-by-byte against mainnet (layout source:
 * `idls/dlmm.json` from MeteoraAg/dlmm-sdk).
 *
 * Layouts (all little-endian):
 *
 *   LbPair (borsh):
 *     0..8     anchor discriminator
 *     8..40    StaticParameters (32 bytes)
 *     40..72   VariableParameters (32 bytes)
 *     72       bump_seed u8
 *     73..75   bin_step_seed [u8;2]
 *     75       pair_type u8
 *     76..80   active_id i32            ‚Üê read
 *     80..82   bin_step u16             ‚Üê read
 *     82..88   status, require_base_factor_seed, base_factor_seed, activation,
 *              creator_pool_on_off_control
 *     88..120  token_x_mint pubkey      ‚Üê read
 *     120..152 token_y_mint pubkey      ‚Üê read
 *
 *   BinArray (zero-copy, C repr):
 *     0..8     discriminator [92,142,92,220,5,148,70,181]
 *     8..16    index i64                ‚Üê read (array covers index*70 ‚Ä¶ index*70+69)
 *     16..24   version u8 + padding
 *     24..56   lb_pair pubkey           ‚Üê memcmp filter offset (24, not 16 ‚Äî
 *                                          verified: 16 returns zero accounts)
 *     56..     Bin[70], stride 144:
 *                +0   amount_x u64      ‚Üê read (raw, smallest unit)
 *                +8   amount_y u64      ‚Üê read
 *                +16  price u128, Q64.64 per-lamport  ‚Üê read
 */

export const DLMM_PROGRAM_ID = 'LBUZKhRxPF3XUpBCjp4YzTKgLccjZhTSDM9YuVaPwxo';
const BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR = Buffer.from([92, 142, 92, 220, 5, 148, 70, 181]);
export const BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY = 70;
export const BIN_STRIDE = 144;
const BIN_ARRAY_HEADER = 56;
const BIN_ARRAY_LB_PAIR_OFFSET = 24;
const LB_PAIR_ACTIVE_ID_OFFSET = 76;
const LB_PAIR_BIN_STEP_OFFSET = 80;
const LB_PAIR_TOKEN_X_MINT_OFFSET = 88;
const LB_PAIR_TOKEN_Y_MINT_OFFSET = 120;
const Q64 = 2n ** 64n;

export interface SolanaRpcBinPort {
  /** getAccountInfo, base64 data; null when the account does not exist. */
  getAccountInfoBase64(address: string): Promise<string | null>;
  /** getProgramAccounts with one memcmp filter, base64, full data. */
  getProgramAccountsMemcmp(programId: string, offset: number, bytesBase58: string): Promise<{ pubkey: string; dataBase64: string }[]>;
  /** SPL mint decimals. */
  getTokenDecimals(mint: string): Promise<number>;
}

/** Raw JSON-RPC over fetch, matching the indexer's heliusRpc pattern. */
export function createWeb3SolanaBinPort(rpcUrl: string): SolanaRpcBinPort {
  let nextId = 0;
  const rpc = async <T>(method: string, params: unknown[]): Promise<T> => {
    const response = await fetch(rpcUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: ++nextId, method, params })
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Solana RPC ${method} returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
    }
    const payload = (await response.json()) as { result?: T; error?: { message?: string } };
    if (payload.error) {
      throw new Error(`Solana RPC ${method} failed: ${payload.error.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
    }
    return payload.result as T;
  };

  return {
    async getAccountInfoBase64(address) {
      const result = await rpc<{ value: { data: [string, string] } | null }>('getAccountInfo', [
        address,
        { encoding: 'base64' }
      ]);
      return result.value ? result.value.data[0] : null;
    },
    async getProgramAccountsMemcmp(programId, offset, bytesBase58) {
      const result = await rpc<{ pubkey: string; account: { data: [string, string] } }[]>(
        'getProgramAccounts',
        [
          programId,
          {
            filters: [{ memcmp: { offset, bytes: bytesBase58 } }],
            encoding: 'base64'
          }
        ]
      );
      return result.map((entry) => ({ pubkey: entry.pubkey, dataBase64: entry.account.data[0] }));
    },
    async getTokenDecimals(mint) {
      const result = await rpc<{ value: { decimals: number } }>('getTokenSupply', [mint]);
      return result.value.decimals;
    }
  };
}

export function readU128LE(buffer: Buffer, offset: number): bigint {
  return buffer.readBigUInt64LE(offset) + buffer.readBigUInt64LE(offset + 8) * 2n ** 64n;
}

/** Decoded pair state, raw units. */
export function decodeLbPairState(data: Buffer): {
  activeBinId: number;
  binStep: number;
  tokenXMint: string;
  tokenYMint: string;
} {
  if (data.length < LB_PAIR_TOKEN_Y_MINT_OFFSET + 32) {
    throw new Error(`LbPair account too short: ${data.length} bytes`);
  }
  return {
    activeBinId: data.readInt32LE(LB_PAIR_ACTIVE_ID_OFFSET),
    binStep: data.readUInt16LE(LB_PAIR_BIN_STEP_OFFSET),
    tokenXMint: bs58.encode(data.subarray(LB_PAIR_TOKEN_X_MINT_OFFSET, LB_PAIR_TOKEN_X_MINT_OFFSET + 32)),
    tokenYMint: bs58.encode(data.subarray(LB_PAIR_TOKEN_Y_MINT_OFFSET, LB_PAIR_TOKEN_Y_MINT_OFFSET + 32))
  };
}

export interface DecodedBin {
  readonly binId: number;
  readonly rawAmountX: bigint;
  readonly rawAmountY: bigint;
  readonly priceQ64: bigint;
}

export function decodeBinArrayBins(data: Buffer): { index: number; bins: DecodedBin[] } {
  if (data.length < BIN_ARRAY_HEADER) {
    throw new Error(`BinArray account too short: ${data.length} bytes`);
  }
  if (!data.subarray(0, 8).equals(BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR)) {
    throw new Error('account is not a DLMM BinArray (discriminator mismatch)');
  }
  const index = Number(data.readBigInt64LE(8));
  const capacity = Math.min(BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY, Math.floor((data.length - BIN_ARRAY_HEADER) / BIN_STRIDE));
  const bins: DecodedBin[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < capacity; i += 1) {
    const base = BIN_ARRAY_HEADER + i * BIN_STRIDE;
    bins.push({
      binId: index * BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY + i,
      rawAmountX: data.readBigUInt64LE(base),
      rawAmountY: data.readBigUInt64LE(base + 8),
      priceQ64: readU128LE(data, base + 16)
    });
  }
  return { index, bins };
}

export interface RpcSolanaBinSourceOptions {
  readonly rpcUrl?: string;
  readonly port?: SolanaRpcBinPort;
  /** Bins each side of the active bin to return. */
  readonly binsEachSide?: number;
}

/**
 * The MeteoraBinSource the scanner and the live preview consume. Returns
 * human-scale amounts and quote-per-base prices ‚Äî the on-chain Q64.64
 * per-lamport price with the decimals adjustment `√ó 10^(decX ‚àí decY)`
 * (verified on mainnet: MET/USDC, both 6 decimals, price 0.299 matches the
 * implied (1+binStep/10000)^activeId).
 */
export function createRpcSolanaBinSource(options: RpcSolanaBinSourceOptions = {}): MeteoraBinSource {
  const port = options.port ?? createWeb3SolanaBinPort(options.rpcUrl ?? 'https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com');
  const binsEachSide = options.binsEachSide ?? 10;

  return {
    async fetchBins(poolAddress) {
      const rawPool = poolAddress.startsWith('solana:') ? poolAddress.slice('solana:'.length) : poolAddress;

      const lbPairBase64 = await port.getAccountInfoBase64(rawPool);
      if (!lbPairBase64) {
        throw new Error(`DLMM pair ${rawPool} not found`);
      }
      const state = decodeLbPairState(Buffer.from(lbPairBase64, 'base64'));

      const arrays = await port.getProgramAccountsMemcmp(
        DLMM_PROGRAM_ID,
        BIN_ARRAY_LB_PAIR_OFFSET,
        rawPool // already base58 of the 32-byte pubkey; memcmp bytes accepts it directly
      );

      const [decX, decY] = await Promise.all([
        port.getTokenDecimals(state.tokenXMint),
        port.getTokenDecimals(state.tokenYMint)
      ]);
      const decimalAdjustment = 10 ** (decX - decY);

      const bins: MeteoraBin[] = [];
      for (const array of arrays) {
        const { bins: decoded } = decodeBinArrayBins(Buffer.from(array.dataBase64, 'base64'));
        for (const bin of decoded) {
          if (Math.abs(bin.binId - state.activeBinId) > binsEachSide) continue;
          bins.push({
            binId: bin.binId,
            price: (Number(bin.priceQ64) / Number(Q64)) * decimalAdjustment,
            baseAmount: Number(bin.rawAmountX) / 10 ** decX,
            quoteAmount: Number(bin.rawAmountY) / 10 ** decY
          });
        }
      }

      return { bins, activeBinId: state.activeBinId, binStep: state.binStep };
    }
  };
}

import type { LpChain, LpProtocol } from '@swat/shared';

export type { LpProtocol };

/**
 * One pool as the scan job writes it ‚Äî chain-normalized so every downstream
 * consumer (fee APR, ranking, the Discover feed) is chain-agnostic.
 *
 * Addresses are chain-prefixed per the repo invariant. Money fields are USD;
 * `fees7d` is nullable because a pool younger than 7 days has no 7d window.
 */
export interface NormalizedPool {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly protocol: LpProtocol;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly pairLabel: string;
  /** Chain-prefixed base (Solana: token X; Uniswap: token0). */
  readonly baseTokenMint: string;
  /** Chain-prefixed quote (Solana: token Y; Uniswap: token1). */
  readonly quoteTokenMint: string;
  readonly feeBps: number;
  readonly binStep: number | null;
  readonly tickSpacing: number | null;
  /** Quote-per-base at scan time; `null` when the chain read failed. */
  readonly currentPrice: number | null;
  /** Total liquidity in the pool, USD. */
  readonly tvl: number;
  /**
   * Liquidity tradeable at the current price, USD. Falls back to `tvl` (with
   * `activeTvlExact: false`) when bin/tick context or prices are unavailable ‚Äî
   * a ceiling, never an underestimate.
   */
  readonly activeTvlUsd: number;
  /** False when `activeTvlUsd` is the total-TVL fallback rather than an observation. */
  readonly activeTvlExact: boolean;
  /** Trailing 24h volume, USD; 0 when not measurable. */
  readonly volume24h: number;
  /** Trailing 24h protocol fees, USD. */
  readonly fees24h: number;
  /** Trailing 7d protocol fees, USD; `null` when the window is unavailable. */
  readonly fees7d: number | null;
}

import { prefixChainValue } from '@swat/shared';
import type { LpPositionReader, ObservedPosition } from './types.js';

/**
 * Robinhood Chain position reader (Track D2) ‚Äî Uniswap v3 position NFTs, with
 * v4 positions behind the same port once the v4 contracts are confirmed.
 *
 * `positions(tokenId)` gives the raw position; valuation needs the pool state
 * and both token prices, which the port provides already computed per leg, so
 * this reader only normalizes and prefixes.
 */

export interface V3PositionView {
  readonly tokenId: string;
  /** Raw token contract addresses. */
  readonly token0: string;
  readonly token1: string;
  /** Raw pool address backing the position. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  /** Human-scale amounts under the current price, priced legs. */
  readonly amount0: number;
  readonly amount1: number;
  /** Human-scale uncollected fees per leg. */
  readonly uncollectedFees0: number;
  readonly uncollectedFees1: number;
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

export interface V3PositionsPort {
  /** All position NFTs the wallet owns, with priced amounts. */
  fetchWalletPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly V3PositionView[]>;
  /** The NonfungiblePositionManager contract holding these token ids. */
  readonly positionManagerAddress: string;
}

export interface LegUsdPriceSource {
  /** USD price by raw token address (lowercased); null when unknown. */
  priceUsd(token: string): Promise<number | null>;
}

export function createRobinhoodLpPositionReader(options: {
  port: V3PositionsPort;
  prices: LegUsdPriceSource;
  protocol?: 'uniswap-v3' | 'uniswap-v4';
}): LpPositionReader {
  void options.protocol; // valuation is protocol-agnostic through the port
  return {
    chain: 'robinhood-chain',
    async readPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly ObservedPosition[]> {
      const views = await options.port.fetchWalletPositions(walletAddress);
      const observed: ObservedPosition[] = [];

      for (const view of views) {
        const [price0, price1] = await Promise.all([
          options.prices.priceUsd(view.token0.toLowerCase()),
          options.prices.priceUsd(view.token1.toLowerCase())
        ]);
        if (price0 === null || price1 === null) continue;

        observed.push({
          // An EVM position's identity is its tokenId inside the position
          // manager, not an address. The chain prefix stays first and the
          // (contract, tokenId) pair rides behind it:
          // `robinhood-chain:<positionManager>:<tokenId>`.
          positionAddress: `robinhood-chain:${options.port.positionManagerAddress.toLowerCase()}:${view.tokenId}`,
          poolAddress: prefixChainValue(view.poolAddress.toLowerCase(), 'robinhood-chain'),
          positionValueUsd: view.amount0 * price0 + view.amount1 * price1,
          uncollectedFeesUsd: view.uncollectedFees0 * price0 + view.uncollectedFees1 * price1,
          inRange: view.inRange
        });
      }
      return observed;
    }
  };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { computeWalletPositionPnl } from './pnl.js';

const t0 = Date.parse('2026-10-01T00:00:00Z');

function point(hoursAfter: number, value: number, fees: number) {
  return {
    capturedAt: new Date(t0 + hoursAfter * 3_600_000),
    positionValueUsd: value,
    uncollectedFeesUsd: fees,
    inRange: true
  };
}

describe('computeWalletPositionPnl', () => {
  it('nets fee growth and inventory growth through the shared netLpResult', () => {
    const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl([
      point(0, 1_000, 0),
      point(24, 1_050, 12)
    ]);
    expect(pnl?.feesEarnedUsd).toBe(12);
    expect(pnl?.inventoryChangeUsd).toBe(50);
    expect(pnl?.netResultUsd).toBe(62);
    expect(pnl?.closed).toBe(false);
  });

  it('a shrinking position nets negative', () => {
    const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl([
      point(0, 2_000, 40),
      point(48, 1_700, 45)
    ]);
    expect(pnl?.inventoryChangeUsd).toBe(-300);
    expect(pnl?.feesEarnedUsd).toBe(5);
    expect(pnl?.netResultUsd).toBe(-295);
  });

  it('orders the series by capture time regardless of input order', () => {
    const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl([
      point(24, 1_050, 12),
      point(0, 1_000, 0)
    ]);
    expect(pnl?.firstObservedAt).toEqual(new Date(t0));
    expect(pnl?.lastObservedAt).toEqual(new Date(t0 + 24 * 3_600_000));
    expect(pnl?.netResultUsd).toBe(62);
  });

  it('a single snapshot is an observation, not a result', () => {
    expect(computeWalletPositionPnl([point(0, 1_000, 0)])).toBeNull();
    expect(computeWalletPositionPnl([])).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a series ending emptied out is marked closed', () => {
    const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl([
      point(0, 1_000, 0),
      point(24, 0, 0)
    ]);
    expect(pnl?.closed).toBe(true);
    expect(pnl?.netResultUsd).toBe(-1_000);
  });
});

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/pnl.ts <==
import { netLpResult } from '../domain/net-lp-result.js';

/**
 * Per-wallet PnL calculator (Track D3).
 *
 * Closes the books for one tracked wallet position from its snapshot series,
 * reusing the Track A net-LP-result function verbatim. The series decomposition
 * is honest about what snapshots can and cannot know:
 *
 *   - `feesEarned` = the growth of uncollected fees between first and last
 *     observation. Fees *collected mid-series* are invisible to this method ‚Äî
 *     the value is documented, and the live indexer will fold fee-claim
 *     events into the series later.
 *   - `inventoryChange` = the growth of inventory value. Sign-convention note:
 *     inventory *growth* is positive, and netLpResult adds it.
 *   - `impermanentLoss`, `gasCost`, `rebalanceCost` are 0 here: the snapshot
 *     series cannot separate IL from inventory drift without a HODL baseline,
 *     and gas/repositioning are execution-side facts. What this computes is
 *     "series PnL" ‚Äî a floor on the true net result.
 */

export interface WalletPositionSnapshotPoint {
  readonly capturedAt: Date;
  readonly positionValueUsd: number;
  readonly uncollectedFeesUsd: number;
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

export interface WalletPositionPnl {
  readonly netResultUsd: number;
  readonly feesEarnedUsd: number;
  readonly inventoryChangeUsd: number;
  readonly firstObservedAt: Date;
  readonly lastObservedAt: Date;
  /** True when the series shows the position emptied out (value and fees at zero). */
  readonly closed: boolean;
}

export function computeWalletPositionPnl(
  series: readonly WalletPositionSnapshotPoint[]
): WalletPositionPnl | null {
  if (series.length < 2) {
    // One point is an observation, not a result ‚Äî nothing has been earned or
    // lost *over time* yet.
    return null;
  }

  const ordered = [...series].sort(
    (left, right) => left.capturedAt.getTime() - right.capturedAt.getTime()
  );
  const first = ordered[0]!;
  const last = ordered[ordered.length - 1]!;

  const feesEarnedUsd = last.uncollectedFeesUsd - first.uncollectedFeesUsd;
  const inventoryChangeUsd = last.positionValueUsd - first.positionValueUsd;

  const netResultUsd = netLpResult({
    feesEarned: feesEarnedUsd,
    impermanentLoss: 0,
    gasCost: 0,
    rebalanceCost: 0,
    inventoryChange: inventoryChangeUsd
  });

  return {
    netResultUsd,
    feesEarnedUsd,
    inventoryChangeUsd,
    firstObservedAt: first.capturedAt,
    lastObservedAt: last.capturedAt,
    closed: last.positionValueUsd === 0 && last.uncollectedFeesUsd === 0
  };
}

    expect(observed?.uncollectedFeesUsd).toBeCloseTo(12.5, 9);
    expect(observed?.inRange).toBe(false);
  });

  it('skips positions with unknown leg prices', async () => {
    const reader = createRobinhoodLpPositionReader({
      port,
      prices: { priceUsd: async () => null }

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/solana-positions.ts <==
import { prefixChainValue } from '@swat/shared';
import type { LpPositionReader, ObservedPosition } from './types.js';

/**
 * Solana DLMM position reader (Track D1).
 *
 * The DLMM SDK call (`getAllLbPairPositionsByUser`) sits behind a port so the
 * normalization is testable without a chain. The SDK returns per-pair amounts
 * in token units; this reader prices both legs through an injected mint-price
 * source and skips positions it cannot price ‚Äî an unpriceable position must
 * read as *absent* from the snapshot, not as a zero-value one, or the PnL
 * series would book a phantom total loss.
 */

export interface DlmmPairPosition {
  /** Raw pair pubkey (unprefixed). */
  readonly pairAddress: string;
  /** Raw position pubkey (unprefixed). */
  readonly positionAddress: string;
  /** Raw mints for pricing. */
  readonly baseMint: string;
  readonly quoteMint: string;
  /** Human-scale token amounts in the position's inventory. */
  readonly baseAmount: number;
  readonly quoteAmount: number;
  /** Human-scale uncollected fees per leg. */
  readonly uncollectedBaseFees: number;
  readonly uncollectedQuoteFees: number;
  /** Current quote-per-base price at the pair's active bin. */
  readonly currentPrice: number;
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

export interface DlmmUserPositionsPort {
  fetchUserPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly DlmmPairPosition[]>;
}

export interface MintUsdPriceSource {
  /** USD price by chain-prefixed mint; null when unknown. */
  priceUsd(chainPrefixedMint: string): Promise<number | null>;
}

export function createSolanaLpPositionReader(options: {
  port: DlmmUserPositionsPort;
  prices: MintUsdPriceSource;
}): LpPositionReader {
  return {
    chain: 'solana',
    async readPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly ObservedPosition[]> {
      const pairs = await options.port.fetchUserPositions(walletAddress);
      const observed: ObservedPosition[] = [];

      for (const pair of pairs) {
        const [basePriceUsd, quotePriceUsd] = await Promise.all([
          options.prices.priceUsd(prefixChainValue(pair.baseMint, 'solana')),
          options.prices.priceUsd(prefixChainValue(pair.quoteMint, 'solana'))
        ]);
        if (basePriceUsd === null || quotePriceUsd === null) continue;

        // Each leg is priced once, in USD per token. `currentPrice` is
        // quote-per-base ‚Äî multiplying it in as well would double-count the
        // quote leg's unit and inflate the base leg by the pool price.
        const positionValueUsd =
          pair.baseAmount * basePriceUsd + pair.quoteAmount * quotePriceUsd;
        const uncollectedFeesUsd =
          pair.uncollectedBaseFees * basePriceUsd
          + pair.uncollectedQuoteFees * quotePriceUsd;

        observed.push({
          positionAddress: prefixChainValue(pair.positionAddress, 'solana'),
          poolAddress: prefixChainValue(pair.pairAddress, 'solana'),
          positionValueUsd,
          uncollectedFeesUsd,
          inRange: pair.inRange
        });
      }
      return observed;
    }
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/types.ts <==
import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';

/**
 * LP wallet indexer shapes (Track D).
 *
 * A reader turns one wallet into a set of *observations* ‚Äî what the wallet's
 * LP positions are worth right now. Valuation happens inside the reader (it
 * has the chain context); the indexer records the series and the PnL
 * calculator closes the books from the series.
 */

export interface ObservedPosition {
  /** Chain-prefixed position identifier (Solana position pubkey; EVM tokenId as address-shaped? no ‚Äî `position:<tokenId>` is NOT valid here; use the chain-prefixed NFT/position account). */
  readonly positionAddress: string;
  /** Chain-prefixed pool the position sits in. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  /** Current inventory value of the position, USD (excludes uncollected fees). */
  readonly positionValueUsd: number;
  /** Uncollected fees sitting in the position, USD. */
  readonly uncollectedFeesUsd: number;
  /** Whether the position's range contains the current price. */
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

export interface LpPositionReader {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  /** All LP positions one wallet holds, ready to be recorded as a snapshot row. */
  readPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly ObservedPosition[]>;
}

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/wallet-indexer.ts <==
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import {
  recordLpWalletIndexPass,
  trackLpWallet,
  untrackLpWallet,
  upsertLpWalletPositionResult
} from '@swat/db';
import { computeWalletPositionPnl, type WalletPositionSnapshotPoint } from './pnl.js';
import type { LpPositionReader, ObservedPosition } from './types.js';

/**
 * The wallet indexer (Track D4) ‚Äî storage wiring around the readers.
 *
 * `runWalletIndexPass` is one scheduled sweep: every tracked wallet is read
 * through its chain's reader, the observation becomes a snapshot row, and any
 * position whose series can close the books gets its net result upserted into
 * the results table the leaderboard aggregates.
 *
 * Track D5 (the leaderboard query) lives in `@swat/db`
 * (`queryLpWalletLeaderboard`) because it is a pure SQL aggregation.
 */

export interface TrackedWalletRef {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly chain: Chain;
  readonly walletAddress: string;
}

export interface WalletIndexPassDeps {
  readonly readers: readonly LpPositionReader[];
  readonly listWallets?: () => Promise<readonly TrackedWalletRef[]>;
  readonly recordPass?: typeof recordLpWalletIndexPass;
  readonly upsertResult?: typeof upsertLpWalletPositionResult;
  /** Snapshot series per (tracked wallet id, position address), for PnL closing. */
  readonly snapshotSeries?: (trackedWalletId: string, positionAddress: string) => Promise<readonly WalletPositionSnapshotPoint[]>;
}

export interface WalletIndexPassSummary {
  walletsIndexed: number;
  positionsObserved: number;
  resultsClosed: number;
  failedWallets: string[];
}

export async function runWalletIndexPass(deps: WalletIndexPassDeps): Promise<WalletIndexPassSummary> {
  const listWallets = deps.listWallets ?? defaultListWallets;
  const recordPass = deps.recordPass ?? recordLpWalletIndexPass;
  const upsertResult = deps.upsertResult ?? upsertLpWalletPositionResult;
  const snapshotSeries = deps.snapshotSeries ?? (async () => []);

  const wallets = await listWallets();
  const summary: WalletIndexPassSummary = {
    walletsIndexed: 0,
    positionsObserved: 0,
    resultsClosed: 0,
    failedWallets: []
  };

  for (const wallet of wallets) {
    const reader = deps.readers.find((candidate) => candidate.chain === wallet.chain);
    if (!reader) {
      summary.failedWallets.push(wallet.walletAddress);
      continue;
    }
    try {
      const observed = await reader.readPositions(wallet.walletAddress);
      await recordPass(
        wallet.id,
        observed.map((position) => ({
          positionAddress: position.positionAddress,
          poolAddress: position.poolAddress,
          capturedAt: new Date(),
          positionValueUsd: position.positionValueUsd,
          uncollectedFeesUsd: position.uncollectedFeesUsd,
          inRange: position.inRange
        }))
      );
      summary.walletsIndexed += 1;
      summary.positionsObserved += observed.length;

      for (const position of observed) {
        const series = await snapshotSeries(wallet.id, position.positionAddress);
        const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl(series);
        if (!pnl) continue;
        await upsertResult(wallet.id, {
          positionAddress: position.positionAddress,
          poolAddress: position.poolAddress,
          chain: reader.chain,
          strategyType: 'spot', // strategy attribution arrives with position metadata; spot is the ladder default
          netResultUsd: pnl.netResultUsd,
          firstObservedAt: pnl.firstObservedAt,
          lastObservedAt: pnl.lastObservedAt,
          closed: pnl.closed
        });
        summary.resultsClosed += 1;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      summary.failedWallets.push(wallet.walletAddress);
      console.error(
        '[lp] wallet index pass failed for',
        wallet.walletAddress,
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
      );
    }
  }

  return summary;
}

async function defaultListWallets(): Promise<readonly TrackedWalletRef[]> {
  const { listTrackedLpWallets } = await import('@swat/db');
  const wallets = await listTrackedLpWallets({ limit: 500 });
  return wallets.map((wallet) => ({
    id: wallet.id,
    chain: wallet.chain,
    walletAddress: wallet.walletAddress
  }));
}

export { trackLpWallet, untrackLpWallet };

==> apps/mcp-server/src/index.ts <==
import { Server } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js";
import { SSEServerTransport } from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/sse.js";
import {
  CallToolRequestSchema,
  ListToolsRequestSchema,
} from "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/types.js";
import express from "express";
import { Redis } from "ioredis";
import { query, resolvePrefixedAddress, withTransaction } from "@swat/db";
import { initLogger, REDIS_CHANNELS } from "@swat/shared";
import { z } from "zod";

initLogger("mcp-server");

const PORT = Number(process.env.MCP_PORT ?? 3005);
const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? "redis://localhost:6379";
const redis = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });

// Initialize MCP Server
const server = new Server(
  {
    name: "swat-mcp-server",
    version: "0.1.0",
  },
  {
    capabilities: {
      tools: {},
    },
  }
);

// Define tools
const TOOL_DEFINITIONS = [
  {
    name: "get_recent_signals",
    description: "Fetch the most recent trading signals generated by the SWAT engine.",
    inputSchema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        limit: {
          type: "number",
          description: "Maximum number of signals to return (default 10).",
        },
      },
    },
  },
  {
    name: "get_wallet_score",
    description: "Retrieve risk scoring, tier, confidence, and statistics for a given Solana wallet address.",
    inputSchema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        walletAddress: {
          type: "string",
          description: "The Solana public key of the wallet to inspect.",
        },
      },
      required: ["walletAddress"],
    },
  },
  {
    name: "get_performance",
    description: "Fetch overall trading performance statistics (win rate, net USD P&L, open positions, recent execution fills).",
    inputSchema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {},
    },
  },
  {
    name: "get_blacklist",
    description: "Retrieve the list of currently blacklisted token mint addresses.",
    inputSchema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {},
    },
  },
  {
    name: "add_to_blacklist",
    description: "Add a new token mint address (e.g. stablecoins, spam tokens) to the blacklist config.",
    inputSchema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        tokenMint: {
          type: "string",
          description: "The Solana mint address of the token to blacklist.",
        },
      },
      required: ["tokenMint"],
    },
  },
  {
    name: "remove_from_blacklist",
    description: "Remove a token mint address from the blacklist config.",
    inputSchema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        tokenMint: {
          type: "string",
          description: "The Solana mint address of the token to remove.",
        },
      },
      required: ["tokenMint"],
    },
  },
  {
    name: "trigger_scorer",
    description: "Trigger an on-demand scorer batch run to recalculate wallet tiers, average ROI, and clusters.",
    inputSchema: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {},
    },
  },
];

// Register list tools handler
server.setRequestHandler(ListToolsRequestSchema, async () => {
  return {
    tools: TOOL_DEFINITIONS,
  };
});

// Register call tool handler
server.setRequestHandler(CallToolRequestSchema, async (request) => {
  const { name, arguments: args } = request.params;

  try {
    switch (name) {
      case "get_recent_signals": {
        // Validate MCP limit: clamp to prevent extreme queries
        const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, Number(args?.limit ?? 10)));
        const rows = await query(
          `SELECT id, pattern_type, cluster_id, token_mint, token_name, token_symbol, confidence, signal_score, status, created_at
           FROM signals
           ORDER BY created_at DESC
           LIMIT $1`,
          [limit]
        );
        return {
          content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) }],
        };
      }

      case "get_wallet_score": {
        const { walletAddress } = z
          .object({ walletAddress: z.string() })
          .parse(args);

        const resolvedWalletAddress = await resolvePrefixedAddress(walletAddress);

        // Fetch wallet details from scoring tables
        const walletRows = await query(
          `SELECT w.address, w.tier, w.composite_score, w.realized_roi, w.total_trades, w.win_rate
           FROM wallets w
           WHERE w.address = $1`,
          [resolvedWalletAddress]
        );

        if (walletRows.length === 0) {
          return {
            content: [{ type: "text", text: `Wallet ${walletAddress} has not been scored or indexed yet.` }],
          };
        }

        const clusterRows = await query(
          `SELECT c.id, c.name, c.avg_composite_score, c.avg_win_rate
           FROM wallet_clusters c
           JOIN cluster_memberships m ON c.id = m.cluster_id
           WHERE m.wallet_address = $1`,
          [resolvedWalletAddress]
        );

        return {
          content: [
            {
              type: "text",
              text: JSON.stringify(
                {
                  wallet: walletRows[0],
                  clusters: clusterRows,
                },
                null,
                2
              ),
            },
          ],
        };
      }

      case "get_performance": {
        // Net P&L & Win Rate
        const summaryRows = await query<{
          net_pnl_usd: string | null;
          win_rate: string | null;
          total_trades: string | null;
        }>(`
          SELECT
            SUM(pnl_usd) AS net_pnl_usd,
            CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd > 0) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) ELSE 0 END AS win_rate,
            COUNT(*) AS total_trades
          FROM signals
          WHERE status = 'executed' AND pnl_usd IS NOT NULL
        `);

        // Open positions (from trades)
        const openRows = await query(`
          SELECT token_mint, SUM(amount_sol) AS total_sol, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_usd, direction
          FROM trades
          WHERE execution_mode IS NULL OR execution_mode != 'shadow'
          GROUP BY token_mint, direction
        `);

        // Executed fills
        const fillRows = await query(`
          SELECT id, token_mint, direction, amount_sol, amount_usd, token_amount, price_usd, executor, status, executed_at
          FROM trades
          WHERE execution_mode IS NULL OR execution_mode != 'shadow'
          ORDER BY executed_at DESC
          LIMIT 20
        `);

        return {
          content: [
            {
              type: "text",
              text: JSON.stringify(
                {
                  summary: {
                    net_pnl_usd: summaryRows[0]?.net_pnl_usd ?? 0,
                    win_rate: summaryRows[0]?.win_rate ?? 0,
                    total_trades: summaryRows[0]?.total_trades ?? 0
                  },
                  openPositions: openRows,
                  recentFills: fillRows,
                },
                null,
                2
              ),
            },
          ],
        };
      }

      case "get_blacklist": {
        const rows = await query(`SELECT value FROM config WHERE key = 'blacklist'`);
        const value = rows[0]?.value;
        let blacklist: string[] = [];
        if (value) {
          if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            blacklist = value;
          } else if (typeof value === "string") {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
              blacklist = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
            } catch {
              blacklist = value.split(",").map((s) => s.trim());
            }
          }
        }
        return {
          content: [{ type: "text", text: JSON.stringify({ blacklist }, null, 2) }],
        };
      }

      case "add_to_blacklist": {
        const { tokenMint } = z.object({ tokenMint: z.string() }).parse(args);

        const limitReached = await withTransaction(async (client) => {
          const res = await client.query(`SELECT value FROM config WHERE key = 'blacklist' FOR UPDATE`);
          const value = res.rows[0]?.value;
          let blacklist: string[] = [];
          if (value) {
            if (Array.isArray(value)) {
              blacklist = value;
            } else if (typeof value === "string") {
              try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
                blacklist = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
              } catch {
                blacklist = value.split(",").map((s) => s.trim());
              }
            }
          }

          if (!blacklist.includes(tokenMint)) {
            if (blacklist.length >= 100) {
              // Returning commits the (still read-only) transaction and drops
              // the FOR UPDATE row lock ‚Äî what the explicit ROLLBACK on this
              // path did. Nothing has been written yet.
              return true;
            }
            blacklist.push(tokenMint);
          }

          await client.query(
            `INSERT INTO config (key, value) VALUES ('blacklist', $1)
             ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW()`,
            [JSON.stringify(blacklist)]
          );
          return false;
        });

        if (limitReached) {
          return {
            content: [{ type: "text", text: "Blacklist limit reached. Please remove items first." }],
          };
        }

        return {
          content: [{ type: "text", text: `Successfully added ${tokenMint} to the blacklist.` }],
        };
      }

      case "remove_from_blacklist": {
        const { tokenMint } = z.object({ tokenMint: z.string() }).parse(args);

        await withTransaction(async (client) => {
          const res = await client.query(`SELECT value FROM config WHERE key = 'blacklist' FOR UPDATE`);
          const value = res.rows[0]?.value;
          let blacklist: string[] = [];
          if (value) {
            if (Array.isArray(value)) {
              blacklist = value;
            } else if (typeof value === "string") {
              try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
                blacklist = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
              } catch {
                blacklist = value.split(",").map((s) => s.trim());
              }
            }
          }

          const filtered = blacklist.filter((m) => m !== tokenMint);

          await client.query(
            `UPDATE config SET value = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE key = 'blacklist'`,
            [JSON.stringify(filtered)]
          );
        });

        return {
          content: [{ type: "text", text: `Successfully removed ${tokenMint} from the blacklist.` }],
        };
      }

      case "trigger_scorer": {
        await redis.publish(REDIS_CHANNELS.scorerRun, JSON.stringify({}));
        return {
          content: [{ type: "text", text: "Successfully published scorer run command to Redis channel." }],
        };
      }

      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
    }
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error(`[mcp-server] Error executing tool ${name}:`, error);
    return {
      isError: true,
      content: [{ type: "text", text: `Error: ${error.message || error}` }],
    };
  }
});

==> apps/scorer/_ingest_wallets.ts <==
/**
 * SWAT Wallet Ingestion Tool
 *
 * Reads the generated `wallet-starter-pack.json` from the repository root,
 * validates the chain-aware input, upserts the wallets, and enqueues them for
 * on-chain indexing via BullMQ.
 *
 * Run: npx tsx --env-file=../../.env _ingest_wallets.ts
 */
import { Queue } from 'bullmq';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { upsertWallet } from '@swat/db';
import {
  createWalletBackfillJob,
  QUEUES
} from '@swat/shared';
import {
  parseStarterPackWallets,
  parseWalletChain,
  resolveStarterPackPath
} from './src/starter-pack.js';

const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
const connection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
const backfillQueue = new Queue(QUEUES.walletBackfill, { connection });

async function run() {
  const walletChain = parseWalletChain(process.env.WALLET_CHAIN);
  const jsonPath = resolveStarterPackPath(
    import.meta.url,
    process.env.STARTER_PACK_PATH
  );

  let wallets;
  try {
    wallets = parseStarterPackWallets(
      await readFile(jsonPath, 'utf8'),
      walletChain
    );
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(
      `Unable to load starter pack at ${jsonPath}: ${
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      }`
    );
  }

  console.log(`Starting ingestion of ${wallets.length} wallets from ${jsonPath}...`);

  let inserted = 0;
  for (const wallet of wallets) {
    try {
      await upsertWallet({
        address: wallet.address,
        chain: wallet.chain,
        source: 'discovered'
      });

      const job = createWalletBackfillJob(wallet.address, wallet.chain);
      await backfillQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);

      console.log(`  Processed & enqueued: ${wallet.chain}:${wallet.address}`);
      inserted++;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        `  Failed to process ${wallet.chain}:${wallet.address}:`,
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
      );
    }
  }

  console.log(
    `\nSuccessfully ingested and enqueued ${inserted}/${wallets.length} wallets for indexing.`
  );
}

run()
  .catch((error) => {
    console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await backfillQueue.close();
    await connection.quit();
  });

==> apps/scorer/src/close-all.ts <==
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import type { CloseAllLotJob, CopyExecutionRecord, LotExitExecutionInput } from '@swat/db';

export interface CloseAllSweepResult {
  readonly scanned: number;
  readonly claimed: number;
  readonly queued: number;
  readonly ended: number;
  readonly failed: number;
}

export interface CloseAllSellPayload {
  readonly signalId: string;
  readonly tokenMint: string;
  readonly direction: 'sell';
  readonly sellTokenAmount: number;
  readonly userId: string;
  readonly closeAll: true;
  readonly exitLotId: string;
  readonly copyExecutionId: string;
  readonly score: number;
}

export interface CloseAllSweepDeps {
  readonly listJobs: () => Promise<CloseAllLotJob[]>;
  readonly claimExit: (input: LotExitExecutionInput) => Promise<{ execution: CopyExecutionRecord; created: boolean }>;
  readonly enqueueSell: (payload: CloseAllSellPayload, jobId: string, chain: Chain) => Promise<unknown>;
  readonly endCompleted: () => Promise<number>;
}

/**
 * Sweeps subscriptions in 'winding_down' with a close_all request.
 *
 * Claims exact lot exits idempotently and enqueues sell jobs to the trade queue.
 * After all candidate lots are claimed and queued, checks if any subscriptions
 * have no remaining open lots and transitions them to 'ended'.
 */
export async function runCloseAllSweep(deps: CloseAllSweepDeps): Promise<CloseAllSweepResult> {
  const jobs = await deps.listJobs();
  let claimed = 0;
  let queued = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  for (const job of jobs) {
    try {
      const claimResult = await deps.claimExit({
        lotId: job.lotId,
        userId: job.userId,
        requestId: job.jobId,
        trigger: 'close-all',
        requestedBaseQuantity: job.sellTokenAmount.toString()
      });
      claimed++;

      if (claimResult.execution.state !== 'confirmed' && claimResult.execution.state !== 'failed') {
        await deps.enqueueSell(
          {
            signalId: job.signalId,
            tokenMint: job.tokenMint,
            direction: 'sell',
            sellTokenAmount: job.sellTokenAmount,
            userId: job.userId,
            closeAll: true,
            exitLotId: job.lotId,
            copyExecutionId: claimResult.execution.id,
            score: 100
          },
          job.jobId,
          job.chain
        );
        queued++;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      failed++;
      console.error(`[scorer] Close-all exit claim/enqueue failed for lot ${job.lotId}:`, error);
    }
  }

  const ended = await deps.endCompleted();
  return {
    scanned: jobs.length,
    claimed,
    queued,
    ended,
    failed
  };
}

describe('formatExpectancyDigest', () => {
  it('renders eligible outcome counts from a persisted report', () => {

      id: 'report-1',

      config_snapshot: {},
      rows: [{
        pattern_type: 'snipe',
        tier: 'elite',
        chain: 'solana',
        execution_mode: 'live',
        eligible_outcomes: 1,
        hit_rate_pct: 100,
        avg_win_usd: 2,
        avg_loss_usd: null,
        expectancy_usd: 2
      }]
    };

    await expect(runAttributionReporting({
      rebuildOutcomes: async () => { calls.push('rebuild'); },
      persistReport: async () => { calls.push('persist'); return report; },
      publishDigest: async () => { calls.push('publish'); }
    })).resolves.toEqual(report);

    expect(calls).toEqual(['rebuild', 'persist', 'publish']);
  });

  it('does not persist or publish when rebuilding outcomes fails', async () => {
    const persistReport = vi.fn();
    const publishDigest = vi.fn();

    await expect(runAttributionReporting({
      rebuildOutcomes: async () => { throw new Error('rebuild failed'); },
      persistReport,
      publishDigest
    })).rejects.toThrow('rebuild failed');

    expect(persistReport).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(publishDigest).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('persists empty reports without publishing a fabricated digest', async () => {
    const publishDigest = vi.fn();

      id: 'report-empty',
      generated_at: '2026-07-26T02:00:00.000Z',
      config_snapshot: {},
      rows: []
    };

    await runAttributionReporting({
      rebuildOutcomes: async () => undefined,
      persistReport: async () => report,
      publishDigest
    });

    expect(publishDigest).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

==> apps/scorer/src/expectancy.ts <==
import type { ExpectancyReport } from '@swat/db';

export type AttributionReportingDependencies = {
  rebuildOutcomes: () => Promise<void>;
  persistReport: () => Promise<ExpectancyReport>;
  publishDigest: (message: string) => Promise<unknown>;
};

export function formatExpectancyDigest(report: ExpectancyReport): string | null {
  if (report.rows.length === 0) return null;

  return report.rows.slice(0, 10).map((row) =>
    `${row.pattern_type} | ${row.tier ?? 'all'} | ${row.chain} | ${row.execution_mode}\n` +
    `Count: ${row.eligible_outcomes} | HR: ${Number(row.hit_rate_pct).toFixed(1)}% | ` +
    `Exp: $${Number(row.expectancy_usd).toFixed(2)}`
  ).join('\n\n');
}

/** Rebuild first so a failed attribution query can never publish a stale report. */
export async function runAttributionReporting(
  dependencies: AttributionReportingDependencies
): Promise<ExpectancyReport> {
  await dependencies.rebuildOutcomes();
  const report = await dependencies.persistReport();
  const digest = formatExpectancyDigest(report);
  if (digest) await dependencies.publishDigest(digest);
  return report;
}

// Stop-loss exits go through the same durable queues the signal engine uses, so
// they inherit the executor's mode gating, circuit breaker and reconciliation.
// One queue per chain since S3-25, so a stalled venue cannot hold up another
// chain's exits ‚Äî which for a stop-loss is the difference between a bounded loss
// and an unbounded one.
const tradeQueueConnection = new Redis(redisUrlForPublish, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
const tradeQueues = new Map<Chain, Queue>(
  (['solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain'] as const).map((chain) => {
    const queue = new Queue(tradeQueueForChain(chain), { connection: tradeQueueConnection });
    queue.on('error', (error) => console.error(`[scorer] ${chain} trade queue error`, error));
    return [chain, queue];
  })
);

initLogger('scorer');

/** Regenerate clusters on demand (API POST /v1/clusters/:id/refresh). */
async function regenerateClusters() {
  console.log('[scorer] Regenerating clusters on demand...');
  await generateFundingClusters();
  await generateBehavioralClusters();
  await refreshClusterPerformance();
  console.log('[scorer] Cluster regeneration complete.');
}

async function runStage<T>(label: string, action: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T | null> {
  try {
    return await action();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`[scorer] ${label} failed`, error);
    return null;
  }
}

async function refreshClusterPerformance() {
  const clusters = await listClusters();
  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    clusters.map((cluster: any) => updateClusterPerformance(cluster.id))
  );
  const failures = results.filter((result) => result.status === 'rejected').length;
  if (failures > 0) {
    throw new Error(`${failures} cluster performance updates failed`);
  }
}

async function runScoringBatch() {
  console.log('[scorer] Starting nightly scoring batch...');
  const startTime = Date.now();

  const wallets = await getActiveWallets();
  console.log(`[scorer] Scoring ${wallets.length} active wallets...`);

  let scored = 0;
  let errors = 0;

  for (const wallet of wallets) {
    try {
      const metrics = await getWalletMetrics(wallet.address, wallet.chain);
      const score = calculateCompositeScore(metrics);
      const tier = scoreToTier(score);
      await updateWalletScore(wallet.address, score, tier, metrics);
      scored++;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(`[scorer] Error scoring ${wallet.address}:`, e);
      errors++;
    }
  }
  console.log(`[scorer] Scored ${scored} wallets (${errors} errors)`);

  console.log('[scorer] Running pruning rules...');
  await runStage('pause underperforming wallets', pauseUnderperformingWallets);
  await runStage('promote discovered wallets', promoteHighScoringDiscoveredWallets);
  await runStage('reactivate dormant wallets', reactivateDormantWallets);

  // Now that token-discovered 'token-big' wallets have been scored, drop the ones
  // that turned out unprofitable (ROI <= 0 OR win rate < 50%) before they enter
  // clustering. 'token-early' wallets are kept unconditionally.
  const pruned = await runStage('prune unprofitable token-big wallets', pruneUnprofitableBigBuyers);
  if (pruned !== null && pruned > 0) {
    console.log(`[scorer] Pruned ${pruned} unprofitable token-big wallets`);
  }

  console.log('[scorer] Running clustering engines...');
  await runStage('funding clustering', generateFundingClusters);
  await runStage('behavioral clustering', generateBehavioralClusters);
  await runStage('cluster performance refresh', refreshClusterPerformance);

  console.log('[scorer] Marking open positions to market...');
  await runStage('mark-to-market', runMarkToMarketGuarded);

  console.log('[scorer] Running nightly attribution and expectancy report...');
  await runStage('nightly attribution and expectancy report', () => runAttributionReporting({
    rebuildOutcomes: runNightlyAttribution,
    persistReport: persistExpectancyReport,
    publishDigest: (message) => redisPublishClient.publish(
      REDIS_CHANNELS.alertQueue,
      JSON.stringify({
        type: 'NIGHTLY_EXPECTANCY',
        title: 'Nightly Expectancy Report',
        message
      })
    )
  }));

  console.log('[scorer] Computing out-of-sample master metrics (24h / 7d / 30d)...');
  await runStage('master metrics', runMasterMetrics);

  const elapsed = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
  console.log(`[scorer] Batch complete in ${elapsed}s.`);
}

/**
 * S4-M8 - out-of-sample master metrics over 24h / 7d / 30d. Runs on the nightly
 * batch because a track record does not change intraday in a way any user acts
 * on, and the round-trip reconstruction reads up to 180 days per master.
 */
async function runMasterMetrics() {
  const asOf = new Date();
  const result = await runMasterMetricsBatch({
    listMasters: () => listMasterCandidates({ asOf }),
    fetchTrades: fetchMasterTradeRows,
    asOf
  });

  console.log(
    `[scorer] Master metrics: ${result.masters} candidates, ${result.reports.length} reported, ` +
    `${result.decaying} decaying, ${result.improving} improving, ` +
    `${result.insufficientEverywhere} with insufficient history in every window, ` +
    `${result.failed} failed.`
  );
  // Divergence is itself the finding (ADR-0005 section 5.3), so a decaying
  // master is logged individually rather than only counted.
  for (const report of result.reports) {
    if (report.trend === 'decaying') console.log(`[scorer] decaying master - ${formatMasterMetricsLine(report)}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Refresh unrealised P&L on open positions. Runs inside the nightly batch and
 * on a short standalone cron so /v1/trading/performance stays current.
 */
async function runMarkToMarket() {
  let positions: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof markToMarketOpenPositions>>['positions'] = [];
  try {
    const result = await markToMarketOpenPositions();
    positions = result.positions;
    console.log(`[scorer] Mark-to-market: updated ${result.updated}, skipped ${result.skipped}.`);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[scorer] Mark-to-market failed:', e);
    return;
  }

  // Stop-loss is evaluated against the prices the pass above just fetched, so a
  // breach is acted on within one mark-to-market interval and never on a stale
  // quote. A failure here must not mask a successful mark-to-market.
  try {
    const sweep = await runStopLossSweep({
      positions,
      resolvePolicy: resolveRiskPolicy,
      claim: claimStopLossTrigger,
      release: releaseStopLossTrigger,
      enqueueSell: (job, jobId, chain) => {
        const queue = tradeQueues.get(chain);
        // Refuse rather than fall back to another chain's queue: the sweep
        // releases the claim on a throw, so the next pass retries the exit.
        if (!queue) throw new Error(`No trade queue configured for chain ${chain}`);
        return queue.add('stop-loss-sell', job, {
          jobId,
          removeOnComplete: true,
          attempts: 4,
          backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 5000 }
        });
      },
      publishAlert: (alert) => redisPublishClient.publish(
        REDIS_CHANNELS.alertQueue,
        JSON.stringify(alert)
      )
    });
    if (sweep.breached > 0) {
      console.log(
        `[scorer] Stop-loss: scanned ${sweep.scanned}, breached ${sweep.breached}, ` +
        `queued ${sweep.queued}, already triggered ${sweep.alreadyTriggered}, failed ${sweep.failed}.`
      );
    }
    // Logged outside the `breached` guard and on its own line: an unaccountable position
    // never reaches the breach check, so it would otherwise be invisible in exactly the
    // case where nothing breached. Worded as a ledger problem because that is the fix --
    // a `trades.user_id` that is neither a uuid nor NULL, which no retry will clear.
    if (sweep.unaccountable > 0) {
      console.error(
        `[scorer] Stop-loss: ${sweep.unaccountable} position(s) skipped with an unusable ` +
        `owner -- check trades.user_id on those signals; this will not self-resolve.`
      );
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[scorer] Stop-loss sweep failed:', e);
  }

  // Close-all sweep: claims exact lot exits, enqueues sells, and ends completed subscriptions.
  try {
    const sweep = await runCloseAllSweep({
      listJobs: listCloseAllLotJobs,
      claimExit: claimLotExitExecution,
      enqueueSell: (job, jobId, chain) => {
        const queue = tradeQueues.get(chain);
        if (!queue) throw new Error(`No trade queue configured for chain ${chain}`);
        return queue.add('close-all-sell', job, {
          jobId,
          removeOnComplete: true,
          attempts: 4,
          backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 5000 }
        });
      },
      endCompleted: endCompletedCloseAllSubscriptions
    });
    if (sweep.scanned > 0 || sweep.ended > 0) {
      console.log(
        `[scorer] Close-all: scanned ${sweep.scanned}, claimed ${sweep.claimed}, ` +
        `queued ${sweep.queued}, ended ${sweep.ended}, failed ${sweep.failed}.`
      );
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[scorer] Close-all sweep failed:', e);
  }
}

// In-process guards prevent overlapping runs: a batch that overruns into the
// next schedule, or the nightly batch's mark-to-market racing the 5-minute one
// (both issue overlapping UPDATEs). Single-process deployment, so a boolean
// flag is sufficient and avoids the cross-connection pitfalls of pooled
// pg_advisory_lock.
let batchRunning = false;
let mtmRunning = false;

async function runScoringBatchGuarded() {
  if (batchRunning) {
    console.log('[scorer] batch already running, skipping this trigger.');
    return;
  }
  batchRunning = true;
  try {
    await runScoringBatch();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[scorer] batch failed', e);
  } finally {
    batchRunning = false;
  }
}

async function runMarkToMarketGuarded() {
  if (mtmRunning) return;
  mtmRunning = true;
  try {
    await runMarkToMarket();
  } finally {
    mtmRunning = false;
  }
}

// Nightly at 02:00 UTC
cron.schedule('0 2 * * *', () => {
  runScoringBatchGuarded().catch(console.error);
}, { timezone: 'UTC' });

// Mark-to-market every 5 minutes so paper-trade P&L stays fresh.
cron.schedule('*/5 * * * *', () => {
  runMarkToMarketGuarded().catch(console.error);
}, { timezone: 'UTC' });

// On-demand cluster refresh: the API publishes here when a user hits
// POST /v1/clusters/:id/refresh. Without this subscriber the endpoint was a
// silent no-op.
const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
const subscriber = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
let clusterRefreshing = false;

function subscribeScorerEvents() {
  subscriber.subscribe(REDIS_CHANNELS.clusterRefresh, REDIS_CHANNELS.scorerRun, (err) => {
    if (err) console.error('[scorer] subscribe failed', err);
    else console.log('[scorer] subscribed to cluster-refresh and scorer-run channels.');
  });
}
subscribeScorerEvents();
subscriber.on('ready', subscribeScorerEvents); // resubscribe after reconnect
subscriber.on('error', (e) => console.error('[scorer] redis error', e.message));
subscriber.on('message', (channel) => {
  if (channel === REDIS_CHANNELS.clusterRefresh) {
    if (clusterRefreshing) return;
    clusterRefreshing = true;
    regenerateClusters()
      .catch((e) => console.error('[scorer] cluster refresh failed', e))
      .finally(() => { clusterRefreshing = false; });
  } else if (channel === REDIS_CHANNELS.scorerRun) {
    console.log('[scorer] Manual scorer batch run triggered on-demand.');
    runScoringBatchGuarded()
      .catch((e) => console.error('[scorer] manual scoring batch failed', e));
  }
});

console.log('[scorer] Service running. Scheduled at 02:00 UTC daily; mark-to-market every 5m; listening for cluster-refresh.');

if (process.env.RUN_ON_STARTUP === 'true') {
  runScoringBatchGuarded().catch(console.error);
}

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

// `master-metrics.ts` imports `query` from @swat/db, whose barrel eagerly
// constructs the pg pool. Nothing here connects - every DB call in the batch is
// an injected dependency - but the module demands a URL at import time.
vi.hoisted(() => {
  process.env.DATABASE_URL ??= 'postgres://master-metrics-unit-test/unused';

// The oracle. `calculateAverageCostPnl` is the repo's existing average-cost
// ledger; asserting our round-trip walker sums to its `realizedPnlUsd` is what
// stops the two conventions drifting apart.
import { calculateAverageCostPnl } from '@swat/db';

// `PositionLedgerTrade` is declared in `packages/db/src/pnl-math.ts` but is not
// re-exported by `pnl-queries.ts`, so it is not reachable through `@swat/db` in
// either `src` or `dist`. Structurally identical local copy rather than a change
// to a package this item may not touch.
type PositionLedgerTrade = {
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell';
  tokenAmount: number;
  amountUsd: number;
  feeUsd?: number;
};

import {
  DEFAULT_MIN_TRADES_BY_WINDOW,
  MASTER_METRIC_WINDOWS,
  ROUND_TRIP_LOOKBACK_MS,
  buildMasterRoundTrips,
  compareWindows,
  computeMasterMetrics,
  computeWindowMetrics,
  formatMasterMetricsLine,
  median,
  realizedMaxDrawdownUsd,
  resolveMinTradesByWindow,
  roundTripsInWindow,
  runMasterMetricsBatch,
  type MasterMetricsBatchDependencies,
  type MasterRoundTrip,
  type MasterTradeRow,
  type MasterWindowFigures
} from './master-metrics.js';

const T0 = new Date('2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z');
const HOUR = 3_600_000;
const at = (hours: number) => new Date(T0.getTime() + hours * HOUR);

function row(overrides: Partial<MasterTradeRow> = {}): MasterTradeRow {
  return {
    walletAddress: 'solana:MASTER',
    chain: 'solana',
    tokenMint: 'solana:TOKEN-A',
    direction: 'buy',
    tokenAmount: 100,
    amountUsd: 1000,
    feeUsd: null,
    eventAt: at(0),
    ...overrides
  };
}

function roundTrip(overrides: Partial<MasterRoundTrip> = {}): MasterRoundTrip {
  const openedAt = overrides.openedAt ?? at(0);
  const closedAt = overrides.closedAt ?? at(1);
  return {
    walletAddress: 'solana:MASTER',
    chain: 'solana',
    tokenMint: 'solana:TOKEN-A',
    openedAt,
    closedAt,
    holdMs: closedAt.getTime() - openedAt.getTime(),
    costBasisUsd: 1000,
    proceedsUsd: 1100,
    realizedPnlUsd: 100,
    feeUsd: 0,
    feesRecorded: false,
    legs: 2,
    ...overrides
  };
}

/** The five-trade window sample used by several assertions below. */
function sampleWindowRoundTrips(): MasterRoundTrip[] {
  return [
    roundTrip({ openedAt: at(0), closedAt: at(1), realizedPnlUsd: 100 }),
    roundTrip({ openedAt: at(1), closedAt: at(3), realizedPnlUsd: -50 }),
    roundTrip({ openedAt: at(2), closedAt: at(5), realizedPnlUsd: -80 }),
    roundTrip({ openedAt: at(3), closedAt: at(7), realizedPnlUsd: 30 }),
    roundTrip({ openedAt: at(4), closedAt: at(9), realizedPnlUsd: 200 })
  ];
}

function ok(metrics: ReturnType<typeof computeWindowMetrics>): MasterWindowFigures {
  if (metrics.status !== 'ok') {
    throw new Error(`expected figures, got ${metrics.status} for ${metrics.window}`);
  }
  return metrics;
}

describe('buildMasterRoundTrips', () => {
  it('pairs one buy to one sell and reports basis, proceeds, PnL and hold time', () => {
    const set = buildMasterRoundTrips([
      row({ direction: 'buy', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1000, eventAt: at(0) }),
      row({ direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1500, eventAt: at(2) })
    ]);

    expect(set.roundTrips).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(set.openEpisodes).toBe(0);
    expect(set.unmatchedSells).toBe(0);
    const [trip] = set.roundTrips;
    expect(trip!.costBasisUsd).toBe(1000);
    expect(trip!.proceedsUsd).toBe(1500);
    expect(trip!.realizedPnlUsd).toBe(500);
    expect(trip!.holdMs).toBe(2 * HOUR);
    expect(trip!.openedAt).toEqual(at(0));
    expect(trip!.closedAt).toEqual(at(2));
    expect(trip!.legs).toBe(2);
  });

  it('folds fees into basis and proceeds, and agrees with calculateAverageCostPnl', () => {
    const legs: PositionLedgerTrade[] = [
      { direction: 'buy', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1000, feeUsd: 10 },
      { direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1500, feeUsd: 5 }
    ];
    const set = buildMasterRoundTrips([
      row({ direction: 'buy', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1000, feeUsd: 10, eventAt: at(0) }),
      row({ direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1500, feeUsd: 5, eventAt: at(1) })
    ]);

    // 1500 - 5 - (1000 + 10) = 485
    expect(set.roundTrips[0]!.realizedPnlUsd).toBeCloseTo(485, 10);
    expect(set.roundTrips[0]!.feeUsd).toBeCloseTo(15, 10);
    expect(set.roundTrips[0]!.feesRecorded).toBe(true);
    expect(set.roundTrips[0]!.realizedPnlUsd)
      .toBeCloseTo(calculateAverageCostPnl(legs, null)!.realizedPnlUsd, 10);
  });

  it('folds partial exits into one round trip closing at the final leg', () => {
    const legs: PositionLedgerTrade[] = [
      { direction: 'buy', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1000 },
      { direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 40, amountUsd: 500 },
      { direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 60, amountUsd: 900 }
    ];
    const set = buildMasterRoundTrips([
      row({ direction: 'buy', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1000, eventAt: at(0) }),
      row({ direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 40, amountUsd: 500, eventAt: at(1) }),
      row({ direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 60, amountUsd: 900, eventAt: at(3) })
    ]);

    expect(set.roundTrips).toHaveLength(1);
    const [trip] = set.roundTrips;
    expect(trip!.realizedPnlUsd).toBeCloseTo(400, 10);
    expect(trip!.costBasisUsd).toBeCloseTo(1000, 10);
    expect(trip!.proceedsUsd).toBeCloseTo(1400, 10);
    expect(trip!.holdMs).toBe(3 * HOUR);
    expect(trip!.legs).toBe(3);
    // Same ledger through the repo's existing average-cost function.
    expect(trip!.realizedPnlUsd)
      .toBeCloseTo(calculateAverageCostPnl(legs, null)!.realizedPnlUsd, 10);
  });

  it('excludes a still-open position instead of emitting a zero-return trade', () => {
    const set = buildMasterRoundTrips([
      row({ direction: 'buy', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1000, eventAt: at(0) }),
      row({ direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 40, amountUsd: 500, eventAt: at(1) })
    ]);

    expect(set.roundTrips).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(set.openEpisodes).toBe(1);
    expect(set.incompleteEpisodes).toBe(0);
  });

  it('records a sell with nothing open as unmatched rather than a phantom trade', () => {
    const set = buildMasterRoundTrips([
      row({ direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 50, amountUsd: 100, eventAt: at(0) })
    ]);

    expect(set.roundTrips).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(set.unmatchedSells).toBe(1);
    expect(set.openEpisodes).toBe(0);
  });

  it('caps an oversized sell at the visible quantity and pro-rates its proceeds', () => {
    const set = buildMasterRoundTrips([
      row({ direction: 'buy', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1000, eventAt: at(0) }),
      row({ direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 150, amountUsd: 3000, eventAt: at(1) })
    ]);

    expect(set.unmatchedSells).toBe(1);
    expect(set.roundTrips).toHaveLength(1);
    // 100 of 150 credited: proceeds 3000 * 2/3 = 2000, basis 1000.
    expect(set.roundTrips[0]!.proceedsUsd).toBeCloseTo(2000, 10);
    expect(set.roundTrips[0]!.realizedPnlUsd).toBeCloseTo(1000, 10);
  });

  it('excludes an episode with a leg missing amountUsd', () => {

      row({ direction: 'sell', tokenAmount: 100, amountUsd: 1500, eventAt: at(1) })
    ]);

    expect(set.roundTrips).toHaveLength(0);

  });

  it('ignores non-mirrorable directions such as transfers', () => {

  it('sorts unordered rows and keeps re-entries as separate round trips', () => {

      row({ tokenMint: 'solana:TOKEN-B', direction: 'buy', amountUsd: 2000, eventAt: at(1) }),
      row({ tokenMint: 'solana:TOKEN-A', direction: 'sell', amountUsd: 1100, eventAt: at(2) }),
      row({ tokenMint: 'solana:TOKEN-B', direction: 'sell', amountUsd: 1500, eventAt: at(3) })
    ]);

    expect(set.roundTrips.map((trip) => trip.tokenMint)).toEqual(['solana:TOKEN-A', 'solana:TOKEN-B']);

  it('returns a null drawdown percentage when no capital is attributable', () => {
    const trips = [
      roundTrip({ closedAt: at(1), realizedPnlUsd: -5, costBasisUsd: 0 }),
      roundTrip({ closedAt: at(2), realizedPnlUsd: 5, costBasisUsd: 0 })
    ];
    const metrics = ok(computeWindowMetrics('24h', trips, at(3), 2));
    expect(metrics.maxDrawdownUsd).toBe(5);
    expect(metrics.maxDrawdownPctOfDeployedCapital).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('compareWindows - divergence is the finding', () => {
  const figures = (
    pnlPerTradeUsd: number,
    hitRatePct: number,
    window: '24h' | '7d' | '30d'
  ): MasterWindowFigures => ({
    ...ok(computeWindowMetrics(window, sampleWindowRoundTrips(), at(24), 5)),
    pnlPerTradeUsd,
    hitRatePct
  });

  it('calls a sign flip from strong 30d to negative 24h decaying', () => {
    const result = compareWindows(figures(-10, 20, '24h'), figures(10, 60, '30d'));
    expect(result.trend).toBe('decaying');
    expect(result.relativeChange).toBeCloseTo(-2, 10);
    expect(result.hitRatePctDelta).toBe(-40);
    expect(result.reason).toBeNull();
  });

  it('calls a small change stable', () => {
    const result = compareWindows(figures(10, 55, '24h'), figures(12, 56, '30d'));
    expect(result.trend).toBe('stable');
    expect(result.relativeChange).toBeCloseTo(-2 / 12, 10);
  });

  it('calls a large rise improving', () => {
    const result = compareWindows(figures(30, 70, '24h'), figures(10, 50, '30d'));
    expect(result.trend).toBe('improving');
    expect(result.relativeChange).toBeCloseTo(20 / 30, 10);
  });

  it('treats two flat windows as stable rather than dividing by zero', () => {
    const result = compareWindows(figures(0, 50, '24h'), figures(0, 50, '30d'));
    expect(result.trend).toBe('stable');
    expect(result.relativeChange).toBe(0);
  });

  it('is indeterminate, with a reason, when either side lacks history', () => {
    const gated = computeWindowMetrics('24h', sampleWindowRoundTrips(), at(24), 99);
    const result = compareWindows(gated, figures(10, 50, '30d'));
    expect(result.trend).toBe('indeterminate');
    expect(result.relativeChange).toBeNull();
    expect(result.reason).toBe('insufficient history in 24h');
  });
});

describe('resolveMinTradesByWindow', () => {
  it('defaults to the policy table and scales with the window', () => {
    expect(resolveMinTradesByWindow()).toEqual(DEFAULT_MIN_TRADES_BY_WINDOW);
    expect(DEFAULT_MIN_TRADES_BY_WINDOW['24h']).toBeLessThan(DEFAULT_MIN_TRADES_BY_WINDOW['30d']);
  });

  it('applies per-window overrides and ignores nonsense', () => {
    expect(resolveMinTradesByWindow({ '24h': 2, '7d': 0, '30d': Number.NaN })).toEqual({
      '24h': 2,
      '7d': DEFAULT_MIN_TRADES_BY_WINDOW['7d'],
      '30d': DEFAULT_MIN_TRADES_BY_WINDOW['30d']
    });
  });

        // Still open at asOf.
        row({ tokenMint: 'solana:TOKEN-B', direction: 'buy', amountUsd: 5000, eventAt: at(3) })

    expect(window.hitRatePct).toBe(100);
    expect(window.pnlNetUsd).toBeCloseTo(200, 10);

    expect(report.divergence.map((entry) => `${entry.shorter}->${entry.longer}`))
      .toEqual(['24h->7d', '7d->30d', '24h->30d']);
    expect(report.trend).toBe('indeterminate');
  });

  it('surfaces a decaying master: strong on 30d, negative on 24h', () => {
    const rows: MasterTradeRow[] = [];

    for (let index = 0; index < 6; index++) {

      rows.push(row({ tokenMint: token, direction: 'sell', amountUsd: 1600, eventAt: at(-28 * 24 + index) }));
    }
    // Three losers closing inside the last 24h.
    for (let index = 0; index < 3; index++) {
