==> apps/signal-engine/src/polymarket-book-reader.ts <==
/**
 * The read side of the Polymarket order-book bridge (`S4-M38`, and the feed
 * `S4-M6` has been waiting on).
 *
 * ‚îÄ‚îÄ What this closes ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
 *
 * `indexer` streams books into Redis (`polymarket-book-subscriber.ts` writing
 * through `createPolymarketBookPublisher`). `signal-engine` decides fan-out. The
 * two are separate processes, so the subscriber's in-process cache is invisible
 * here, and until this module existed `resolveFanoutCapacity` was called without
 * a `polymarketBook` argument at all. Its own doc comment names the consequence:
 * omitted means *no subscriber is wired*, which makes every polygon fan-out
 * `capacity-unknown`, which under `unassessablePolicy: 'skip'` admits nobody.
 *
 * This module turns one Redis read into the `UsableLiquidity` that call site
 * takes. It is the only new fact in the path; every decision it rests on was
 * already built and tested elsewhere:
 *
 *   * whether a cached entry is fresh, decodable and version-compatible ‚Äî
 *     `loadPolymarketBookEntry` / `buildPolymarketBookSnapshot`
 *     (`packages/shared/src/polymarket-book-transport.ts`);
 *   * what a ladder is worth inside a bps bound, and which of the seven unknown
 *     causes applies ‚Äî `assessPolymarketBookDepth`
 *     (`packages/shared/src/polymarket-book-depth.ts`);
 *   * what the cap does with the figure ‚Äî `assessMasterCapacity`
 *     (`packages/db/src/master-capacity.ts`).
 *
 * ‚îÄ‚îÄ Calibration is the reason this takes a cap argument ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
 *
 * The depth model does not publish raw depth. It publishes
 * `capacityNotionalUsd * 10_000 / impactCapBps` ‚Äî an *equivalent one-sided
 * reserve* chosen so that the constant-product `priceImpactBps(N, reserve)` the
 * cap already runs stays within the cap exactly when `N` fits the real book walk.
 * That equality holds only at the cap the reserve was built for.
 *
 * So the cap in force has to be known **before** the book is read, not after. It
 * is a per-master, per-chain value (`master_capacity_policy.max_aggregate_impact_bps`
 * overriding `PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS[chain]`), which is why `read`
 * takes `impactCapBps` per call rather than fixing one at construction: a single
 * signal-engine process fans out for many masters, and a reader that cached one
 * master's cap would price another master's book against the wrong denominator
 * and be wrong in a direction nothing downstream could detect.
 *
 * `assertPolymarketBookLiquidityCalibration` is run on every priced verdict for
 * exactly that reason ‚Äî it is cheap, and a mismatch here is a fail-open bug.
 *
 * ‚îÄ‚îÄ Unknown is never a number, and never "fine" ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
 *
 * Every failure ‚Äî no key, stale entry, undecodable value, version skew, empty
 * or crossed ladder, a transport that threw ‚Äî returns `unknownLiquidity`, never
 * `0` and never a last-known value. Zero is a *figure*: it would flow into the
 * cap as "this market has no liquidity" and produce a confident refusal, where
 * unknown produces `capacity-unknown` and sends an operator to the feed. The
 * distinction is the whole discipline of `S4-M41`/`S4-M42` and it is the single
 * most load-bearing line in this file.
 *
 * ‚îÄ‚îÄ Never throws ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
 *
 * `resolveFanoutCapacity` wraps its reads in a try/catch that returns
 * `capacity: null` on any throw ‚Äî which excludes everyone on *every* chain in
 * that fan-out, not just polygon. A Redis blip must not do that. So this returns
 * unknown-with-a-note instead, which lands in the same safe place while saying
 * which of the two happened.
 */

import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import {
  assertPolymarketBookLiquidityCalibration,
  assessPolymarketBookDepth,
  loadPolymarketBookEntry,
  POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS,
  type PolymarketBookDepthVerdict,
  type PolymarketBookKeyValueTransport,
  type PolymarketBookSnapshot
} from '@swat/shared';
import { unknownLiquidity, type UsableLiquidity } from '@swat/db';

/**
 * The chain whose liquidity is an order book rather than a pool.
 *
 * Named rather than inlined so the one place that knows this is the one place
 * that has to change if another CLOB venue is ever added.
 */
export const POLYMARKET_BOOK_CHAIN: Chain = 'polygon';

export interface PolymarketBookLiquidityReaderOptions {
  readonly transport: PolymarketBookKeyValueTransport;
  /** Injected clock. Nothing in this module calls `Date.now()`. */
  readonly now: () => number;
  /**
   * Freshness budget. Defaults to the shared `POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS`, which
   * the subscriber's resync cadence is asserted against
   * (`assertPolymarketBookResyncBudget`). Overriding it here without moving that
   * cadence would make entries read stale that the writer believes it is
   * refreshing in time.
   */
  readonly maxAgeMs?: number;
  readonly logger?: {
    readonly warn: (message: string, error?: unknown) => void;
  };
}

export interface PolymarketBookLiquidityRequest {
  /**
   * Chain-prefixed as the repo stores it (`polygon:<tokenId>`). The transport
   * strips the prefix to derive the key, so either form reads the same slot; the
   * prefixed form is what the rest of the fan-out path carries.
   */
  readonly tokenMint: string;
  /** The direction the **cohort** trades. Picks the side of the book consumed. */
  readonly cohortDirection: 'buy' | 'sell';
  /**
   * The aggregate impact cap in force for this master on this chain. Required:
   * the published reserve is exact only at its own cap, so there is no safe
   * default here and a wrong one fails open.
   */
  readonly impactCapBps: number;
  /** Optional bound override, forwarded to the depth model unchanged. */
  readonly boundBps?: number;
}

export interface PolymarketBookLiquidityRead {
  /** Exactly what `resolveFanoutCapacity`'s `polymarketBook` param takes. */
  readonly liquidity: UsableLiquidity;
  /**
   * The verdict behind it, or `null` when the read failed before one could be
   * formed. Carries the stable unknown code an operator needs.
   */
  readonly verdict: PolymarketBookDepthVerdict | null;
  /** One ops line. Carries figures, so it is never rendered to a user. */
  readonly logLine: string;
}

export interface PolymarketBookLiquidityReader {
  readonly read: (request: PolymarketBookLiquidityRequest) => Promise<PolymarketBookLiquidityRead>;
  /** The freshness budget in force, so a service can log what it configured. */
  readonly maxAgeMs: number;
}

/**
 * Wrong-chain guard, as a pure function so the rule is testable without a
 * transport.
 *
 * A caller asking for Solana book depth has a bug, but throwing would abort the
 * whole fan-out through `resolveFanoutCapacity`'s catch ‚Äî punishing every chain
 * in that signal for one caller's mistake. Unknown-with-a-note fails closed in
 * the ordinary way and names the caller error in the place an operator reads.
 */
export function polymarketBookChainMismatch(chain: Chain, tokenMint: string): UsableLiquidity | null {
  if (chain === POLYMARKET_BOOK_CHAIN) return null;
  return unknownLiquidity(
    chain,
    tokenMint,
    `Order-book depth was requested for ${chain}, but the Polymarket book feed only covers `
      + `${POLYMARKET_BOOK_CHAIN}. This is a caller error rather than a venue condition: `
      + 'Solana and Robinhood Chain route through AMM pairs and are priced from pool TVL by '
      + 'usableLiquidityForFanout. Returned as unknown rather than thrown so one miswired '
      + 'caller cannot fail the fan-out for every other chain in the same signal.'
  );
}

/**
 * Turn a depth verdict into the fan-out's liquidity input. Pure.
 *
 * Split from the I/O so every branch here is testable with no transport at all,
 * matching `pusd-liquidity.ts` and `master-capacity.ts`.
 *
 * **The `'assessed'` check is on the outcome, not on the figure being truthy.**
 * `no-depth-within-bound` is a *known zero* ‚Äî the ladder was read and holds
 * nothing inside the bound ‚Äî and it is deliberately routed to unknown here, not
 * published as `0`. The reasoning: the depth model already sets
 * `liquidity.basis: 'unknown'` on that outcome (it publishes a reserve only on
 * `'assessed'`), so passing it through as a figure would require inventing one.
 * The note preserves which of the two it was, so an operator is not sent to the
 * feed for a market that is merely empty.
 */
export function usableLiquidityFromBookVerdict(
  verdict: PolymarketBookDepthVerdict,
  impactCapBps: number
): UsableLiquidity {
  const chain = POLYMARKET_BOOK_CHAIN;

  if (verdict.outcome === 'assessed') {
    const figure = verdict.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd;
    if (
      verdict.liquidity.basis !== 'order-book-depth'
      || figure === null
      || !Number.isFinite(figure)
      || figure <= 0
    ) {
      // Cannot happen through `assessPolymarketBookDepth`, which populates the
      // reserve on exactly this outcome. Asserted anyway because a basis/figure
      // disagreement is the one corruption that produces a plausible number, and
      // a plausible wrong number fails open.
      return unknownLiquidity(
        chain,
        verdict.tokenMint,
        'Polymarket book depth reported outcome=assessed but published no usable reserve '
          + `(basis=${verdict.liquidity.basis}, figure=${String(figure)}). Treated as unknown: an `
          + 'assessed verdict without a figure is a defect in the depth model, not a liquidity '
          + 'reading, and guessing one here would fail open.'
      );
    }

    // Throws on a mismatch. Left as a throw rather than folded into unknown
    // because it is not a venue condition or an outage: it means this reader was
    // handed a cap different from the one the reserve was built for, which is a
    // wiring defect that must be loud. `read` catches it and degrades, so the
    // fan-out still survives, but the note says defect rather than feed.
    assertPolymarketBookLiquidityCalibration(verdict.liquidity, impactCapBps);
    return verdict.liquidity;
  }

  if (verdict.outcome === 'no-depth-within-bound') {
    return unknownLiquidity(
      chain,
      verdict.tokenMint,
      `Polymarket book was read and is fresh, but holds no depth within ${verdict.boundBps}bps on `
        + `the ${verdict.cohortDirection} side (${verdict.reasonCode}). This is a known-zero, not a `
        + 'missing feed: the market is too thin to copy rather than unobserved. Carried as unknown '
        + 'because the depth model publishes a reserve only on an assessed walk, and a zero here '
        + 'would read to the cap as a measured figure.'
    );
  }

  return unknownLiquidity(
    chain,
    verdict.tokenMint,
    `Polymarket book depth is unknown (${verdict.reasonCode}`
      + `${verdict.ageMs === null ? '' : `, entry age ${verdict.ageMs}ms`}). `
      + `${verdict.detail} Never substituted with a last-known value: a stale book that reads as `
      + 'truth is how a cohort gets admitted against liquidity that has already left.'
  );
}

/**
 * One Redis read, one pure assessment, one liquidity value.
 *
 * **No local caching between calls, deliberately.** The fan-out runs on a 15s
 * interval and the entry TTL is tens of seconds; a memo in front of a read that
 * is *already* a point-in-time snapshot with its own freshness check would let a
 * decision rest on an entry the snapshot would have called stale, and would
 * defeat the one guarantee this path has. The read is a single `GET`.
 */
export function createPolymarketBookLiquidityReader(
  options: PolymarketBookLiquidityReaderOptions
): PolymarketBookLiquidityReader {
  const maxAgeMs = options.maxAgeMs ?? POLYMARKET_BOOK_MAX_AGE_MS;
  const warn = (message: string, error?: unknown): void => {
    if (options.logger !== undefined) options.logger.warn(message, error);
  };

  return {
    maxAgeMs,
    read: async (request: PolymarketBookLiquidityRequest): Promise<PolymarketBookLiquidityRead> => {
      let snapshot: PolymarketBookSnapshot;
      try {
        snapshot = await loadPolymarketBookEntry(
          { transport: options.transport, now: options.now, maxAgeMs },
          request.tokenMint,
          (detail) => warn(`[polymarket-book-reader] ${detail}`)
        );
      } catch (error) {
        // `loadPolymarketBookEntry` already swallows a transport throw into
        // key-missing, so reaching here means something upstream of the
        // transport failed ‚Äî a bad key derivation, say. Still not allowed to
        // propagate: see the module header.
        const detail = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        warn(`[polymarket-book-reader] snapshot load failed for ${request.tokenMint}: ${detail}`);
        return {
          liquidity: unknownLiquidity(
            POLYMARKET_BOOK_CHAIN,
            request.tokenMint,
            `Polymarket book snapshot could not be loaded: ${detail}. Treated as unknown, which `
              + 'excludes this cohort with capacity-unknown rather than aborting the fan-out for '
              + 'every chain in this signal.'
          ),
          verdict: null,
          logLine: `book read failed for ${request.tokenMint}: ${detail}`
        };
      }

      let verdict: PolymarketBookDepthVerdict;
      try {
        verdict = assessPolymarketBookDepth(snapshot.cache, {
          tokenMint: request.tokenMint,
          cohortDirection: request.cohortDirection,
          impactCapBps: request.impactCapBps,
          now: snapshot.readAt,
          maxAgeMs,
          ...(request.boundBps === undefined ? {} : { boundBps: request.boundBps })
        });
      } catch (error) {
        // A bad cap or a non-finite clock: caller error, which the depth model
        // throws on by design. Degraded rather than propagated for the same
        // reason as above, but logged as a defect so it is not read as a feed
        // problem.
        const detail = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        warn(`[polymarket-book-reader] depth assessment refused for ${request.tokenMint}: ${detail}`);
        return {
          liquidity: unknownLiquidity(
            POLYMARKET_BOOK_CHAIN,
            request.tokenMint,
            `Polymarket book depth could not be assessed: ${detail}. This is a caller/wiring `
              + 'defect rather than a venue condition ‚Äî the feed may be healthy. Fails closed.'
          ),
          verdict: null,
          logLine: `book assessment refused for ${request.tokenMint}: ${detail}`
        };
      }

      let liquidity: UsableLiquidity;
      try {
        liquidity = usableLiquidityFromBookVerdict(verdict, request.impactCapBps);
      } catch (error) {
        const detail = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        warn(`[polymarket-book-reader] calibration mismatch for ${request.tokenMint}: ${detail}`);
        liquidity = unknownLiquidity(
          POLYMARKET_BOOK_CHAIN,
          request.tokenMint,
          `Polymarket book reserve failed its calibration check: ${detail} Fails closed rather `
            + 'than pricing a cohort against a reserve built for a different cap.'
        );
      }

      const status = snapshot.statusFor(request.tokenMint);
      return {
        liquidity,
        verdict,
        logLine:
          `polymarket book ${verdict.outcome} (${verdict.reasonCode}) for ${request.tokenMint} `
          + `${request.cohortDirection} @ ${request.impactCapBps}bps | transport `
          + `${status?.code ?? 'no-status'} | reserve `
          + `${liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd === null ? 'unknown' : `$${liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd.toFixed(2)}`}`
      };
    }
  };
}

    expect(isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(standardEvent, { outcome: 'Other' })).toEqual({
      isPlaceholder: false
    });
    expect(isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(standardEvent, { outcome: 'Person A' })).toEqual({

    });
    expect(isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(standardEvent, { outcome: 'Alice Smith' })).toEqual({
      isPlaceholder: false
    });
  });

    const augmentedEvent = { enableNegRisk: true, negRiskAugmented: true };
    const result = isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(augmentedEvent, { outcome: 'Other' });
    expect(result.isPlaceholder).toBe(true);
    expect(result.code).toBe('polymarket-augmented-placeholder-unstable');
    expect(result.reason).toContain('legally changes definition');
  });

  it('identifies and rejects unclarified placeholder slots on augmented neg-risk events', () => {
    const augmentedEvent = { enableNegRisk: true, negRiskAugmented: true };

    const personA = isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(augmentedEvent, { outcome: 'Person A' });
    expect(personA.isPlaceholder).toBe(true);
    expect(personA.code).toBe('polymarket-placeholder-unnamed');

    const candidateX = isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(augmentedEvent, { outcome: 'Candidate 2' });
    expect(candidateX.isPlaceholder).toBe(true);
    expect(candidateX.code).toBe('polymarket-placeholder-unnamed');

    const genericPlaceholder = isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(augmentedEvent, { outcome: 'TBD Placeholder' });
    expect(genericPlaceholder.isPlaceholder).toBe(true);
    expect(genericPlaceholder.code).toBe('polymarket-placeholder-unnamed');
  });

  it('allows established named candidates in augmented neg-risk events', () => {
    const augmentedEvent = { enableNegRisk: true, negRiskAugmented: true };
    const alice = isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(augmentedEvent, { outcome: 'Alice Smith' });
    expect(alice.isPlaceholder).toBe(false);

    const bob = isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(augmentedEvent, {
      outcome: 'Yes',
      groupItemTitle: 'Bob Jones'
    });
    expect(bob.isPlaceholder).toBe(false);
  });
});

==> apps/signal-engine/src/polymarket-context.ts <==
import type { PolymarketOutcomeContext } from '@swat/db';

export function requirePolymarketSignalContext(
  context: PolymarketOutcomeContext | null,
  tokenMint: string
): {
  tokenName: string;
  tokenSymbol: string;
  triggerData: Record<string, unknown>;
} {
  if (!context || !context.contextComplete) {
    throw new Error(`Missing complete Polymarket context for ${tokenMint}`);
  }
  if (
    !context.question.trim()
    || !context.outcome.trim()
    || Number.isNaN(context.endDate.getTime())
    || !context.marketStatus.trim()
    || !context.resolutionStatus.trim()
    || !Number.isFinite(Number(context.tickSize))
    || Number(context.tickSize) <= 0
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Incomplete Polymarket context for ${tokenMint}`);
  }

  return {
    tokenName: context.question,
    tokenSymbol: context.outcome.toUpperCase().slice(0, 20),
    triggerData: {
      pmConditionId: context.conditionId,
      pmQuestion: context.question,
      pmOutcome: context.outcome,
      pmEndDate: context.endDate.toISOString(),
      pmState: context.marketStatus,
      pmTickSize: context.tickSize,
      pmNegRisk: context.negRisk,
      pmAcceptingOrders: context.acceptingOrders,
      pmResolutionStatus: context.resolutionStatus
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Assessment result for augmented negative-risk placeholder and unstable outcome checking (S4-M30).
 */
export interface PolymarketNegRiskAssessment {
  readonly isPlaceholder: boolean;
  readonly code?: 'polymarket-augmented-placeholder-unstable' | 'polymarket-placeholder-unnamed';
  readonly reason?: string;
}

/**
 * Evaluates whether a Polymarket outcome is a dynamic placeholder or unstable "Other" slot (S4-M30).
 *
 * The venue documents a warning for augmented negative-risk markets (enableNegRisk && negRiskAugmented):
 * Trade only named outcomes; ignore placeholders until named, and avoid trading the "Other" outcome
 * directly because its legal/market definition dynamically contracts whenever a placeholder is clarified.
 */
export function isPlaceholderOrUnstableOutcome(
  event: { enableNegRisk?: boolean; negRiskAugmented?: boolean },
  market: { outcome: string; groupItemTitle?: string }
): PolymarketNegRiskAssessment {
  if (!event.enableNegRisk || !event.negRiskAugmented) {
    return { isPlaceholder: false }; // Standard neg-risk or binary market; outcomes are fixed
  }

  const label = (market.groupItemTitle || market.outcome || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Explicit dynamic "Other"
  if (label === 'other') {
    return {
      isPlaceholder: true,
      code: 'polymarket-augmented-placeholder-unstable',
      reason: 'Augmented negative-risk "Other" outcome is dynamic and legally changes definition as candidates are clarified'
    };
  }

  // 2. Polymarket placeholder convention: "Person A", "Candidate X", "Placeholder", etc.
  if (/^(person|candidate|slot|outcome)\s+[a-z0-9]+$/i.test(label) || label.includes('placeholder')) {
    return {
      isPlaceholder: true,
      code: 'polymarket-placeholder-unnamed',
      reason: `Placeholder outcome "${market.outcome}" is an unclarified reserve slot on an augmented neg-risk market`
    };
  }

  return { isPlaceholder: false };
}

      kind: 'skip',

    });
    expect(quoteFn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

    const quoteFn = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('Network timeout'));
    const cache = new RoutabilityCache();

    expect(result).toEqual({
      kind: 'pass',
      code: 'probe-unavailable',
      reason: 'Routability probe unavailable: Network timeout'
    });
  });

    currentTime = new Date('2026-10-29T12:06:00Z');

    const bad2 = await probeTokenRoutability('solana:BAD_TOKEN', { quoteFn, now, cache });
    expect(bad2.code).toBe('routable');
    expect(quoteFn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });
});

==> apps/signal-engine/src/routability-probe.ts <==
import {
  chainFromTokenMint,
  stripChainPrefix,
  getJupiterQuote,
  type Chain,
  type JupiterQuote
} from '@swat/shared';

/**
 * Solana LP & liquid-staking routability probe (checklist S4-M31).
 *
 * Swap-shaped LP deposits and liquid staking events are ingested by indexers
 * as `buy`/`sell` trades because they involve balance movements. These cannot
 * be distinguished from real trades downstream by side alone.
 *
 * Instead of maintaining a brittle token allowlist or reverse-engineering
 * external protocol programs, we ask whether Jupiter can route the token at all.
 * An LP token has no market/route on Jupiter, so quote resolution returns null.
 *
 * Critical safety invariants:
 * 1. Scoped to Solana only: other chains return `chain-not-probed` (passing).
 * 2. Fail OPEN on probe transport error (`probe-unavailable`): an outage of the
 *    probe must NEVER halt all copy trading across Solana.
 * 3. Asymmetric caching:
 *    - Routable tokens: cached for hours (default 2h).
 *    - Unroutable tokens: cached briefly (default 5m) so brand new pools can be detected.
 *    - Clock-injected for deterministic testing without real time.
 */

export const SOL_MINT = 'So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112';
export const DEFAULT_ROUTABLE_TTL_MS = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 2 hours
export const DEFAULT_UNROUTABLE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes

export type RoutabilityProbeResult =
  | {
      readonly kind: 'pass';
      readonly code: 'routable' | 'chain-not-probed' | 'probe-unavailable';
      readonly reason: string;
    }
  | {
      readonly kind: 'skip';
      readonly code: 'no-route';
      readonly reason: string;
    };

interface CacheEntry {
  readonly result: RoutabilityProbeResult;
  readonly expiresAtMs: number;
}

export class RoutabilityCache {
  private readonly entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();

  get(mint: string, nowMs: number): RoutabilityProbeResult | null {
    const entry = this.entries.get(mint);
    if (!entry) return null;
    if (nowMs >= entry.expiresAtMs) {
      this.entries.delete(mint);
      return null;
    }
    return entry.result;
  }

  set(mint: string, result: RoutabilityProbeResult, ttlMs: number, nowMs: number): void {
    if (ttlMs <= 0) return;
    this.entries.set(mint, {
      result,
      expiresAtMs: nowMs + ttlMs
    });
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.entries.clear();
  }
}

export const defaultRoutabilityCache = new RoutabilityCache();

export interface RoutabilityProbeOptions {
  readonly quoteFn?: (params: {
    inputMint: string;
    outputMint: string;
    amountLamports: number;
    slippageBps?: number;
    swapMode?: 'ExactIn' | 'ExactOut';
  }) => Promise<JupiterQuote | null>;
  readonly now?: () => Date;
  readonly cache?: RoutabilityCache;
  readonly routableTtlMs?: number;
  readonly unroutableTtlMs?: number;
}

/**
 * Evaluates whether a target token is routable on Solana.
 */
export async function probeTokenRoutability(
  tokenMint: string,
  options: RoutabilityProbeOptions = {}
): Promise<RoutabilityProbeResult> {
  let chain: Chain;
  try {
    chain = chainFromTokenMint(tokenMint);
  } catch {
    chain = 'solana';
  }

  if (chain !== 'solana') {
    return {
      kind: 'pass',
      code: 'chain-not-probed',
      reason: `Chain ${chain} is not probed for Jupiter routability`
    };
  }

  const clean = stripChainPrefix(tokenMint);
  const now = options.now ? options.now() : new Date();
  const nowMs = now.getTime();
  const cache = options.cache ?? defaultRoutabilityCache;

  const cached = cache.get(clean, nowMs);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const routableTtlMs = options.routableTtlMs ?? DEFAULT_ROUTABLE_TTL_MS;
  const unroutableTtlMs = options.unroutableTtlMs ?? DEFAULT_UNROUTABLE_TTL_MS;
  const quoteFn = options.quoteFn ?? getJupiterQuote;

  try {
    const quote = await quoteFn({
      inputMint: SOL_MINT,
      outputMint: clean,
      amountLamports: 1_000_000, // 0.001 SOL test quote
      slippageBps: 150,
      swapMode: 'ExactIn'
    });

    if (quote) {
      const result: RoutabilityProbeResult = {
        kind: 'pass',
        code: 'routable',
        reason: 'Token has an active Jupiter route'
      };
      cache.set(clean, result, routableTtlMs, nowMs);
      return result;
    }

    const result: RoutabilityProbeResult = {
      kind: 'skip',
      code: 'no-route',
      reason: 'Token has no Jupiter route (likely LP deposit token or illiquid staking)'
    };
    cache.set(clean, result, unroutableTtlMs, nowMs);
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    // Fail open on probe error: a transport failure must never halt copy execution
    return {
      kind: 'pass',
      code: 'probe-unavailable',
      reason: `Routability probe unavailable: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'error'}`
    };
  }
}

import { createPublicClient, http } from 'viem';
import { polygon } from 'viem/chains';
import { query } from '@swat/db';
import {
  fetchDexScreenerLiquidity,
  getChainPrefix,
  prefixChainValue,

export type SafetyResult = {
  isSafe: boolean;
  passed: boolean;  // alias for !hasHardFlags
  flags: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  liquidity?: number | null;
  top10HolderPct?: number | null;

// Define Robinhood Chain custom definition
const robinhoodChain = {
  id: 4663,
  name: 'Robinhood Chain',
  network: 'robinhood-chain',
  nativeCurrency: {
    decimals: 18,
    name: 'Ether',
    symbol: 'ETH',
  },
  rpcUrls: {

    public: { http: [process.env.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL ?? 'https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com'] },
  },

function getPublicClient(chain: string) {
  if (chain === 'polygon') {
    const url = process.env.POLYGON_RPC_URL ?? 'https://polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com';
    return createPublicClient({ chain: polygon, transport: http(url) });
  } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
    const url = process.env.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL ?? 'https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com';
    return createPublicClient({ chain: robinhoodChain, transport: http(url) });
  }
  throw new Error(`Unsupported chain: ${chain}`);
}

const heliusApiKey = process.env.HELIUS_API_KEY;
const heliusRpcUrl = heliusApiKey
  ? `https://mainnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=${heliusApiKey}`
  : null;

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Live On-Chain Solana Mint Info ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

type MintInfo = {
  mintAuthority: string | null;
  freezeAuthority: string | null;
  decimals: number;
};

async function getMintInfoFromChain(tokenMint: string): Promise<MintInfo | null> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) return null;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        jsonrpc: '2.0',
        id: 'getMintInfo',
        method: 'getAccountInfo',
        params: [tokenMint, { encoding: 'jsonParsed' }]
      })
    });
    if (!response.ok) return null;
    const json = await response.json() as any;
    const info = json.result?.value?.data?.parsed?.info;
    if (!info) return null;
    return {
      mintAuthority: info.mintAuthority ?? null,
      freezeAuthority: info.freezeAuthority ?? null,
      decimals: info.decimals ?? 9
    };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[safety] getMintInfo error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Solana Top Holder Concentration ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

async function getTop10HolderPct(tokenMint: string): Promise<number | null> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) return null;
  try {
    const [accountsResponse, supplyResponse] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: '2.0',
          id: 'getTopHolders',
          method: 'getTokenLargestAccounts',
          params: [tokenMint, { commitment: 'finalized' }]
        })
      }),
      fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: '2.0',
          id: 'getTokenSupply',
          method: 'getTokenSupply',
          params: [tokenMint, { commitment: 'finalized' }]
        })
      })
    ]);
    if (!accountsResponse.ok || !supplyResponse.ok) return null;

    const accountsJson = await accountsResponse.json() as any;
    const supplyJson = await supplyResponse.json() as any;
    const accounts = accountsJson.result?.value as Array<{ amount?: string }> | undefined;
    const supplyAmount = supplyJson.result?.value?.amount;
    if (!accounts || accounts.length === 0) return null;
    if (typeof supplyAmount !== 'string') return null;

    const totalSupply = BigInt(supplyAmount);
    if (totalSupply <= 0n) return null;
    const top10 = accounts.slice(0, 10).reduce(
      (sum, account) => sum + BigInt(account.amount ?? '0'),
      0n
    );
    return Number((top10 * 10_000n) / totalSupply) / 100;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[safety] getTopHolderPct error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ EVM Contract Owner Read ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

async function getEvmContractOwner(client: any, address: `0x${string}`) {
  try {
    const owner = await client.readContract({
      address,
      abi: [{ name: 'owner', type: 'function', inputs: [], outputs: [{ type: 'address' }] }],
      functionName: 'owner'
    });
    return String(owner);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ Main Safety Check ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ

export async function checkTokenSafety(tokenMint: string): Promise<SafetyResult> {
  const flags: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  const prefixChain = getChainPrefix(tokenMint);
  const tokenRows = prefixChain
    ? []
    : await query<{ chain: Chain }>(
        `SELECT chain FROM tokens WHERE mint LIKE '%:' || $1 LIMIT 1`,
        [stripChainPrefix(tokenMint)]
      );
  const chain: Chain = prefixChain ?? tokenRows[0]?.chain ?? 'solana';
  const storedMint = prefixChainValue(tokenMint, chain);
  const rawMint = stripChainPrefix(storedMint);

  let top10Pct: number | null = null;
  let liquidity: number | null = null;

  if (chain === 'solana') {
    // ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ SOLANA SAFETY FLOW ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
    const mintInfo = await getMintInfoFromChain(rawMint);

    if (!mintInfo) {
      // Helius not configured ‚Äî fall back to DB values and warn
      const rows = await query<{ mint_authority_disabled: boolean; freeze_authority_disabled: boolean }>(
        `SELECT mint_authority_disabled, freeze_authority_disabled FROM tokens WHERE mint = $1`,
        [storedMint]
      );
      const token = rows[0];
      if (!token) {
        return {
          isSafe: false,
          passed: false,
          flags: ['unverified_token'],
          warnings: ['Token not indexed ‚Äî cannot verify safety'],
          liquidity: null,
          top10HolderPct: null
        };
      }
      if (!token.mint_authority_disabled) {
        flags.push('MINT_AUTHORITY_ACTIVE');
      }
      if (!token.freeze_authority_disabled) {
        warnings.push('FREEZE_AUTHORITY_SET');
      }
    } else {
      // Live on-chain check
      if (mintInfo.mintAuthority !== null) {
        flags.push('MINT_AUTHORITY_ACTIVE');
      }
      if (mintInfo.freezeAuthority !== null) {
        warnings.push('FREEZE_AUTHORITY_SET');
      }

      // Persist results back to DB so they're cached
      await query(
        `UPDATE tokens SET
           mint_authority_disabled = $1,
           freeze_authority_disabled = $2,
           decimals = $3
         WHERE mint = $4`,
        [
          mintInfo.mintAuthority === null,
          mintInfo.freezeAuthority === null,
          mintInfo.decimals,
          storedMint
        ]
      );
    }

    // Top holder concentration check (Solana largest accounts via Helius)
    top10Pct = await getTop10HolderPct(rawMint);
    if (top10Pct !== null) {
      if (top10Pct > 60) {
        flags.push(`TOP_10_HOLD_${top10Pct}PCT`);
      } else if (top10Pct > 35) {
        warnings.push(`TOP_10_HOLD_${top10Pct}PCT`);
      }
    }

  } else {
    // ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ EVM / EVM L2 SAFETY FLOW ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ‚îÄ
    try {
      const client = getPublicClient(chain);
      const owner = await getEvmContractOwner(client, rawMint as `0x${string}`);

      if (owner !== null) {
        const isRenounced = owner === '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000';
        if (!isRenounced) {
          flags.push('OWNER_ACTIVE');
        }

        // Cache in existing DB columns to avoid schema bloat
        await query(
          `UPDATE tokens SET
             mint_authority_disabled = $1,
             freeze_authority_disabled = true
           WHERE mint = $2`,
          [isRenounced, storedMint]
        );
      } else {
        warnings.push('CONTRACT_OWNER_UNVERIFIED');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[safety] EVM contract owner query failed for ${tokenMint}:`, err);
      warnings.push('CHAIN_RPC_UNREACHABLE');
    }
  }

  // DexScreener liquidity check (works for all chains)
  liquidity = await fetchDexScreenerLiquidity(rawMint, chain);
  if (liquidity !== null && liquidity < 25_000) {
    flags.push(`LOW_LIQUIDITY_${Math.round(liquidity / 1000)}K`);
  } else if (liquidity === null) {
    warnings.push('LIQUIDITY_UNVERIFIED');
  }

  const isSafe = flags.length === 0;

  return {
    isSafe,
    passed: isSafe,
    flags,
    warnings,
    liquidity,
    top10HolderPct: top10Pct
  };
}

==> apps/signal-engine/src/trade-eligibility.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS,
  mayPatternTrade,
  type SignalPatternType
} from './trade-eligibility.js';

/**
 * These tests exist to make ADR-0005 ¬ß6.1 hard to undo by accident.
 *
 * The previous shape of this decision was `suppressTrade: true` passed by each
 * cluster detector ‚Äî four independent literals, none of which any test could
 * reach, because the detectors query the database directly and `index.ts` starts
 * timers at import. Deleting one would have silently resumed trading on a signal
 * whose own definition guarantees it fires.
 */
describe('trade eligibility by signal pattern', () => {
  it('lets a master trade be copied', () => {
    // `source_trade` is the whole product: one wallet a user chose, mirrored.
    expect(mayPatternTrade('source_trade')).toBe(true);
  });

  it.each<SignalPatternType>(['snipe', 'accumulation', 'rotation', 'exit'])(
    'refuses to trade the %s cluster pattern',
    (pattern) => {
      expect(mayPatternTrade(pattern)).toBe(false);
    }
  );

  it('is exactly one pattern, so widening it cannot pass unnoticed', () => {
    // Asserting the whole list rather than individual members. A new pattern that
    // may trade has to change this line, which puts the decision in a diff a
    // reviewer will see, next to a test name explaining why it matters.
    expect([...TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS]).toEqual(['source_trade']);
  });

  it('fails closed on a pattern it does not recognise', () => {
    // `enqueueSignal` types `patternType` as `string`, so an unrecognised value
    // reaches this function without a compile error. Alerting on something we
    // cannot classify is fine; trading on it is not.
    expect(mayPatternTrade('cluster_consensus')).toBe(false);
    expect(mayPatternTrade('')).toBe(false);
    expect(mayPatternTrade('SOURCE_TRADE')).toBe(false); // case-sensitive by design
  });

  it('cannot be widened at runtime', () => {
    // `readonly` is a compile-time claim and types vanish at runtime, but this
    // gate decides whether money moves. Two independent protections, both checked
    // here: the exported list is frozen, and the internal lookup is a copy ‚Äî so
    // even a caster who defeats the first cannot reach the second.
    const escaped = TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS as SignalPatternType[];
    expect(() => escaped.push('snipe')).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS)).toBe(true);
    expect(mayPatternTrade('snipe')).toBe(false);
  });
});

==> apps/signal-engine/src/trade-eligibility.ts <==
/**
 * Which signal patterns may result in a trade (ADR-0005 ¬ß6.1).
 *
 * **Why this exists as a module rather than a literal at each call site.** The
 * decision that cluster patterns are discovery-only was originally expressed as
 * `suppressTrade: true` passed by each of the four cluster detectors. That works
 * until someone deletes one ‚Äî and deleting one is easy, because the flag reads
 * like a local formatting choice rather than the load-bearing consequence of an
 * ADR. There is no test that can catch its removal at the call site, because the
 * detectors query the database directly and `index.ts` starts timers at import.
 *
 * So the gate lives here instead: a single set, consulted by `enqueueSignal`, and
 * unit-testable without importing the service. Removing `suppressTrade: true`
 * from a detector now changes a log line, not whether money moves.
 *
 * **Why cluster patterns cannot trade.** A cluster is built from wallets that
 * share a funder (`clustering-queries.ts` calls that "the Sybil/coordination
 * signal") or that repeatedly buy the same tokens together. The snipe detector
 * then fires when those wallets buy the same token together ‚Äî so the grouping
 * predicate and the signal predicate are one statement at two time scales, and
 * firing carries almost no information beyond "this group did what defines it".
 * Worse, co-movement among wallets grouped *for* co-moving is evidence of shared
 * control rather than of a shared fact, and a coordinated group's next move is to
 * sell into the flow their buying attracted. Trading it made us their exit
 * liquidity. Copy trades come from `source_trade` ‚Äî one master's own trade,
 * mirrored proportionally.
 */

/**
 * Every pattern `enqueueSignal` accepts. Declared here rather than inline at the
 * call site so that adding a pattern is a decision made against this list.
 */
export type SignalPatternType =
  | 'source_trade'
  | 'snipe'
  | 'accumulation'
  | 'rotation'
  | 'exit';

/**
 * The only pattern that may queue a trade.
 *
 * A frozen array rather than an exported `Set`, for a reason that matters more
 * than it looks: `ReadonlySet` is a compile-time claim only, and a `Set` handed
 * out of a module stays mutable at runtime, so one stray `.add()` anywhere in the
 * process would re-enable cluster trading globally with no diff to review. This
 * is frozen, and the lookup below is built from a *copy* ‚Äî so neither mutating
 * this array nor reaching into the internal set can widen what trades.
 *
 * Deliberately a list rather than a boolean on `source_trade`: it makes "what
 * else could trade?" an explicit question with a visible answer, and the
 * accompanying test asserts the membership exactly, so widening it cannot happen
 * silently.
 */
export const TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS: readonly SignalPatternType[] = Object.freeze<
  SignalPatternType[]
>(['source_trade']);

/** Private lookup, copied from the frozen list so external mutation cannot reach it. */
const ELIGIBLE: ReadonlySet<SignalPatternType> = new Set(TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS);

/**
 * Whether a pattern may queue a trade.
 *
 * Takes `string` rather than `SignalPatternType` on purpose. `enqueueSignal`'s
 * `patternType` is typed as `string`, so an unrecognised value is reachable
 * without a compile error ‚Äî and the honest answer for something we do not
 * recognise is "no". Fails closed: an unknown pattern alerts but never trades.
 */
export function mayPatternTrade(patternType: string): boolean {
  return ELIGIBLE.has(patternType as SignalPatternType);
}

    expect(capBaseUnitSpend(100n, 450n, 50n)).toBe(100n);
    expect(capBaseUnitSpend(100n, 40n, 50n)).toBe(0n);
  });

  const rentExemptMin = 890_880n; // typical 42-byte vault state rent
  const feeBuffer = DEFAULT_SOLANA_FEE_LAMPORTS; // 5,000n

  it('correctly nets rent exemption and transaction fee from gross lamport balance', () => {
    const total = 10_000_000n; // 0.01 SOL
    const expected = total - rentExemptMin - feeBuffer;
    expect(calculateMaxWithdrawableSolLamports({
      totalLamports: total,
      rentExemptMinLamports: rentExemptMin
    })).toBe(expected);
  });

  it('returns 0n if balance is less than or equal to required reserve', () => {
    expect(calculateMaxWithdrawableSolLamports({
      totalLamports: rentExemptMin,
      rentExemptMinLamports: rentExemptMin
    })).toBe(0n);

    expect(calculateMaxWithdrawableSolLamports({
      totalLamports: rentExemptMin + feeBuffer - 1n,
      rentExemptMinLamports: rentExemptMin
    })).toBe(0n);
  });

  it('rejects negative lamport parameters', () => {
    expect(() => calculateMaxWithdrawableSolLamports({
      totalLamports: -1n,
      rentExemptMinLamports: rentExemptMin
    })).toThrow(/non-negative/);
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/balances.ts <==
import { resolveChainAddress } from '@swat/shared';

type FetchLike = typeof fetch;

type SolanaBalanceResponse = {
  error?: { message?: unknown };
  result?: { value?: unknown };
};

export function capBaseUnitSpend(
  requested: bigint,
  balance: bigint,
  reserve: bigint
): bigint {
  if (requested < 0n || balance < 0n || reserve < 0n) {
    throw new Error('Base-unit balance inputs must be non-negative');
  }
  const spendable = balance > reserve ? balance - reserve : 0n;
  return requested < spendable ? requested : spendable;
}

/** Standard Solana transfer network fee in lamports (0.000005 SOL). */
export const DEFAULT_SOLANA_FEE_LAMPORTS = 5_000n;

/**
 * Calculates the safe maximum withdrawable native SOL in lamports, netting both the
 * rent-exempt minimum required to preserve the vault account on-chain and a network fee buffer.
 *
 * Prevents transaction reverts caused by rent-exemption violations or gas starvation.
 */
export function calculateMaxWithdrawableSolLamports(opts: {
  totalLamports: bigint;
  rentExemptMinLamports: bigint;
  feeBufferLamports?: bigint;
}): bigint {
  const { totalLamports, rentExemptMinLamports, feeBufferLamports = DEFAULT_SOLANA_FEE_LAMPORTS } = opts;
  if (totalLamports < 0n || rentExemptMinLamports < 0n || feeBufferLamports < 0n) {
    throw new Error('Lamport balance inputs must be non-negative');
  }
  const requiredReserve = rentExemptMinLamports + feeBufferLamports;
  return totalLamports > requiredReserve ? totalLamports - requiredReserve : 0n;
}

export async function fetchSolanaBalanceSol(opts: {
  walletAddress: string;
  heliusApiKey: string;
  timeoutMs: number;
  fetchFn?: FetchLike;
}): Promise<number> {
  const walletAddress = resolveChainAddress(opts.walletAddress, 'solana').raw;
  if (!opts.heliusApiKey) {
    throw new Error('HELIUS_API_KEY is required to verify the Trojan wallet balance');
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(opts.timeoutMs) || opts.timeoutMs <= 0) {
    throw new Error('Solana balance timeout must be a positive integer');
  }

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), opts.timeoutMs);
  try {
    const response = await (opts.fetchFn ?? fetch)(
      `https://mainnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=${encodeURIComponent(opts.heliusApiKey)}`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        signal: controller.signal,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: '2.0',
          id: 'swat-trade-balance',
          method: 'getBalance',
          params: [walletAddress, { commitment: 'confirmed' }]
        })
      }
    );
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Solana balance RPC returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
    }

    const body = await response.json() as SolanaBalanceResponse;
    if (body.error) {
      throw new Error(`Solana balance RPC error: ${String(body.error.message ?? 'unknown error')}`);
    }
    const lamports = body.result?.value;
    if (typeof lamports !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(lamports) || lamports < 0) {
      throw new Error('Solana balance RPC returned an invalid lamport balance');
    }
    return lamports / 1_000_000_000;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

    expect(sourceSellFractionToBps('0.25')).toBe(2_500);
    expect(sourceSellFractionToBps('0.33339')).toBe(3_333);
    expect(sourceSellFractionToBps('1')).toBe(10_000);
    expect(decimalQuantityToBaseUnits('1.234567', 6)).toBe(1_234_567n);
  });

  it('fails closed for unusable fractional exits', () => {
    expect(() => sourceSellFractionToBps('0.00001')).toThrow('rounds outside');
    expect(() => sourceSellFractionToBps('1.01')).toThrow('between 0 and 1');
    expect(() => decimalQuantityToBaseUnits('0.0000001', 6)).toThrow('rounds to zero');
  });
});

import { parseUnits } from 'viem';
import type { Chain, CopyExecutionMode } from '@swat/shared';

const PAPER_TARGETS: Record<Chain, string> = {
  solana: '11111111111111111111111111111111',
  polygon: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001',
  'robinhood-chain': '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001',
  base: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001',
  ethereum: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001',
  bsc: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001'
};

/**
 * The synthetic account paper executions settle "from".
 *
 * ONE address per chain, shared by every paper user ‚Äî deliberately, and this is
 * now correct rather than merely tolerated. Paper mode has no counterparty, so
 * there is no real address to name; minting a per-user fake address would
 * invent one, and every downstream consumer that reasonably assumes an address
 * corresponds to something on-chain (grant lookups, reconcilers, explorer
 * links, user_execution_grants.uq_ueg_account) would then be reading a fiction.
 *
 * Before migration 050_copy_tenancy.sql the sharing WAS a bug, because
 * copy_positions was keyed (target_account, chain, token_mint): every paper
 * user on a chain collapsed onto one row, so A's buy inflated B's
 * confirmed_quantity and B's exit computed P&L against A's cost basis. The fix
 * was to put user_id in the key, not to make the address per-user.
 *
 * So: do NOT make this per-user. If two paper users appear to share a position,
 * the missing piece is a userId that was not threaded to
 * requestCopyExecution / claimSourceSignalForCopyExecution, not this address.
 *
 * NOT YET PROVEN: S4-10's acceptance test ‚Äî two paper users on one chain and
 * token holding independent quantities and cost bases, written so that it fails
 * against the old three-column key ‚Äî has not been written. Until it exists this
 * comment describes the intent of 050, not a verified property.
 */
const PAPER_TARGET_ENV: Record<Chain, string> = {
  solana: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_SOLANA',
  polygon: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_POLYGON',
  'robinhood-chain': 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_ROBINHOOD_CHAIN',
  base: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_BASE',
  ethereum: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_ETHEREUM',
  bsc: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_BSC'
};

export function resolvePaperCopyTargetAccount(
  chain: Chain,
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env
): string {
  return env[PAPER_TARGET_ENV[chain]]?.trim() || PAPER_TARGETS[chain];
}

export function executionModesForChainMode(
  mode: 'paper' | 'live' | 'live+shadow'
): CopyExecutionMode[] {
  if (mode === 'live+shadow') return ['live', 'shadow'];
  return [mode];
}

export function sourceSellFractionToBps(value: string): number {
  if (!/^(?:0(?:\.\d+)?|1(?:\.0+)?)$/.test(value)) {
    throw new Error('source sell fraction must be a decimal between 0 and 1');
  }
  const bps = Math.floor(Number(value) * 10_000);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(bps) || bps < 1 || bps > 10_000) {
    throw new Error('source sell fraction rounds outside 1..10000 basis points');
  }
  return bps;
}

export function decimalQuantityToBaseUnits(quantity: string, decimals: number): bigint {
  if (!Number.isInteger(decimals) || decimals < 0 || decimals > 255) {
    throw new Error('token decimals must be an integer between 0 and 255');
  }
  if (!/^(?:\d+\.?\d*|\d*\.\d+)$/.test(quantity)) {
    throw new Error('token quantity must be an unsigned decimal');
  }
  const baseUnits = parseUnits(quantity, decimals);
  if (baseUnits <= 0n) throw new Error('token quantity rounds to zero base units');
  return baseUnits;
}

    expect(decision.allowed).toBe(true);

==> apps/trade-executor/src/copy-eligibility.ts <==
import type { CopyEligibilityFacts, CopyEligibilityRejection } from '@swat/db';
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import { evaluateCopyPolicy } from '@swat/shared';

/**
 * The copy-eligibility policy for the canonical claim boundary.
 *
 * Everything else in `handleJob` asks "can this trade be executed safely?" ‚Äî
 * balances, exposure caps, chain readiness, token safety. Nothing asked the
 * prior question: "do we still follow the wallet that produced this signal, and
 * has it done enough for us to have an opinion about it?" The signal-engine
 * checks selection when it *emits* a candidate, but the nightly scorer sweep
 * pauses underperforming wallets, and a signal that sat in the queue across
 * that sweep would still be copied from a source we have since dropped.
 *
 * This runs before the claim rather than after it on purpose. Claiming first
 * and rejecting after would burn the signal's one-shot canonical claim and
 * leave a `requested` execution row that has to be cancelled ‚Äî extra lifecycle
 * state for a trade we were never going to place.
 */

/** Operator account this policy runs for (Standing Rule 2). */
export const COPY_ELIGIBILITY_ACCOUNT = 'operator';

export interface CopyEligibilityThresholds {
  /** Reject a source event older than this ‚Äî the price it implies is gone. */
  maxEventAgeMs: number;
  /** Tolerance for an indexer clock running ahead of ours. */
  maxClockSkewMs: number;
  /** Confirmed USD the source wallet must have traded in the lookback window. */
  minimumSourceActivityUsd: number;
  /** Lifetime recorded trades the source wallet must have. */
  minimumSourceTradeCount: number;
  /** How far back `minimumSourceActivityUsd` is measured. */
  activityLookbackMs: number;
}

export type CopyEligibilityDecision =
  | { allowed: true; facts: CopyEligibilityFacts }
  | { allowed: false; reasons: string[] };

export interface CopyEligibilityDependencies {
  loadFacts: (input: {
    signalId: string;
    activityLookbackMs: number;
    now: Date;
  }) => Promise<CopyEligibilityFacts | null>;
  recordRejection: (input: CopyEligibilityRejection) => Promise<unknown>;
  thresholds: CopyEligibilityThresholds;
  now?: () => Date;
}

export async function enforceCopyEligibility(
  input: { account: string; signalId: string; chain: Chain },
  dependencies: CopyEligibilityDependencies
): Promise<CopyEligibilityDecision> {
  const { thresholds } = dependencies;
  const now = dependencies.now?.() ?? new Date();

  let facts: CopyEligibilityFacts | null;
  try {
    facts = await dependencies.loadFacts({
      signalId: input.signalId,
      activityLookbackMs: thresholds.activityLookbackMs,
      now
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // A policy that cannot read its own inputs must not wave the trade through.
    console.error(
      `[trade-executor] copy-eligibility lookup failed for signal ${input.signalId}`,
      error
    );
    return reject(input, dependencies, null, ['source-facts-unreadable'], now);
  }

  if (!facts) {
    return reject(input, dependencies, null, ['source-facts-unavailable'], now);
  }

  // The queued job derived its chain from the token mint prefix; the facts come
  // from the immutable source event. If they disagree, one of them is about a
  // different trade and neither can be trusted to gate this claim.
  if (facts.chain !== input.chain) {
    return reject(input, dependencies, facts, ['source-chain-mismatch'], now);
  }

  const decision = evaluateCopyPolicy({
    chain: facts.chain,
    selectedWallet: facts.walletKnown && facts.walletStatus === 'active',
    selectedCluster: facts.clusterSelected,
    eventAt: facts.eventAt,
    now,
    maxEventAgeMs: thresholds.maxEventAgeMs,
    maxClockSkewMs: thresholds.maxClockSkewMs,
    sourceActivityUsd: facts.sourceActivityUsd,
    minimumSourceActivityUsd: thresholds.minimumSourceActivityUsd,
    // The remaining gates in `evaluateCopyPolicy` have owners elsewhere and are
    // passed satisfied so this boundary reports only what it actually decided:
    // liquidity and token safety by the signal-engine screen that has to pass
    // before a trade job is queued at all, exposure by the rolling 24h cap in
    // `handleJob` just above this call, and chain readiness by `resolveChainMode`
    // plus the `execMode === 'off'` return. Duplicating them here with a second
    // set of thresholds would give two answers to the same question.
    liquidityUsd: 0,
    minimumLiquidityUsd: 0,
    currentExposureUsd: 0,
    requestedExposureUsd: 0,
    maximumExposureUsd: 0,
    chainReady: true,
    supportedAsset: true,
    safetyAllowed: true
  });

  const reasons = [...decision.reasons];
  if (!facts.walletKnown) {
    reasons.push('source-wallet-untracked');
  }
  // `evaluateCopyPolicy` measures activity in USD only. A wallet can clear a USD
  // floor on a single outsized trade while having no track record at all, which
  // is the case a count floor catches.
  if (facts.walletTradeCount < thresholds.minimumSourceTradeCount) {
    reasons.push('source-trade-count-below-minimum');
  }

  if (reasons.length > 0) {
    return reject(input, dependencies, facts, [...new Set(reasons)], now);
  }
  return { allowed: true, facts };
}

async function reject(
  input: { account: string; signalId: string; chain: Chain },
  dependencies: CopyEligibilityDependencies,
  facts: CopyEligibilityFacts | null,
  reasons: string[],
  rejectedAt: Date
): Promise<CopyEligibilityDecision> {
  try {
    await dependencies.recordRejection({
      account: input.account,
      signalId: input.signalId,
      chain: facts?.chain ?? input.chain,
      walletAddress: facts?.walletAddress ?? null,
      reasons,
      rejectedAt
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // Losing the audit row is bad, but executing a trade we already decided
    // against is worse. The decision stands either way.
    console.error(
      `[trade-executor] failed to record copy-eligibility rejection for signal ${input.signalId}`,
      error
    );
  }
  return { allowed: false, reasons };
}

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { PaymasterBudgetTracker } from './paymaster-budget.js';

/**
 * The six adapters (`S4-P7`). No key, no RPC, no wallet client ‚Äî every dependency
 * is a function, which is the whole reason the port has this shape.
 */

const OPERATOR: ExecutionPrincipal = { kind: 'operator' };
const ALICE: ExecutionPrincipal = { kind: 'user', userId: 'alice' };

function request(
  chain: GrantedExecutionAuthority['chain'],
  principal: ExecutionPrincipal,
  action: VenueActionKind = 'venue-trade'
): ExecutionAuthorityRequest {
  return { chain, principal, action };
}

function fakeSolanaSigner(): SolanaTransactionSigner & {
  signed: string[];
  tips: { tipAccount: string; lamports: number }[];
} {
  const signed: string[] = [];
  const tips: { tipAccount: string; lamports: number }[] = [];
  return {
    publicKey: 'SoLSigner11111111111111111111111111111111111',
    signed,
    tips,
    async sign(transactionBase64) {
      signed.push(transactionBase64);
      return `signed:${transactionBase64}`;
    },
    async buildTip(input) {
      tips.push(input);
      return `tip:${input.tipAccount}:${input.lamports}`;
    }
  };
}

const PERMIT: Eip712TypedData = {
  domain: { name: 'Permit2', chainId: 4663, verifyingContract: '0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3' },
  types: {
    PermitSingle: [
      { name: 'details', type: 'PermitDetails' },
      { name: 'spender', type: 'address' },
      { name: 'sigDeadline', type: 'uint256' }
    ]

  primaryType: 'PermitSingle',
  message: { spender: '0xrouter', sigDeadline: '1' }
};

function granted(
  verdict: Awaited<ReturnType<ReturnType<typeof createOperatorSolanaAuthority>['authorize']>>
): GrantedExecutionAuthority {
  if (verdict.kind !== 'granted') {
    throw new Error(`expected a grant, got ${verdict.code}: ${verdict.reason}`);
  }
  return verdict.authority;
}

describe('operator Solana adapter', () => {
  it('settles on the Trojan wallet and reports the Jito signer separately', async () => {
    const signer = fakeSolanaSigner();
    const authority = createOperatorSolanaAuthority({
      trojanWalletAddress: () => 'TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111',
      signer: () => signer
    });

    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('solana', OPERATOR)));

    // Preserved exactly: `copy_executions.target_account` has always held the
    // Trojan wallet on Solana, on both routes. Changing it would orphan every
    // in-flight canonical execution.
    expect(grant.settlementAddress).toBe('TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111');
    expect(grant.signingAddress).toBe(signer.publicKey);
    expect(grant.capabilities).toEqual(['venue-managed-submission', 'sign-chain-transaction']);
    expect(grant.principal).toEqual(OPERATOR);
    expect(grant.expiresAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it('grants with no signing address when only the Trojan route is configured', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorSolanaAuthority({
      trojanWalletAddress: () => 'TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111',
      signer: () => null
    });

    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('solana', OPERATOR)));

    // The certified default. Authority exists ‚Äî a third party holds the key ‚Äî
    // so this must be a grant, not a denial, or live Solana stops working.
    expect(grant.signingAddress).toBeNull();
    expect(grant.capabilities).toEqual(['venue-managed-submission']);
  });

      signer: () => signer
    });

    expect(await grant.sign({ kind: 'solana-transaction', transactionBase64: 'AQID' }))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'signed', encoding: 'base64', value: 'signed:AQID' });
    expect(await grant.sign({ kind: 'solana-tip-transfer', tipAccount: 'tip1', lamports: 42 }))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'signed', encoding: 'base64', value: 'tip:tip1:42' });
    expect(signer.signed).toEqual(['AQID']);
    expect(signer.tips).toEqual([{ tipAccount: 'tip1', lamports: 42 }]);
  });

    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('solana', OPERATOR)));

    // No `sign-chain-transaction` capability on the Trojan-only route, so being

    // exist when the module graph loads. A snapshot taken at construction would
    // report the route unconfigured for the life of the process.
    let signer: SolanaTransactionSigner | null = null;

      typedDataSigner: () => async () => '0xsig'
    });

    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', OPERATOR)));

    // Same string the per-account nonce serialisation locks on. Two spellings of
    // one account would defeat both `withSubmissionLock` and `EvmNonceLock`.
    expect(grant.settlementAddress).toBe('0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000aa');
    expect(grant.signingAddress).toBe(grant.settlementAddress);
    expect(grant.capabilities).toEqual(['venue-managed-submission', 'sign-typed-data']);
  });

  it('authorizes a Permit2 permit as a typed-data signature (S4-M13)', async () => {
    const signTypedData = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('0xdeadbeef');
    const authority = createOperatorRobinhoodAuthority({
      accountAddress: () => '0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000aa',
      typedDataSigner: () => signTypedData
    });

    const verdict = await authority.authorize(
      request('robinhood-chain', OPERATOR, 'token-spend-permission')
    );
    const grant = granted(verdict);
    const signed = await grant.sign({ kind: 'eip712-typed-data', typedData: PERMIT });

    // The permit never becomes a transaction: it goes out as a signature through
    // the same port as everything else, which is the seam `S4-P7` provides.
    expect(signed).toEqual({ kind: 'signed', encoding: 'hex', value: '0xdeadbeef' });
    expect(signTypedData).toHaveBeenCalledWith(PERMIT);
  });

  it('denies when EVM_PRIVATE_KEY is absent', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorRobinhoodAuthority({
      accountAddress: () => null,
      typedDataSigner: () => null
    });

    expect(await authority.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', OPERATOR))).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'denied',
      code: 'authority-operator-not-configured'
    });
  });

  it('turns a thrown signer into a refusal that does not echo the payload', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorRobinhoodAuthority({
      accountAddress: () => '0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000aa',
      typedDataSigner: () => async () => { throw new Error('hardware wallet locked'); }
    });
    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', OPERATOR)));

    const result = await grant.sign({ kind: 'eip712-typed-data', typedData: PERMIT });

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'refused', code: 'authority-signing-failed' });
    expect(result.kind === 'refused' && result.reason).toContain('hardware wallet locked');
    expect(result.kind === 'refused' && result.reason).not.toContain('sigDeadline');
  });
});

describe('operator Polymarket adapter', () => {
  it('separates the funder it settles against from the signer it signs with', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorPolymarketAuthority({

describe('per-user adapters fail closed when mechanism is unavailable', () => {
  it.each([
    ['solana', createUserSolanaAuthority({ enabled: false }), 'authority-solana-delegate-unavailable'],
    [
      'robinhood-chain',
      createUserRobinhoodAuthority(),
      'authority-evm-session-key-unavailable'
    ],
    ['polygon', createUserPolymarketAuthority(), 'authority-polymarket-delegation-unsupported']
  ] as const)('%s denies with %s', async (chain, authority, code) => {
    const verdict = await authority.authorize(request(chain, ALICE));

    expect(verdict).toMatchObject({ kind: 'denied', code });
    // A generic error would send an operator to read the wrong thing. Each
    // reason names the blocking checklist item or the ADR section that settles it.
    expect(verdict.kind === 'denied' && verdict.reason).toMatch(/S4-|ADR-0003|section/);
    expect(verdict.kind === 'denied' && verdict.reason).toContain('user:alice');
  });

  it('gives the three chains three different codes when unavailable', async () => {
    // Deliberately distinct: two are scheduling answers with very different
    // schedules, and Polymarket's is architectural. One shared code would send
    // an operator to debug the wrong thing, the mistake `solana-simulation.ts`
    // splits `refuse` from `unavailable` to avoid.
    const codes = new Set<string>();
    for (const adapter of [
      createUserSolanaAuthority({ enabled: false }),
      createUserRobinhoodAuthority(),
      createUserPolymarketAuthority()
    ]) {
      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request(adapter.chain, ALICE));
      if (verdict.kind === 'denied') codes.add(verdict.code);
    }

    expect(codes.size).toBe(3);
  });

  it('never serves the operator, so a missing per-user grant cannot borrow one', async () => {
    for (const adapter of [
      createUserSolanaAuthority(),
      createUserRobinhoodAuthority(),
      createUserPolymarketAuthority()
    ]) {
      expect(adapter.serves(OPERATOR)).toBe(false);
      expect(adapter.serves(ALICE)).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});

      // Every operator request is granted.
      expect(await resolve(request(chain, OPERATOR))).toMatchObject({ kind: 'granted' });
      const forUser = await resolve(request(chain, ALICE));

      if (chain === 'solana') {

        expect(forUser.kind).toBe('granted');
        if (forUser.kind === 'granted') {
          expect(forUser.authority.adapterId).toBe('user-solana');
        }
      } else {

        expect(forUser.kind).toBe('denied');
        expect(forUser.kind === 'denied' && forUser.code).not.toBe('authority-adapter-missing');
      }
    }
  });

  it('denies user Solana request when explicitly disabled in adapters set', async () => {
    const resolve = createExecutionAuthorityRegistry(
      createExecutionAuthorityAdapters(deps, { enabled: false })
    );
    const forUser = await resolve(request('solana', ALICE));
    expect(forUser.kind).toBe('denied');
    if (forUser.kind === 'denied') {
      expect(forUser.code).toBe('authority-solana-delegate-unavailable');
    }
  });

  it('registers the operator adapters in the same list as the per-user ones', () => {
    const adapters = createExecutionAuthorityAdapters(deps);

    // Criterion 4 of `S4-P7`, asserted structurally: six adapters, one interface,
    // no chain served by only one class of principal. If someone lifts the
    // operator path back out into a branch, this count changes.
    expect(adapters).toHaveLength(6);
    for (const chain of ['solana', 'robinhood-chain', 'polygon'] as const) {
      const onChain = adapters.filter((adapter) => adapter.chain === chain);
      expect(onChain.filter((adapter) => adapter.serves(OPERATOR))).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(onChain.filter((adapter) => adapter.serves(ALICE))).toHaveLength(1);

      });

      expect(verdict).toEqual({
        kind: 'denied',

      });
      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', ALICE));
      expect(verdict).toMatchObject({
        kind: 'denied',
        code: 'authority-grant-expired'
      });
      if (verdict.kind === 'denied') {
        expect(verdict.reason).toContain('expired at 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z');
