import { ethers } from 'ethers';

export const POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS = Object.freeze({
  ctfExchange: '0xE111180000d2663C0091e4f400237545B87B996B',
  negRiskCtfExchange: '0xe2222d279d744050d28e00520010520000310F59',
  conditionalTokens: '0x4D97DCd97eC945f40cF65F87097ACe5EA0476045',
  pUsd: '0xC011a7E12a19f7B1f670d46F03B03f3342E82DFB',
  pUsdImplementation: '0x6bBCef9f7ef3B6C592c99e0f206a0DE94Ad0925f',
  collateralOnramp: '0x93070a847efEf7F70739046A929D47a521F5B8ee',
  usdcE: '0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174',
  proxyFactory: '0xaB45c5A4B0c941a2F231C04C3f49182e1A254052',
  proxyImplementation: '0x44e999d5c2F66Ef0861317f9A4805AC2e90aEB4f',
  safeFactory: '0xaacFeEa03eb1561C4e67d661e40682Bd20E3541b',
  depositWalletFactory: '0x00000000000Fb5C9ADea0298D729A0CB3823Cc07',
  depositWalletBeacon: '0x7A18EDfe055488A3128f01F563e5B479D92ffc3a',
  depositWalletImplementation: '0x58CA52ebe0DadfdF531Cde7062e76746de4Db1eB'
});

const ERC20_ABI = [
  'function decimals() view returns (uint8)',
  'function balanceOf(address account) view returns (uint256)',
  'function allowance(address owner, address spender) view returns (uint256)',
  'function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) returns (bool)'
];

const ONRAMP_ABI = [
  'function wrap(address asset, address to, uint256 amount)'
];

const CONDITIONAL_TOKENS_ABI = [
  'function isApprovedForAll(address account, address operator) view returns (bool)',
  'function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved)'
];

export interface PolymarketCollateralGateway {
  getPusdDecimals(): Promise<number>;
  getUsdcEDecimals(): Promise<number>;
  getPusdBalance(account: string): Promise<bigint>;
  getUsdcEBalance(account: string): Promise<bigint>;
  getUsdcEAllowance(account: string, spender: string): Promise<bigint>;
  approveUsdcE(spender: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string>;
  wrapUsdcE(to: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string>;
  getPusdAllowance(account: string, spender: string): Promise<bigint>;
  approvePusd(spender: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string>;
  isConditionalTokenApproved(account: string, operator: string): Promise<boolean>;
  approveConditionalTokenOperator(operator: string): Promise<string>;
}

export interface PolymarketCollateralReadinessOptions {
  funderAddress: string;
  signerAddress: string;
  accountWalletType: 'EOA' | 'POLY_PROXY' | 'POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE' | 'POLY_1271';
  directWalletWritesAllowed: boolean;
  minimumPusdUnits: bigint;
  allowanceCapUnits: bigint;
  autoOnramp: boolean;
  autoApprove: boolean;
}

export interface PolymarketCollateralReadiness {
  pUsdBalanceUnits: bigint;
  allowanceCapUnits: bigint;
  actions: Array<{ type: string; transactionHash: string }>;
}

function assertNonNegative(value: bigint, name: string): void {
  if (value < 0n) throw new Error(`${name} cannot be negative`);
}

async function approveExact(
  current: bigint,
  required: bigint,
  read: () => Promise<bigint>,
  approve: (amount: bigint) => Promise<string>,
  actionType: string,
  actions: Array<{ type: string; transactionHash: string }>
): Promise<void> {
  if (current === required) return;
  if (current > 0n) {
    actions.push({ type: `${actionType}-reset`, transactionHash: await approve(0n) });
    const resetAllowance = await read();
    if (resetAllowance !== 0n) {
      throw new Error(`${actionType} allowance did not reset to zero`);
    }
  }
  actions.push({ type: actionType, transactionHash: await approve(required) });
  const confirmedAllowance = await read();
  if (confirmedAllowance !== required) {
    throw new Error(`${actionType} allowance did not confirm at the configured exact cap`);
  }
}

function normalizeAddress(address: string, label: string): string {
  try {
    return ethers.utils.getAddress(address);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${label} must be a valid EVM address`);
  }
}

function manualWalletInstruction(
  options: PolymarketCollateralReadinessOptions,
  action: string
): string {
  return (
    `${options.accountWalletType} account wallet ${options.funderAddress} requires ${action}; ` +
    `complete it through that account wallet rather than signer ${options.signerAddress}`
  );
}

function assertWalletWritePath(options: PolymarketCollateralReadinessOptions): void {
  const signer = normalizeAddress(options.signerAddress, 'signerAddress');
  const funder = normalizeAddress(options.funderAddress, 'funderAddress');
  const isEoa = options.accountWalletType === 'EOA';

  if (options.directWalletWritesAllowed !== isEoa) {
    throw new Error('direct wallet writes are permitted only for an EOA account wallet');
  }
  if (isEoa && signer !== funder) {
    throw new Error('EOA collateral setup requires signerAddress and funderAddress to match');
  }
  if (!isEoa && (options.autoOnramp || options.autoApprove)) {
    throw new Error(
      manualWalletInstruction(
        options,
        'manual collateral and approval setup because automatic setup is EOA-only'
      )
    );
  }
}

function assertSixDecimalCollateral(pUsdDecimals: number, usdcEDecimals: number): void {
  if (pUsdDecimals !== 6) {
    throw new Error(`pUSD decimals mismatch: expected 6, got ${pUsdDecimals}`);
  }
  if (usdcEDecimals !== 6) {
    throw new Error(`USDC.e decimals mismatch: expected 6, got ${usdcEDecimals}`);
  }
}

export async function ensurePolymarketCollateralReadiness(
  gateway: PolymarketCollateralGateway,
  options: PolymarketCollateralReadinessOptions
): Promise<PolymarketCollateralReadiness> {
  assertWalletWritePath(options);
  assertNonNegative(options.minimumPusdUnits, 'minimumPusdUnits');
  assertNonNegative(options.allowanceCapUnits, 'allowanceCapUnits');
  if (options.minimumPusdUnits === 0n) {
    throw new Error('minimumPusdUnits must be greater than zero for live execution');
  }
  if (options.allowanceCapUnits === 0n) {
    throw new Error('allowanceCapUnits must be greater than zero for live execution');
  }
  if (options.minimumPusdUnits > options.allowanceCapUnits) {
    throw new Error('minimumPusdUnits cannot exceed the bounded allowanceCapUnits');
  }

  const [pUsdDecimals, usdcEDecimals] = await Promise.all([
    gateway.getPusdDecimals(),
    gateway.getUsdcEDecimals()
  ]);
  assertSixDecimalCollateral(pUsdDecimals, usdcEDecimals);

  const actions: Array<{ type: string; transactionHash: string }> = [];
  let pUsdBalance = await gateway.getPusdBalance(options.funderAddress);
  assertNonNegative(pUsdBalance, 'pUSD balance');

  if (pUsdBalance < options.minimumPusdUnits) {
    if (!options.autoOnramp) {
      if (!options.directWalletWritesAllowed) {
        throw new Error(
          manualWalletInstruction(options, 'manual pUSD funding to reach the configured live minimum')
        );
      }
      throw new Error(
        'pUSD balance is below the configured live minimum; fund it manually or explicitly enable POLYMARKET_AUTO_ONRAMP=true'
      );
    }

    const amount = options.minimumPusdUnits - pUsdBalance;
    const usdcEBalance = await gateway.getUsdcEBalance(options.signerAddress);
    assertNonNegative(usdcEBalance, 'USDC.e balance');
    if (usdcEBalance < amount) {
      throw new Error('USDC.e balance cannot cover the exact pUSD onramp amount');
    }

    const usdcEAllowance = await gateway.getUsdcEAllowance(
      options.signerAddress,
      POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp
    );
    await approveExact(
      usdcEAllowance,
      amount,
      () => gateway.getUsdcEAllowance(
        options.signerAddress,
        POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp
      ),
      (value) => gateway.approveUsdcE(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp, value),
      'approve-usdce-onramp',
      actions
    );
    actions.push({
      type: 'wrap-usdce-to-pusd',
      transactionHash: await gateway.wrapUsdcE(options.funderAddress, amount)
    });

    pUsdBalance = await gateway.getPusdBalance(options.funderAddress);
    assertNonNegative(pUsdBalance, 'pUSD balance');
    if (pUsdBalance < options.minimumPusdUnits) {
      throw new Error('pUSD balance remained below the live minimum after onramp confirmation');
    }
  }

  for (const exchange of [POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.ctfExchange, POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.negRiskCtfExchange]) {
    const allowance = await gateway.getPusdAllowance(options.funderAddress, exchange);
    assertNonNegative(allowance, `pUSD allowance for ${exchange}`);
    if (allowance !== options.allowanceCapUnits) {
      if (!options.autoApprove) {
        const relation = allowance < options.allowanceCapUnits ? 'below' : 'above';
        if (!options.directWalletWritesAllowed) {
          throw new Error(
            manualWalletInstruction(
              options,
              `an exact pUSD allowance of ${options.allowanceCapUnits} units for exchange ${exchange}; current allowance is ${relation} the cap`
            )
          );
        }
        throw new Error(
          `pUSD allowance is ${relation} the configured exact cap for exchange ${exchange}; ` +
          'set it manually or explicitly enable POLYMARKET_AUTO_APPROVE=true'
        );
      }
      await approveExact(
        allowance,
        options.allowanceCapUnits,
        () => gateway.getPusdAllowance(options.funderAddress, exchange),
        (value) => gateway.approvePusd(exchange, value),
        'approve-pusd-exchange',
        actions
      );
    }

    const conditionalApproved = await gateway.isConditionalTokenApproved(options.funderAddress, exchange);
    if (!conditionalApproved) {
      if (!options.autoApprove) {
        if (!options.directWalletWritesAllowed) {
          throw new Error(
            manualWalletInstruction(
              options,
              `manual Conditional Tokens operator approval for exchange ${exchange}`
            )
          );
        }
        throw new Error(
          `conditional-token sell approval is missing for exchange ${exchange}; ` +
          'set it manually or explicitly enable POLYMARKET_AUTO_APPROVE=true'
        );
      }
      actions.push({
        type: 'approve-conditional-token-exchange',
        transactionHash: await gateway.approveConditionalTokenOperator(exchange)
      });
      if (!await gateway.isConditionalTokenApproved(options.funderAddress, exchange)) {
        throw new Error(`conditional-token approval did not confirm for exchange ${exchange}`);
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    pUsdBalanceUnits: pUsdBalance,
    allowanceCapUnits: options.allowanceCapUnits,
    actions
  };
}

function asBigInt(value: ethers.BigNumber): bigint {
  return BigInt(value.toString());
}

async function waitForSuccess(transaction: ethers.ContractTransaction): Promise<string> {
  const receipt = await transaction.wait(1);
  if (receipt.status !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket collateral transaction failed: ${transaction.hash}`);
  }
  return transaction.hash;
}

export class EthersPolymarketCollateralGateway implements PolymarketCollateralGateway {
  private readonly pUsdRead: ethers.Contract;
  private readonly usdcERead: ethers.Contract;
  private readonly conditionalTokensRead: ethers.Contract;
  private readonly pUsdWrite: ethers.Contract | null;
  private readonly usdcEWrite: ethers.Contract | null;
  private readonly conditionalTokensWrite: ethers.Contract | null;
  private readonly onrampWrite: ethers.Contract | null;

  constructor(provider: ethers.providers.Provider, signer: ethers.Signer | null) {
    this.pUsdRead = new ethers.Contract(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.pUsd, ERC20_ABI, provider);
    this.usdcERead = new ethers.Contract(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.usdcE, ERC20_ABI, provider);
    this.conditionalTokensRead = new ethers.Contract(
      POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.conditionalTokens,
      CONDITIONAL_TOKENS_ABI,
      provider
    );
    this.pUsdWrite = signer ? this.pUsdRead.connect(signer) : null;
    this.usdcEWrite = signer ? this.usdcERead.connect(signer) : null;
    this.conditionalTokensWrite = signer ? this.conditionalTokensRead.connect(signer) : null;
    this.onrampWrite = signer
      ? new ethers.Contract(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp, ONRAMP_ABI, signer)
      : null;
  }

  async getPusdDecimals(): Promise<number> {
    return Number(await this.pUsdRead.decimals());
  }

  async getUsdcEDecimals(): Promise<number> {
    return Number(await this.usdcERead.decimals());
  }

  async getPusdBalance(account: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return asBigInt(await this.pUsdRead.balanceOf(account));
  }

  async getUsdcEBalance(account: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return asBigInt(await this.usdcERead.balanceOf(account));
  }

  async getUsdcEAllowance(account: string, spender: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return asBigInt(await this.usdcERead.allowance(account, spender));
  }

  async approveUsdcE(spender: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.usdcEWrite) throw new Error('No signer is configured for USDC.e approval');
    return waitForSuccess(await this.usdcEWrite.approve(spender, amount.toString()));
  }

  async wrapUsdcE(to: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.onrampWrite) throw new Error('No signer is configured for the USDC.e onramp');
    return waitForSuccess(
      await this.onrampWrite.wrap(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.usdcE, to, amount.toString())
    );
  }

  async getPusdAllowance(account: string, spender: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return asBigInt(await this.pUsdRead.allowance(account, spender));
  }

  async approvePusd(spender: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.pUsdWrite) throw new Error('No signer is configured for pUSD approval');
    return waitForSuccess(await this.pUsdWrite.approve(spender, amount.toString()));
  }

  async isConditionalTokenApproved(account: string, operator: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.conditionalTokensRead.isApprovedForAll(account, operator);
  }

  async approveConditionalTokenOperator(operator: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.conditionalTokensWrite) {
      throw new Error('No signer is configured for conditional-token approval');
    }
    return waitForSuccess(await this.conditionalTokensWrite.setApprovalForAll(operator, true));
  }
}

type Harness = {
  submitted: PolymarketExitLimitRung[];
  alerts: PolymarketExitAlert[];
  redemptions: PolymarketExitRedeem[];
  submitRung: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  ports: any;
};

function harness(options: {
  candidates?: PolymarketExitEscalationCandidate[];
  fillPerRung?: number;
  sellableShares?: number;
  market?: typeof OPEN_MARKET;
  bids?: { price: string; size: string }[];
} = {}): Harness {
  const submitted: PolymarketExitLimitRung[] = [];
  const alerts: PolymarketExitAlert[] = [];
  const redemptions: PolymarketExitRedeem[] = [];
  const submitRung = vi.fn(async (rung: PolymarketExitLimitRung) => {
    submitted.push(rung);
    return { filledShares: options.fillPerRung ?? 0 };
  });
  return {
    submitted,
    alerts,
    redemptions,
    submitRung,
    ports: {
      loadCandidates: vi.fn(async () => options.candidates ?? [candidate()]),
      fetchBook: vi.fn(async () => book({ bids: options.bids })),
      fetchSellableShares: vi.fn(async () => options.sellableShares ?? 40),
      fetchMarketState: vi.fn(async () => options.market ?? OPEN_MARKET),
      submitRungFor: vi.fn(() => submitRung),
      emitAlert: vi.fn(async (alert: PolymarketExitAlert) => { alerts.push(alert); }),
      requestRedemption: vi.fn(async (redeem: PolymarketExitRedeem) => { redemptions.push(redeem); }),
      now: () => NOW,
      log: () => {}
    }
  };
}

describe('runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep ‚Äî the call site of the ladder', () => {
  it('advances a rung for an unfilled sell and terminates in an alert, not in more rungs', async () => {
    const h = harness();

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    // Rung advanced: one rung per ladder step, each strictly cheaper than the
    // last, on the 0.01 tick grid, measured down from the 0.59 reference.
    expect(h.submitted.map((rung) => rung.price)).toEqual([0.58, 0.56, 0.53]);
    expect(h.submitted.map((rung) => rung.attempt)).toEqual([0, 1, 2]);
    expect(h.submitted.map((rung) => rung.rungBps)).toEqual([...POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS]);

    // And it stopped. The ladder alerted once instead of escalating forever.
    expect(h.submitRung).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS.length);
    expect(h.alerts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(h.alerts[0]!.code).toBe('exit-escalation-exhausted');
    expect(h.alerts[0]!.severity).toBe('critical');
    expect(h.alerts[0]!.remainingShares).toBe(40);
    expect(h.ports.emitAlert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(h.ports.emitAlert.mock.calls[0]![1].id).toBe('trade-1');

    expect(result).toMatchObject({
      scanned: 1, escalated: 1, alerted: 1, redeemed: 0, failed: 0, skipped: 0
    });
    expect(result.outcomes[0]!.outcome.terminal).toBe('alert');
    expect(result.outcomes[0]!.outcome.rungsSubmitted).toBe(3);
  });

  it('re-observes between rungs, so a rung that fills the position ends the ladder', async () => {
    // The sweep observes once to build the ladder's input, then the driver
    // re-observes after each rung: 40 held, rung fills it, 0 left.
    const shares = [40, 0];
    const h = harness({ fillPerRung: 40 });
    h.ports.fetchSellableShares = vi.fn(async () => shares.shift() ?? 0);

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(h.submitted).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(h.alerts).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ escalated: 1, completed: 1, alerted: 0 });
    expect(result.outcomes[0]!.outcome.terminal).toBe('complete');
    expect(result.outcomes[0]!.outcome.filledShares).toBe(40);
  });

  it('does not walk the same exit twice, so a later pass cannot re-alert it', async () => {
    const h = harness();

    const first = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);
    const second = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(first.alerted).toBe(1);
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ scanned: 1, escalated: 0, alerted: 0, skipped: 1 });
    expect(second.skips[0]!.reason).toContain('already walked a ladder');
    // Still three rungs total across both passes, not six.
    expect(h.submitRung).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    expect(h.alerts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('routes a market that stopped accepting orders to redemption instead of a rung', async () => {
    const h = harness({
      market: { ...OPEN_MARKET, acceptingOrders: false, closed: true, resolutionStatus: 'resolved' }
    });

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(h.submitted).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(h.alerts).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(h.redemptions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(h.redemptions[0]!.conditionId).toBe(CONDITION_ID);
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ escalated: 0, redeemed: 1, alerted: 0 });
  });

  it('alerts rather than escalating when there is no bid to escalate into', async () => {
    const h = harness({ bids: [] });

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(h.submitted).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(h.alerts[0]!.code).toBe('no-bid-liquidity');
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ escalated: 0, alerted: 1 });
  });

  it('submits nothing when Polymarket live execution is not ready', async () => {
    setPolymarketLiveReadiness(false, 'uncertified in this environment');
    const h = harness();

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(h.ports.loadCandidates).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(h.submitRung).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ scanned: 0, escalated: 0, alerted: 0 });
  });

  it('honours the per-pass limit so one ladder cannot monopolise the reconciliation pass', async () => {
    const h = harness({
      candidates: [candidate(), candidate({ id: 'trade-2', venue_order_id: 'order-fak-2' })]
    });

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(result.scanned).toBe(2);
    expect(result.escalated).toBe(1);
    expect(h.submitRung).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });
});
