==> apps/trade-executor/src/robinhood-base-spend.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { describeRobinhoodBaseSpend } from './robinhood.js';

const WETH = '0x0bd7d308f8e1639fab988df18a8011f41eacad73' as const;
const USDG = '0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168' as const;

/**
 * S4-M41 ‚Äî the base-asset spend must carry its unit.
 *
 * The defect these pin: `amountEth` is a `number` whose name hardcodes a currency
 * only one of the two base-asset modes uses. In `erc20` mode it was `0`, and the
 * ledger wrote that zero as a real ETH cost ‚Äî a fabricated value on a trade that
 * spent a stablecoin. A zero cost basis makes an ordinary position look like an
 * infinite-return winner, and one that can never trip a stop-loss.
 *
 * Every case here exercises `erc20` mode explicitly. A suite that only covered
 * `native-weth` would pass with the bug fully intact, which is why it survived.
 */
describe('describeRobinhoodBaseSpend (S4-M41)', () => {
  describe('native-weth mode', () => {
    it('reports the ETH amount that went in on a buy', () => {
      const spend = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
        baseAssetMode: 'native-weth',
        baseAsset: WETH,
        direction: 'buy',
        actualAmountIn: 100000000000000000n, // 0.1 ETH
        actualAmountOut: 4900n
      });
      expect(spend).toEqual({ kind: 'native', currency: 'ETH', amount: 0.1 });
    });

    it('reports the ETH amount that came out on a sell', () => {
      // The base asset is what we spend on a buy and what we receive on a sell,
      // so the leg flips with direction. Reading the wrong one silently reports a
      // token quantity as an ETH amount.
      const spend = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
        baseAssetMode: 'native-weth',
        baseAsset: WETH,
        direction: 'sell',
        actualAmountIn: 4900n,
        actualAmountOut: 250000000000000000n // 0.25 ETH
      });
      expect(spend).toEqual({ kind: 'native', currency: 'ETH', amount: 0.25 });
    });
  });

  describe('erc20 mode ‚Äî where the fabricated zero used to be', () => {
    it('never reports ETH, and never reports zero, for a USDG spend', () => {
      const spend = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
        baseAssetMode: 'erc20',
        baseAsset: USDG,
        direction: 'buy',
        actualAmountIn: 250_000_000n, // 250 USDG at 6 decimals
        actualAmountOut: 4900n
      });
      expect(spend).toEqual({ kind: 'erc20', token: USDG, baseUnits: 250_000_000n });
      // The two assertions that are the whole point of the item.
      expect(spend).not.toMatchObject({ currency: 'ETH' });
      expect(spend).not.toMatchObject({ amount: 0 });
    });

    it('carries base units rather than a decimal, because USDG has 6 decimals not 18', () => {
      // 250 USDG is 250_000_000 base units. Formatting it with the ether helpers
      // would yield 2.5e-10 ‚Äî understated by 10^12, which presents as "no funds"
      // rather than as a scaling bug. Keeping the integer makes the amount exact
      // and forces the caller that knows the decimals to do the conversion.
      const spend = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
        baseAssetMode: 'erc20',
        baseAsset: USDG,
        direction: 'buy',
        actualAmountIn: 250_000_000n,
        actualAmountOut: 1n
      });
      expect(spend.kind).toBe('erc20');
      if (spend.kind !== 'erc20') throw new Error('unreachable');
      expect(spend.baseUnits).toBe(250_000_000n);
      expect(typeof spend.baseUnits).toBe('bigint');
    });

    it('flips to the output leg on a sell, same as native mode', () => {
      const spend = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
        baseAssetMode: 'erc20',
        baseAsset: USDG,
        direction: 'sell',
        actualAmountIn: 4900n,
        actualAmountOut: 310_500_000n
      });
      expect(spend).toEqual({ kind: 'erc20', token: USDG, baseUnits: 310_500_000n });
    });

    it('reports the configured base asset, not a hardcoded one', () => {
      // A caller could reasonably assume erc20 mode means USDG. It means whatever
      // ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET is set to, and the ledger needs to know which token
      // the number is denominated in to ever convert it.
      const other = '0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111' as const;
      const spend = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
        baseAssetMode: 'erc20',
        baseAsset: other,
        direction: 'buy',
        actualAmountIn: 1n,
        actualAmountOut: 1n
      });
      expect(spend).toMatchObject({ kind: 'erc20', token: other });
    });

    it('reports a genuinely zero spend as zero base units, not as unassessed', () => {
      // Distinguishing the two directions of the unknown-vs-zero rule: a real zero
      // is representable and must not be laundered into "unknown" either.
      const spend = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
        baseAssetMode: 'erc20',
        baseAsset: USDG,
        direction: 'buy',
        actualAmountIn: 0n,
        actualAmountOut: 0n
      });
      expect(spend).toEqual({ kind: 'erc20', token: USDG, baseUnits: 0n });
    });
  });

  it('the two modes never produce the same shape, so a consumer must branch', () => {
    // Structural point: `kind` is what forces the ledger call site to decide what
    // to record. The old `number` let it skip that decision and write a zero.
    const native = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
      baseAssetMode: 'native-weth', baseAsset: WETH, direction: 'buy',
      actualAmountIn: 1n, actualAmountOut: 1n
    });
    const erc20 = describeRobinhoodBaseSpend({
      baseAssetMode: 'erc20', baseAsset: USDG, direction: 'buy',
      actualAmountIn: 1n, actualAmountOut: 1n
    });
    expect(native.kind).not.toBe(erc20.kind);
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/robinhood-nonce.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  NonceContentionError,
  executeRobinhoodOrder,
  type EvmNonceLock,
  type RobinhoodExecutionAdapter,
  type RobinhoodExecutionConfig,
  type RobinhoodPendingStore
} from './robinhood.js';

/**
 * S4-M12 ‚Äî nonce serialisation.
 *
 * These cases deliberately use an order that fails validation immediately (an
 * empty `clientOrderId`), so the adapter and pending store are never reached.
 * What is under test is the *locking* around the order, not the order itself ‚Äî
 * which has 28 cases of its own in `robinhood.test.ts`. Keeping the body trivial
 * means a failure here can only be the lock.
 */
function minimalOrder(account: `0x${string}`, nonceLock: EvmNonceLock) {
  return {
    order: {
      clientOrderId: '', // rejected before any adapter or store call
      token: '0x5000000000000000000000000000000000000005' as `0x${string}`,
      direction: 'buy' as const,
      amountInBaseUnits: 1n,
      slippageBps: 100
    },
    config: { maxSlippageBps: 500 } as unknown as RobinhoodExecutionConfig,
    account,
    adapter: {} as unknown as RobinhoodExecutionAdapter,
    pendingStore: {} as unknown as RobinhoodPendingStore,
    safetyAssessment: vi.fn(),
    requireReadiness: false as const,
    nonceLock
  };
}

const ACCOUNT_A = '0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa' as const;
const ACCOUNT_B = '0xbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb' as const;

/** A lock whose critical section blocks until the returned latch is released. */
function latchedLock() {
  const entered: string[] = [];
  const released: string[] = [];
  const gates = new Map<string, () => void>();
  const lock: EvmNonceLock = async (account, run) => {
    entered.push(account);
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => gates.set(account, resolve));
    const result = await run();
    released.push(account);
    return { acquired: true, result };
  };
  return {
    lock,
    entered,
    released,
    open: (account: string) => gates.get(account)?.()
  };
}

describe('cross-process nonce lock (S4-M12)', () => {
  it('refuses to run the order when the lock is held elsewhere', async () => {
    // The whole point of the item: a second process must not read the same
    // pending nonce. Running the body anyway is the bug.
    const run = vi.fn();
    const contended: EvmNonceLock = async () => {
      run();
      return { acquired: false };
    };

    await expect(executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, contended)))
      .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NonceContentionError);
  });

  it('names the account in the contention error', async () => {
    const contended: EvmNonceLock = async () => ({ acquired: false });
    await expect(executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, contended)))
      .rejects.toThrow(new RegExp(ACCOUNT_A));
  });

  it('is NOT an UnrecoverableError, so the queue retries rather than burying the job', async () => {
    // An UnrecoverableError would drop the mirror permanently for a millisecond
    // overlap. BullMQ must be free to retry once the holder has submitted.
    const contended: EvmNonceLock = async () => ({ acquired: false });
    const error = await executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, contended)).catch((e) => e);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(NonceContentionError);
    expect(error.constructor.name).toBe('NonceContentionError');
  });

  it('runs the order inside the lock, not around it', async () => {
    const calls: string[] = [];
    const lock: EvmNonceLock = async (account, run) => {
      calls.push('lock-acquired');
      const result = await run();
      calls.push('lock-released');
      return { acquired: true, result };
    };

    await executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, lock));
    expect(calls).toEqual(['lock-acquired', 'lock-released']);
  });

  it('passes the signing account through as the lock key', async () => {
    const seen: string[] = [];
    const lock: EvmNonceLock = async (account, run) => {
      seen.push(account);
      return { acquired: true, result: await run() };
    };
    await executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_B, lock));
    expect(seen).toEqual([ACCOUNT_B]);
  });
});

describe('in-process submission chain is per account (S4-M12)', () => {
  it('lets two different accounts hold their locks concurrently', async () => {
    // Before S4-M12 this chain was global: user B's mirror waited on user A's,
    // on a venue where being late is the entire risk. Both must be in flight.
    const { lock, entered, open } = latchedLock();

    const a = executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, lock));
    const b = executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_B, lock));
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(entered).toHaveLength(2));

    expect(entered).toEqual([ACCOUNT_A, ACCOUNT_B]);
    open(ACCOUNT_A);
    open(ACCOUNT_B);
    await Promise.all([a, b]);
  });

  it('serialises two orders for the SAME account', async () => {
    // This is the ordering nonce allocation actually requires: one account's
    // second order must not read the pending nonce until the first has submitted.
    const { lock, entered, open } = latchedLock();

    const first = executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, lock));
    const second = executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, lock));
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(entered).toHaveLength(1));

    // The second call has not entered the lock at all while the first is inside.
    expect(entered).toEqual([ACCOUNT_A]);

    open(ACCOUNT_A);
    await first;
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(entered).toHaveLength(2));
    open(ACCOUNT_A);
    await second;
  });

  it('releases the chain when an order throws, so one failure cannot wedge an account', async () => {
    const boom: EvmNonceLock = async () => { throw new Error('lock backend down'); };
    await expect(executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, boom)))
      .rejects.toThrow('lock backend down');

    // A wedged chain would hang here instead of resolving.
    const ok: EvmNonceLock = async (_a, run) => ({ acquired: true, result: await run() });
    await expect(executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, ok)))
      .resolves.toMatchObject({ status: 'skipped' });
  });

  it('releases the chain after a contention throw too', async () => {
    const contended: EvmNonceLock = async () => ({ acquired: false });
    await expect(executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, contended)))
      .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NonceContentionError);

    const ok: EvmNonceLock = async (_a, run) => ({ acquired: true, result: await run() });
    await expect(executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, ok)))
      .resolves.toMatchObject({ status: 'skipped' });
  });

  it('treats differently-cased forms of one account as one chain', async () => {
    // viem returns checksummed addresses; other paths lowercase them. Two
    // spellings must not both proceed for the same account.
    const { lock, entered, open } = latchedLock();
    const upper = ACCOUNT_A.toUpperCase().replace('0X', '0x') as `0x${string}`;

    const first = executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(ACCOUNT_A, lock));
    const second = executeRobinhoodOrder(minimalOrder(upper, lock));
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(entered).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(entered).toHaveLength(1);

    open(ACCOUNT_A);
    await first;
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(entered).toHaveLength(2));
    open(upper);
    await second;
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/robinhood-runtime.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  createRedisRobinhoodPendingStore,
  createRobinhoodSafetyAssessment
} from './robinhood-runtime.js';
import { evaluateRobinhoodSafety, type PendingRobinhoodSubmission } from './robinhood.js';
import { encodeRuntimeValue } from './runtime-codec.js';

function redisHash() {
  const values = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();
  return {
    async hget(key: string, field: string) {
      return values.get(key)?.get(field) ?? null;
    },
    async hgetall(key: string) {
      return Object.fromEntries(values.get(key) ?? []);
    },
    async hset(key: string, field: string, value: string) {
      const hash = values.get(key) ?? new Map<string, string>();
      hash.set(field, value);
      values.set(key, hash);
      return 1;
    }
  };
}

const pending: PendingRobinhoodSubmission = {
  clientOrderId: 'signal-rh-1',
  stage: 'swap',
  hash: '0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa',
  submittedAt: new Date('2026-07-26T10:00:00.000Z'),
  expiresAt: new Date('2026-07-26T10:10:00.000Z'),
  direction: 'buy',
  account: '0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111',
  token: '0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222',
  baseAsset: '0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333',
  amountIn: '100000000000000000',
  quotedAmountOut: '5000',
  feeTier: 3000,
  slippageBps: 300
};

describe('Redis Robinhood pending store', () => {
  it('restores unresolved submissions and terminal receipt truth after a process restart', async () => {
    const redis = redisHash();
    const firstProcess = createRedisRobinhoodPendingStore(redis);
    await firstProcess.save(pending);

    const restartedProcess = createRedisRobinhoodPendingStore(redis);
    await expect(restartedProcess.findUnresolved('signal-rh-1')).resolves.toEqual(pending);

    await restartedProcess.resolve('signal-rh-1', {
      status: 'filled',
      clientOrderId: 'signal-rh-1',
      signature: pending.hash!,
      transactionHash: pending.hash!,
      amountEth: 0.1,
      // native-weth mode, so baseSpend mirrors amountEth (S4-M41).
      baseSpend: { kind: 'native' as const, currency: 'ETH' as const, amount: 0.1 },
      actualAmountIn: 100000000000000000n,
      actualAmountOut: 4900n,
      quotedAmountOut: 5000n,
      feeTier: 3000,
      gasUsed: 100000n,
      latencyMs: 1200
    });

    await expect(firstProcess.findUnresolved('signal-rh-1')).resolves.toBeNull();
    await expect(firstProcess.findResolution('signal-rh-1')).resolves.toMatchObject({
      status: 'filled',
      actualAmountOut: 4900n
    });
  });

  it('decodes legacy v1 records with an unknown fee tier as null', async () => {
    const redis = redisHash();
    const key = 'test:pending:robinhood:v1';
    const legacyPending = {
      clientOrderId: pending.clientOrderId,
      stage: pending.stage,
      hash: pending.hash,
      submittedAt: pending.submittedAt,
      expiresAt: pending.expiresAt,
      direction: pending.direction,
      account: pending.account,
      token: pending.token,
      baseAsset: pending.baseAsset,
      amountIn: pending.amountIn,
      quotedAmountOut: pending.quotedAmountOut,
      slippageBps: pending.slippageBps
    };
    await redis.hset(key, pending.clientOrderId, encodeRuntimeValue({
      state: 'pending',
      pending: legacyPending
    }));
    await redis.hset(key, 'legacy-resolution', encodeRuntimeValue({
      state: 'resolved',
      resolution: {
        status: 'filled',
        clientOrderId: 'legacy-resolution',
        signature: pending.hash,
        transactionHash: pending.hash,
        amountEth: 0.1,
        actualAmountIn: 100000000000000000n,
        actualAmountOut: 4900n,
        quotedAmountOut: 5000n,
        gasUsed: 100000n,
        latencyMs: 1200
      }
    }));

    const store = createRedisRobinhoodPendingStore(redis, key);
    await expect(store.findUnresolved(pending.clientOrderId)).resolves.toEqual({
      ...pending,
      feeTier: null
    });
    await expect(store.listUnresolved()).resolves.toEqual([{ ...pending, feeTier: null }]);
    await expect(store.findResolution('legacy-resolution')).resolves.toMatchObject({
      status: 'filled',
      feeTier: null
    });
  });
});

describe('Robinhood runtime safety assessment', () => {
  it('uses a real reverse quote and fails closed when liquidity evidence is unavailable', async () => {
    const quote = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(90n);
    const assess = createRobinhoodSafetyAssessment({
      quote,
      liquidityLookup: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null),
      readOwner: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null),
      minimumLiquidityUsd: 50_000
    });

    const assessment = await assess({
      order: {
        clientOrderId: 'signal-rh-2',
        token: pending.token,
        direction: 'buy',
        amountInBaseUnits: 100n,

      },
      route: { status: 'route', fee: 3000, amountOut: 100n },
      tokenIn: pending.baseAsset,
      tokenOut: pending.token
    });

    expect(quote).toHaveBeenCalledWith(pending.token, pending.baseAsset, 100n, 3000);
    expect(evaluateRobinhoodSafety(assessment)).toContain('liquidity did not pass reliably');
  });
});

describe('Robinhood asset-provenance and transfer-tax checks', () => {
  const context = {
    order: {
      clientOrderId: 'signal-rh-checks',
      token: pending.token,
      direction: 'buy' as const,
      amountInBaseUnits: 100n,
      slippageBps: 300
    },
    route: { status: 'route' as const, fee: 3000, amountOut: 100n },
    tokenIn: pending.baseAsset,
    tokenOut: pending.token
  };

  function assessWith(options: Record<string, unknown>) {
    return createRobinhoodSafetyAssessment({
      quote: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(90n),
      liquidityLookup: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(1_000_000),
      minimumLiquidityUsd: 50_000,
      ...options
    })(context);
  }

  function check(assessment: Awaited<ReturnType<ReturnType<typeof createRobinhoodSafetyAssessment>>>, name: string) {
    return assessment.checks.find((candidate) => candidate.name === name);
  }

  it('declares provenance checks unreliable when no provider is configured', async () => {
    // The honest default. Guessing either way on unverified source or unknown
    // holder distribution would be worse than saying the evidence is absent.
    const assessment = await assessWith({});

    expect(check(assessment, 'source_verification')).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', reliable: false });
    expect(check(assessment, 'holder_concentration')).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', reliable: false });
    expect(check(assessment, 'fee_on_transfer')).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', reliable: false });
    // Unreliable is not failing: only sell_simulation and liquidity are required.
    expect(evaluateRobinhoodSafety(assessment)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rejects an unverified contract once a provider is wired', async () => {
    const assessment = await assessWith({ verifySource: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(false) });

    expect(check(assessment, 'source_verification')).toMatchObject({ status: 'fail', reliable: true });
    expect(evaluateRobinhoodSafety(assessment)).toContain('source_verification: contract source is unverified');
  });

  it('passes a verified contract', async () => {
    const assessment = await assessWith({ verifySource: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true) });

    expect(check(assessment, 'source_verification')).toMatchObject({ status: 'pass', reliable: true });
    expect(evaluateRobinhoodSafety(assessment)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rejects supply concentrated in one holder and accepts a spread book', async () => {
    const concentrated = await assessWith({ readHolderConcentration: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(0.81) });
    expect(check(concentrated, 'holder_concentration')).toMatchObject({ status: 'fail', reliable: true });
    expect(evaluateRobinhoodSafety(concentrated)[0]).toContain('81.00% of supply');

    const spread = await assessWith({ readHolderConcentration: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(0.12) });
    expect(check(spread, 'holder_concentration')).toMatchObject({ status: 'pass', reliable: true });
  });

  it('treats an out-of-range or failing provider as no evidence, not as a pass', async () => {
    const nonsense = await assessWith({ readHolderConcentration: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(4.2) });
    expect(check(nonsense, 'holder_concentration')).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', reliable: false });

    const broken = await assessWith({
      verifySource: vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('explorer 502'))
    });
    expect(check(broken, 'source_verification')).toMatchObject({ status: 'unknown', reliable: false });
    expect(check(broken, 'source_verification')?.evidence).toBe('explorer 502');
  });

  it('refuses any transfer tax by default', async () => {
    // Uniswap V3 credits the pool less than it was sent for a taxed token, so
    // there is no safe amount of tax ‚Äî the default tolerance is zero.
    const taxed = await assessWith({ probeFeeOnTransfer: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(50) });

    expect(check(taxed, 'fee_on_transfer')).toMatchObject({ status: 'fail', reliable: true });
    expect(evaluateRobinhoodSafety(taxed)[0]).toContain('Uniswap V3 cannot route fee-on-transfer tokens');

    const untaxed = await assessWith({ probeFeeOnTransfer: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(0) });
    expect(check(untaxed, 'fee_on_transfer')).toMatchObject({ status: 'pass', reliable: true });
  });

  it('honours an explicit transfer-tax tolerance', async () => {
    const assessment = await assessWith({
      probeFeeOnTransfer: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(25),
      maxTransferFeeBps: 30
    });

    expect(check(assessment, 'fee_on_transfer')).toMatchObject({ status: 'pass', reliable: true });
  });

  it('probes the traded token on an EXIT, not the base asset (S3-11)', async () => {
    // The exit is where a transfer tax actually strands a position: V3's
    // exactInputSingle credits the pool less than it was sent, so a taxed token
    // that was somehow entered cannot be sold through this router at all.
    //
    // On a sell the route reverses ‚Äî tokenIn is the traded token and tokenOut is
    // the base asset. The probe must follow `order.token`, not `tokenIn`/
    // `tokenOut`, or a sell would probe the untaxed base asset, pass, and strand
    // the position on submission.
    const probeFeeOnTransfer = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(50);
    const sellContext = {
      order: {
        clientOrderId: 'signal-rh-exit',
        token: pending.token,
        direction: 'sell' as const,
        amountInBaseUnits: 100n,
        slippageBps: 300
      },
      route: { status: 'route' as const, fee: 3000, amountOut: 100n },
      // Reversed relative to a buy.
      tokenIn: pending.token,
      tokenOut: pending.baseAsset
    };

    const assessment = await createRobinhoodSafetyAssessment({
      quote: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(90n),
      liquidityLookup: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(1_000_000),
      minimumLiquidityUsd: 50_000,
      probeFeeOnTransfer
    })(sellContext);

    expect(probeFeeOnTransfer).toHaveBeenCalledWith(pending.token);
    expect(probeFeeOnTransfer).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(pending.baseAsset);
    expect(check(assessment, 'fee_on_transfer')).toMatchObject({ status: 'fail', reliable: true });
    expect(evaluateRobinhoodSafety(assessment)[0]).toContain(
      'Uniswap V3 cannot route fee-on-transfer tokens'
    );
  });

  it('lets an untaxed token exit cleanly', async () => {
    const sellContext = {
      order: {
        clientOrderId: 'signal-rh-exit-ok',
        token: pending.token,
        direction: 'sell' as const,
        amountInBaseUnits: 100n,
        slippageBps: 300
      },
      route: { status: 'route' as const, fee: 3000, amountOut: 100n },
      tokenIn: pending.token,
      tokenOut: pending.baseAsset
    };

    const assessment = await createRobinhoodSafetyAssessment({
      quote: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(90n),
      liquidityLookup: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(1_000_000),
      minimumLiquidityUsd: 50_000,
      probeFeeOnTransfer: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(0)
    })(sellContext);

    expect(check(assessment, 'fee_on_transfer')).toMatchObject({ status: 'pass', reliable: true });
    expect(evaluateRobinhoodSafety(assessment)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rejects a negative tolerance at construction', () => {
    expect(() => createRobinhoodSafetyAssessment({
      quote: vi.fn(),
      minimumLiquidityUsd: 50_000,
      maxTransferFeeBps: -1
    })).toThrow('non-negative integer');
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/robinhood-runtime.ts <==
import { fetchDexScreenerLiquidity } from '@swat/shared';
import type { Hex } from 'viem';
import {
  type RobinhoodPendingStore,
  type PendingRobinhoodSubmission,
  type RobinhoodFilledResult,
  type RobinhoodQuoteAdapter,
  type RobinhoodReconciliationResult,
  type RobinhoodSafetyAssessment,
  type RobinhoodOrder,
  type RobinhoodRouteResult
} from './robinhood.js';
import {
  decodeRuntimeValue,
  encodeRuntimeValue,
  type RedisHashClient
} from './runtime-codec.js';

const DEFAULT_STORE_KEY = 'swat:trade-executor:pending:robinhood:v1';

type StoredRobinhoodState =
  | { state: 'pending'; pending: PendingRobinhoodSubmission }
  | { state: 'resolved'; resolution: RobinhoodReconciliationResult };

type LegacyPendingRobinhoodSubmission = Omit<PendingRobinhoodSubmission, 'feeTier'> & {
  feeTier?: number | null;
};

type LegacyRobinhoodFilledResult = Omit<RobinhoodFilledResult, 'feeTier'> & {
  feeTier?: number | null;
};

type StoredRobinhoodWireState =
  | { state: 'pending'; pending: LegacyPendingRobinhoodSubmission }
  | {
      state: 'resolved';
      resolution:
        | LegacyRobinhoodFilledResult
        | Exclude<RobinhoodReconciliationResult, RobinhoodFilledResult>;
    };

function decodeStoredRobinhoodState(encoded: string): StoredRobinhoodState {
  const stored = decodeRuntimeValue<StoredRobinhoodWireState>(encoded);
  if (stored.state === 'pending') {
    return {
      state: 'pending',
      pending: {
        ...stored.pending,
        feeTier: stored.pending.feeTier ?? null
      }
    };
  }
  if (stored.resolution.status === 'filled') {
    return {
      state: 'resolved',
      resolution: {
        ...stored.resolution,
        feeTier: stored.resolution.feeTier ?? null
      }
    };
  }
  return { state: 'resolved', resolution: stored.resolution };
}

export function createRedisRobinhoodPendingStore(
  redis: RedisHashClient,
  key = DEFAULT_STORE_KEY
): RobinhoodPendingStore {
  async function read(clientOrderId: string): Promise<StoredRobinhoodState | null> {
    const encoded = await redis.hget(key, clientOrderId);
    return encoded ? decodeStoredRobinhoodState(encoded) : null;
  }

  return {
    async findUnresolved(clientOrderId) {
      const stored = await read(clientOrderId);
      return stored?.state === 'pending' ? stored.pending : null;
    },
    async findResolution(clientOrderId) {
      const stored = await read(clientOrderId);
      return stored?.state === 'resolved' ? stored.resolution : null;
    },
    async listUnresolved() {
      const values = await redis.hgetall(key);
      return Object.values(values).flatMap((encoded) => {
        const stored = decodeStoredRobinhoodState(encoded);
        return stored.state === 'pending' ? [stored.pending] : [];
      });
    },
    async save(record) {
      await redis.hset(key, record.clientOrderId, encodeRuntimeValue({
        state: 'pending',
        pending: record
      } satisfies StoredRobinhoodState));
    },
    async resolve(clientOrderId, resolution) {
      await redis.hset(key, clientOrderId, encodeRuntimeValue({
        state: 'resolved',
        resolution
      } satisfies StoredRobinhoodState));
    }
  };
}

type SafetyContext = {
  order: RobinhoodOrder;
  route: Extract<RobinhoodRouteResult, { status: 'route' }>;
  tokenIn: `0x${string}`;
  tokenOut: `0x${string}`;
};

export function createRobinhoodSafetyAssessment(options: {
  quote: RobinhoodQuoteAdapter;
  minimumLiquidityUsd: number;
  liquidityLookup?: (token: string) => Promise<number | null>;
  readOwner?: (token: `0x${string}`) => Promise<`0x${string}` | null>;
  /**
   * Reports whether the token's contract source is verified on a reviewed
   * Robinhood Chain explorer. Absent by default: there is no such provider
   * configured, and an unverified assumption either way would be worse than
   * declaring the check unreliable.
   */
  verifySource?: (token: `0x${string}`) => Promise<boolean | null>;
  /**
   * Returns the share of supply held by the largest non-pool holder, as a
   * fraction in [0,1]. Absent by default for the same reason.
   */
  readHolderConcentration?: (token: `0x${string}`) => Promise<number | null>;
  /**
   * Returns the token's transfer tax in basis points, or 0 for a plain ERC-20.
   * Uniswap V3 has no fee-on-transfer swap variant, so a taxed token cannot be
   * exited through this router at all and is refused rather than attempted.
   */
  probeFeeOnTransfer?: (token: `0x${string}`) => Promise<number | null>;
  /** Maximum tolerated transfer tax in bps. Defaults to 0 ‚Äî any tax is refused. */
  maxTransferFeeBps?: number;
}): (context: SafetyContext) => Promise<RobinhoodSafetyAssessment> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(options.minimumLiquidityUsd) || options.minimumLiquidityUsd <= 0) {
    throw new Error('Robinhood minimum liquidity must be positive');
  }
  const liquidityLookup = options.liquidityLookup
    ?? ((token: string) => fetchDexScreenerLiquidity(token, 'robinhood-chain'));
  const maximumTransferFeeBps = options.maxTransferFeeBps ?? 0;
  if (!Number.isInteger(maximumTransferFeeBps) || maximumTransferFeeBps < 0) {
    throw new Error('Robinhood maximum transfer fee must be a non-negative integer');
  }
  // A single holder above this share can move the price against any exit.
  const maximumHolderShare = 0.5;

  return async (context) => {
    let sellSimulation: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment['checks'][number];
    try {
      const reverseAmount = context.order.direction === 'sell'
        ? context.route.amountOut
        : await options.quote(
            context.tokenOut,
            context.tokenIn,
            context.route.amountOut,
            context.route.fee
          );
      sellSimulation = reverseAmount > 0n
        ? {
            name: 'sell_simulation',
            status: 'pass',
            reliable: true,
            evidence: context.order.direction === 'sell'
              ? `sell route returned ${reverseAmount.toString()} base units`
              : `reverse route returned ${reverseAmount.toString()} base units`
          }
        : {
            name: 'sell_simulation',
            status: 'fail',
            reliable: true,
            evidence: 'reverse route returned zero output'
          };
    } catch (error) {
      sellSimulation = {
        name: 'sell_simulation',
        status: 'unknown',
        reliable: false,
        evidence: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'reverse route lookup failed'
      };
    }

    const liquidityUsd = await liquidityLookup(context.order.token).catch(() => null);
    const liquidity = liquidityUsd === null
      ? {
          name: 'liquidity' as const,
          status: 'unknown' as const,
          reliable: false,
          evidence: 'liquidity provider returned no chain-matched evidence'
        }
      : liquidityUsd >= options.minimumLiquidityUsd
        ? {
            name: 'liquidity' as const,
            status: 'pass' as const,
            reliable: true,
            evidence: `$${liquidityUsd.toFixed(2)} >= $${options.minimumLiquidityUsd.toFixed(2)}`
          }
        : {
            name: 'liquidity' as const,
            status: 'fail' as const,
            reliable: true,
            evidence: `$${liquidityUsd.toFixed(2)} < $${options.minimumLiquidityUsd.toFixed(2)}`
          };

    let ownership: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment['checks'][number] = {
      name: 'ownership_admin',
      status: 'unknown',
      reliable: false,
      evidence: 'owner() evidence is unavailable for this contract'
    };
    if (options.readOwner) {
      try {
        const owner = await options.readOwner(context.order.token);
        if (owner) {
          const renounced = /^0x0{40}$/i.test(owner);
          ownership = {
            name: 'ownership_admin',
            status: renounced ? 'pass' : 'fail',
            reliable: true,
            evidence: renounced ? 'owner() is the zero address' : `owner() is ${owner}`
          };
        }
      } catch (error) {
        ownership = {
          name: 'ownership_admin',
          status: 'unknown',
          reliable: false,
          evidence: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'owner() lookup failed'
        };
      }
    }

    let sourceVerification: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment['checks'][number] = {
      name: 'source_verification',
      status: 'unknown',
      reliable: false,
      evidence: 'no reviewed Robinhood explorer source-verification provider is configured'
    };
    if (options.verifySource) {
      try {
        const verified = await options.verifySource(context.order.token);
        if (verified !== null) {
          sourceVerification = {
            name: 'source_verification',
            status: verified ? 'pass' : 'fail',
            reliable: true,
            evidence: verified ? 'contract source is verified' : 'contract source is unverified'
          };
        }
      } catch (error) {
        sourceVerification = {
          name: 'source_verification',
          status: 'unknown',
          reliable: false,
          evidence: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'source verification lookup failed'
        };
      }
    }

    let holderConcentration: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment['checks'][number] = {
      name: 'holder_concentration',
      status: 'unknown',
      reliable: false,
      evidence: 'no reviewed Robinhood holder-distribution provider is configured'
    };
    if (options.readHolderConcentration) {
      try {
        const topShare = await options.readHolderConcentration(context.order.token);
        if (topShare !== null) {
          if (!Number.isFinite(topShare) || topShare < 0 || topShare > 1) {
            holderConcentration = {
              name: 'holder_concentration',
              status: 'unknown',
              reliable: false,
              evidence: `holder concentration provider returned an out-of-range share: ${topShare}`
            };
          } else {
            const concentrated = topShare > maximumHolderShare;
            holderConcentration = {
              name: 'holder_concentration',
              status: concentrated ? 'fail' : 'pass',
              reliable: true,
              evidence: `largest non-pool holder controls ${(topShare * 100).toFixed(2)}% of supply`
            };
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        holderConcentration = {
          name: 'holder_concentration',
          status: 'unknown',
          reliable: false,
          evidence: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'holder distribution lookup failed'
        };
      }
    }

    let feeOnTransfer: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment['checks'][number] = {
      name: 'fee_on_transfer',
      status: 'unknown',
      reliable: false,
      evidence: 'no transfer-tax probe is configured'
    };
    if (options.probeFeeOnTransfer) {
      try {
        const feeBps = await options.probeFeeOnTransfer(context.order.token);
        if (feeBps !== null) {
          if (!Number.isFinite(feeBps) || feeBps < 0) {
            feeOnTransfer = {
              name: 'fee_on_transfer',
              status: 'unknown',
              reliable: false,
              evidence: `transfer-tax probe returned an invalid rate: ${feeBps}`
            };
          } else {
            const taxed = feeBps > maximumTransferFeeBps;
            feeOnTransfer = {
              name: 'fee_on_transfer',
              status: taxed ? 'fail' : 'pass',
              reliable: true,
              // V3's exactInputSingle credits the pool less than it was sent,
              // so a taxed token cannot be exited through this router at all.
              evidence: taxed
                ? `token charges ${feeBps} bps on transfer; Uniswap V3 cannot route fee-on-transfer tokens`
                : 'token transfers untaxed'
            };
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        feeOnTransfer = {
          name: 'fee_on_transfer',
          status: 'unknown',
          reliable: false,
          evidence: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'transfer-tax probe failed'
        };
      }
    }

    return {
      checks: [
        sellSimulation,
        liquidity,
        ownership,
        sourceVerification,
        holderConcentration,
        feeOnTransfer
      ]
    };
  };
}

export type RobinhoodTerminalPersistence = {
  clientOrderId: string;
  transactionHash?: Hex;
  status: 'filled' | 'failed';
  reason?: string;
};

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

vi.mock('@swat/db', () => ({ resolveChainMode: vi.fn() }));

import {
  getLastRobinhoodOpsAlert,
  verifyRobinhoodEnvironment
} from './robinhood-startup.js';

const values = {
  ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_ID: '4663',
  ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL: 'http://rpc.invalid',
  ROBINHOOD_SWAP_ROUTER: '0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111',
  ROBINHOOD_QUOTER: '0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222',
  ROBINHOOD_WETH9: '0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333',
  ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET: '0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333',
  ROBINHOOD_SANITY_TOKEN: '0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444',
  ROBINHOOD_FEE_TIERS: '3000',
  ROBINHOOD_ROUTER_ABI_VERSION: 'uniswap-v3-swap-router-01',
  ROBINHOOD_QUOTER_ABI_VERSION: 'uniswap-v3-quoter-v2',
  ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET_MODE: 'native-weth'
};

/**
 * Builds a client stub whose `getBytecode` returns empty for the named contracts.
 *
 * The default is a non-empty result for everything, so a test names only the
 * address it wants to be missing -- otherwise every one of these tests would
 * have to enumerate five contracts to say something about one.
 */
function clientWithEmptyCodeAt(missing: readonly string[]) {
  const empty = new Set(missing.map((address) => address.toLowerCase()));
  return {
    getChainId: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(4663),
    getBytecode: vi.fn(async ({ address }: { address: string }) =>
      empty.has(address.toLowerCase()) ? '0x' : '0x60806040'),
    simulateContract: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ result: [1n] })
  } as never;
}

const liveMode = () => vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
  requestedMode: 'live' as const,
  effectiveMode: 'live' as const,
  certified: true
});

/**
 * The configured-address bytecode gate (S4-M39).
 *
 * This gate already existed and had **no test**, which is how a documented
 * Ethereum-mainnet quoter address survived in `.env.example` for chain 4663: the
 * check that would have caught it was never proven to run. An untested guard on
 * a funds path is indistinguishable from an absent one, so each configured
 * contract gets its own case -- a loop that silently skipped an entry would
 * otherwise pass.
 */
describe('Robinhood configured-address bytecode gate (S4-M39)', () => {
  it.each([
    ['router', values.ROBINHOOD_SWAP_ROUTER],
    ['quoter', values.ROBINHOOD_QUOTER],
    ['WETH9', values.ROBINHOOD_WETH9],
    ['sanity token', values.ROBINHOOD_SANITY_TOKEN]
  ])('refuses live when the configured %s has no deployed bytecode', async (label, address) => {
    const result = await verifyRobinhoodEnvironment({
      values,
      resolveMode: liveMode(),
      client: clientWithEmptyCodeAt([address]),
      emitOpsAlert: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    });

    expect(result.ready).toBe(false);
    // The label is in the message on purpose: "no deployed bytecode" alone sends
    // an operator to check five addresses instead of one.
    expect(result.reason).toContain(label);
    expect(result.reason).toContain('no deployed bytecode');
  });

  it('alerts rather than failing quietly, because a refused boot is an ops event', async () => {
    const emitOpsAlert = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    await verifyRobinhoodEnvironment({
      values,
      resolveMode: liveMode(),
      client: clientWithEmptyCodeAt([values.ROBINHOOD_QUOTER]),
      emitOpsAlert
    });
    expect(emitOpsAlert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      type: 'ROBINHOOD_LIVE_NOT_READY',
      severity: 'critical'
    }));
  });

  it('refuses live when the RPC chain id does not match the configured one', async () => {
    // A wrong-chain RPC is the other half of the same defect class: the addresses
    // may all have code, just not on the chain we think we are trading on.
    const client = clientWithEmptyCodeAt([]) as unknown as { getChainId: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn> };
    client.getChainId = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(1);
    const result = await verifyRobinhoodEnvironment({
      values,
      resolveMode: liveMode(),
      client: client as never,
      emitOpsAlert: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    });
    expect(result.ready).toBe(false);
    expect(result.reason).toContain('does not match RPC chain ID');
  });

  it('passes the gate when every configured address has code', async () => {
    // The complement, so the four refusals above are not passing for an
    // unrelated reason.
    const result = await verifyRobinhoodEnvironment({
      values,
      resolveMode: liveMode(),
      client: clientWithEmptyCodeAt([]),
      emitOpsAlert: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
    });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ ready: true, reason: 'onchain_environment_verified_for_process' });
  });
});

describe('Robinhood startup runtime readiness', () => {
  it('clamps live readiness and emits the ops alert when durable runtime setup fails', async () => {
    const emitOpsAlert = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    const result = await verifyRobinhoodEnvironment({
      values,
      resolveMode: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
        requestedMode: 'live',
        effectiveMode: 'live',
        certified: true
      }),
      runtimeCheck: () => {

      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      severity: 'critical'
    }));
    expect(getLastRobinhoodOpsAlert()).toMatchObject({
      type: 'ROBINHOOD_LIVE_NOT_READY',
      reason: 'durable pending store unavailable'
    });

    await verifyRobinhoodEnvironment({
      resolveMode: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
        requestedMode: 'paper',
        effectiveMode: 'paper',
        certified: false
      })
    });

==> apps/trade-executor/src/robinhood-startup.ts <==
import { resolveChainMode } from '@swat/db';
import type { PublicClient } from 'viem';
import {
  discoverRobinhoodRoute,
  getRobinhoodLiveReadiness,
  parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig,
  QUOTER_ABI,
  robinhoodPublicClient,
  setRobinhoodLiveReadiness,
  type RobinhoodExecutionConfig,
  type RobinhoodReadiness
} from './robinhood.js';

export type RobinhoodOpsAlert = {
  type: 'ROBINHOOD_LIVE_NOT_READY';
  chain: 'robinhood-chain';
  severity: 'critical';
  reason: string;
  checkedAt: string;
  requestedMode: 'live' | 'live+shadow';
};

export type RobinhoodOpsAlertEmitter = (alert: RobinhoodOpsAlert) => Promise<void>;

let opsAlertEmitter: RobinhoodOpsAlertEmitter | null = null;
let lastOpsAlert: RobinhoodOpsAlert | null = null;

export function configureRobinhoodOpsAlertEmitter(emitter: RobinhoodOpsAlertEmitter): void {
  opsAlertEmitter = emitter;
}

export function getLastRobinhoodOpsAlert(): RobinhoodOpsAlert | null {
  return lastOpsAlert ? { ...lastOpsAlert } : null;
}

async function quoteSanityRoute(client: PublicClient, config: RobinhoodExecutionConfig) {
  return discoverRobinhoodRoute({
    config,
    tokenIn: config.baseAsset,
    tokenOut: config.sanityToken,
    amountIn: 100_000_000_000_000n,
    quote: async (tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, fee) => {
      const { result } = await client.simulateContract({
        address: config.quoter,
        abi: QUOTER_ABI,
        functionName: 'quoteExactInputSingle',
        args: [{ tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, fee, sqrtPriceLimitX96: 0n }]
      });
      return result[0];
    }
  });
}

export async function verifyRobinhoodEnvironment(options: {
  client?: PublicClient;
  resolveMode?: typeof resolveChainMode;
  emitOpsAlert?: RobinhoodOpsAlertEmitter;
  runtimeCheck?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  values?: Record<string, string | undefined>;
} = {}): Promise<RobinhoodReadiness> {
  const resolveMode = options.resolveMode ?? resolveChainMode;
  const mode = await resolveMode('robinhood-chain');
  if (mode.requestedMode !== 'live' && mode.requestedMode !== 'live+shadow') {
    lastOpsAlert = null;
    const state: RobinhoodReadiness = {
      ready: false,
      reason: 'live_execution_not_requested',
      checkedAt: new Date()
    };
    setRobinhoodLiveReadiness(state);
    return getRobinhoodLiveReadiness();
  }

  const checkedAt = new Date();
  try {
    const config = parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(options.values);
    await options.runtimeCheck?.();
    const client = options.client ?? robinhoodPublicClient;
    const actualChainId = await client.getChainId();
    if (actualChainId !== config.chainId) {
      throw new Error(`configured chain ID ${config.chainId} does not match RPC chain ID ${actualChainId}`);
    }

    const contracts = new Map<string, `0x${string}`>([
      ['router', config.router],
      ['quoter', config.quoter],
      ['WETH9', config.weth9],
      ['base asset', config.baseAsset],
      ['sanity token', config.sanityToken]
    ]);
    for (const [label, contract] of contracts) {
      const code = await client.getBytecode({ address: contract });
      if (!code || code === '0x') throw new Error(`no deployed bytecode at configured ${label}`);
    }

    const sanity = await quoteSanityRoute(client, config);
    if (sanity.status !== 'route') {
      throw new Error(`known-liquid sanity quote failed across configured tiers: ${sanity.failures.join('; ')}`);
    }

    const tuple = {
      chainId: config.chainId,
      router: config.router,
      quoter: config.quoter,
      weth9: config.weth9,
      baseAsset: config.baseAsset,
      sanityToken: config.sanityToken,
      feeTiers: [...config.feeTiers],
      routerAbiVersion: config.routerAbiVersion,
      quoterAbiVersion: config.quoterAbiVersion
    };
    const state: RobinhoodReadiness = {
      ready: true,
      reason: 'onchain_environment_verified_for_process',
      checkedAt,
      tuple
    };
    setRobinhoodLiveReadiness(state);
    lastOpsAlert = null;
    console.log('[trade-executor] Robinhood on-chain tuple verified', tuple);
    return getRobinhoodLiveReadiness();
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown Robinhood startup verification failure';
    const state: RobinhoodReadiness = { ready: false, reason, checkedAt };
    setRobinhoodLiveReadiness(state);
    const alert: RobinhoodOpsAlert = {
      type: 'ROBINHOOD_LIVE_NOT_READY',
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      severity: 'critical',
      reason,
      checkedAt: checkedAt.toISOString(),
      requestedMode: mode.requestedMode
    };
    lastOpsAlert = alert;
    const emit = options.emitOpsAlert ?? opsAlertEmitter;
    if (emit) {
      try {
        await emit(alert);
      } catch (alertError) {
        console.error('[trade-executor] Robinhood readiness ops alert delivery failed', alertError);
      }
    }
    console.error('[trade-executor] Robinhood live readiness clamped', { reason, checkedAt: alert.checkedAt });
    return getRobinhoodLiveReadiness();
  }
}

const transferEvent = parseAbiItem(
  'event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)'
);

function transferLog(
  address: Address,
  from: Address,
  to: Address,
  amount: bigint,
  logIndex: number
) {
  return {
    address,
    topics: encodeEventTopics({ abi: [transferEvent], eventName: 'Transfer', args: { from, to } }),
    data: encodeAbiParameters([{ type: 'uint256' }], [amount]),
    logIndex,
    transactionHash: hash,
    blockHash: hash,
    blockNumber: 1n,
    transactionIndex: 0,
    removed: false
  };
}

function receipt(logs: ReturnType<typeof transferLog>[], status: 'success' | 'reverted' = 'success') {
  return {
    status,
    logs,
    gasUsed: 50_000n,
    blockNumber: 1n,
    transactionHash: hash
  } as unknown as TransactionReceipt;
}

const passingSafety: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment = {
  checks: [
    { name: 'sell_simulation', status: 'pass', reliable: true, evidence: 'reverse route quoted' },
    { name: 'liquidity', status: 'pass', reliable: true, evidence: 'configured route quoted' },
    { name: 'ownership_admin', status: 'unknown', reliable: false, evidence: 'provider not configured' },
    { name: 'source_verification', status: 'unknown', reliable: false, evidence: 'provider not configured' },
    { name: 'holder_concentration', status: 'unknown', reliable: false, evidence: 'provider not configured' }
  ]
};

function fakeAdapter(overrides: Partial<RobinhoodExecutionAdapter> = {}): RobinhoodExecutionAdapter {

async function executeBuy(options: {
  config?: RobinhoodExecutionConfig;
  adapter?: RobinhoodExecutionAdapter;
  pendingStore?: RobinhoodPendingStore;
  clientOrderId?: string;
} = {}) {
  return executeRobinhoodOrder({
      nonceLock: passThroughNonceLock,
    order: {
      clientOrderId: options.clientOrderId ?? 'signal-buy-1',
      token,
      direction: 'buy',
      amountInBaseUnits: 100_000_000_000_000_000n,
      slippageBps: 300
    },
    config: options.config ?? parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(configValues()),
    account,
    adapter: options.adapter ?? fakeAdapter(),
    pendingStore: options.pendingStore ?? createMemoryRobinhoodPendingStore(),
    safetyAssessment: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(passingSafety),
    requireReadiness: false
  });
}

/**
 * Adapter for a leg that spends an ERC-20 and therefore sends two transactions:
 * the exact approval, then the swap. The native-weth buy leg sends only the
 * swap, which is what `fakeAdapter` already models.
 */
function matrixAdapter(params: {
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell';
  baseAssetMode: 'native-weth' | 'erc20';
  /** Base units actually spent, which the receipt's outbound leg must match. */
  spent?: bigint;
  overrides?: Partial<RobinhoodExecutionAdapter>;
}): RobinhoodExecutionAdapter {
  const baseAsset = params.baseAssetMode === 'erc20' ? baseErc20 : weth;
  const spent = params.spent ?? (params.direction === 'sell' ? 10_000n : 100_000_000_000_000_000n);
  // The receipt is verified on both legs: what left the account and what
  // arrived. A native-weth buy spends native value, so it has no outbound
  // ERC-20 transfer to show.
  const logs = params.direction === 'buy'
    ? [
        ...(params.baseAssetMode === 'erc20'
          ? [transferLog(baseAsset, account, router, spent, 0)]
          : []),
        transferLog(token, router, account, 4_900n, 1)
      ]
    : [
        transferLog(token, account, router, spent, 0),
        transferLog(baseAsset, router, account, 4_900n, 1)
      ];
  const swapReceipt = receipt(logs);
  const needsApproval = params.direction === 'sell' || params.baseAssetMode === 'erc20';
  if (!needsApproval) {
    return fakeAdapter({ waitForReceipt: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(swapReceipt), ...params.overrides });
  }
  return fakeAdapter({
    send: vi.fn().mockResolvedValueOnce(approvalHash).mockResolvedValueOnce(hash),
    waitForReceipt: vi.fn()
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(receipt([]))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(swapReceipt),
    ...params.overrides
  });
}

async function executeOrder(options: {
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell';
  baseAssetMode?: 'native-weth' | 'erc20';
  adapter?: RobinhoodExecutionAdapter;
  safety?: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment;
  proportionBps?: number;
  clientOrderId?: string;
}) {
  const baseAssetMode = options.baseAssetMode ?? 'native-weth';
  const values = configValues(
    baseAssetMode === 'erc20'
      ? { ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET_MODE: 'erc20', ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET: baseErc20 }
      : {}
  );
  return executeRobinhoodOrder({
      nonceLock: passThroughNonceLock,
    order: {
      clientOrderId: options.clientOrderId ?? `signal-${options.direction}-matrix`,
      token,
      direction: options.direction,
      ...(options.direction === 'buy'
        ? { amountInBaseUnits: 100_000_000_000_000_000n }
        : { proportionBps: options.proportionBps ?? 10_000 }),
      slippageBps: 300
    },
    config: parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(values),
    account,
    adapter: options.adapter ?? matrixAdapter({ direction: options.direction, baseAssetMode }),
    pendingStore: createMemoryRobinhoodPendingStore(),
    safetyAssessment: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(options.safety ?? passingSafety),
    requireReadiness: false
  });
}

/**
 * Pass-through nonce lock for cases that are not about serialisation (S4-M12).
 * `executeRobinhoodOrder` requires the dependency rather than defaulting it,
 * because a silently-absent lock is the bug the item exists to close ‚Äî so every
 * call site has to state which behaviour it wants.
 */
const passThroughNonceLock = async <T,>(_account: string, run: () => Promise<T>) =>
  ({ acquired: true as const, result: await run() });

describe('Robinhood entry and exit matrix', () => {
  // Both base-asset modes crossed with both directions. Previously only the
  // native-weth buy leg was exercised, so the erc20 legs and every sell leg
  // were untested paths in live code.
  it.each([
    ['native-weth', 'buy'],
    ['native-weth', 'sell'],
    ['erc20', 'buy'],
    ['erc20', 'sell']
  ] as const)('fills a %s %s through the router', async (baseAssetMode, direction) => {
    const adapter = matrixAdapter({ direction, baseAssetMode });

    const result = await executeOrder({ direction, baseAssetMode, adapter });

    expect(result.status).toBe('filled');
    expect(adapter.send).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it.each([
    ['native-weth', 'buy', false],
    ['native-weth', 'sell', true],
    ['erc20', 'buy', true],
    ['erc20', 'sell', true]
  ] as const)('%s %s approves the router only when spending an ERC-20', async (
    baseAssetMode,
    direction,
    expectsApproval
  ) => {
    // A native-weth buy spends native value, so there is nothing to approve.
    // Every other leg spends a token and must set an exact allowance first.
    const adapter = matrixAdapter({ direction, baseAssetMode });

    await executeOrder({ direction, baseAssetMode, adapter });

    expect(adapter.getAllowance).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(expectsApproval ? 1 : 0);
  });

  it('caps an exit to the actual token balance, not the requested proportion', async () => {
    const adapter = matrixAdapter({
      direction: 'sell',
      baseAssetMode: 'native-weth',
      // 50% of a real 4,000 balance.
      spent: 2_000n,
      overrides: { getTokenBalance: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(4_000n) }
    });

    const result = await executeOrder({ direction: 'sell', proportionBps: 5_000, adapter });

    expect(result.status).toBe('filled');
    // 50% of the real 4,000 balance ‚Äî never the stale figure a caller supplied.
    expect(adapter.getAllowance).toHaveBeenCalledWith(token, account, router);
    const approvalCall = vi.mocked(adapter.simulate).mock.calls[0]![0];
    expect(approvalCall.data).toContain('7d0');
  });

  it('refuses an exit with nothing to sell rather than submitting an empty swap', async () => {
    const adapter = matrixAdapter({
      direction: 'sell',
      baseAssetMode: 'native-weth',
      overrides: { getTokenBalance: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(0n) }
    });

    const result = await executeOrder({ direction: 'sell', adapter });

    expect(result.status).toBe('skipped');
    expect(adapter.send).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe('Robinhood fee-on-transfer exits', () => {
  const taxedSafety: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment = {
    checks: [
      ...passingSafety.checks,
      {
        name: 'fee_on_transfer',
        status: 'fail',
        reliable: true,
        evidence: 'token charges 500 bps on transfer; Uniswap V3 cannot route fee-on-transfer tokens'
      }
    ]
  };

  it('refuses to exit a taxed token instead of attempting an unroutable swap', async () => {
    // Uniswap V3 has no fee-on-transfer swap variant: the pool is credited less
    // than it was sent, so the swap cannot settle. Refusing is the handling.
    const adapter = fakeAdapter();

    const result = await executeOrder({ direction: 'sell', adapter, safety: taxedSafety });

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ status: 'skipped', state: 'safety_rejected' });
    expect(result).toHaveProperty('reason', expect.stringContaining('fee_on_transfer'));
    expect(adapter.send).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('refuses a taxed entry on the same evidence', async () => {
    const adapter = fakeAdapter();

    const result = await executeOrder({ direction: 'buy', adapter, safety: taxedSafety });

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ status: 'skipped', state: 'safety_rejected' });
    expect(adapter.send).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('does not block on an unavailable transfer-tax probe', async () => {
    // An unreliable check is not a failing one; only reliable failures reject.
    const adapter = matrixAdapter({ direction: 'sell', baseAssetMode: 'native-weth' });
    const unknownProbe: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment = {
      checks: [
        ...passingSafety.checks,
        { name: 'fee_on_transfer', status: 'unknown', reliable: false, evidence: 'no probe configured' }
      ]
    };

    const result = await executeOrder({ direction: 'sell', adapter, safety: unknownProbe });

    expect(result.status).toBe('filled');
  });

  it('skips a taxed exit whose swap simulation reverts, without submitting', async () => {
    const adapter = matrixAdapter({
      direction: 'sell',
      baseAssetMode: 'native-weth',
      overrides: {
        simulate: vi.fn()
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined)
          .mockRejectedValue(new Error('execution reverted: STF'))
      }
    });

    const result = await executeOrder({ direction: 'sell', adapter });

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ status: 'skipped', state: 'simulation_revert' });
    // The approval goes out ‚Äî it simulated fine ‚Äî but the swap never does.
    expect(adapter.send).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

describe('Robinhood strict deployment configuration', () => {
  it('requires every deployment fact and rejects self sanity quotes', () => {
    expect(() => parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(configValues({ ROBINHOOD_SWAP_ROUTER: undefined })))
      .toThrow('ROBINHOOD_SWAP_ROUTER is required');
    expect(() => parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(configValues({ ROBINHOOD_SANITY_TOKEN: weth })))
      .toThrow('router, quoter, WETH9, and sanity token must be distinct');
    expect(() => parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(configValues({ ROBINHOOD_ROUTER_ABI_VERSION: 'guessed' })))
      .toThrow('ROBINHOOD_ROUTER_ABI_VERSION is unsupported');
  });

  it('quotes every configured tier and selects the best output', async () => {
    const quote = vi.fn()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('pool missing'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(8n)
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(10n);
    await expect(discoverRobinhoodRoute({
      config: parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(configValues()),
      tokenIn: weth,
      tokenOut: token,
      amountIn: 1n,
      quote
    })).resolves.toEqual({ status: 'route', fee: 500, amountOut: 10n });
    expect(quote).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });

  it('distinguishes no route from RPC failure', async () => {
    const config = parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(configValues());
    const noRoute = await discoverRobinhoodRoute({
      config,
      tokenIn: weth,
      tokenOut: token,
      amountIn: 1n,
      quote: async () => { throw new Error('pool reverted'); }
    });
    expect(noRoute.status).toBe('no_route');
    const rpcFailure = await discoverRobinhoodRoute({
      config,
      tokenIn: weth,
      tokenOut: token,
      amountIn: 1n,
      quote: async () => { throw new RobinhoodRpcFailure('RPC offline'); }
    });
    expect(rpcFailure.status).toBe('rpc_failure');
  });
});

    })).toEqual({ actualAmountIn: 2_000n, actualAmountOut: 900n });

describe('Robinhood execution state machine', () => {
  beforeEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());

  it('bounds minOut, preserves gas reserve, simulates the exact calldata, and returns receipt amounts', async () => {
    const adapter = fakeAdapter();
    const result = await executeBuy({ adapter });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({
      status: 'filled',

function required(values: Record<string, string | undefined>, key: string): string {
  const value = values[key]?.trim();
  if (!value) throw new Error(`${key} is required`);
  return value;
}

function address(values: Record<string, string | undefined>, key: string): `0x${string}` {
  const value = required(values, key);
  try {
    return getAddress(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${key} must be a valid EVM address`);
  }
}

function positiveInteger(value: string, key: string): number {
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(value)) throw new Error(`${key} must be a positive integer`);
  const parsed = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) || parsed <= 0) throw new Error(`${key} must be a positive integer`);
  return parsed;
}

function positiveBigInt(value: string, key: string): bigint {
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(value)) throw new Error(`${key} must be a positive integer`);
  const parsed = BigInt(value);
  if (parsed <= 0n) throw new Error(`${key} must be a positive integer`);
  return parsed;
}

export function parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig(
  values: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env
): RobinhoodExecutionConfig {
  const chainId = positiveInteger(required(values, 'ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_ID'), 'ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_ID');
  const router = address(values, 'ROBINHOOD_SWAP_ROUTER');
  const quoter = address(values, 'ROBINHOOD_QUOTER');
  const weth9 = address(values, 'ROBINHOOD_WETH9');
  const baseAsset = address(values, 'ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET');
  const sanityToken = address(values, 'ROBINHOOD_SANITY_TOKEN');
  const uniqueContracts = new Set([router.toLowerCase(), quoter.toLowerCase(), weth9.toLowerCase(), sanityToken.toLowerCase()]);
  if (uniqueContracts.size !== 4) {
    throw new Error('Robinhood router, quoter, WETH9, and sanity token must be distinct');
  }
  if (sanityToken.toLowerCase() === baseAsset.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_SANITY_TOKEN must be distinct from ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET');
  }

  const feeTiers = required(values, 'ROBINHOOD_FEE_TIERS').split(',').map((part) =>
    positiveInteger(part.trim(), 'ROBINHOOD_FEE_TIERS')
  );
  if (new Set(feeTiers).size !== feeTiers.length || feeTiers.some((fee) => fee >= 1_000_000)) {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_FEE_TIERS must contain unique values below 1000000');
  }

  const routerAbiVersion = required(values, 'ROBINHOOD_ROUTER_ABI_VERSION');
  if (routerAbiVersion !== 'uniswap-v3-swap-router-01' && routerAbiVersion !== 'uniswap-v3-swap-router-02') {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_ROUTER_ABI_VERSION is unsupported');
  }
  const quoterAbiVersion = required(values, 'ROBINHOOD_QUOTER_ABI_VERSION');
  if (quoterAbiVersion !== 'uniswap-v3-quoter-v2') {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_QUOTER_ABI_VERSION is unsupported');
  }
  const baseAssetMode = required(values, 'ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET_MODE');
  if (baseAssetMode !== 'native-weth' && baseAssetMode !== 'erc20') {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET_MODE must be native-weth or erc20');
  }
  if (baseAssetMode === 'native-weth' && baseAsset.toLowerCase() !== weth9.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error('native-weth mode requires ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET to equal ROBINHOOD_WETH9');
  }

  const gasReserve = values.ROBINHOOD_GAS_RESERVE_ETH ?? '0.005';
  let gasReserveWei: bigint;
  try {
    gasReserveWei = parseEther(gasReserve);
  } catch {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_GAS_RESERVE_ETH must be a non-negative decimal ETH amount');
  }
  if (gasReserveWei < 0n) throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_GAS_RESERVE_ETH must be non-negative');

  const maxFeeGwei = values.ROBINHOOD_MAX_FEE_PER_GAS_GWEI ?? '10';
  let maxFeePerGasWei: bigint;
  try {
    maxFeePerGasWei = parseGwei(maxFeeGwei);
  } catch {
    throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_MAX_FEE_PER_GAS_GWEI must be a positive decimal gwei amount');
  }
  if (maxFeePerGasWei <= 0n) throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_MAX_FEE_PER_GAS_GWEI must be positive');

  const receiptTimeoutMs = positiveInteger(
    values.ROBINHOOD_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT_MS ?? '60000',
    'ROBINHOOD_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT_MS'
  );
  if (receiptTimeoutMs > 120_000) throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_RECEIPT_TIMEOUT_MS cannot exceed 120000');
  const maxSlippageBps = positiveInteger(
    values.ROBINHOOD_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS ?? '500',
    'ROBINHOOD_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS'
  );
  if (maxSlippageBps > 1_000) throw new Error('ROBINHOOD_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS cannot exceed 1000');

  return {
    chainId,
    rpcUrl: values.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL ?? getActiveRpcUrl('robinhood', values),
    router,
    quoter,
    weth9,
    baseAsset,
    sanityToken,
    feeTiers,
    routerAbiVersion,
    quoterAbiVersion,
    baseAssetMode,
    gasReserveWei,
    maxFeePerGasWei,
    maxSwapGas: positiveBigInt(values.ROBINHOOD_MAX_SWAP_GAS ?? '500000', 'ROBINHOOD_MAX_SWAP_GAS'),
    maxApprovalGas: positiveBigInt(values.ROBINHOOD_MAX_APPROVAL_GAS ?? '100000', 'ROBINHOOD_MAX_APPROVAL_GAS'),
    receiptTimeoutMs,
    maxSlippageBps
  };
}

export const QUOTER_ABI = parseAbi([
  'struct QuoteExactInputSingleParams { address tokenIn; address tokenOut; uint256 amountIn; uint24 fee; uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96; }',

]);

export function encodeRobinhoodSwapCalldata(input: {
  config: RobinhoodExecutionConfig;
  tokenIn: `0x${string}`;
  tokenOut: `0x${string}`;
  fee: number;
  recipient: `0x${string}`;
  deadline: bigint;
  amountIn: bigint;
  amountOutMinimum: bigint;
}): Hex {
  const common = {
    tokenIn: input.tokenIn,
    tokenOut: input.tokenOut,
    fee: input.fee,
    recipient: input.recipient,
    amountIn: input.amountIn,
    amountOutMinimum: input.amountOutMinimum,
    sqrtPriceLimitX96: 0n
  };
  const args = input.config.routerAbiVersion === 'uniswap-v3-swap-router-01'
    ? [{ ...common, deadline: input.deadline }]
    : [common];
  return encodeFunctionData({
    abi: getRobinhoodRouterAbi(input.config.routerAbiVersion),
    functionName: 'exactInputSingle',
    args
  });
}

export class RobinhoodRpcFailure extends Error {}

function isRpcFailure(error: unknown): boolean {
  if (error instanceof RobinhoodRpcFailure) return true;
  const name = error instanceof Error ? error.name : '';
  return /HttpRequest|Timeout|Socket|RpcRequest|Network/i.test(name);
}

export type RobinhoodQuoteAdapter = (
  tokenIn: `0x${string}`,
  tokenOut: `0x${string}`,
  amountIn: bigint,
  fee: number
) => Promise<bigint>;

export type RobinhoodRouteResult =
  | { status: 'route'; fee: number; amountOut: bigint }
  | { status: 'no_route'; failures: string[] }
  | { status: 'rpc_failure'; failures: string[] };

export async function discoverRobinhoodRoute(input: {
  config: RobinhoodExecutionConfig;
  tokenIn: `0x${string}`;
  tokenOut: `0x${string}`;
  amountIn: bigint;
  quote: RobinhoodQuoteAdapter;
}): Promise<RobinhoodRouteResult> {
  const routes: Array<{ fee: number; amountOut: bigint }> = [];
  const failures: string[] = [];
  let rpcFailed = false;
  for (const fee of input.config.feeTiers) {
    try {
      const amountOut = await input.quote(input.tokenIn, input.tokenOut, input.amountIn, fee);
      if (amountOut > 0n) routes.push({ fee, amountOut });
      else failures.push(`${fee}: zero output`);
    } catch (error) {
      if (isRpcFailure(error)) rpcFailed = true;
      failures.push(`${fee}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'quote failed'}`);
    }
  }
  if (routes.length > 0) {
    const best = routes.reduce((current, route) =>
      route.amountOut > current.amountOut ? route : current
    );
    return { status: 'route', ...best };
  }
  return rpcFailed ? { status: 'rpc_failure', failures } : { status: 'no_route', failures };
}

export async function getRobinhoodQuote(
  tokenIn: string,
  tokenOut: string,
  amountInWei: bigint,
  feeTier = 3000
): Promise<bigint> {
  const config = parseRobinhoodExecutionConfig();
  const { result } = await robinhoodPublicClient.simulateContract({
    address: config.quoter,
    abi: QUOTER_ABI,
    functionName: 'quoteExactInputSingle',
    args: [{
      tokenIn: getAddress(tokenIn),
      tokenOut: getAddress(tokenOut),
      amountIn: amountInWei,
      fee: feeTier,
      sqrtPriceLimitX96: 0n
    }]
  });
  return result[0];
}

export type RobinhoodSafetyCheck = {
  name: 'sell_simulation' | 'ownership_admin' | 'liquidity' | 'source_verification' | 'holder_concentration' | 'fee_on_transfer';
  status: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'unknown';
  reliable: boolean;
  evidence: string;
};

export type RobinhoodSafetyAssessment = { checks: RobinhoodSafetyCheck[] };

export function evaluateRobinhoodSafety(assessment: RobinhoodSafetyAssessment): string[] {
  const reasons: string[] = [];
  for (const requiredName of ['sell_simulation', 'liquidity'] as const) {
    const check = assessment.checks.find((candidate) => candidate.name === requiredName);
    if (!check || !check.reliable || check.status !== 'pass') reasons.push(`${requiredName} did not pass reliably`);
  }
  for (const check of assessment.checks) {
    if (check.reliable && check.status === 'fail') reasons.push(`${check.name}: ${check.evidence}`);
  }
  return reasons;
}
