            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-status-warning mt-1">
              ${overview ? overview.cumulativeGasTipBurnUsd.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }) : '0.00'}
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">Solana / EVM Tips</span>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-4">
            <span className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold">
              Active Copiers
            </span>
            <div className="text-xl font-bold font-mono text-primary mt-1">
              {overview ? overview.totalCopiersActive : 0}
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">
              {overview ? overview.openPositionsCount : 0} Open Positions
            </span>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 2. User-by-User Trading Matrix */}
        <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6 mb-8">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-headline-md text-lg font-bold text-primary">Multi-Tenant User Trading Matrix</h2>
              <span className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">
                Showing {users.length} of {totalUsers} registered users
              </span>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search email or UUID..."
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-surface-container border border-border-subtle rounded-lg text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary w-full sm:w-64"
              />
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <select
                  value={tierFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setTierFilter(e.target.value);
                    setPage(1);
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-none px-3 py-1.5 bg-surface-container border border-border-subtle rounded-lg text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary"
                >
                  <option value="">All Tiers</option>
                  <option value="free">Free</option>
                  <option value="operator">Operator</option>
                  <option value="ultra">Ultra</option>
                  <option value="lifetime">Lifetime</option>
                </select>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-primary text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity"
                >
                  Filter
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>

          {loading ? (
            <LoadingSkeleton rows={5} />
          ) : users.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-12 text-on-surface-variant text-sm">
              No users found matching query criteria.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-sm min-w-[850px]">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border-subtle text-on-surface-variant text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">User</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Tier</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Custody Grants</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Cash Float</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Copied Masters</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Open Positions</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Realized P&L</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">24h Ops</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border-subtle">
                  {users.map((u) => (
                    <tr key={u.id} className="hover:bg-surface-container-low transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-4">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-primary">{u.email}</div>
                        <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant">{u.id.slice(0, 13)}...</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4">
                        <TierBadge tier={u.tier} />
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {Object.keys(u.custodyStatus).length === 0 ? (
                            <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant italic">None</span>
                          ) : (
                            Object.entries(u.custodyStatus).map(([chain, grant]) => (
                              <span
                                key={chain}
                                className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant border border-border-subtle"
                              >
                                {chain}: {grant}
                              </span>
                            ))
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4 font-mono font-medium text-primary">
                        ${u.totalCashFloatUsd.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 max-w-xs">
                          {u.copiedMasters.length === 0 ? (
                            <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant italic">0 masters</span>
                          ) : (
                            u.copiedMasters.map((m) => (
                              <span
                                key={m.masterAddress}
                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono bg-surface-container border border-border-subtle"
                              >
                                <span className="font-semibold">{m.label || m.masterAddress.slice(0, 8)}</span>
                                {m.membershipSlot !== null && (
                                  <span className="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">#{m.membershipSlot}/50</span>
                                )}
                              </span>
                            ))
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4">
                        <div className="font-mono font-medium text-primary">
                          {u.openPositionsCount} pos (${u.openPositionsValueUsd.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })})
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4">
                        <span
                          className={`font-mono font-semibold ${
                            u.realizedPnlUsd >= 0 ? 'text-status-success' : 'text-status-error'
                          }`}
                        >
                          ${u.realizedPnlUsd.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4 font-mono text-on-surface-variant">
                        {u.trades24hCount}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4 text-right">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => openUserDrillDown(u.id)}
                          className="px-3 py-1 bg-surface-container hover:bg-surface-container-high border border-border-subtle rounded text-xs font-semibold text-primary transition-colors"
                        >
                          Drill Down
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Pagination */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-border-subtle pt-4 mt-4">
            <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">
              Page {page} of {Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalUsers / 25))}
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                disabled={page <= 1}
                onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                className="px-3 py-1 bg-surface-container rounded border border-border-subtle text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                Previous
              </button>
              <button
                disabled={page >= Math.ceil(totalUsers / 25)}
                onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
                className="px-3 py-1 bg-surface-container rounded border border-border-subtle text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                Next
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 3. Bottom Grid: Master Alpha & Fleet Token Concentration */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
          {/* Master Alpha Board */}
          <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <h2 className="font-headline-md text-lg font-bold text-primary">Master Alpha & Follower Profitability</h2>
              <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant font-mono">CAP 50/MASTER</span>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-sm min-w-[520px]">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border-subtle text-on-surface-variant text-[11px] font-mono uppercase">
                    <th className="pb-2">Master Wallet</th>
                    <th className="pb-2">Members</th>
                    <th className="pb-2">Follower Float</th>
                    <th className="pb-2">Copier P&L</th>
                    <th className="pb-2 text-right">Win Rate</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border-subtle">
                  {masters.map((m) => (
                    <tr key={m.masterWalletAddress} className="hover:bg-surface-container-low">
                      <td className="py-3">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-primary">{m.label || m.masterWalletAddress.slice(0, 12)}</div>
                        <ChainBadge chain={m.chain} />
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 font-mono font-medium">
                        <span className={m.followerCount >= 45 ? 'text-status-warning font-bold' : ''}>
                          {m.followerCount}/{m.followerCap}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 font-mono">
                        ${m.totalFollowerCapitalUsd.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 font-mono font-semibold">
                        <span className={m.copierRealizedPnlUsd >= 0 ? 'text-status-success' : 'text-status-error'}>
                          ${m.copierRealizedPnlUsd.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-[#0E9F6E] dark:text-solana-teal">
                        {m.copierWinRatePct}%
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                  {masters.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={5} className="py-6 text-center text-on-surface-variant text-xs italic">
                        No active master allocations indexed yet.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>

          {/* Fleet Token Concentration */}
          <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <h2 className="font-headline-md text-lg font-bold text-primary">Fleet Token Concentration Heatmap</h2>
              <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant font-mono">SYSTEMIC RISK</span>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto -mx-6 px-6 sm:mx-0 sm:px-0">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-sm min-w-[520px]">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border-subtle text-on-surface-variant text-[11px] font-mono uppercase">
                    <th className="pb-2">Token</th>
                    <th className="pb-2">Holders</th>
                    <th className="pb-2">Fleet Exposure</th>
                    <th className="pb-2 text-right">Pool Conc. %</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border-subtle">
                  {tokens.map((t) => (
                    <tr key={t.tokenMint} className="hover:bg-surface-container-low">
                      <td className="py-3">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-primary">{t.tokenSymbol}</div>
                        <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">{t.tokenMint.slice(0, 16)}...</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 font-mono">{t.totalHolders} copiers</td>
                      <td className="py-3 font-mono font-semibold text-primary">
                        ${t.totalExposureUsd.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 text-right font-mono">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-bold ${
                            t.concentrationPct > 5
                              ? 'bg-status-error/10 text-status-error border border-status-error/30'
                              : 'text-on-surface-variant'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {t.concentrationPct}%
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                  {tokens.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={4} className="py-6 text-center text-on-surface-variant text-xs italic">
                        No open positions held across the fleet.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>

        {/* 4. Single-User Drilldown Drawer */}
        {selectedUserId && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex justify-end animate-fade-in">
            <div className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-surface-container-lowest h-full overflow-y-auto p-6 flex flex-col shadow-2xl">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border-subtle pb-4 mb-6">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-headline-md text-xl font-bold text-primary">User Trading Dossier</h3>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-on-surface-variant">{selectedUserId}</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedUserId(null)}
                  className="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant"
                >
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-xl">close</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {detailLoading || !userDetail ? (
                <LoadingSkeleton rows={6} />
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  {/* User Profile Bar */}
                  <div className="bg-surface-container-high/40 rounded-xl p-4 border border-border-subtle grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 text-sm">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase font-semibold">Email</span>
                      <div className="font-semibold text-primary truncate">{userDetail.user.email}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase font-semibold">Tier</span>
                      <div><TierBadge tier={userDetail.user.tier} /></div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase font-semibold">Kill Switch</span>

                        {userDetail.user.killSwitchActive ? (
                          <span className="text-status-error">ACTIVE</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-status-success">NORMAL</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase font-semibold">Slippage Cap</span>
                      <div className="font-mono font-bold text-xs">{userDetail.user.maxSlippageBps} bps</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Tabs */}
                  <div className="flex border-b border-border-subtle gap-4">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setActiveTab('positions')}
                      className={`pb-2 text-sm font-semibold border-b-2 transition-colors ${
                        activeTab === 'positions'
                          ? 'border-primary text-primary'
                          : 'border-transparent text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary'
                      }`}
                    >
                      Open Positions ({userDetail.openPositions.length})
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setActiveTab('masters')}
                      className={`pb-2 text-sm font-semibold border-b-2 transition-colors ${
                        activeTab === 'masters'
                          ? 'border-primary text-primary'
                          : 'border-transparent text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary'
                      }`}
                    >
                      Subscribed Masters ({userDetail.subscriptions.length})

                    <button
                      onClick={() => setActiveTab('executions')}
                      className={`pb-2 text-sm font-semibold border-b-2 transition-colors ${
                        activeTab === 'executions'
                          ? 'border-primary text-primary'
                          : 'border-transparent text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary'
                      }`}
                    >
                      Execution Audit (50 Trades)
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Tab 1: Open Positions */}
                  {activeTab === 'positions' && (
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      {userDetail.openPositions.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="text-center py-8 text-on-surface-variant text-sm italic">
                          No open positions currently held by this user.
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        userDetail.openPositions.map((pos: any) => (
                          <div
                            key={pos.id}
                            className="bg-surface-container-low border border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-4 flex items-center justify-between"
                          >
                            <div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span className="font-bold text-primary">{pos.tokenSymbol}</span>
                                <ChainBadge chain={pos.chain} />
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-xs font-mono text-on-surface-variant mt-1">
                                Qty: {pos.confirmedQuantity} ¬∑ Basis: ${pos.costBasisUsd}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-right">
                              <div className="text-sm font-mono font-bold text-primary">
                                ${(pos.confirmedQuantity * pos.currentPriceUsd).toFixed(2)}
                              </div>
                              <button
                                onClick={async () => {
                                  if (confirm('Force exit this position immediately on-chain?')) {
                                    try {
                                      await api.post(`/v1/me/positions/${pos.id}/exit`, {});
                                      alert('Exit order submitted');
                                    } catch (err: any) {
                                      alert(`Exit failed: ${err.message}`);
                                    }
                                  }
                                }}
                                className="mt-1 px-2.5 py-1 bg-status-error/10 hover:bg-status-error text-status-error hover:text-white border border-status-error/30 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-colors"
                              >
                                Force Exit
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Tab 2: Subscribed Masters */}
                  {activeTab === 'masters' && (
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      {userDetail.subscriptions.map((s: any) => (
                        <div
                          key={s.walletAddress}
                          className="bg-surface-container-low border border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-4 flex items-center justify-between"
                        >
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="font-bold text-primary">{s.label || s.walletAddress.slice(0, 14)}</span>
                              <ChainBadge chain={s.chain} />
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-surface-container">
                                Slot #{s.membershipSlot ?? 'N/A'}/50
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-xs font-mono text-on-surface-variant mt-1">
                              Status: {s.state} ¬∑ Joined: {new Date(s.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Tab 3: Execution Audit */}
                  {activeTab === 'executions' && (
                    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                      {userDetail.executionLedger.map((ex: any) => (
                        <div
                          key={ex.id}
                          className="bg-surface-container-low border border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-3 text-xs flex items-center justify-between"
                        >
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono">
                              <span className={`font-bold ${ex.direction === 'buy' ? 'text-status-success' : 'text-status-error'}`}>
                                {ex.direction.toUpperCase()}
                              </span>
                              <span>{ex.tokenMint.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                              <span className="text-on-surface-variant">[{ex.executionMode}]</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant font-mono mt-0.5">
                              {ex.confirmedAt ? new Date(ex.confirmedAt).toLocaleTimeString() : 'Pending'} ¬∑ Fee: ${ex.feeUsd}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-right font-mono">
                            <div className="font-semibold text-primary">${ex.fillPriceUsd}</div>
                            {ex.txHash && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 underline">tx: {ex.txHash.slice(0, 8)}...</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 5. Data Export Modal */}
        {showExportModal && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h3 className="font-headline-md text-lg font-bold text-primary">Export Trading Data</h3>
                <button onClick={() => setShowExportModal(false)} className="text-on-surface-variant">
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold block mb-1">
                    Export Type
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={exportType}
                    onChange={(e: any) => setExportType(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-surface-container border border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm"
                  >
                    <option value="users">Fleet User Summary (Balances & P&L)</option>
                    <option value="positions">Open Positions Snapshot (All Tenants)</option>
                    <option value="executions">Trade Executions Ledger (Granular Transactions)</option>
                    <option value="masters">Master Attribution Matrix</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold block mb-1">
                    Output Format
                  </label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExportFormat('csv')}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${
                        exportFormat === 'csv'
                          ? 'border-primary bg-surface-container text-primary'
                          : 'border-border-subtle text-on-surface-variant'
                      }`}
                    >
                      CSV (Excel / Sheets)
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setExportFormat('json')}
                      className={`p-3 rounded-lg border text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${
                        exportFormat === 'json'
                          ? 'border-primary bg-surface-container text-primary'
                          : 'border-border-subtle text-on-surface-variant'
                      }`}
                    >
                      JSON (Quant / API)
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={triggerExport}
                    className="w-full bg-primary text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-lg">download</span>
                    <span>Download Stream</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { AdminNav } from '../../../components/AdminNav.js';
import { TierBadge, LoadingSkeleton } from '../../../components/UIPrimitives.js';
import { api } from '../../../lib/api.js';
import { copyToClipboard } from '../../../lib/wallets.js';

interface SubscriberUser {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  role: string;
  tier: string;
  createdAt: string;
  totalCashFloatUsd: number;
}

export default function AdminRevenuePage() {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<SubscriberUser[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUsers();
  }, []);

  const fetchUsers = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.get<{ users: SubscriberUser[] }>('/v1/admin/portfolio/users?page=1&limit=100');
      if (res?.users) {
        setUsers(res.users);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load user subscriptions for revenue ledger:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    if (copyToClipboard(text)) {
      setCopiedKey(key);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey((curr) => (curr === key ? null : curr)), 2000);
    }
  };

  // Derive counts and metrics
  const freeCount = users.filter((u) => u.tier === 'free').length;
  const operatorCount = users.filter((u) => u.tier === 'operator').length;
  const ultraCount = users.filter((u) => u.tier === 'ultra').length;
  const lifetimeCount = users.filter((u) => u.tier === 'lifetime').length;

  const totalPaidSubscribers = operatorCount + ultraCount + lifetimeCount;
  const mrrUsd = operatorCount * 35 + ultraCount * 150;
  const cumulativeRevenueUsd = mrrUsd + lifetimeCount * 1999;

  const plans = [
    {
      id: 'free',
      name: 'Starter (View-Only)',
      price: '$0 / mo',
      count: freeCount,
      features: 'Mempool telemetry, token discovery stream, cluster viewing',
      mrr: '$0',
      badgeColor: 'border-slate-500/30 text-slate-400 bg-slate-500/10',
    },
    {
      id: 'operator',
      name: 'Operator Tier',
      price: '$35 / mo',
      count: operatorCount,
      features: 'Autonomous live copy trading, 25 tracked wallets across Solana, Robinhood, and Polymarket, instant signals',
      mrr: `$${(operatorCount * 35).toLocaleString()}`,
      badgeColor: 'border-[#14F195]/30 text-[#0E9F6E] dark:text-[#14F195] bg-[#14F195]/10',
    },
    {
      id: 'ultra',
      name: 'Ultra Tier',
      price: '$150 / mo',
      count: ultraCount,
      features: 'Unlimited tracked wallets, dynamic custom EVM chains, maximum contract backfill depth, priority execution',
      mrr: `$${(ultraCount * 150).toLocaleString()}`,
      badgeColor: 'border-[#8B5CF6]/30 text-[#8B5CF6] bg-[#8B5CF6]/10',
    },
    {
      id: 'lifetime',
      name: 'Lifetime Pass',
      price: '$1,999 once',
      count: lifetimeCount,
      features: 'Permanent Ultra tier access, bespoke cluster scoring API, VIP routing (Zero monthly renewals)',
      mrr: `$${(lifetimeCount * 1999).toLocaleString()} (Fixed)`,
      badgeColor: 'border-[#FFB800]/30 text-[#B45309] dark:text-[#FFB800] bg-[#FFB800]/10',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="bg-background text-on-background min-h-screen antialiased font-sans">
      <AdminNav />

      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#14F195]/10 text-[#0E9F6E] dark:text-[#14F195] border border-[#14F195]/30">
                ON-CHAIN FINANCIALS
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant font-mono">ADR-0063 USDC BILLING</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">
              Operator SaaS Revenue &amp; Subscriptions
            </h1>
            <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant max-w-2xl mt-1">
              Live audit of platform revenue, subscription tier retention, on-chain treasury floats, and verified crypto billing intents.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={fetchUsers}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-surface-container hover:bg-surface-container-high border border-border-subtle rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">refresh</span>
              <span>Sync Ledgers</span>
            </button>
            <Link
              href="/admin/portfolio"
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-primary text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">hub</span>
              <span>Trading Matrix</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 1. Executive Revenue KPI Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8">
          <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">
              Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
            </span>
            <div className="font-mono text-2xl font-bold text-primary">
              ${mrrUsd.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant font-normal">USDC/mo</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-status-success font-medium mt-1">
              ‚Üë 100% On-Chain Non-Custodial
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">
              Active Paid Subscribers
            </span>
            <div className="font-mono text-2xl font-bold text-primary">
              {totalPaidSubscribers}{' '}
              <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant font-normal">/ {users.length} total users</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant mt-1">
              {users.length > 0 ? ((totalPaidSubscribers / users.length) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}% Paid Conversion Rate
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">
              Cumulative Platform Revenue
            </span>
            <div className="font-mono text-2xl font-bold text-[#14F195]">
              ${cumulativeRevenueUsd.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant font-normal">USDC</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant mt-1">
              Zero Chargeback &amp; Zero Intermediary Risk
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">
              Active Billing Protocol
            </span>
            <div className="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-primary truncate mt-1">
              Solana &amp; Polygon USDC
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant mt-1">
              Direct On-Chain Treasury Routing
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Tier Breakdown Matrix */}
        <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl overflow-hidden mb-8 shadow-sm">
          <div className="p-5 border-b border-border-subtle flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-headline-md text-base font-bold text-primary">Subscription Tier Breakdown</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">Active subscriber retention and feature limits per tier.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-surface-container border-b border-border-subtle font-mono uppercase text-on-surface-variant">
                  <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Tier</th>
                  <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Price</th>
                  <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Active Subscribers</th>
                  <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Execution Limits</th>
                  <th className="p-4 font-semibold text-right">Contribution</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-border-subtle">
                {plans.map((p) => (
                  <tr key={p.id} className="hover:bg-surface-container/50 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold font-mono text-[11px] border ${p.badgeColor}`}>
                        {p.name}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4 font-mono font-bold text-primary">{p.price}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 font-mono text-primary">
                      <strong>{p.count}</strong> subscriber{p.count === 1 ? '' : 's'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-on-surface-variant">{p.features}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 font-mono font-bold text-right text-primary">{p.mrr}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 3. Protocol Treasury Addresses & Balances */}
        <section className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-8">
          <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#14F195]" />
                <h3 className="font-bold text-primary text-base">Solana Treasury Wallet</h3>
              </div>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#14F195]/10 text-[#0E9F6E] dark:text-[#14F195] border border-[#14F195]/30">
                SPL USDC
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant mb-4">
              Receiving destination for Solana USDC subscriptions and gas float deposits.
            </p>
            <div className="p-3 bg-surface-container-low rounded-lg border border-border-subtle font-mono text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase font-semibold">Address</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleCopy('WAKETreasurySolana1111111111111111111111111', 'sol-treasury')}
                  className="text-[10px] text-primary underline font-bold"
                >
                  {copiedKey === 'sol-treasury' ? <span className="text-status-success">‚úì Copied!</span> : 'Copy'}
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="font-bold text-primary truncate select-all">
                WAKETreasurySolana1111111111111111111111111
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#8B5CF6]" />
                <h3 className="font-bold text-primary text-base">Polygon Treasury Wallet</h3>
              </div>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#8B5CF6]/10 text-[#8B5CF6] border border-[#8B5CF6]/30">
                ERC-20 USDC
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant mb-4">
              Receiving destination for Polygon USDC subscriptions and Polymarket prediction float deposits.
            </p>
            <div className="p-3 bg-surface-container-low rounded-lg border border-border-subtle font-mono text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase font-semibold">Address</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleCopy('0xWAKETreasuryPolygon00000000000000000000000', 'poly-treasury')}
                  className="text-[10px] text-primary underline font-bold"
                >
                  {copiedKey === 'poly-treasury' ? <span className="text-status-success">‚úì Copied!</span> : 'Copy'}
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="font-bold text-primary truncate select-all">
                0xWAKETreasuryPolygon00000000000000000000000
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* 4. Active Subscriber Ledger */}
        <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
          <div className="p-5 border-b border-border-subtle">
            <h2 className="font-headline-md text-base font-bold text-primary">Registered Accounts &amp; Subscription Ledger</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">Live audit of all provisioned accounts across the protocol.</p>
          </div>

          {loading ? (
            <div className="p-6">
              <LoadingSkeleton rows={4} />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-surface-container border-b border-border-subtle font-mono uppercase text-on-surface-variant">
                    <th className="p-4 font-semibold">User</th>
                    <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Role</th>
                    <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Tier</th>
                    <th className="p-4 font-semibold">Created At</th>
                    <th className="p-4 font-semibold text-right">Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border-subtle">
                  {users.map((u) => (
                    <tr key={u.id} className="hover:bg-surface-container/50 transition-colors">
                      <td className="p-4">
                        <div className="font-bold text-primary">{u.email}</div>
                        <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-on-surface-variant">{u.id}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant uppercase">
                          {u.role}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4">
                        <TierBadge tier={u.tier} />
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4 font-mono text-on-surface-variant">
                        {new Date(u.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4 text-right">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-status-success/10 text-status-success border border-status-success/30 uppercase">
                          ACTIVE
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

==> apps/web/app/billing/page.tsx <==
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, Suspense } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { SaaSNav } from '../../components/SaaSNav.js';
import { AdminNav } from '../../components/AdminNav.js';
import { TierBadge, LoadingSkeleton, ErrorBanner } from '../../components/UIPrimitives.js';
import { api } from '../../lib/api.js';

interface BillingStatus {
  tier: string;
  effectiveTier: string;
  tierExpiresAt: string | null;
  isLifetime: boolean;
  daysRemaining: number | null;
  inGracePeriod: boolean;
  renewalAlert: boolean;
  activeUntil: string | null;
}

interface PlanItem {
  id: string;
  tier: string;
  durationDays: number | null;
  priceUsdc: number;
  displayName: string;
  description: string;
  features: string[];
  isPopular?: boolean;
}

interface PlanCatalog {
  plans: PlanItem[];
  treasuryAddresses: {
    solana: string;
    polygon: string;
  };
}

const DEFAULT_FEATURES: Record<string, string[]> = {
  operator: [
    '0s Real-Time Signal Stream & Execution',
    'Up to 5 Active Master Tracking Slots',
    'Solana Anchor PDA & 4337 Smart Account',
    'Autonomous Stop-Loss & Laddered Exits',
    '30 Days Stackable Access Duration',
  ],
  ultra: [
    'Everything in Operator Pass',
    'Up to 25 Active Master Tracking Slots',
    'Priority Sub-Second Trade Fan-Out Queue',
    'Dynamic Custom Chains Registry API',
    'Dedicated Quant Webhook Streams',
    '30 Days Stackable Access Duration',
  ],
  lifetime: [
    'Permanent Ultra Tier Benefits Forever',
    'Zero Recurring Subscription Fees',
    'Priority Fleet Execution Allocation',
    'Direct Core Engineer Telegram Desk',
    'Exclusive Early Access to Beta Modules',
  ],
};

function BillingView() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const autoSelectTier = searchParams.get('selected');

  const [role, setRole] = useState<'admin' | 'user'>('user');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<BillingStatus | null>(null);
  const [catalog, setCatalog] = useState<PlanCatalog | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Modal payment state
  const [selectedPlanId, setSelectedPlanId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [chain, setChain] = useState<'solana' | 'polygon'>('solana');
  const [referenceMemo, setReferenceMemo] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [txHash, setTxHash] = useState('');
  const [verifying, setVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [verificationSuccess, setVerificationSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchBilling();
  }, []);

  const fetchBilling = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [statusRes, catalogRes, meRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get<BillingStatus>('/v1/billing/status').catch(() => null),
        api.get<any>('/v1/billing/plans').catch(() => null),
        api.get<{ user?: { role?: string } }>('/v1/auth/me').catch(() => null),
      ]);

      if (meRes?.user?.role === 'admin') {
        setRole('admin');
      }

      setStatus(
        statusRes || {
          tier: 'operator',
          effectiveTier: 'operator',
          tierExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 25 * 86400000).toISOString(),
          isLifetime: false,
          daysRemaining: 25,
          inGracePeriod: false,
          renewalAlert: false,
          activeUntil: new Date(Date.now() + 25 * 86400000).toISOString(),
        }
      );

      // Safe normalization of catalog plans to prevent undefined features crash
      const rawPlans = Array.isArray(catalogRes?.plans) ? catalogRes.plans : [];
      const fallbackPlans = [
        {
          id: 'operator_monthly',
          tier: 'operator',
          durationDays: 30,
          priceUsdc: 35,
          name: 'Operator Pass',
          description: 'Real-time multi-chain automated execution across Solana, Robinhood, and Polymarket.',
          features: DEFAULT_FEATURES.operator,
          isPopular: true,
        },
        {
          id: 'ultra_monthly',
          tier: 'ultra',
          durationDays: 30,
          priceUsdc: 150,
          name: 'Ultra Tier',
          description: 'Institutional-grade bandwidth, priority fan-out queue, and custom dynamic chains.',
          features: DEFAULT_FEATURES.ultra,
        },
        {
          id: 'lifetime',
          tier: 'ultra',
          durationDays: null,
          priceUsdc: 1999,
          name: 'Lifetime Pass',
          description: 'Permanent unrestricted access to Wake Protocol with no recurring subscription fees ever.',
          features: DEFAULT_FEATURES.lifetime,
        },
      ];

      const sourcePlans = rawPlans.length > 0 ? rawPlans : fallbackPlans;
      const normalizedPlans: PlanItem[] = sourcePlans.map((p: any) => {
        const tierKey = p.id === 'lifetime' ? 'lifetime' : p.tier || 'operator';
        const defaultFeats = DEFAULT_FEATURES[tierKey] || DEFAULT_FEATURES.operator;
        return {
          id: p.id,
          tier: p.tier || 'operator',
          durationDays: p.durationDays !== undefined ? p.durationDays : 30,
          priceUsdc: Number(p.priceUsdc || (p.id === 'lifetime' ? 1999 : p.tier === 'ultra' ? 150 : 35)),
          displayName: p.displayName || p.name || p.id,
          description: p.description || '',
          features: Array.isArray(p.features) && p.features.length > 0 ? p.features : defaultFeats,
          isPopular: p.isPopular ?? (p.id === 'operator_monthly' || p.tier === 'operator'),
        };
      });

      const treasuryAddresses = {
        solana: catalogRes?.treasuryAddresses?.solana || 'WAKETreasurySolana1111111111111111111111111',
        polygon: catalogRes?.treasuryAddresses?.polygon || '0xWAKETreasuryPolygon00000000000000000000000',
      };

      setCatalog({
        plans: normalizedPlans,
        treasuryAddresses,
      });

      // Auto-open modal if specified in query string
      if (autoSelectTier) {
        const match = normalizedPlans.find((p) => p.id === autoSelectTier || p.tier === autoSelectTier);
        if (match) {
          handleOpenPayment(match.id);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to fetch billing status');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenPayment = async (planId: string) => {
    setSelectedPlanId(planId);
    setVerificationSuccess(false);
    setTxHash('');
    try {
      const intent = await api.post<{ referenceMemo: string }>('/v1/billing/crypto/intent', { planId });
      setReferenceMemo(intent.referenceMemo);
    } catch {
      setReferenceMemo(`WAKE-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`);
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyPayment = async () => {
    if (!txHash.trim() || !selectedPlanId) return;
    setVerifying(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/v1/billing/crypto/verify', {
        planId: selectedPlanId,
        chain,
        txHash: txHash.trim(),
        memo: referenceMemo || undefined,
        referenceMemo: referenceMemo || undefined,
      });
      setVerificationSuccess(true);
      fetchBilling();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Payment verification failed: ${err.message || 'Transaction could not be verified on-chain yet. Please confirm it has finalized and retry.'}`);
    } finally {
      setVerifying(false);
    }
  };

  const selectedPlan = catalog?.plans.find((p) => p.id === selectedPlanId);

  return (
    <div className="bg-background text-on-background min-h-screen antialiased font-sans">
      {/* Role-adaptive Navigation Header */}
      {role === 'admin' ? <AdminNav /> : <SaaSNav />}

      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8">
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">
              Subscription &amp; Crypto Billing Rail
            </h1>
            <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">
              Pure crypto-native USDC payments with zero banking bottlenecks. Instant automated on-chain activation.
            </p>
          </div>
          {role === 'admin' && (
            <span className="self-start sm:self-auto px-2 py-1 rounded bg-status-error/10 text-status-error border border-status-error/30 text-xs font-mono font-bold">
              OPERATOR FLEET VIEW
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {error && <div className="mb-6"><ErrorBanner message={error} onRetry={fetchBilling} /></div>}

        {/* Grace Period Alert Banner (S6-56) */}
        {status?.inGracePeriod && (
          <div className="mb-8 p-4 rounded-xl bg-status-error/10 border border-status-error/40 flex items-center justify-between animate-pulse">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl text-status-error">warning</span>
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-status-error text-sm">Subscription in Grace Period</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-status-error/90">
                  Your access expired and is currently in a 3-day grace period. Automated copying will pause unless renewed.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleOpenPayment('operator_monthly')}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-status-error text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-lg hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity"
            >
              Renew Now
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Current Subscription Status Card */}
        <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6 mb-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-high flex items-center justify-center text-primary shrink-0">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">verified</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="font-headline-md text-lg font-bold text-primary">Active Plan</span>
                {status && <TierBadge tier={status.effectiveTier} />}
              </div>
              <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant mt-1">
                {status?.isLifetime
                  ? 'Permanent Lifetime Pass active with unlimited duration.'
                  : status?.daysRemaining !== null && status?.daysRemaining !== undefined
                  ? `${status.daysRemaining} days remaining in current billing cycle.`
                  : 'Free tier with paper-only simulation.'}

                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs text-primary truncate">
                        {catalog?.treasuryAddresses[chain] || 'WAKETreasurySolana1111111111111111111111111'}
                      </span>

                      >
                        Copy
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Reference Memo */}
                  {referenceMemo && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-amber-500/10 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/30">

                    </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant uppercase font-semibold block mb-1">
                      Enter Finalized Transaction Hash
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="e.g. 5Kx2... or 0x4f8..."
                      value={txHash}
                      onChange={(e) => setTxHash(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-surface-container border border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm font-mono outline-none focus:border-primary"
                    />
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-on-surface-variant mt-1 block">
                      Transfer exact ${selectedPlan.priceUsdc} USDC to the address above, then paste tx hash to activate instantly.
                    </span>

                      </>
                    ) : (

                        <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">verified</span>
                        <span>Verify &amp; Unlock Tier</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function BillingPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div className="min-h-screen bg-background" />}>
      <BillingView />

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { AdminNav } from '../../components/AdminNav.js';
import { api } from '../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../lib/api-error-message.js';

export default function ClustersPage() {
  const [clusters, setClusters] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [expandedCluster, setExpandedCluster] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [clusterMembers, setClusterMembers] = useState<Record<string, any[]>>({});

  const fetchClusters = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const data = await api.get<{ items?: any[] }>('/v1/clusters');
      setClusters(data.items || []);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to fetch clusters'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchClusterMembers = async (clusterId: string) => {
    if (clusterMembers[clusterId]) {
      setExpandedCluster(expandedCluster === clusterId ? null : clusterId);
      return;
    }

    try {
      // The API exposes members under GET /v1/clusters/:id (returns { cluster, members }).
      const data = await api.get<{ members?: any[] }>(`/v1/clusters/${clusterId}`);
      setClusterMembers(prev => ({ ...prev, [clusterId]: data.members || [] }));
      setExpandedCluster(clusterId);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to fetch cluster members'));
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClusters();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-on-background antialiased font-sans">
      <AdminNav />
      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8">
        <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">Wallet Clusters</h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant mb-6">
          Clusters are groups of wallets with coordinated behavior patterns. Click to view members.
        </p>

      {error && (
        <div className="card" style={{ background: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)', borderColor: 'var(--danger)', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', margin: 0 }}>{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: '1.5rem', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
        <button
          onClick={fetchClusters}
          disabled={loading}
          style={{
            padding: '0.5rem 1rem',
            background: 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)',
            color: 'var(--accent)',
            border: '1px solid var(--accent)',
            borderRadius: '6px',
            cursor: loading ? 'wait' : 'pointer',
            fontWeight: 500
          }}
        >
          {loading ? 'Loading...' : 'Refresh'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {clusters.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="card" style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '3rem' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            No clusters found. Run the scorer batch to generate clusters from tracked wallets.
          </p>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.9rem', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
            Go to <a href="/setup" style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>Setup</a> to trigger the scorer.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr' }}>
          {clusters.map((cluster: any) => (
            <div key={cluster.id} className="card" style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              <div
                onClick={() => fetchClusterMembers(cluster.id)}
                style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}
              >
                <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 0.5rem 0', color: 'var(--text-primary)', textTransform: 'none' }}>
                    Cluster {cluster.id.slice(0, 8)}
                  </h3>
                  <div style={{ marginTop: '0.75rem' }}>
                    <span className={`badge ${
                      cluster.cluster_type === 'funding' ? 'success' :
                      cluster.cluster_type === 'behavioral' ? 'warning' : ''
                    }`} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }}>
                      {cluster.cluster_type}
                    </span>
                    <span className="badge" style={{ background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', marginRight: '0.5rem' }}>
                      {cluster.wallet_count || 0} members
                    </span>
                    {cluster.confidence != null && (
                      <span className="badge" style={{ background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)' }}>
                        Confidence: {(cluster.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {cluster.total_realized_roi != null && (
                    <div style={{ marginTop: '0.75rem', fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                      Avg ROI: {(cluster.total_realized_roi * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '1.2rem' }}>
                    {expandedCluster === cluster.id ? '‚ñº' : '‚ñ∂'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Expanded members */}
              {expandedCluster === cluster.id && clusterMembers[cluster.id] && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: '1.5rem', paddingTop: '1.5rem', borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-color)' }}>
                  <h4 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem 0', color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
                    CLUSTER MEMBERS
                  </h4>
                  {clusterMembers[cluster.id].length === 0 ? (
                    <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>No members found</p>
                  ) : (
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
                      {clusterMembers[cluster.id].map((member: any, idx: number) => (
                        <div
                          key={member.address || idx}
                          style={{
                            padding: '0.75rem',
                            background: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                            borderRadius: '6px',
                            border: '1px solid var(--border-color)'
                          }}
                        >
                          <code className="break-all font-mono" style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--accent)' }}>
                            {member.address}
                          </code>
                          {member.tier && (
                            <span className={`badge ${
                              member.tier === 'elite' ? 'success' :
                              member.tier === 'pro' ? 'warning' : ''
                            }`} style={{ marginLeft: '0.75rem', fontSize: '0.7rem' }}>
                              {member.tier}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </main>
  </div>
);
}
