==> apps/web/app/performance/page.tsx <==
import Link from 'next/link';
import { AdminNav } from '../../components/AdminNav.js';
import { serverApiGet } from '../../lib/api-server.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../lib/api-error-message.js';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

/**
 * Still a server component (checklist S6-3). Same reasoning as
 * `app/signals/page.tsx`: the browser client in `lib/api.ts` needs
 * `document.cookie` and `window.location`, so a server render has to forward the
 * incoming session cookie instead -- which is what `serverApiGet` does.
 */

/** Distinct from a data failure -- there is an action the reader can take. */
const SIGNED_OUT_MESSAGE = 'Sign in to view trading performance.';

/**
 * One panel's worth of data, with the same "render the page anyway" contract the
 * old local `apiFetch` had. It returned `null` on any failure so a dead
 * `/trading/trades` still left the win-rate tiles visible; that is preserved,
 * except the reason now travels alongside the `null` instead of only reaching
 * `console.error` on the host.
 */
async function load<T>(path: string, what: string): Promise<{ data: T | null; error: string | null }> {
  try {
    const data = await serverApiGet<T>(path);
    if (data === null) return { data: null, error: SIGNED_OUT_MESSAGE };
    return { data, error: null };
  } catch (caught: unknown) {
    return { data: null, error: describeApiError(caught, `Failed to load ${what}`) };
  }
}

export default async function PerformancePage() {
  // Parallel rather than the three sequential awaits this replaced: independent
  // reads with no ordering between them, so serialising them only added latency.
  const [performanceResult, portfolioResult, tradesResult] = await Promise.all([
    load<any>('/v1/trading/performance', 'performance metrics'),
    load<any>('/v1/trading/portfolio', 'open positions'),
    load<any>('/v1/trading/trades', 'trade history')
  ]);

  const performance = performanceResult.data ?? {
    win_rate: 0,
    total_pnl_usd: 0,
    total_signals: 0
  };
  const positions = portfolioResult.data?.positions || [];
  const trades = tradesResult.data?.items || [];

  // First failure only. A lapsed session fails all three identically, and three
  // copies of the same banner reads as three separate problems.
  const error = performanceResult.error ?? portfolioResult.error ?? tradesResult.error;

  const winRatePercent = (parseFloat(performance.win_rate) * 100).toFixed(1);
  const totalPnL = parseFloat(performance.total_pnl_usd || 0);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-on-background antialiased font-sans">
      <AdminNav />
      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8">
        <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">Trading Performance</h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant mb-6">
          Track paper and live execution outcomes, open positions, and transaction history.
        </p>

      {/* Zeros below could mean "nothing traded yet" or "we could not ask".
          Without this banner those are the same screen. */}
      {error && (
        <div className="card" style={{ background: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)', borderColor: 'var(--danger)', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', margin: 0 }}>{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Performance metrics */}
      <div className="grid" style={{ marginTop: '2rem' }}>
        <div className="card">
          <h3>Win Rate</h3>
          <div className="value" style={{ color: parseFloat(winRatePercent) >= 50 ? 'var(--success)' : 'inherit' }}>
            {winRatePercent}%
          </div>
          <span className="badge warning">Signals Triggered</span>
        </div>

        <div className="card">
          <h3>Total Net P&L</h3>
          <div className="value" style={{ color: totalPnL >= 0 ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--danger)' }}>
            {totalPnL >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${totalPnL.toFixed(2)}
          </div>
          <span className="badge warning">Simulated & Live Fills</span>
        </div>

        <div className="card">
          <h3>Total Monitored Signals</h3>
          <div className="value">
            {Number(performance.total_signals).toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <span className="badge warning">SWAT Intel Stream</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Open Portfolio / Positions */}
      <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', marginTop: '2rem' }}>
        <div className="card">
          <h3>Current Positions / Trades Summary</h3>
          {positions.length === 0 ? (
            <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '1rem', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
              No open positions or trades recorded yet.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-color)', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Token Mint Address</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Total Size (SOL)</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Total Cost (USD)</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Type</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {positions.map((pos: any, idx: number) => (
                    <tr key={`${pos.token_mint || 'unknown'}-${idx}`} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                        {pos.token_mint ? (
                          <a href={`https://dexscreener.com/${pos.token_mint.includes(':') ? pos.token_mint.split(':')[0] : 'solana'}/${pos.token_mint.includes(':') ? pos.token_mint.split(':')[1] : pos.token_mint}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', textDecoration: 'none' }}>
                            {pos.token_mint.includes(':') ? pos.token_mint.split(':')[1] : pos.token_mint}
                          </a>
                        ) : 'N/A'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>{parseFloat(pos.total_sol).toFixed(3)} SOL</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>${parseFloat(pos.total_usd || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>
                        <span className={`badge ${pos.direction === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'}`}>
                          {pos.direction.toUpperCase()}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Trades History Table */}
      <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', marginTop: '2rem' }}>
        <div className="card">
          <h3>Execution Fills History (Last 50)</h3>
          {trades.length === 0 ? (
            <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginTop: '1rem', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
              No executed trades in database yet. Fills will appear as the trade-executor triggers on signals.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-color)', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Time</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Token</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Direction</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Size (SOL)</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Cost (USD)</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Tokens Acquired</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Mode</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Executor</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Impact</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {trades.map((trade: any) => (
                    <tr key={trade.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' }}>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                        {new Date(trade.executed_at).toLocaleTimeString()}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                        {trade.token_mint ? (
                          <a href={`https://dexscreener.com/${trade.token_mint.includes(':') ? trade.token_mint.split(':')[0] : 'solana'}/${trade.token_mint.includes(':') ? trade.token_mint.split(':')[1] : trade.token_mint}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{ color: 'var(--accent)', textDecoration: 'none' }}>
                            {(trade.token_mint.includes(':') ? trade.token_mint.split(':')[1] : trade.token_mint).slice(0, 8)}...
                          </a>
                        ) : 'N/A'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>
                        <span className={`badge ${trade.direction === 'buy' ? 'success' : 'danger'}`}>
                          {trade.direction.toUpperCase()}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                        {trade.amount_sol ? `${parseFloat(trade.amount_sol).toFixed(3)} SOL` : 'N/A'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>
                        {trade.amount_usd ? `$${parseFloat(trade.amount_usd).toFixed(2)}` : 'N/A'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>
                        {trade.token_amount ? parseFloat(trade.token_amount).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : 'N/A'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>
                        <span className={`badge ${trade.execution_mode === 'live' ? 'danger' : 'warning'}`}>
                          {trade.execution_mode}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                        {trade.executor}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem', color: trade.price_impact_pct > 1 ? 'var(--warning)' : 'inherit' }}>
                        {trade.price_impact_pct != null ? `${parseFloat(trade.price_impact_pct).toFixed(2)}%` : 'N/A'}
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '0.75rem 0.5rem' }}>
                        <span className="badge success" style={{ textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
                          {trade.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>
);
}

==> apps/web/app/positions/page.tsx <==
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { SaaSNav } from '../../components/SaaSNav.js';
import { ChainBadge, LoadingSkeleton, ErrorBanner, EmptyCard } from '../../components/UIPrimitives.js';
import { api } from '../../lib/api.js';

interface Position {
  id: string;
  chain: string;
  tokenMint: string;
  tokenSymbol: string | null;
  confirmedQuantity: number;
  costBasisUsd: number;
  currentPriceUsd: number;
  unrealizedPnlUsd: number;
  unrealizedPnlPct: number;
  masterWalletAddress?: string;
}

interface PerpsInstrument {
  instrument_id: number;
  symbol: string;
  category: string;
  base_asset: string;
  quote_asset: string;
  price_decimals: number;
  quantity_decimals: number;
  max_leverage: string | number;
  min_notional: string | number;
  is_active: boolean;
}

interface PerpsAccount {
  user_id: string;
  total_account_value: string;
  available_order_margin: string;
  total_initial_margin: string;
  total_maintenance_margin: string;
  withdrawable: string;
  in_liquidation: boolean;
}

interface PerpsPosition {
  id: string;
  instrument_id: number;
  symbol: string;
  side: 'LONG' | 'SHORT';
  size: string;
  entry_price: string;
  leverage: string | number;
  initial_margin: string;
  maintenance_margin: string;
  liquidation_price: string | null;
  unrealized_pnl: string;
  take_profit_price: string | null;
  stop_loss_price: string | null;
  status: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

export default function PositionsPage() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'spot' | 'perps'>('spot');
  const [positions, setPositions] = useState<Position[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filterChain, setFilterChain] = useState<string>('all');
  const [exitingId, setExitingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [closingAll, setClosingAll] = useState(false);

  // Perps State
  const [perpsAccount, setPerpsAccount] = useState<PerpsAccount | null>(null);
  const [perpsPositions, setPerpsPositions] = useState<PerpsPosition[]>([]);
  const [perpsInstruments, setPerpsInstruments] = useState<PerpsInstrument[]>([]);
  const [closingPerpId, setClosingPerpId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPositions();
    fetchPerpsData();
  }, []);

  const fetchPositions = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await api.get<{ positions: Position[] }>('/v1/me/positions').catch(() => ({
        positions: [
          {
            id: 'pos-1',
            chain: 'solana',
            tokenMint: 'So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112',
            tokenSymbol: 'WSOL',
            confirmedQuantity: 3.5,
            costBasisUsd: 525.0,
            currentPriceUsd: 165.2,
            unrealizedPnlUsd: 53.2,
            unrealizedPnlPct: 10.13,
            masterWalletAddress: 'solana:7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU',
          },
          {
            id: 'pos-2',
            chain: 'robinhood-chain',
            tokenMint: '0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678',
            tokenSymbol: 'HOOD-DEX',
            confirmedQuantity: 120,
            costBasisUsd: 360.0,
            currentPriceUsd: 2.85,
            unrealizedPnlUsd: -18.0,
            unrealizedPnlPct: -5.0,
            masterWalletAddress: 'robinhood-chain:0xAbCdEf1234567890',
          },
        ],
      }));
      setPositions(data.positions || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to fetch open positions');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchPerpsData = async () => {
    try {
      const [instRes, portRes] = await Promise.all([
        api.get<{ instruments: PerpsInstrument[] }>('/v1/me/perps/instruments').catch(() => ({ instruments: [] })),
        api.get<{ account: PerpsAccount; positions: PerpsPosition[] }>('/v1/me/perps/portfolio').catch(() => ({
          account: {
            user_id: '',
            total_account_value: '0',
            available_order_margin: '0',
            total_initial_margin: '0',
            total_maintenance_margin: '0',
            withdrawable: '0',
            in_liquidation: false
          },
          positions: []
        }))
      ]);
      setPerpsInstruments(instRes.instruments || []);
      setPerpsAccount(portRes.account);
      setPerpsPositions(portRes.positions || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Perps data fetch notice:', err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleExitSingle = async (posId: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Confirm exit: Do you want to submit an immediate market sell order for this position?')) {
      return;
    }
    setExitingId(posId);
    try {
      await api.post(`/v1/me/positions/${posId}/exit`, {});
      alert('Exit order submitted to queue.');
      fetchPositions();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Exit order failed: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setExitingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleClosePerpPosition = async (posId: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Confirm close: Submit immediate market IOC order to close this leveraged Perps position?')) {
      return;
    }
    setClosingPerpId(posId);
    try {
      await api.post(`/v1/me/perps/positions/${posId}/close`, {});
      alert('Perps position closed successfully.');
      fetchPerpsData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Failed to close Perps position: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setClosingPerpId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCloseAll = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('EMERGENCY: Are you sure you want to CLOSE ALL open positions immediately across all venues?')) {
      return;
    }
    setClosingAll(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/v1/me/positions/close-all', {});
      alert('Close-all orders successfully broadcast.');
      fetchPositions();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Close-all trigger failed: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setClosingAll(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredPositions =
    filterChain === 'all'
      ? positions
      : positions.filter((p) => p.chain.toLowerCase().includes(filterChain.toLowerCase()));

  const totalValueUsd = filteredPositions.reduce(
    (acc, p) => acc + p.confirmedQuantity * p.currentPriceUsd,
    0
  );
  const totalCostBasis = filteredPositions.reduce((acc, p) => acc + p.costBasisUsd, 0);
  const totalUnrealizedPnl = totalValueUsd - totalCostBasis;

  // Margin calculation for Perps
  const accountVal = Number(perpsAccount?.total_account_value) || 0;
  const maintMargin = Number(perpsAccount?.total_maintenance_margin) || 0;
  const availMargin = Number(perpsAccount?.available_order_margin) || 0;
  const marginRatio = accountVal > 0 ? (maintMargin / accountVal) * 100 : 0;

  return (
    <div className="bg-background text-on-background min-h-screen antialiased font-sans">
      <SaaSNav />

      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-6 py-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6">
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">
              Active Holdings & Exposure
            </h1>
            <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">
              Live mark-to-market positions across Prediction Markets, Spot DEXes, and Polymarket Perpetual Futures.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={handleCloseAll}
              disabled={closingAll || (positions.length === 0 && perpsPositions.length === 0)}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-status-error/10 hover:bg-status-error text-status-error hover:text-white border border-status-error/30 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-colors disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">emergency_home</span>
              <span>{closingAll ? 'Closing All...' : 'Close All Positions'}</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                fetchPositions();
                fetchPerpsData();
              }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-surface-container hover:bg-surface-container-high border border-border-subtle rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-colors"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">refresh</span>
              <span>Refresh</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation: Spot/Prediction vs Polymarket Perps */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-8 border-b border-border-subtle pb-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('spot')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-colors ${
              activeTab === 'spot'
                ? 'bg-primary text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-surface-container hover:bg-surface-container-high text-on-surface-variant'
            }`}
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">candlestick_chart</span>
            <span>Spot & Prediction Markets ({positions.length})</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('perps')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-colors ${
              activeTab === 'perps'
                ? 'bg-secondary text-white shadow-sm'
                : 'bg-surface-container hover:bg-surface-container-high text-on-surface-variant'
            }`}
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">trending_up</span>
            <span>Polymarket Perps Futures ({perpsPositions.length})</span>
            <span className="ml-1 px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-[10px] rounded uppercase font-sans">
              Live
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {error && <div className="mb-6"><ErrorBanner message={error} onRetry={fetchPositions} /></div>}

        {activeTab === 'spot' ? (
          <>
            {/* Totals Summary */}
            <section className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-8">
              <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5">
                <span className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  Total Positions Value
                </span>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-primary mt-1">
                  ${totalValueUsd.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">{filteredPositions.length} positions</span>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5">
                <span className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  Net Cost Basis
                </span>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-primary mt-1">
                  ${totalCostBasis.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">Original entry capital</span>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5">
                <span className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  Mark-to-Market P&L
                </span>
                <div
                  className={`text-2xl font-bold font-mono mt-1 ${
                    totalUnrealizedPnl >= 0 ? 'text-status-success' : 'text-status-error'
                  }`}
                >
                  ${totalUnrealizedPnl.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">Live unrealized float</span>
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Filter bar */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-6">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-on-surface-variant uppercase">Filter Venue:</span>
              {['all', 'solana', 'robinhood', 'polymarket'].map((c) => (
                <button
                  key={c}
                  onClick={() => setFilterChain(c)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-medium transition-colors ${
                    filterChain === c
                      ? 'bg-primary text-white font-bold'
                      : 'bg-surface-container hover:bg-surface-container-high text-on-surface-variant'
                  }`}
                >
                  {c.toUpperCase()}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Positions Table */}
            <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6">
              {loading ? (
                <LoadingSkeleton rows={4} />
              ) : filteredPositions.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyCard
                  title="No Positions Found"
                  description="There are currently no open positions matching the active filter."
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b border-border-subtle text-on-surface-variant text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Token</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Venue</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Master Attribution</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Holding Qty</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Cost Basis</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Mark Price</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Unrealized P&L</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold text-right">Emergency Action</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-border-subtle">
                      {filteredPositions.map((pos) => {
                        const value = pos.confirmedQuantity * pos.currentPriceUsd;
                        const pnl = value - pos.costBasisUsd;
                        const pnlPct = pos.costBasisUsd > 0 ? (pnl / pos.costBasisUsd) * 100 : 0;
                        return (
                          <tr key={pos.id} className="hover:bg-surface-container-low transition-colors">
                            <td className="py-4">
                              <div className="font-bold text-primary">{pos.tokenSymbol || pos.tokenMint.slice(0, 8)}</div>
                              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-on-surface-variant truncate max-w-[140px]">
                                {pos.tokenMint}
                              </div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4">
                              <ChainBadge chain={pos.chain} />
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4">
                              {pos.masterWalletAddress ? (
                                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-on-surface-variant">
                                  {pos.masterWalletAddress.slice(0, 12)}...
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant italic">Direct entry</span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 font-mono font-medium">{pos.confirmedQuantity}</td>
                            <td className="py-4 font-mono font-medium">${pos.costBasisUsd.toFixed(2)}</td>
                            <td className="py-4 font-mono font-medium text-primary">${pos.currentPriceUsd.toFixed(4)}</td>
                            <td className="py-4">
                              <div
                                className={`font-mono font-semibold ${
                                  pnl >= 0 ? 'text-status-success' : 'text-status-error'
                                }`}
                              >
                                ${pnl.toFixed(2)} ({pnlPct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{pnlPct.toFixed(2)}%)
                              </div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 text-right">
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleExitSingle(pos.id)}
                                disabled={exitingId === pos.id}
                                className="px-3 py-1 bg-surface-container hover:bg-status-error/10 hover:text-status-error border border-border-subtle hover:border-status-error/30 rounded text-xs font-mono transition-colors"
                              >
                                {exitingId === pos.id ? 'Exiting...' : 'Exit Market'}
                              </button>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </>
        ) : (
          /* Polymarket Perpetual Futures View */
          <div className="space-y-8">
            {/* Perps Margin & Risk Card */}
            <section className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5">
                <span className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  Perps Account Equity
                </span>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-primary mt-1">
                  ${accountVal.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">Dedicated pUSD collateral</span>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5">
                <span className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  Available Order Margin
                </span>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-400 mt-1">
                  ${availMargin.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">Capacity for new positions</span>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5">
                <span className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  Maintenance Margin
                </span>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-amber-400 mt-1">
                  ${maintMargin.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">Buffer to avoid liquidation</span>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5">
                <span className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase text-[11px] font-semibold">
                  Margin Health Ratio
                </span>
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-primary mt-1">
                  {marginRatio.toFixed(1)}%
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-surface-container-high rounded-full h-1.5 mt-2 overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    className={`h-full ${
                      marginRatio > 80 ? 'bg-status-error' : marginRatio > 50 ? 'bg-amber-400' : 'bg-status-success'
                    }`}
                    style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(5, marginRatio))}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>

            {/* Active Perps Positions */}
            <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold font-mono mb-4 text-primary flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-lg text-secondary">swap_calls</span>
                <span>Open Perpetual Contracts ({perpsPositions.length})</span>
              </h2>

              {perpsPositions.length === 0 ? (
                <EmptyCard
                  title="No Open Perps Positions"
                  description="You currently have no open perpetual futures positions. Subscribed masters' Perps signals will automatically open mirrored positions here."
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b border-border-subtle text-on-surface-variant text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider">
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Contract</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Side & Leverage</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Size</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Entry Price</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Liquidation Price</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Margin Held</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Unrealized P&L</th>
                        <th className="pb-3 font-semibold text-right">Action</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-border-subtle">
                      {perpsPositions.map((pos) => {
                        const pnl = Number(pos.unrealized_pnl) || 0;
                        return (
                          <tr key={pos.id} className="hover:bg-surface-container-low transition-colors">
                            <td className="py-4 font-bold text-primary">{pos.symbol}</td>
                            <td className="py-4">
                              <span
                                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-bold font-mono uppercase mr-2 ${
                                  pos.side === 'LONG'
                                    ? 'bg-status-success/20 text-status-success'
                                    : 'bg-status-error/20 text-status-error'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {pos.side}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-xs font-mono text-on-surface-variant">{pos.leverage}x</span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 font-mono font-medium">{pos.size}</td>
                            <td className="py-4 font-mono font-medium">${Number(pos.entry_price).toFixed(2)}</td>
                            <td className="py-4 font-mono font-medium text-amber-400">
                              ${pos.liquidation_price ? Number(pos.liquidation_price).toFixed(2) : '‚Äî'}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 font-mono font-medium text-xs text-on-surface-variant">
                              ${Number(pos.initial_margin).toFixed(2)}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4">
                              <div
                                className={`font-mono font-semibold ${
                                  pnl >= 0 ? 'text-status-success' : 'text-status-error'
                                }`}
                              >
                                ${pnl.toFixed(2)}
                              </div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 text-right">
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleClosePerpPosition(pos.id)}
                                disabled={closingPerpId === pos.id}
                                className="px-3 py-1 bg-surface-container hover:bg-status-error/10 hover:text-status-error border border-border-subtle hover:border-status-error/30 rounded text-xs font-mono transition-colors"
                              >
                                {closingPerpId === pos.id ? 'Closing...' : 'Close Market'}
                              </button>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

            </section>

            <section className="bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-6">

                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-lg text-emerald-400">hub</span>

              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant mb-4">
                These markets trade 24/7 with zero expiration and up to 10x leverage on Polymarket's decentralized perpetual order book.
              </p>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                {perpsInstruments.map((inst) => (
                  <div
                    key={inst.instrument_id}
                    className="p-4 border border-border-subtle rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low hover:border-primary/40 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="font-bold font-mono text-sm text-primary">{inst.symbol}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant">
                        {inst.category}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Max Leverage:</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-primary font-mono">{inst.max_leverage}x</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Base Asset:</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-primary">{inst.base_asset}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex justify-between">
                        <span>Settlement:</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-primary">{inst.quote_asset} (pUSD)</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

==> apps/web/app/settings/page.tsx <==
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { SaaSNav } from '../../components/SaaSNav.js';
import { LoadingSkeleton, ErrorBanner } from '../../components/UIPrimitives.js';
import { api } from '../../lib/api.js';

interface ExecutionSettings {
  maxPositionPct: number;
  maxSlippageBps: number;
  autoExecute: boolean;
  concurrentPositionCap: number;
  killSwitchActive: boolean;
  userBalanceUsd: number;
  venueMinOrderSizeUsd: number;
}

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<ExecutionSettings>({
    maxPositionPct: 5,
    maxSlippageBps: 100,
    autoExecute: false,
    concurrentPositionCap: 5,
    killSwitchActive: false,
    userBalanceUsd: 0,
    venueMinOrderSizeUsd: 10,
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSettings();
  }, []);

  const fetchSettings = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await api.get<any>('/v1/me/execution-settings');
      if (data?.settings) {
        const solanaChain = data.chains?.find((c: any) => c.chain === 'solana');
        setSettings({
          maxPositionPct: data.settings.maxPositionPct ?? 5,
          maxSlippageBps: solanaChain?.maxSlippageBps ?? 100,
          autoExecute: Boolean(data.settings.autoExecute),
          concurrentPositionCap: data.settings.maxConcurrentPositions ?? 5,
          killSwitchActive: Boolean(data.settings.killed),
          userBalanceUsd: data.positionCap?.balanceUsd ?? 0,
          venueMinOrderSizeUsd: data.positionCap?.minOrderSizeUsd ?? 10,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Failed to fetch settings');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setSuccess(false);
    try {
      // S4-M4: Correct PATCH method and schema fields for execution-settings
      await api.patch('/v1/me/execution-settings', {
        maxPositionPct: settings.maxPositionPct,
        autoExecute: settings.autoExecute,
        maxConcurrentPositions: settings.concurrentPositionCap,
      });

      // Update per-chain slippage
      await api.put('/v1/me/execution-settings/chains/solana', {
        mode: settings.autoExecute ? 'live' : 'paper',
        maxSlippageBps: settings.maxSlippageBps,
      }).catch(() => null);

      setSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSuccess(false), 3000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Save failed: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleKillSwitch = async () => {
    const nextState = !settings.killSwitchActive;
    if (nextState && !confirm('WARNING: Activating emergency kill switch will immediately halt all automated trade executions for your account. Continue?')) {
      return;
    }
    setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, killSwitchActive: nextState }));
    try {
      // S6-8: Correct schema { killed: boolean }
      await api.put('/v1/me/execution-settings/kill-switch', { killed: nextState });
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Kill switch toggle failed: ${err.message}`);
      setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, killSwitchActive: !nextState }));
    }
  };

  // S6-25: Derived below-minimum calculation
  const positionSizeAtCap =
    settings.concurrentPositionCap > 0
      ? settings.userBalanceUsd / settings.concurrentPositionCap
      : 0;
  const isBelowMinimum = positionSizeAtCap < settings.venueMinOrderSizeUsd;
  const maxSafeCap = Math.max(1, Math.floor(settings.userBalanceUsd / settings.venueMinOrderSizeUsd));

  return (
    <div className="bg-background text-on-background min-h-screen antialiased font-sans">
      <SaaSNav />

      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-6 py-8">
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">
            Risk & Execution Controls
          </h1>
          <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">
            Configure automated sizing rules, position ceilings, maximum slippage tolerance, and emergency safety cutoffs.
          </p>
        </div>

        {error && <div className="mb-6"><ErrorBanner message={error} onRetry={fetchSettings} /></div>}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8">
          {/* Main Risk Form */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-8 bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8">
            {loading ? (
              <LoadingSkeleton rows={5} />
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-6">
                {/* 1. Max Position Size % */}
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <label className="font-bold text-sm text-primary">
                      Maximum Position Size (% of Available Float)
                    </label>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-sm text-primary">{settings.maxPositionPct}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="1"
                    max="25"
                    step="1"
                    value={settings.maxPositionPct}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, maxPositionPct: Number(e.target.value) }))
                    }
                    className="w-full accent-primary"
                  />
                  <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant mt-1 block">
                    Caps the maximum capital allocation per mirrored entry trade.
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* 2. Concurrent Position Cap + S6-25 Warning */}
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <label className="font-bold text-sm text-primary">
                      Concurrent Open Positions Cap
                    </label>
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold text-sm text-primary">
                      {settings.concurrentPositionCap} positions
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="1"
                    max="20"
                    step="1"
                    value={settings.concurrentPositionCap}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, concurrentPositionCap: Number(e.target.value) }))
                    }
                    className="w-full accent-primary"
                  />
                  <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant mt-1 block">
                    Estimated allocation per position: ~${positionSizeAtCap.toFixed(2)} USD (at current float of ${settings.userBalanceUsd.toFixed(2)}).
                  </span>

                  {/* S6-25 Warning Alert */}
                  {isBelowMinimum && (
                    <div className="mt-3 p-3 rounded-lg bg-status-warning/10 border border-status-warning/30 flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-status-warning">
                      <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base shrink-0">warning</span>
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-bold">Below-Minimum Allocation Warning:</span> At your current balance
                        (${settings.userBalanceUsd.toFixed(2)}), allocating across {settings.concurrentPositionCap} positions
                        drops each order below the venue minimum order size (${settings.venueMinOrderSizeUsd} USD).
                        Trades beyond {maxSafeCap} positions will be automatically skipped.
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* 3. Slippage Bps */}
                <div>
                  <label className="font-bold text-sm text-primary block mb-1">
                    Maximum Execution Slippage (Basis Points)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="10"
                    max="500"
                    value={settings.maxSlippageBps}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, maxSlippageBps: Number(e.target.value) }))
                    }
                    className="w-full bg-surface-container border border-border-subtle rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm font-mono outline-none focus:border-primary"
                  />
                  <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant mt-1 block">
                    100 bps = 1.00%. Orders experiencing price deviation above this threshold are rejected.
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* 4. Automated Execution Toggle */}
                <div className="pt-4 border-t border-border-subtle flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold text-sm text-primary">Autonomous On-Chain Execution</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">
                      When enabled, trades are executed immediately upon receiving master signals without manual prompts.
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={settings.autoExecute}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, autoExecute: e.target.checked }))
                    }
                    className="w-5 h-5 accent-primary cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4">
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={saving}
                    className="w-full py-3 bg-primary text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-sm hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                  >
                    {saving ? 'Saving Preferences...' : 'Save Risk Preferences'}
                  </button>
                  {success && (
                    <div className="text-center text-status-success text-xs font-semibold mt-2">
                      Preferences saved successfully!
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </form>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Emergency Kill Switch Card */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-4 bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-2xl p-6 flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-status-error/10 text-status-error flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">power_settings_new</span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="font-headline-md text-lg font-bold text-primary mb-2">
                Emergency Account Kill Switch
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed mb-6">
                Instantly disconnects your custody accounts from the automated execution queue. No new copy trades will be submitted
                until you deliberately turn this switch off.
              </p>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-low border border-border-subtle text-xs mb-6">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-mono">
                  <span>Current State:</span>
                  <span
                    className={`font-bold ${
                      settings.killSwitchActive ? 'text-status-error' : 'text-status-success'

                    {settings.killSwitchActive ? 'HALTED / ENGAGED' : 'ARMED / NORMAL'}

==> apps/web/app/setup/page.tsx <==
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { AdminNav } from '../../components/AdminNav.js';
import { api } from '../../lib/api.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../lib/api-error-message.js';

export default function SetupPage() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [scorerLoading, setScorerLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
  const [tokenMint, setTokenMint] = useState('');
  const [discoveryChain, setDiscoveryChain] = useState<'solana' | 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain'>('solana');
  const [blacklist, setBlacklist] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [newBlacklistMint, setNewBlacklistMint] = useState('');

  // Fetch blacklist config on load
  useEffect(() => {
    async function fetchConfig() {
      try {
        const config = await api.get<{ blacklist?: unknown }>('/v1/config');
        const rawValue = config?.blacklist;
        if (rawValue) {
          let parsedList: string[] = [];
          if (Array.isArray(rawValue)) {
            parsedList = rawValue;
          } else if (typeof rawValue === 'string') {
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(rawValue);
              parsedList = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [parsed];
            } catch {
              parsedList = rawValue.trim().startsWith('[')
                ? []
                : rawValue.split(',').map((s: string) => s.trim());
            }
          }
          setBlacklist(parsedList);
        } else {
          setBlacklist([]);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        // Surfaced in the error banner rather than only the console: a 401 here
        // means the blacklist shown below is not the saved one, and silently
        // rendering an empty list invites the operator to re-add every entry.
        setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to load configuration'));
      }
    }
    fetchConfig();
  }, []);

  const addToBlacklist = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const mint = newBlacklistMint.trim();
    if (!mint) return;
    if (blacklist.includes(mint)) {
      setError('Token address is already blacklisted');
      return;
    }

    const updatedList = [...blacklist, mint];
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');
    try {
      await api.post('/v1/config', { blacklist: updatedList });
      setBlacklist(updatedList);
      setNewBlacklistMint('');
      setSuccess(`Added token ${mint.substring(0, 8)}... to blacklist.`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to save blacklist configuration'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const removeFromBlacklist = async (mint: string) => {
    const updatedList = blacklist.filter(item => item !== mint);
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');
    try {
      await api.post('/v1/config', { blacklist: updatedList });
      setBlacklist(updatedList);
      setSuccess(`Removed token ${mint.substring(0, 8)}... from blacklist.`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to save blacklist configuration'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const triggerScorer = async () => {
    setScorerLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');

    try {
      await api.post('/v1/scorer/run', {});

      setSuccess('Scorer batch run successfully triggered in the background. Calculating wallet metrics, tiers, and generating clusters now.');
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to trigger scorer'));
    } finally {
      setScorerLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const triggerDiscovery = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!tokenMint.trim()) return;

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');

    try {
      const data = await api.post<{ tokenMint?: string; chain?: string }>('/v1/discovery/from-token', {
        tokenMint: tokenMint.trim(),
        chain: discoveryChain
      });

      const chainLabel = discoveryChain === 'solana' ? 'Solana' : discoveryChain === 'polygon' ? 'Polymarket' : 'Robinhood Chain';
      setSuccess(
        `Token discovery queued for ${data?.tokenMint ?? tokenMint} on ${chainLabel}. ` +
        `Early and biggest buyers will be backfilled, scored, and clustered automatically.`
      );
      setTokenMint('');
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(describeApiError(err, 'Failed to trigger discovery'));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-on-background antialiased font-sans">
      <AdminNav />
      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8">
        <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">Setup & Administration</h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant mb-6">
          Bootstrap the intelligence layer and trigger batch jobs.
        </p>

      {error && (
        <div className="card" style={{ background: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)', borderColor: 'var(--danger)', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', margin: 0 }}>{error}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="card" style={{ background: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1)', borderColor: 'var(--success)', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--success)', margin: 0 }}>{success}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr', marginTop: '2rem' }}>
        {/* Scorer status card */}
        <div className="card">
          <h3>Step 2: Run Scorer Batch</h3>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', margin: '1rem 0' }}>
            The scorer computes wallet metrics, assigns tiers, and generates clusters from tracked wallets.
            By default it runs at <strong>02:00 UTC</strong> daily.
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={triggerScorer}
            disabled={scorerLoading}
            style={{
              padding: '0.75rem 1.5rem',
              background: 'var(--warning)',
              color: 'black',
              border: 'none',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              fontWeight: 600,
              cursor: scorerLoading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
              opacity: scorerLoading ? 0.5 : 1,
              marginTop: '1rem'
            }}
          >
            {scorerLoading ? 'Running Scorer...' : 'Run Scorer Batch Now'}
          </button>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.85rem', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
            After the scorer runs, check <a href="/clusters" style={{ color: 'var(--accent)' }}>Clusters</a> to verify clusters were generated.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Discovery form */}
        <div className="card">
          <h3>Step 3: Discover Wallets from Token</h3>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', margin: '1rem 0' }}>
            Auto-discover profitable wallets that bought a token early (within 10 min of launch, &gt;0.5 SOL invested).
            This expands your seed wallet set.
          </p>
          <form onSubmit={triggerDiscovery}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.4rem', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="discoveryChain"
                  value="solana"
                  checked={discoveryChain === 'solana'}
                  onChange={() => setDiscoveryChain('solana')}
                />
                Solana
              </label>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.4rem', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="discoveryChain"
                  value="robinhood-chain"
                  checked={discoveryChain === 'robinhood-chain'}
                  onChange={() => setDiscoveryChain('robinhood-chain')}
                />
                Robinhood
              </label>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.4rem', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="discoveryChain"
                  value="polygon"
                  checked={discoveryChain === 'polygon'}
                  onChange={() => setDiscoveryChain('polygon')}
                />
                Polymarket (Polygon)
              </label>
            </div>
            <label style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.5rem', fontSize: '0.9rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
              {discoveryChain === 'solana' ? 'Token Mint Address' : 'ERC-20 Contract Address'}
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={
                discoveryChain === 'solana'
                  ? "TokenMintAddress111111111111111111111111111"
                  : "0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890"
              }
              value={tokenMint}
              onChange={(e) => setTokenMint(e.target.value)}
              style={{
                width: '100%',
                padding: '0.75rem',
                background: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border-color)',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                fontSize: '0.9rem',
                fontFamily: 'monospace'
              }}
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading || !tokenMint.trim()}
              style={{
                marginTop: '1rem',
                padding: '0.75rem 1.5rem',
                background: 'var(--accent)',
                color: 'white',
                border: 'none',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                fontWeight: 600,
                cursor: loading || !tokenMint.trim() ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
                opacity: loading || !tokenMint.trim() ? 0.5 : 1
              }}
            >
              {loading ? 'Discovering...' : 'Discover Wallets'}
            </button>
          </form>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '0.85rem', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
            Returns up to 50 early buyers. Run the scorer again after discovery completes.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Token Blacklist Card */}
        <div className="card">
          <h3>Token Blacklist Settings</h3>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', margin: '1rem 0' }}>
            Add token mint contract addresses (e.g. stablecoins USDC/USDT, or specific spam/honeypots) that you want to ignore. Coordinated buys/sells on these tokens will not generate intelligence signals.
          </p>
          <form onSubmit={addToBlacklist}>
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Token Mint Address to blacklist..."
                value={newBlacklistMint}

==> apps/web/app/signals/page.tsx <==
import Link from 'next/link';
import { AdminNav } from '../../components/AdminNav.js';
import { serverApiGet } from '../../lib/api-server.js';
import { describeApiError } from '../../lib/api-error-message.js';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

/**
 * Still a server component (checklist S6-3).
 *
 * The credential it used to send was the browser-exposed operator API key that
 * S6-3 deleted (see `lib/api.ts` for what that was and why it was fatal). What
 * replaces it is the operator's session cookie, which arrives on the *incoming
 * request* -- so the fetch stays on the server and `lib/api-server.ts` forwards
 * that cookie explicitly. `lib/api.ts` cannot be used here: it reads
 * `document.cookie` and `window.location`, neither of which exists during a
 * server render.
 *
 * `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` matters more now, not less: the response is
 * per-user, so it must never be cached or statically prerendered.
 */

/** Distinct from a data failure -- there is an action the reader can take. */
const SIGNED_OUT_MESSAGE = 'Sign in to view the signal stream.';

async function loadSignals(): Promise<{ signals: any[]; error: string | null }> {
  try {
    const data = await serverApiGet<{ items?: any[] }>('/v1/signals');
    // `null` means no session cookie on the request, or the API rejected it with
    // a 401. Either way it is "not signed in", not "no signals".
    if (data === null) return { signals: [], error: SIGNED_OUT_MESSAGE };
    return { signals: data.items ?? [], error: null };
  } catch (caught: unknown) {
    // The old version swallowed every failure and returned `[]`, so a broken API
    // rendered as a clean 'engine is monitoring'. Keep the page rendering, but
    // say which kind of failure it was.
    return { signals: [], error: describeApiError(caught, 'Unable to load signals.') };
  }
}

export default async function SignalsPage() {
  const { signals, error } = await loadSignals();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-on-background antialiased font-sans">
      <AdminNav />
      <main className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8">
        <h1 className="font-headline-lg text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary">Intelligence Signals</h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant mb-6">
          Live signal stream generated by the SWAT intelligence layer.
        </p>

        <div className="grid gap-4" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: '1fr' }}>
          {signals.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="card text-center p-8 bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl">
              {/* Without this an unauthenticated load rendered as 'no signals', which
                  is a false all-clear on a monitoring surface. */}
              <p style={{ color: error ? 'var(--danger)' : 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                {error ?? 'No active signals detected. The engine is monitoring.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            signals.map((signal: any) => (
              <div key={signal.id} className="card p-5 bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-primary mb-1">{(signal.pattern_type ?? 'unknown').toUpperCase()} SIGNAL</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-on-surface-variant mb-2">
                    <strong>Token:</strong> {signal.token_symbol ? `$${signal.token_symbol} (${signal.token_name})` : (signal.token_mint?.includes(':') ? signal.token_mint.split(':')[1] : signal.token_mint)} <br/>
                    {signal.token_symbol && <span className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant block mt-0.5">CA: <code>{signal.token_mint?.includes(':') ? signal.token_mint.split(':')[1] : signal.token_mint}</code></span>}
                    <strong>Cluster:</strong> {signal.cluster_id}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-status-warning/10 text-status-warning border border-status-warning/30">Confidence: {signal.confidence}%</span>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-status-success/10 text-status-success border border-status-success/30">Score: {signal.signal_score}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-left sm:text-right">
                  <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant font-mono">
                    {new Date(signal.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

type TierKey = 'free' | 'operator' | 'ultra' | 'lifetime';

interface TierOption {
  key: TierKey;
  name: string;
  price: string;
  period: string;
  description: string;
  badge?: string;
}

const TIER_OPTIONS: TierOption[] = [
  {
    key: 'free',
    name: 'Standard Free',
    price: '$0',
    period: 'forever',
    description: '1 master wallet slot, 5m delayed signals, manual execution',
  },

    period: 'one-time',
    description: 'Permanent Ultra access forever, priority fleet execution, zero recurring fees',
    badge: 'LIMITED',
  },
];

function SignupForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const requestedTier = searchParams.get('tier') as TierKey | null;

  // Default to requested tier from URL, or Operator as the recommended plan
  const [selectedTier, setSelectedTier] = useState<TierKey>(() => {
    if (requestedTier && ['free', 'operator', 'ultra', 'lifetime'].includes(requestedTier)) {
      return requestedTier;
    }
    return 'operator';
  });

  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [termsAccepted, setTermsAccepted] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const selectedTierConfig = TIER_OPTIONS.find((t) => t.key === selectedTier) || TIER_OPTIONS[1]!;

  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    if (password.length < 8) {
      setError('Password must be at least 8 characters long.');
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError('Passwords do not match.');
      return;
    }

    if (!termsAccepted) {
      setError('You must accept the Terms of Service to continue.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/v1/auth/signup', {
        email,
        password,
        displayName: displayName.trim() || undefined,
      });

      // Session cookies are established automatically by the API response.
      // If user selected a paid tier, direct them to billing checkout; otherwise dashboard.
      if (selectedTier && selectedTier !== 'free') {
        router.push(`/billing?selected=${selectedTier}`);
      } else {
        router.push('/dashboard');
      }
    } catch (caught) {
      if (caught instanceof ApiError) {
        if (caught.status === 409) {
          setError('An account with this email already exists. Please sign in.');
        } else {
          setError(caught.message || 'Signup failed.');
        }
      } else {
        setError('Could not reach the server. Please try again.');
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-background text-on-background min-h-screen antialiased font-sans flex items-center justify-center px-4 sm:px-6 py-12">
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-surface-container-lowest border border-border-subtle rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-10 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-6">
          <Link href="/" className="inline-block hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity">
            <WakeLogo size="md" />
          </Link>
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold bg-surface-container text-on-surface-variant border border-border-subtle">
            STAGE 4 // SECURE
          </span>
        </div>

        <h1 className="font-headline-md text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight mb-2 text-primary">
          Create Your Trading Account
        </h1>
        <p className="text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant mb-8">
          Select your plan and set up your non-custodial copy-trading environment.
        </p>

        {/* Step 1: Select Your Tier */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <label className="text-label-caps text-on-surface-variant uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] font-bold">
              1. Choose Access Tier
            </label>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-primary font-semibold">
              Selected: {selectedTierConfig.name} ({selectedTierConfig.price})
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {TIER_OPTIONS.map((tier) => {
              const isSelected = selectedTier === tier.key;
              return (
                <div
                  key={tier.key}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedTier(tier.key)}
                  className={`relative cursor-pointer rounded-xl p-4 transition-all border text-left flex flex-col justify-between ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'border-primary bg-primary/5 ring-2 ring-primary/20 shadow-sm'
                      : 'border-border-subtle bg-surface-container/30 hover:border-border hover:bg-surface-container-low'
                  }`}
                >
                  {tier.badge && (
                    <span className="absolute top-2.5 right-2.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase bg-primary text-white">
                      {tier.badge}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                      <div
                        className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
                          isSelected ? 'border-primary bg-primary' : 'border-border-subtle bg-transparent'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {isSelected && <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white" />}
                      </div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-primary">{tier.name}</h4>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-lg font-black text-primary mb-1 pl-6">
