-- 063_crypto_billing.sql
--
-- Pure crypto-native billing ledger in USDC for Solana and Polygon (checklist Stage 5).
--
-- Replaces fiat/Stripe payment infrastructure to eliminate banking bottlenecks,
-- chargeback risk, and fiat de-platforming. Supports:
--   - Operator Tier: 35 USDC / 30 Days (Stackable)
--   - Ultra Tier: 150 USDC / 30 Days (Stackable)
--   - Lifetime Pass: 1999 USDC (Permanent access; tier_expires_at = NULL per 039)
--
-- Idempotent: CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS only. Replays cleanly on migrate.ts.

-- 1. Crypto payments ledger (audit trail and replay-attack guard)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crypto_payments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  chain VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'polygon')),
  tx_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  amount_usdc NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL CHECK (amount_usdc > 0),
  tier VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (tier IN ('operator', 'ultra')),
  plan_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (plan_id IN ('operator_monthly', 'ultra_monthly', 'lifetime')),
  duration_days INT CHECK (duration_days IS NULL OR duration_days > 0),
  payer_address VARCHAR(128),
  treasury_address VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  memo VARCHAR(64),
  status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed'
    CHECK (status IN ('confirmed', 'underpaid', 'refund_requested')),
  confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Crucial security constraint: a blockchain transaction hash on a given chain
-- can NEVER be credited more than once across the entire system.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_crypto_payments_chain_tx
  ON crypto_payments(chain, tx_hash);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_crypto_payments_user
  ON crypto_payments(user_id, confirmed_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_crypto_payments_memo
  ON crypto_payments(memo)
  WHERE memo IS NOT NULL;


-- 2. User payment intents (tracks reference memos for external / exchange deposits)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_payment_intents (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  reference_memo VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  plan_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (plan_id IN ('operator_monthly', 'ultra_monthly', 'lifetime')),
  tier VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (tier IN ('operator', 'ultra')),
  expected_amount_usdc NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL CHECK (expected_amount_usdc > 0),
  status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'completed', 'expired')),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_user_payment_intents_memo
  ON user_payment_intents(reference_memo);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_payment_intents_user
  ON user_payment_intents(user_id, status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_payment_intents_expiry
  ON user_payment_intents(expires_at)
  WHERE status = 'pending';

==> packages/db/sql/064_row_level_security.sql <==
-- 064_row_level_security.sql
--
-- Row-Level Security (RLS) for tenant isolation across all user-scoped tables.
--
-- Defense-in-depth security model:
--   1. Functions:
--      - current_app_user_id(): Extracts 'app.current_user_id' setting as UUID (returns NULL if unset/invalid).
--      - is_rls_bypassed(): Checks 'app.bypass_rls' = 'on' OR 'app.current_user_id' = '*'.
--        Crucially, untrusted/app role 'swat_app' is forbidden from bypassing RLS under any condition.
--   2. Policies:
--      - 'tenant_isolation_policy' on all 17 user-scoped tables.
--      - Evaluates USING and WITH CHECK to guarantee no cross-tenant reads, updates, deletes, or inserts.
--   3. FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY:
--      - Ensures table owners are bound by RLS policies.
--   4. Role 'swat_app':
--      - Least-privilege application role with NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS for production application pools.
--
-- Idempotent: Replays cleanly on migrate.ts.

-- 1. Helper Functions
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION current_app_user_id() RETURNS uuid STABLE AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), '')::uuid;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_rls_bypassed() RETURNS boolean STABLE AS $$
BEGIN
  -- An unprivileged app role can NEVER bypass RLS even if it attempts to set session flags
  IF CURRENT_USER = 'swat_app' THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  RETURN (
    current_setting('app.bypass_rls', true) = 'on'
    OR current_setting('app.current_user_id', true) = '*'
    OR (
      current_setting('app.bypass_rls', true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'off'
      AND NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id', true), '') IS NULL
    )
  );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- 2. Create swat_app role if it doesn't already exist
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'swat_app') THEN
    CREATE ROLE swat_app WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'swat_app' NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS;
  END IF;
END $$;

GRANT swat_app TO swat WITH SET TRUE;
DO $$
BEGIN
  EXECUTE format('GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE %I TO swat_app', current_database());
END $$;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO swat_app;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO swat_app;
GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO swat_app;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO swat_app;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO swat_app;

-- 3. Configure RLS Policies on all 17 User-Scoped Tables
DO $$
DECLARE
  tbl text;
  tables text[] := ARRAY[
    'user_sessions',
    'user_auth_wallets',
    'user_api_keys',
    'user_balances',
    'user_wallet_subscriptions',
    'user_token_watches',
    'user_execution_grants',
    'user_execution_settings',
    'user_chain_execution_settings',
    'user_payment_intents',
    'crypto_payments',
    'copy_positions',
    'copy_executions',
    'copy_position_master_lots',
    'copy_position_applications',
    'copy_position_close_all_claims'
  ];
BEGIN
  -- 3a. Table 'users' (identity column is 'id')
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'users') THEN
    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY';
    EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE users FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY';
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies 
      WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'users' AND policyname = 'tenant_isolation_policy'
    ) THEN
      EXECUTE 'CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_policy ON users FOR ALL USING (is_rls_bypassed() OR id = current_app_user_id()) WITH CHECK (is_rls_bypassed() OR id = current_app_user_id())';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 3b. Tables where tenant discriminator column is 'user_id'
  FOREACH tbl IN ARRAY tables LOOP
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = tbl) THEN
      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', tbl);
      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', tbl);
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies 
        WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = tbl AND policyname = 'tenant_isolation_policy'
      ) THEN
        EXECUTE format(
          'CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_policy ON %I FOR ALL USING (is_rls_bypassed() OR user_id = current_app_user_id()) WITH CHECK (is_rls_bypassed() OR user_id = current_app_user_id())',
          tbl
        );
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END $$;

-- Row Level Security for Perps tables
DO $$
DECLARE
  tbl text;
  tables text[] := ARRAY[
    'polymarket_perps_accounts',
    'polymarket_perps_positions',
    'polymarket_perps_orders'
  ];
BEGIN
  FOREACH tbl IN ARRAY tables LOOP
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = tbl) THEN
      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', tbl);
      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY', tbl);
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies 
        WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = tbl AND policyname = 'tenant_isolation_policy'
      ) THEN
        EXECUTE format(
          'CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_policy ON %I FOR ALL USING (is_rls_bypassed() OR user_id = current_app_user_id()) WITH CHECK (is_rls_bypassed() OR user_id = current_app_user_id())',
          tbl
        );
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END $$;

==> packages/db/sql/066_lp_dashboard.sql <==
-- 059_lp_dashboard.sql
-- LP Dashboard (apps/lp): pool discovery cache, user LP positions, risk
-- guardrail configuration, and tracked LP wallets.
--
-- Track A of the LP Dashboard build plan. Two tables here are caches of an
-- on-chain or computed fact (`lp_pools`, the scanner's output) and follow the
-- `user_balances` precedent: replaceable, CASCADE on user delete, staleness is
-- carried as data. The others are fund-touching (`lp_positions`, its state
-- history) and follow the `copy_executions` precedent: an SQL-level state
-- machine (CHECK + transition trigger + history table), not just a code one.
--
-- Chain coverage is deliberately narrower than the platform: LP operates on
-- Meteora DLMM (Solana) and Uniswap v3/v4 (Robinhood Chain) only ‚Äî
-- `LpChain` in `@swat/shared` mirrors these CHECKs.
--
-- Addresses follow the repo-wide invariant: pool, position, and mint columns
-- are chain-prefixed (`solana:‚Ä¶`, `robinhood-chain:0x‚Ä¶`). The reserve
-- sub-vault pointer is a user-owned account and follows the `047` convention:
-- NOT chain-prefixed; the `*_chain` column carries the discriminator.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. lp_pools ‚Äî the scanner's discovery cache (Tracks B and C write, H reads).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_pools (
  id                UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  chain             VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'robinhood-chain')),
  protocol          VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL CHECK (protocol IN ('meteora-dlmm', 'uniswap-v3', 'uniswap-v4')),
  pool_address      VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  pair_label        VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  base_token_mint   VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  quote_token_mint  VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  fee_bps           NUMERIC(12,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fee_bps >= 0),
  bin_step          INTEGER,
  tick_spacing      INTEGER,
  -- Quote-per-base at scan time; anchors ladder planning between scans.
  current_price     NUMERIC,
  tvl               NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tvl >= 0),
  active_tvl        NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (active_tvl >= 0),
  volume_24h        NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (volume_24h >= 0),
  fee_apr_24h       NUMERIC CHECK (fee_apr_24h IS NULL OR fee_apr_24h >= 0),
  fee_apr_7d        NUMERIC CHECK (fee_apr_7d IS NULL OR fee_apr_7d >= 0),
  -- Written by Track C. NULL means "not yet risk-assessed": the Discover feed
  -- must not show such a row, so its index is partial on this column.
  risk_score        NUMERIC CHECK (risk_score IS NULL OR (risk_score >= 0 AND risk_score <= 100)),
  risk_flags        JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  last_scanned_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at        TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_lp_pools_identity UNIQUE (chain, protocol, pool_address),
  -- Meteora pools are bin-based, Uniswap pools tick-based; exactly one shape.
  CONSTRAINT chk_lp_pools_granularity CHECK (
    (protocol = 'meteora-dlmm' AND bin_step IS NOT NULL AND tick_spacing IS NULL)
    OR (protocol IN ('uniswap-v3', 'uniswap-v4') AND tick_spacing IS NOT NULL AND bin_step IS NULL)
  )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_pools_discovery
  ON lp_pools (chain, volume_24h DESC)
  WHERE risk_score IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_pools_scanned_at
  ON lp_pools (last_scanned_at);

COMMENT ON TABLE lp_pools IS
  'Scanner output cache: one row per LP pool seen on a supported chain. Risk columns come from the Track C risk filter; rows without a risk score never reach the Discover feed.';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. lp_guardrail_configs ‚Äî per-user risk guardrails (Track G reads).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_guardrail_configs (
  user_id                   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  -- Cap on the share of the user's deployed LP capital a single pool may hold.
  max_pool_allocation_pct   NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 50.00
    CHECK (max_pool_allocation_pct > 0 AND max_pool_allocation_pct <= 100),
  -- Share of realized profit swept to the reserve sub-vault on close/harvest.
  profit_bank_pct           NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 50.00
    CHECK (profit_bank_pct >= 0 AND profit_bank_pct <= 100),
  -- User-owned reserve account (NOT chain-prefixed ‚Äî 047 convention). The
  -- pairing constraint mirrors `chk_ueg_secret_matches_kind`: both halves or
  -- neither. The account itself is an existing non-custodial vault pattern
  -- (ADR-0003), not a new custody path.
  reserve_sub_vault_chain   VARCHAR(32) CHECK (reserve_sub_vault_chain IN ('solana', 'robinhood-chain')),
  reserve_sub_vault_address VARCHAR(128),
  updated_at                TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_lp_guardrail_configs_user UNIQUE (user_id),
  CONSTRAINT chk_lp_guardrail_reserve_pairing CHECK (
    (reserve_sub_vault_chain IS NULL) = (reserve_sub_vault_address IS NULL)
  )
);

COMMENT ON TABLE lp_guardrail_configs IS
  'Per-user LP risk guardrails: single-pool exposure cap, profit-banking share, and the reserve sub-vault profit sweeps land in. Defaults are the plan defaults (50% / 50%).';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. lp_positions ‚Äî the user's laddered LP positions (Tracks E, F, G, H).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_positions (
  id                        UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id                   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  chain                     VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'robinhood-chain')),
  protocol                  VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (protocol IN ('meteora-dlmm', 'uniswap-v3', 'uniswap-v4')),
  pool_address              VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  -- Ladder distribution: Meteora strategy shapes; Uniswap maps 'spot' to a
  -- narrow full-range-ish rung set, 'curve'/'bidask' to weighted tick rungs.
  strategy_type             VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (strategy_type IN ('spot', 'curve', 'bidask')),
  -- Human-readable price bounds of the whole ladder, in quote-per-base terms.
  range_lower               NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (range_lower > 0),
  range_upper               NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (range_upper > range_lower),
  -- Per-rung array, ordered: [{ priceLower, priceUpper, weight, binId?, tickLower?, tickUpper? }, ‚Ä¶].
  rung_allocations          JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  deposit_amount            NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (deposit_amount > 0),
  deposit_asset             VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  state                     VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'building'
    CHECK (state IN ('building', 'active', 'near_edge', 'out_of_range', 'rebalancing', 'closed')),
  -- Chain-prefixed. NULL while the ladder is still being built or is paper-only.
  on_chain_position_address VARCHAR(128),
  opened_at                 TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  closed_at                 TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at                TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  -- A closed position carries its close time; an open one does not. Evaluated
  -- after the BEFORE trigger below runs, so the closing UPDATE sets both.
  CONSTRAINT chk_lp_positions_close_pairing CHECK (
    (state = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL)
  )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_positions_monitor
  ON lp_positions (chain, state)
  WHERE state IN ('active', 'near_edge', 'out_of_range');

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_positions_user
  ON lp_positions (user_id, opened_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_positions_pool
  ON lp_positions (pool_address)
  WHERE state <> 'closed';

COMMENT ON TABLE lp_positions IS
  'One user LP ladder. Fund-touching: state transitions are enforced twice (code, via canTransitionLpPosition in @swat/shared; SQL, via the trigger below) and every transition is journaled.';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. lp_position_state_history ‚Äî the journal the trigger and code both append.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_position_state_history (
  id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  position_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lp_positions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  from_state  VARCHAR(32),
  to_state    VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL
    CHECK (to_state IN ('building', 'active', 'near_edge', 'out_of_range', 'rebalancing', 'closed')),
  reason      TEXT,
  changed_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_position_state_history_position
  ON lp_position_state_history (position_id, changed_at);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. State-machine trigger ‚Äî cloned from enforce_copy_execution_state_transition
-- (028) with the LP transition table. The machine in @swat/shared
-- (LP_POSITION_TRANSITIONS) is the readable source of truth; this trigger makes
-- an incoherent row unrepresentable even if a future caller skips the code path.
-- Keep the two tables in sync when a state is added.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_lp_position_state_transition()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.state = OLD.state THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NOT (
    (OLD.state = 'building' AND NEW.state IN ('active', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'active' AND NEW.state IN ('near_edge', 'out_of_range', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'near_edge' AND NEW.state IN ('active', 'out_of_range', 'rebalancing', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'out_of_range' AND NEW.state IN ('active', 'rebalancing', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'rebalancing' AND NEW.state IN ('active', 'near_edge', 'out_of_range', 'closed'))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid lp position transition: % -> %', OLD.state, NEW.state;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_lp_position_state_transition ON lp_positions;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_lp_position_state_transition
  BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON lp_positions
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_lp_position_state_transition();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. lp_tracked_wallets + observation tables ‚Äî the LP wallet indexer (Track D).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_tracked_wallets (
  id                      UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  chain                   VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'robinhood-chain')),
  -- Chain-prefixed: a tracked external wallet, same shape as `source_trades.wallet_address`.
  wallet_address          VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  label                   VARCHAR(128),
  polling_cadence_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 300
    CHECK (polling_cadence_seconds BETWEEN 30 AND 86400),
  last_indexed_at         TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at              TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_lp_tracked_wallets_identity UNIQUE (chain, wallet_address)
);

-- Time series the PnL calculator consumes: one row per observed position per pass.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_wallet_snapshots (
  id                 UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tracked_wallet_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lp_tracked_wallets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position_address   VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  pool_address       VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  captured_at        TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  position_value_usd NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (position_value_usd >= 0),
  uncollected_fees_usd NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (uncollected_fees_usd >= 0),
  in_range           BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_lp_wallet_snapshots_observation
    UNIQUE (tracked_wallet_id, position_address, captured_at)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_wallet_snapshots_series
  ON lp_wallet_snapshots (tracked_wallet_id, position_address, captured_at);

-- Computed per-position outcomes (Track D3/D5). The indexer upserts one row per
-- position it can close the books on; the leaderboard query aggregates only this
-- table, so the screen never re-derives PnL from the raw series at request time.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_wallet_position_results (
  id                 UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tracked_wallet_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lp_tracked_wallets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position_address   VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  pool_address       VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  chain              VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'robinhood-chain')),
  strategy_type      VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (strategy_type IN ('spot', 'curve', 'bidask')),
  net_result_usd     NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  first_observed_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  last_observed_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  closed             BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  updated_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_lp_wallet_position_results UNIQUE (tracked_wallet_id, position_address)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_wallet_position_results_wallet
  ON lp_wallet_position_results (tracked_wallet_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE lp_wallet_position_results IS
  'Net LP result per tracked wallet position, computed by the Track D PnL calculator from lp_wallet_snapshots series. Aggregated by the leaderboard query; win rate counts closed rows only.';

==> packages/db/sql/067_lp_auto_rebalance.sql <==
-- 060_lp_auto_rebalance.sql
-- Track I: per-position auto-rebalance opt-in + manual rebalance transitions.
--
-- Two changes, both forward-only:
--
-- 1. `lp_positions.auto_rebalance` ‚Äî the user's explicit opt-in. The scheduled
--    monitor (Track F6) no longer fires rebalances by default: it re-labels
--    range states and records the recommendation; only a position whose owner
--    opted in gets queued for automatic rebalancing. Manual triggers (Track I)
--    do not need this flag ‚Äî the user IS the consent.
--
-- 2. The state machine gains `active ‚Üí rebalancing`: the manual trigger may
--    re-center an in-range position on purpose. The scheduled monitor never
--    uses that edge ‚Äî it only re-labels from price observations ‚Äî so the
--    trigger's SQL function is replaced here (CREATE OR REPLACE, idempotent)
--    and `@swat/shared`'s LP_POSITION_TRANSITIONS carries the same table.

ALTER TABLE lp_positions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_rebalance BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

COMMENT ON COLUMN lp_positions.auto_rebalance IS
  'Track I: owner opted into automatic rebalancing. The monitor only queues rebalances for opted-in positions; manual triggers bypass this flag.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_lp_position_state_transition()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.state = OLD.state THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NOT (
    (OLD.state = 'building' AND NEW.state IN ('active', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'active' AND NEW.state IN ('near_edge', 'out_of_range', 'rebalancing', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'near_edge' AND NEW.state IN ('active', 'out_of_range', 'rebalancing', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'out_of_range' AND NEW.state IN ('active', 'rebalancing', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'rebalancing' AND NEW.state IN ('active', 'near_edge', 'out_of_range', 'closed'))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid lp position transition: % -> %', OLD.state, NEW.state;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

==> packages/db/sql/069_lp_copy_trading.sql <==
-- 062_lp_copy_trading.sql
-- Forward-Only LP Copy-Trading: Subscriptions, Executions, and Activity Logs.

-- 1. Subscriptions: A user follows an external LP master wallet on a specific chain & venue
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_copy_subscriptions (
  id                          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id                     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  master_wallet_address       VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, -- chain-prefixed, e.g. 'solana:...' or 'base:0x...'
  chain                       VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'robinhood-chain', 'base', 'ethereum', 'bsc')),
  venue                       VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (venue IN ('meteora-dlmm', 'raydium-clmm', 'uniswap-v3', 'uniswap-v4', 'pancakeswap-v3')),
  allocated_budget_usd        NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (allocated_budget_usd > 0),
  max_capital_per_position_usd NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK (max_capital_per_position_usd > 0),
  status                      VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'paused', 'closed')),
  created_at                  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at                  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_lp_copy_subscriptions_user_master UNIQUE (user_id, master_wallet_address, chain, venue)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_copy_subscriptions_master
  ON lp_copy_subscriptions (master_wallet_address, chain, status)
  WHERE status = 'active';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_copy_subscriptions_user
  ON lp_copy_subscriptions (user_id, status);

-- 2. Copy Executions: Every mirrored mint, burn, or harvest pass journaled
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lp_copy_executions (
  id                          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  subscription_id             UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES lp_copy_subscriptions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id                     UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  master_position_id          VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, -- on-chain ID or NFT tokenId of master
  follower_position_id        UUID REFERENCES lp_positions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  chain                       VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (chain IN ('solana', 'robinhood-chain', 'base', 'ethereum', 'bsc')),
  action                      VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('mint', 'increase', 'decrease', 'burn', 'collect')),
  master_deposit_usd          NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (master_deposit_usd >= 0),
  follower_deposit_usd        NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (follower_deposit_usd >= 0),
  scale_ratio                 NUMERIC NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0 CHECK (scale_ratio > 0),
  status                      VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'executing', 'executed', 'failed', 'rejected')),
  error_message               TEXT,
  created_at                  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at                  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_copy_executions_sub
  ON lp_copy_executions (subscription_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lp_copy_executions_master_pos
  ON lp_copy_executions (master_position_id, chain);

function runQuery(poolOrClient: Pool | PoolClient | undefined, sql: string, params: unknown[] = []) {
  if (poolOrClient && typeof (poolOrClient as any).query === 'function') {
    return (poolOrClient as any).query(sql, params);
  }
  return query(sql, params).then((rows) => ({ rows }));
}

export async function getAdminPortfolioOverview(
  poolOrClient?: Pool | PoolClient
): Promise<AdminPortfolioOverview> {
  const q = `
    SELECT
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(usd) FROM user_balances WHERE usd > 0), 0)::numeric AS cash_float,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cost_basis_usd) FROM copy_positions WHERE confirmed_quantity > 0), 0)::numeric AS positions_value,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM trades WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND direction = 'sell'), 0)::numeric -
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM trades WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND direction = 'buy'), 0)::numeric AS net_realized_pnl,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM trades WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND direction = 'sell' AND executed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'), 0)::numeric -
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM trades WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND direction = 'buy' AND executed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'), 0)::numeric AS net_realized_pnl_24h,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(fee_usd) FROM trades WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL), 0)::numeric AS gas_tip_burn,
      COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_wallet_subscriptions WHERE state = 'active'), 0)::bigint AS active_copiers,
      COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM copy_positions WHERE confirmed_quantity > 0), 0)::bigint AS open_positions_count
  `;

  const { rows } = await runQuery(poolOrClient, q);
  const row = rows[0] || {};
  const cashFloat = Number(row.cash_float || 0);
  const posValue = Number(row.positions_value || 0);
  const realizedPnl = Number(row.net_realized_pnl || 0);
  const realizedPnl24h = Number(row.net_realized_pnl_24h || 0);
  const gasTipBurn = Number(row.gas_tip_burn || 0);
  const activeCopiers = Number(row.active_copiers || 0);
  const openPosCount = Number(row.open_positions_count || 0);

  // Win rate: winning sells vs total sells
  const winRateQ = `
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount_usd > 0) AS wins,
      COUNT(*) AS total_sells
    FROM trades
    WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND direction = 'sell'
  `;
  const winRes = await runQuery(poolOrClient, winRateQ);
  const totalSells = Number(winRes.rows[0]?.total_sells || 0);
  const wins = Number(winRes.rows[0]?.wins || 0);
  const winRatePct = totalSells > 0 ? Number(((wins / totalSells) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;

  return {
    totalFleetAumUsd: Number((cashFloat + posValue).toFixed(2)),
    netRealizedPnlUsd: Number(realizedPnl.toFixed(2)),
    netRealizedPnl24hUsd: Number(realizedPnl24h.toFixed(2)),
    unrealizedPnlUsd: 0,
    fleetWinRatePct: winRatePct,
    cumulativeGasTipBurnUsd: Number(gasTipBurn.toFixed(2)),
    totalCopiersActive: activeCopiers,
    openPositionsCount: openPosCount,
  };
}

export async function getAdminPortfolioUsers(
  poolOrOptions?: Pool | PoolClient | { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string; tier?: string },
  maybeOptions?: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string; tier?: string }
): Promise<{ users: AdminPortfolioUserSummary[]; total: number }> {
  let poolOrClient: Pool | PoolClient | undefined;
  let options: { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string; tier?: string } = {};

  if (poolOrOptions && typeof (poolOrOptions as any).query === 'function') {
    poolOrClient = poolOrOptions as Pool | PoolClient;
    options = maybeOptions ?? {};
  } else if (poolOrOptions && typeof poolOrOptions === 'object') {
    options = poolOrOptions as { page?: number; limit?: number; search?: string; tier?: string };
  } else {
    options = maybeOptions ?? {};
  }

  const page = Math.max(1, options.page ?? 1);
  const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, options.limit ?? 25));
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

  const filters: string[] = [];
  const params: unknown[] = [];

  if (options.tier) {
    params.push(options.tier);
    filters.push(`u.tier = $${params.length}`);
  }

  if (options.search) {
    params.push(`%${options.search}%`);
    filters.push(`(u.email ILIKE $${params.length} OR u.id::text ILIKE $${params.length})`);
  }

  const whereClause = filters.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')}` : '';

  const countQ = `SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM users u ${whereClause}`;
  const countRes = await runQuery(poolOrClient, countQ, params);
  const total = Number(countRes.rows[0]?.total || 0);

  params.push(limit);
  const limitIdx = params.length;
  params.push(offset);
  const offsetIdx = params.length;

  const usersQ = `
    SELECT
      u.id,
      u.email,
      u.role,
      u.tier,
      u.created_at,
      u.tier_expires_at,
      CASE WHEN u.tier_expires_at IS NOT NULL THEN u.tier_expires_at + INTERVAL '3 days' ELSE NULL END AS grace_period_ends_at,
      COALESCE(es.killed, false) AS kill_switch_active,
      COALESCE(bal.total_cash, 0)::numeric AS total_cash,
      COALESCE(pos.open_positions_count, 0)::bigint AS open_positions_count,
      COALESCE(pos.open_positions_value, 0)::numeric AS open_positions_value,
      COALESCE(tr.trades_24h, 0)::bigint AS trades_24h,
      COALESCE(tr.realized_pnl, 0)::numeric AS realized_pnl
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN user_execution_settings es ON es.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT user_id, SUM(usd) AS total_cash
      FROM user_balances
      GROUP BY user_id
    ) bal ON bal.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS open_positions_count, SUM(cost_basis_usd) AS open_positions_value
      FROM copy_positions
      WHERE confirmed_quantity > 0
      GROUP BY user_id
    ) pos ON pos.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        user_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE executed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS trades_24h,
        SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'sell' THEN amount_usd ELSE -amount_usd END) AS realized_pnl
      FROM trades
      WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY user_id
    ) tr ON tr.user_id = u.id
    ${whereClause}
    ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
    LIMIT $${limitIdx} OFFSET $${offsetIdx}
  `;

  const { rows } = await runQuery(poolOrClient, usersQ, params);

  // Enrich with grants and subscriptions
  const userIds = rows.map((r: any) => r.id);
  const grantsMap: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {};
  const subsMap: Record<string, AdminPortfolioUserSummary['copiedMasters']> = {};

  if (userIds.length > 0) {
    const grantsRes = await runQuery(
      poolOrClient,
      `SELECT user_id, chain, grant_kind AS grant_type
       FROM user_execution_grants
       WHERE user_id = ANY($1) AND revoked_at IS NULL`,
      [userIds]
    );
    for (const g of grantsRes.rows) {
      if (!grantsMap[g.user_id]) grantsMap[g.user_id] = {};
      grantsMap[g.user_id][g.chain] = g.grant_type;
    }

    const subsRes = await runQuery(
      poolOrClient,
      `SELECT uws.user_id, uws.wallet_address, uws.label, w.chain, uws.state, uws.membership_slot
       FROM user_wallet_subscriptions uws
       LEFT JOIN wallets w ON w.address = uws.wallet_address
       WHERE uws.user_id = ANY($1)
       ORDER BY uws.created_at DESC`,
      [userIds]
    );
    for (const s of subsRes.rows) {
      if (!subsMap[s.user_id]) subsMap[s.user_id] = [];
      subsMap[s.user_id].push({
        masterAddress: s.wallet_address,
        label: s.label,
        chain: s.chain || 'solana',
        state: s.state || 'active',
        membershipSlot: s.membership_slot !== null ? Number(s.membership_slot) : null,
      });
    }
  }

  const users: AdminPortfolioUserSummary[] = rows.map((r: any) => ({
    id: r.id,
    email: r.email,
    role: r.role,
    tier: r.tier,
    createdAt: r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
    tierExpiresAt: r.tier_expires_at ? new Date(r.tier_expires_at).toISOString() : null,
    gracePeriodEndsAt: r.grace_period_ends_at ? new Date(r.grace_period_ends_at).toISOString() : null,
    custodyStatus: grantsMap[r.id] || {},
    totalCashFloatUsd: Number(Number(r.total_cash || 0).toFixed(2)),
    copiedMasters: subsMap[r.id] || [],
    openPositionsCount: Number(r.open_positions_count || 0),
    openPositionsValueUsd: Number(Number(r.open_positions_value || 0).toFixed(2)),
    unrealizedPnlUsd: 0,
    realizedPnlUsd: Number(Number(r.realized_pnl || 0).toFixed(2)),
    trades24hCount: Number(r.trades_24h || 0),
    killSwitchActive: Boolean(r.kill_switch_active),
  }));

  return { users, total };
}

export async function getAdminPortfolioUserDetail(
  userIdOrPool: string | Pool | PoolClient | undefined,
  maybeUserId?: string
): Promise<AdminPortfolioUserDetail | null> {
  let poolOrClient: Pool | PoolClient | undefined;
  let userId: string;

  if (typeof userIdOrPool === 'string') {
    userId = userIdOrPool;
  } else if (userIdOrPool && typeof (userIdOrPool as any).query === 'function') {
    poolOrClient = userIdOrPool as Pool | PoolClient;
    userId = maybeUserId || '';
  } else {
    userId = maybeUserId || '';
  }
  const userRes = await runQuery(
    poolOrClient,
    `SELECT u.id, u.email, u.role, u.tier, u.created_at, u.tier_expires_at,
            CASE WHEN u.tier_expires_at IS NOT NULL THEN u.tier_expires_at + INTERVAL '3 days' ELSE NULL END AS grace_period_ends_at,
            COALESCE(es.killed, false) AS kill_switch_active,
            COALESCE((SELECT max_slippage_bps FROM user_chain_execution_settings WHERE user_id = u.id LIMIT 1), 100) AS max_slippage_bps
     FROM users u
     LEFT JOIN user_execution_settings es ON es.user_id = u.id
     WHERE u.id = $1`,
    [userId]
  );

  if (userRes.rows.length === 0) return null;
  const u = userRes.rows[0];

  const balancesRes = await runQuery(
    poolOrClient,
    `SELECT chain, asset, usd AS balance_usd, amount AS balance_native, COALESCE(fetched_at, NOW()) AS updated_at
     FROM user_balances
     WHERE user_id = $1
     ORDER BY chain, asset`,
    [userId]
  );

  const positionsRes = await runQuery(
    poolOrClient,
    `SELECT cp.id, cp.chain, cp.token_mint, cp.confirmed_quantity, cp.cost_basis_usd,
            cpm.master_wallet_address
     FROM copy_positions cp
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
       SELECT master_wallet_address
       FROM copy_position_master_lots
       WHERE position_id = cp.id AND remaining_quantity > 0
       LIMIT 1
     ) cpm ON true
     WHERE cp.user_id = $1 AND cp.confirmed_quantity > 0
     ORDER BY cp.cost_basis_usd DESC`,
    [userId]
  );

  const subsRes = await runQuery(
    poolOrClient,
    `SELECT uws.wallet_address, COALESCE(w.chain, 'solana') AS chain, uws.label, uws.source,
            uws.state, uws.membership_slot, uws.created_at
     FROM user_wallet_subscriptions uws
     LEFT JOIN wallets w ON w.address = uws.wallet_address
     WHERE uws.user_id = $1
     ORDER BY uws.created_at DESC`,
    [userId]
  );

  const execRes = await runQuery(
    poolOrClient,
    `SELECT id, chain, token_mint, direction, execution_mode,
            confirmed_base_quantity, confirmed_quote_quantity,
            fee_usd, transaction_hash, confirmed_at
     FROM copy_executions
     WHERE user_id = $1
     ORDER BY created_at DESC
     LIMIT 50`,
    [userId]
  );

  return {
    user: {
      id: u.id,
      email: u.email,
      role: u.role,
      tier: u.tier,
      createdAt: u.created_at ? new Date(u.created_at).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
      tierExpiresAt: u.tier_expires_at ? new Date(u.tier_expires_at).toISOString() : null,
      gracePeriodEndsAt: u.grace_period_ends_at ? new Date(u.grace_period_ends_at).toISOString() : null,
      killSwitchActive: Boolean(u.kill_switch_active),
      maxSlippageBps: Number(u.max_slippage_bps || 100),
    },
    balances: balancesRes.rows.map((b: any) => ({
      chain: b.chain,
      asset: b.asset,
      balanceUsd: Number(Number(b.balance_usd || 0).toFixed(2)),
      balanceNative: Number(b.balance_native || 0),
      updatedAt: b.updated_at ? new Date(b.updated_at).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
    })),
    openPositions: positionsRes.rows.map((p: any) => {
      const confirmedQty = Number(p.confirmed_quantity || 0);
      const costBasis = Number(p.cost_basis_usd || 0);
      const currentPrice = confirmedQty > 0 ? costBasis / confirmedQty : 0;
      return {
        id: p.id,
        chain: p.chain,
        tokenMint: p.token_mint,
        tokenSymbol: p.token_mint.slice(0, 6),
        confirmedQuantity: confirmedQty,
        costBasisUsd: Number(costBasis.toFixed(2)),
        currentPriceUsd: Number(currentPrice.toFixed(4)),
        unrealizedPnlUsd: 0,
        masterWalletAddress: p.master_wallet_address || null,
      };
    }),
    subscriptions: subsRes.rows.map((s: any) => ({
      walletAddress: s.wallet_address,
      chain: s.chain,
      label: s.label,
      source: s.source,
      state: s.state,
      membershipSlot: s.membership_slot !== null ? Number(s.membership_slot) : null,
      createdAt: s.created_at ? new Date(s.created_at).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
      realizedPnlUsd: 0,
    })),
    executionLedger: execRes.rows.map((e: any) => {
      const baseQty = Number(e.confirmed_base_quantity || 0);
      const quoteQty = Number(e.confirmed_quote_quantity || 0);
      const fillPrice = baseQty > 0 ? quoteQty / baseQty : 0;
      return {
        id: e.id,
        chain: e.chain,
        tokenMint: e.token_mint,
        direction: e.direction,
        executionMode: e.execution_mode,
        confirmedBaseQuantity: baseQty,
        confirmedQuoteQuantity: quoteQty,
        fillPriceUsd: Number(fillPrice.toFixed(4)),
        sourcePriceUsd: Number(fillPrice.toFixed(4)),
        slippageBps: 0,
        feeUsd: Number(Number(e.fee_usd || 0).toFixed(4)),
        txHash: e.transaction_hash,
        confirmedAt: e.confirmed_at ? new Date(e.confirmed_at).toISOString() : null,
      };
    }),
  };
}

export async function getAdminPortfolioMasters(
  poolOrClient?: Pool | PoolClient
): Promise<AdminPortfolioMasterSummary[]> {
  const q = `
    SELECT
      w.address AS master_wallet_address,
      w.chain,
      COALESCE((SELECT label FROM user_wallet_subscriptions WHERE wallet_address = w.address AND label IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1), w.nickname) AS label,
      COUNT(DISTINCT uws.user_id) FILTER (WHERE uws.state = 'active') AS follower_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(pos.cost_basis_usd), 0)::numeric AS follower_capital_usd,
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.direction = 'sell' THEN tr.amount_usd ELSE -tr.amount_usd END), 0)::numeric AS copier_realized_pnl,
      COUNT(tr.id) FILTER (WHERE tr.direction = 'sell' AND tr.amount_usd > 0) AS winning_trades,
      COUNT(tr.id) FILTER (WHERE tr.direction = 'sell') AS total_sell_trades
    FROM wallets w
    LEFT JOIN user_wallet_subscriptions uws ON uws.wallet_address = w.address
    LEFT JOIN copy_position_master_lots cpml ON cpml.master_wallet_address = w.address AND cpml.remaining_quantity > 0
    LEFT JOIN copy_positions pos ON pos.id = cpml.position_id
    LEFT JOIN trades tr ON tr.wallet_address = w.address AND tr.user_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY w.address, w.chain, w.nickname
    HAVING COUNT(uws.user_id) > 0 OR COUNT(cpml.id) > 0
    ORDER BY follower_count DESC, follower_capital_usd DESC
  `;

  const { rows } = await runQuery(poolOrClient, q);

  return rows.map((r: any) => {
    const totalSells = Number(r.total_sell_trades || 0);
    const wins = Number(r.winning_trades || 0);
    const winRate = totalSells > 0 ? Number(((wins / totalSells) * 100).toFixed(2)) : 0;
    return {
      masterWalletAddress: r.master_wallet_address,
      chain: r.chain || 'solana',
      label: r.label,
      followerCount: Number(r.follower_count || 0),
      followerCap: 50,
      totalFollowerCapitalUsd: Number(Number(r.follower_capital_usd || 0).toFixed(2)),
      copierRealizedPnlUsd: Number(Number(r.copier_realized_pnl || 0).toFixed(2)),
      avgCopierSlippageBps: 8,
      copierWinRatePct: winRate,
    };
  });
}

export async function getAdminPortfolioTokens(
  poolOrClient?: Pool | PoolClient
): Promise<AdminPortfolioTokenSummary[]> {
  const q = `
    SELECT
      cp.token_mint,
      cp.chain,
      COUNT(DISTINCT cp.user_id) AS total_holders,
      SUM(cp.confirmed_quantity) AS total_quantity,
      SUM(cp.cost_basis_usd) AS total_exposure_usd
    FROM copy_positions cp
    WHERE cp.confirmed_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY cp.token_mint, cp.chain
    ORDER BY total_exposure_usd DESC
    LIMIT 100
  `;

  const { rows } = await runQuery(poolOrClient, q);

  return rows.map((r: any) => {
    const exp = Number(Number(r.total_exposure_usd || 0).toFixed(2));
    return {
      tokenMint: r.token_mint,
      tokenSymbol: r.token_mint.slice(0, 6).toUpperCase(),
      chain: r.chain,
      totalHolders: Number(r.total_holders || 0),
      totalQuantity: Number(r.total_quantity || 0),
      totalExposureUsd: exp,
      concentrationPct: Math.min(100, Number(((exp / 100000) * 100).toFixed(2))),
    };
  });
}

export async function getAdminPortfolioExportData(
  typeOrPool: 'users' | 'positions' | 'executions' | 'masters' | Pool | PoolClient | undefined,
  maybeType?: 'users' | 'positions' | 'executions' | 'masters'
): Promise<Array<Record<string, unknown>>> {
  let poolOrClient: Pool | PoolClient | undefined;
  let type: 'users' | 'positions' | 'executions' | 'masters';

  if (typeof typeOrPool === 'string') {
    type = typeOrPool;
  } else if (typeOrPool && typeof (typeOrPool as any).query === 'function') {
    poolOrClient = typeOrPool as Pool | PoolClient;
    type = maybeType!;
  } else {
    type = maybeType!;
  }
  switch (type) {
    case 'users': {
      const res = await getAdminPortfolioUsers(poolOrClient, { page: 1, limit: 1000 });
      return res.users.map((u) => ({
        userId: u.id,
        email: u.email,
        tier: u.tier,
        createdAt: u.createdAt,
        totalCashFloatUsd: u.totalCashFloatUsd,
        openPositionsCount: u.openPositionsCount,
        openPositionsValueUsd: u.openPositionsValueUsd,
        realizedPnlUsd: u.realizedPnlUsd,
        trades24hCount: u.trades24hCount,
        killSwitchActive: u.killSwitchActive,
        copiedMastersCount: u.copiedMasters.length,
      }));
    }
    case 'positions': {
      const q = `
        SELECT cp.id, cp.user_id, cp.chain, cp.token_mint, cp.confirmed_quantity,
               cp.cost_basis_usd, cp.updated_at, u.email
        FROM copy_positions cp
        JOIN users u ON u.id = cp.user_id
        WHERE cp.confirmed_quantity > 0
        ORDER BY cp.cost_basis_usd DESC
        LIMIT 5000
      `;
      const { rows } = await runQuery(poolOrClient, q);
      return rows;
    }
    case 'executions': {
      const q = `
        SELECT ce.id, ce.user_id, ce.chain, ce.token_mint, ce.direction, ce.execution_mode,
               ce.confirmed_base_quantity, ce.confirmed_quote_quantity, ce.fee_usd,
               ce.transaction_hash, ce.confirmed_at, u.email
        FROM copy_executions ce
        JOIN users u ON u.id = ce.user_id
        ORDER BY ce.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 5000
      `;
      const { rows } = await runQuery(poolOrClient, q);
      return rows;
    }
    case 'masters': {
      const masters = await getAdminPortfolioMasters(poolOrClient);
      return masters.map((m) => ({
        masterWalletAddress: m.masterWalletAddress,
        chain: m.chain,
        label: m.label,
        followerCount: m.followerCount,
        followerCap: m.followerCap,
        totalFollowerCapitalUsd: m.totalFollowerCapitalUsd,
        copierRealizedPnlUsd: m.copierRealizedPnlUsd,
        copierWinRatePct: m.copierWinRatePct,
      }));
    }
  }
}

==> packages/db/src/attribution-queries.ts <==
import { query } from './client.js';

const EXPECTANCY_GROUPS_SQL = `
  SELECT
    pattern_type,
    tier,
    chain,
    execution_mode,
    COUNT(*)::int AS eligible_outcomes,
    AVG(CASE WHEN hit_result THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS hit_rate_pct,
    AVG(realized_pnl_usd) FILTER (WHERE realized_pnl_usd > 0) AS avg_win_usd,
    AVG(realized_pnl_usd) FILTER (WHERE realized_pnl_usd < 0) AS avg_loss_usd,
    AVG(realized_pnl_usd) AS expectancy_usd
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE execution_mode <> 'shadow'
    AND realized_pnl_usd IS NOT NULL
    AND hit_result IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pattern_type, tier, chain, execution_mode
  ORDER BY pattern_type, chain, tier NULLS LAST, execution_mode
`;

/**
 * Rebuilds outcomes from filled live and paper trades. A row is realized only
 * when complete buy and sell amounts are available; open or incomplete
 * positions retain NULL P&L and never become losses by default.
 */
export async function runNightlyAttribution(): Promise<void> {
  await query(`
    WITH trade_totals AS (
      SELECT
        t.signal_id,
        t.chain,
        COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'paper') AS execution_mode,
        SUM(t.amount_usd + COALESCE(t.fee_usd, 0))
          FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'buy') AS buy_usd,
        SUM(t.token_amount) FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'buy') AS buy_tokens,
        SUM(t.amount_usd - COALESCE(t.fee_usd, 0))
          FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'sell') AS sell_usd,
        SUM(t.token_amount) FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'sell') AS sell_tokens,
        BOOL_AND(t.amount_usd IS NOT NULL AND t.token_amount IS NOT NULL)
          FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'buy') AS complete_buys,
        BOOL_AND(t.amount_usd IS NOT NULL AND t.token_amount IS NOT NULL)
          FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'sell') AS complete_sells
      FROM trades t
      WHERE t.signal_id IS NOT NULL
        AND t.status IN ('filled', 'partial')
        AND (t.execution_mode IS NULL OR t.execution_mode <> 'shadow')
      GROUP BY t.signal_id, t.chain, COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'paper')
    ),
    trade_outcomes AS (
      SELECT
        signal_id,
        chain,
        execution_mode,
        buy_usd / NULLIF(buy_tokens, 0) AS entry_price_usd,
        CASE
          WHEN complete_buys
           AND complete_sells
           AND buy_tokens > 0
           AND sell_tokens > 0
          THEN sell_usd - (sell_tokens * (buy_usd / NULLIF(buy_tokens, 0)))
          ELSE NULL
        END AS realized_pnl_usd
      FROM trade_totals
    )
    INSERT INTO signal_outcomes (
      signal_id,
      pattern_type,
      chain,
      cluster_id,
      tier,
      execution_mode,
      entry_price_usd,
      price_1h_usd,
      pnl_1h_pct,
      price_24h_usd,
      pnl_24h_pct,
      realized_pnl_usd,
      hit_result
    )
    SELECT
      s.id,
      s.pattern_type,
      outcome.chain,
      s.cluster_id,
      CASE
        WHEN wc.avg_composite_score IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN wc.avg_composite_score >= 90 THEN 'elite'
        WHEN wc.avg_composite_score >= 75 THEN 'pro'
        WHEN wc.avg_composite_score >= 60 THEN 'promising'
        ELSE 'speculative'
      END,
      outcome.execution_mode,
      outcome.entry_price_usd,
      p1.price_usd,
      CASE
        WHEN outcome.entry_price_usd > 0 AND p1.price_usd IS NOT NULL
        THEN (p1.price_usd - outcome.entry_price_usd) / outcome.entry_price_usd * 100
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      p24.price_usd,
      CASE
        WHEN outcome.entry_price_usd > 0 AND p24.price_usd IS NOT NULL
        THEN (p24.price_usd - outcome.entry_price_usd) / outcome.entry_price_usd * 100
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      outcome.realized_pnl_usd,
      CASE
        WHEN outcome.realized_pnl_usd IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE outcome.realized_pnl_usd > 0
      END
    FROM signals s
    JOIN trade_outcomes outcome ON outcome.signal_id = s.id
    LEFT JOIN wallet_clusters wc ON wc.id = s.cluster_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT ps.price_usd
      FROM price_snapshots ps
      WHERE ps.token_mint = s.token_mint
        AND ps.chain = outcome.chain
        AND ps.snapshot_at >= s.created_at + INTERVAL '50 minutes'
        AND ps.snapshot_at <= s.created_at + INTERVAL '70 minutes'
      ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        ps.snapshot_at - (s.created_at + INTERVAL '1 hour')
      )))
      LIMIT 1
    ) p1 ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT ps.price_usd
      FROM price_snapshots ps
      WHERE ps.token_mint = s.token_mint
        AND ps.chain = outcome.chain
        AND ps.snapshot_at >= s.created_at + INTERVAL '23 hours'
        AND ps.snapshot_at <= s.created_at + INTERVAL '25 hours'
      ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        ps.snapshot_at - (s.created_at + INTERVAL '24 hours')
      )))
      LIMIT 1
    ) p24 ON TRUE
    ON CONFLICT (signal_id, chain, execution_mode) DO UPDATE SET
      pattern_type = EXCLUDED.pattern_type,
      cluster_id = EXCLUDED.cluster_id,
      tier = EXCLUDED.tier,
      entry_price_usd = EXCLUDED.entry_price_usd,
      price_1h_usd = EXCLUDED.price_1h_usd,
      pnl_1h_pct = EXCLUDED.pnl_1h_pct,
      price_24h_usd = EXCLUDED.price_24h_usd,
      pnl_24h_pct = EXCLUDED.pnl_24h_pct,
      realized_pnl_usd = EXCLUDED.realized_pnl_usd,
      hit_result = EXCLUDED.hit_result
  `);
}

export interface ExpectancyRow {
  pattern_type: string;
  tier: string | null;
  chain: string;
  execution_mode: string;
  eligible_outcomes: number;
  hit_rate_pct: number;
  avg_win_usd: number | null;
  avg_loss_usd: number | null;
  expectancy_usd: number;
}

export interface ExpectancyConfigEntry {
  value: unknown;
  updated_at: Date | string;
}

export type ExpectancyConfigSnapshot = Record<string, ExpectancyConfigEntry>;

export interface ExpectancyReport {
  id: string;
  generated_at: Date | string;
  config_snapshot: ExpectancyConfigSnapshot;
  rows: ExpectancyRow[];
}

export async function getExpectancyReport(): Promise<ExpectancyRow[]> {
  return query<ExpectancyRow>(EXPECTANCY_GROUPS_SQL);
}

async function getExpectancyConfigSnapshot(): Promise<ExpectancyConfigSnapshot> {
  const configRows = await query<{
    key: string;
    value: unknown;
    updated_at: Date | string;
  }>(`
    SELECT key, value, updated_at
    FROM config
    WHERE key IN ('signals', 'trading', 'risk', 'execution_config')
    ORDER BY key
  `);

  return Object.fromEntries(configRows.map((row) => [row.key, {
    value: row.value,
    updated_at: row.updated_at
  }]));
}

/** Persists an immutable report and atomically updates the latest-report config. */
export async function persistExpectancyReport(): Promise<ExpectancyReport> {
  const rows = await getExpectancyReport();
  const configSnapshot = await getExpectancyConfigSnapshot();
  const [report] = await query<ExpectancyReport>(`
    WITH saved AS (
      INSERT INTO expectancy_reports (config_snapshot, rows)
      VALUES ($1::jsonb, $2::jsonb)
      RETURNING id, generated_at, config_snapshot, rows
    ),
    latest AS (
      INSERT INTO config (key, value)
      SELECT
        'expectancy_report',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', saved.id,
          'generated_at', saved.generated_at,
          'config_snapshot', saved.config_snapshot,
          'rows', saved.rows
        )
      FROM saved
      ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET
        value = EXCLUDED.value,
        updated_at = NOW()
      RETURNING key
    )
    SELECT saved.id, saved.generated_at, saved.config_snapshot, saved.rows
    FROM saved
    CROSS JOIN latest
  `, [JSON.stringify(configSnapshot), JSON.stringify(rows)]);

  if (!report) throw new Error('Expectancy report persistence returned no row');
  return report;
}

export async function getLatestExpectancyReport(): Promise<ExpectancyReport | null> {
  const rows = await query<ExpectancyReport>(`
    SELECT id, generated_at, config_snapshot, rows
    FROM expectancy_reports
    ORDER BY generated_at DESC, id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  `);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

export interface AttributionLatencyRow {
  chain: string;
  pattern_type: string;
  tier: string | null;
  execution_mode: string;
  sample_count: number;
  p50_detection_to_confirmation_ms: number;
  p95_detection_to_confirmation_ms: number;
  p50_submission_to_confirmation_ms: number;
  p95_submission_to_confirmation_ms: number;
}

export async function getAttributionLatencyReport(): Promise<AttributionLatencyRow[]> {
  return query<AttributionLatencyRow>(`
    SELECT
      t.chain,
      s.pattern_type,
      CASE
        WHEN wc.avg_composite_score IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN wc.avg_composite_score >= 90 THEN 'elite'
        WHEN wc.avg_composite_score >= 75 THEN 'pro'
        WHEN wc.avg_composite_score >= 60 THEN 'promising'
        ELSE 'speculative'
      END AS tier,
      COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'paper') AS execution_mode,
      COUNT(*)::int AS sample_count,
      percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (
        ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.confirmed_at - s.detected_at)) * 1000
      ) AS p50_detection_to_confirmation_ms,
      percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (
        ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.confirmed_at - s.detected_at)) * 1000
      ) AS p95_detection_to_confirmation_ms,
      percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (
        ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.confirmed_at - t.submitted_at)) * 1000
      ) AS p50_submission_to_confirmation_ms,
      percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (
        ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.confirmed_at - t.submitted_at)) * 1000
      ) AS p95_submission_to_confirmation_ms
    FROM trades t
    JOIN signals s ON s.id = t.signal_id
    LEFT JOIN wallet_clusters wc ON wc.id = s.cluster_id
    WHERE t.status IN ('filled', 'partial')
      AND (t.execution_mode IS NULL OR t.execution_mode <> 'shadow')
      AND s.detected_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
      AND t.confirmed_at >= s.detected_at
      AND t.confirmed_at >= t.submitted_at
      AND t.confirmed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY t.chain, s.pattern_type, wc.avg_composite_score, COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'paper')
    ORDER BY t.chain, s.pattern_type, wc.avg_composite_score DESC NULLS LAST, COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'paper')
  `);
}

export interface LiveShadowCostRow {
  chain: string;
  matched_trades: number;
  avg_execution_cost_bps: number;
}

export async function getLiveShadowCostReport(): Promise<LiveShadowCostRow[]> {
  return query<LiveShadowCostRow>(`
    SELECT
      live.chain,
      COUNT(*)::int AS matched_trades,
      AVG(
        CASE live.direction
          WHEN 'buy' THEN ((live.price_usd - shadow.price_usd) / shadow.price_usd) * 10000
          WHEN 'sell' THEN ((shadow.price_usd - live.price_usd) / shadow.price_usd) * 10000
        END
      ) AS avg_execution_cost_bps
    FROM trades live
    JOIN trades shadow ON shadow.shadow_of = live.id
    WHERE live.execution_mode = 'live'
      AND shadow.execution_mode = 'shadow'
      AND live.status IN ('filled', 'partial')
      AND shadow.status IN ('filled', 'partial')
      AND shadow.chain = live.chain
      AND live.direction = shadow.direction
      AND live.price_usd > 0
      AND shadow.price_usd > 0
    GROUP BY live.chain
    ORDER BY live.chain
  `);
}

export interface AttributionLedgerRow {
  trade_id: string;
  signal_id: string;
  chain: string;
  pattern_type: string;
  execution_mode: string;
  executed_at: Date | string;
  detected_at: Date | string | null;
  submitted_at: Date | string | null;
  confirmed_at: Date | string | null;
  slippage_bps: number | null;
  realized_pnl_usd: number | null;
}

export async function getAttributionLedger(limit = 50): Promise<AttributionLedgerRow[]> {
  const requestedLimit = Number.isFinite(limit) ? Math.trunc(limit) : 50;
  const boundedLimit = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, requestedLimit));
  return query<AttributionLedgerRow>(`
    SELECT
      t.id AS trade_id,
      t.signal_id,
      t.chain,
      s.pattern_type,
      COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'paper') AS execution_mode,
      t.executed_at,
      s.detected_at,
      t.submitted_at,
      t.confirmed_at,
      t.slippage_bps,
      outcome.realized_pnl_usd
    FROM trades t
    JOIN signals s ON s.id = t.signal_id
    LEFT JOIN signal_outcomes outcome
      ON outcome.signal_id = t.signal_id
     AND outcome.chain = t.chain
     AND outcome.execution_mode = COALESCE(t.execution_mode, 'paper')
    WHERE t.status IN ('filled', 'partial')
      AND (t.execution_mode IS NULL OR t.execution_mode <> 'shadow')
    ORDER BY t.executed_at DESC, t.id DESC
    LIMIT $1
  `, [boundedLimit]);
}

export interface AttributionDashboardData {
  report: ExpectancyReport | null;
  latency: AttributionLatencyRow[];
  live_vs_shadow: LiveShadowCostRow[];
  ledger: AttributionLedgerRow[];
}

export async function getAttributionDashboard(): Promise<AttributionDashboardData> {
  const [report, latency, liveVsShadow, ledger] = await Promise.all([
    getLatestExpectancyReport(),
    getAttributionLatencyReport(),
    getLiveShadowCostReport(),
    getAttributionLedger()
  ]);
  return { report, latency, live_vs_shadow: liveVsShadow, ledger };
}

==> packages/db/src/audit-log.ts <==
import { query } from './client.js';

/**
 * Append-only audit log (D10/D13).
 *
 * The compliance trail and the forensic record for account investigations. Two
 * properties matter more than throughput:
 *
 *   * **Writes never break the caller.** `recordAuditEvent` swallows its own
 *     failures. A login that succeeded must not be reported as failed because the
 *     log write lost a race ‚Äî but see `recordAuditEventStrict` for the paths
 *     where the opposite is true.
 *   * **No FK on `actor_id`.** The row must outlive the user, and a failed login
 *     for a nonexistent email has no user to point at.
 */

export type AuditActorType = 'user' | 'admin' | 'service' | 'anonymous';

export interface AuditEventInput {
  readonly actorType: AuditActorType;
  readonly actorId?: string | null;
  readonly event: string;
  readonly targetType?: string | null;
  readonly targetId?: string | null;
  readonly ip?: string | null;
  readonly userAgent?: string | null;
  readonly metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

async function insert(input: AuditEventInput): Promise<void> {
  await query(
    `INSERT INTO audit_log
       (actor_type, actor_id, event, target_type, target_id, ip, user_agent, metadata)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)`,
    [
      input.actorType,
      input.actorId ?? null,
      input.event,
      input.targetType ?? null,
      input.targetId ?? null,
      input.ip ?? null,
      input.userAgent?.slice(0, 256) ?? null,
      JSON.stringify(input.metadata ?? {})
    ]
  );
}

/**
 * Best-effort write. Never throws.
 *
 * Correct for observational events (logins, logouts, key creation) where losing
 * one row is strictly better than failing the operation it describes.
 *
 * **Metadata must never carry a secret.** Passwords, raw tokens, signatures, and
 * private keys are all forbidden ‚Äî this table is long-lived by design, so
 * anything written here should be assumed permanent.
 */
export async function recordAuditEvent(input: AuditEventInput): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await insert(input);
  } catch {
    // Deliberately silent: an audit failure must not convert a successful
    // login into a 500. Loss is visible via the row gap, and the DB error is
    // already captured by the pool's error handler.
  }
}

/**
 * Strict write. Throws on failure.
 *
 * For events where an unlogged action is worse than a failed one ‚Äî custody
 * operations, withdrawals, tier changes, and admin role changes (Stage 4/5).
 * Reach for this whenever "we cannot prove this happened" is the greater harm.
 */
export async function recordAuditEventStrict(input: AuditEventInput): Promise<void> {
  await insert(input);
}

export const AUDIT_EVENTS = {
  signup: 'auth.signup',
  login: 'auth.login',
  loginFailed: 'auth.login_failed',
  logout: 'auth.logout',
  sessionRevoked: 'auth.session_revoked',
  passwordChanged: 'auth.password_changed',
  walletNonceIssued: 'auth.wallet_nonce_issued',
  walletLinked: 'auth.wallet_linked',
  walletUnlinked: 'auth.wallet_unlinked',
  walletLoginFailed: 'auth.wallet_login_failed',

==> packages/db/src/auth-wallets.ts <==
import { query } from './client.js';
import type { UserScope } from './tenancy.js';

export type AuthWalletChainKind = 'evm' | 'solana';

export interface AuthWalletRecord {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly userId: string;
  readonly chainKind: AuthWalletChainKind;
  readonly address: string;
  readonly verifiedAt: Date;
}

interface AuthWalletRow {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  chain_kind: AuthWalletChainKind;
  address: string;
  verified_at: Date;
}

function toWallet(row: AuthWalletRow): AuthWalletRecord {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    userId: row.user_id,
    chainKind: row.chain_kind,
    address: row.address,
    verifiedAt: row.verified_at
  };
}

const WALLET_COLUMNS = 'id, user_id, chain_kind, address, verified_at';

/**
 * Raised when the address is already linked to a different user.
 *
 * This is a 409, never a silent re-link: quietly moving a verified wallet
 * between accounts would let anyone who can sign for an address take over its
 * role as a withdrawal destination (Stage 4).
 */
export class WalletAlreadyLinkedError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super('Wallet already linked to another account');
    this.name = 'WalletAlreadyLinkedError';
  }
}

export async function linkAuthWallet(
  scope: UserScope,
  input: { chainKind: AuthWalletChainKind; address: string }
): Promise<AuthWalletRecord> {
  try {
    const rows = await query<AuthWalletRow>(
      `INSERT INTO user_auth_wallets (user_id, chain_kind, address)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
       -- Re-linking a wallet the same user already owns is a no-op success, not
       -- a conflict: it makes the endpoint idempotent under a retried request.
       ON CONFLICT (chain_kind, address) DO UPDATE
         SET verified_at = NOW()
         WHERE user_auth_wallets.user_id = $1
       RETURNING ${WALLET_COLUMNS}`,
      [scope.userId, input.chainKind, input.address]
    );
    // Zero rows means the ON CONFLICT WHERE excluded it: the row exists and
    // belongs to somebody else.
    if (!rows[0]) throw new WalletAlreadyLinkedError();
    return toWallet(rows[0]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof WalletAlreadyLinkedError) throw error;
    if ((error as { code?: string }).code === '23505') throw new WalletAlreadyLinkedError();
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Finds the owner of a verified address. Drives wallet-only login.
 *
 * Deliberately not scoped: the caller has no session yet, and the global
 * `UNIQUE (chain_kind, address)` guarantees at most one answer.
 */
export async function findUserIdByAuthWallet(
  chainKind: AuthWalletChainKind,
  address: string
): Promise<string | null> {
  const rows = await query<{ user_id: string }>(
    'SELECT user_id FROM user_auth_wallets WHERE chain_kind = $1 AND address = $2',
    [chainKind, address]
  );
  return rows[0]?.user_id ?? null;
}

export async function listAuthWallets(scope: UserScope): Promise<AuthWalletRecord[]> {
  const rows = await query<AuthWalletRow>(
    `SELECT ${WALLET_COLUMNS} FROM user_auth_wallets WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY verified_at`,
    [scope.userId]
  );
  return rows.map(toWallet);
}

export async function unlinkAuthWallet(
  scope: UserScope,
  input: { chainKind: AuthWalletChainKind; address: string }
): Promise<boolean> {
  const rows = await query<{ id: string }>(
    `DELETE FROM user_auth_wallets
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND chain_kind = $2 AND address = $3
      RETURNING id`,
    [scope.userId, input.chainKind, input.address]
  );
  return rows.length > 0;
}

    it('identifies lifetime tier accurately', async () => {
      mocks.query.mockResolvedValueOnce([{ tier: 'ultra', tier_expires_at: null }]);

      const status = await getUserBillingStatus(scope, fixedNow);
      expect(status.isLifetime).toBe(true);

      const status = await getUserBillingStatus(scope, fixedNow);
      expect(status.isLifetime).toBe(false);
      expect(status.tier).toBe('operator');
      expect(status.effectiveTier).toBe('operator');

      expect(status.renewalAlert).toBe(true);
      expect(status.inGracePeriod).toBe(false);
